jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Applied ML
jobs.description: ### **About Circuit** Circuit is the AI execution layer for the physical economy. Industrial and manufacturing enterprises run on expertise: the hard\-won knowledge of how complex products are engineered, configured, sold, and supported. That expertise is scarce, slow to transfer, and walking out the door as a generation of experts retires. It lives in PDFs, spreadsheets, and the heads of a few people, and the hardest technical decisions wait on whoever happens to know. Circuit puts expert judgment in everyone's hands. We capture how the best people make critical technical decisions and turn it into agents that do the judgment\-heavy work, so anyone, regardless of skill level, can make the right call, from quote to install and support, with the accuracy these environments demand. Circuit is built by operators. Our leadership team has built and scaled real industrial companies, and we are already live in production with category\-leading manufacturers. We are not bolting AI onto an old playbook. We are building the layer that runs the last mile of how the physical economy executes. ### **The Role** As a Staff Engineer, Applied ML at Circuit, you’ll join Product Engineering and build the machine learning capabilities that power our product. You’ll work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), Product Engineers, and directly with design customers to understand real\-world challenges and turn them into robust, scalable solutions. A core part of your role is recognizing where a customer need points to a broader product capability, then building it to work across customers and use cases. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on solving current product and customer problems. You’ll use advances in ML where they help, exercise judgment about what is ready to ship, and own solutions end to end, with attention to accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. Success means delivering capabilities that make Circuit’s product more useful, reliable, and broadly applicable. You’ll draw primarily on LLMs, alongside traditional NNs and statistical models, choosing and combining approaches based on the problem. Your work will span understanding customer use cases and how users interact with the product, data and process modeling, understanding what exists today and how to build on it, evaluation, production implementation, and, where it pays off, model training and fine\-tuning. Most importantly, you’ll work end to end with our design customers, building solutions for them. Beyond individual features, you’ll help build shared capabilities such as Circuit’s evaluation framework, improving how we measure quality and catch regressions across the product. As priorities evolve, you’ll apply your engineering judgment wherever it can make the greatest impact. Product Engineering builds the core platform and works directly with customers and design partners. Our FDE teams own solutions architecture and technical demonstrations. You’ll work alongside them on what gets built, and partner with Core ML engineers when a customer problem calls for deeper work on our document models or the agent loop. Your teammates range from full\-stack engineers to applied ML researchers. **This position is based in Austin, TX, onsite 3 days/week.** ### **What Is in Production Today** Our core product includes a long\-running agent loop written in Go. Frontier model APIs drive the loop, while specialized tools handle retrieval, extraction, and agent execution. These tools let us solve industrial problems that general\-purpose agent harnesses struggle with. We use a combination of open\-source and internally fine\-tuned models, particularly vision\-language models (VLMs), hosted on KServe. Our customer data includes technical documents, high\-resolution blueprints, raster images, vector geometry, CAD, and structured data. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work directly with FDEs and design\-customers end to end, to build solutions on top of Circuit that solve their challenges * Generalize and package our solutions and methods, and empower FDEs to efficiently deploy them across customers. * Improve our underlying models, harnesses, eval methodologies and more to power our solutions and help solve customer challenges. * Debug production systems including edge cases and failure modes in ML pipelines and retrieval systems. * Build and maintain evaluation systems, including datasets, scoring approaches, and repeatable testing to detect regressions. ### **Examples of Work You Could Own** * **Build a solution with a design customer.** Work with an FDE and a design customer to turn a judgment\-heavy workflow, from quoting a configured product to troubleshooting in the field, into an agent that gets it right. * **Model the customer’s data.** Turn a customer’s spreadsheets, PDFs, and product rules into a data and process model the agent can reason over. * **Generalize it.** Package a solution built for one customer so FDEs can deploy it for the next custome ne customer needs into something every customer can use. Ideally, you have deep expertise and strong technical opinions in at least one of these areas: * Retrieval systems, including embeddings and ranking * Model training and fine\-tuning for production, across LLMs, deep learning, or traditional ML * Evaluation design and dataset curation from messy, real\-world customer data * Debugging production ML systems with AI observability tools You do not need to be an expert in every area. Strong software engineering fundamentals, good judgment with customers, and the ability to turn one customer’s solution into a product capability matter more than familiarity with our exact stack. Beyond that, we look for: * Strong software engineering background, with a track record of owning and shipping production systems end to end. * Deep experience with data structures and data modeling across relational and graph databases, with strong, well\-reasoned opinions on schema design, normalization, and indexing strategy. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, RAG systems, and agent harnesses, with a solid grounding in how these systems work, fail, and need to be evaluated. * Experience working directly with customers or field teams, turning what you learn into what gets built. * A track record of taking a solution built for one customer and generalizing it so others can deploy it. * Built and maintained features across a multi\-service architecture, with strong proficiency in languages like Python and Go. * Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools. You write effective prompts, iterate when output is wrong, and reliably tell working code from code that only looks right. * Bonus: Vision and multimodal models, especially on technical documents (PDFs, CAD) with text, vector geometry, and raster content. * Bonus: Construction, civil engineering, or other industrial domains. * Bonus: Open\-source models (Qwen, DeepSeek, or similar), and serving them with vLLM, KServe, or similar. * Bonus: Hands\-on PyTorch (or similar) for training and fine\-tuning models. ### **Human Skills** * Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering working systems in production. * Strong product judgment, with an understanding of how system behavior impacts user experience and trust. * Rigorous reviewer of agent instructions, skills, and documentation, ensuring they’re clear, unambiguous, and reliable for agents to act on. * Curiosity about how systems behave in practice and how customers use them. * Bias toward shipping. You take ambiguous problems and drive them to working solutions without needing the path fully defined for you. * Judgment about what is ready to ship, and the willingness to push back to keep the work grounded in customer outcomes. * Clear communicator. You explain ML tradeoffs to FDEs and customers in plain terms, and share progress early. * Critical evaluation of AI output. You spot hallucinated APIs, incorrect logic, and subtle bugs before they reach production. * Systems thinking, including attention to correctness and failure modes. * Low ego, with a focus on team outcomes. ### **What We Offer** * High\-caliber team of seasoned manufacturing and AI leaders * Help create a category\-defining platform transforming how manufacturers sell, support, and innovate * Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and employer\-paid benefits * Flexible PTO and access to the latest AI tools * A values\-driven culture that rewards ownership, curiosity and velocity ### **Who Should Apply** If you like working directly with customers, turning a judgment\-heavy workflow into an agent that gets it right, and then making that solution work for the next customer without starting over, we want to talk. ### **Equal\-Opportunity Employer** We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We are a high\-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. **Secure Issuance (SI):** Secure Issuance, part of HID Global, offers the world’s broadest and most sophisticated portfolio of card printers, laser engravers, encoders and software. For more than 25 years, organizations across a variety of industries — from enterprise corporations and government agencies to financial institutions and universities — have relied on HID Global Secure Issuance for the custom personalization and issuance of secure identity credentials and financial cards. With a history of pioneering patented technologies and expertise, business integrity and long\-standing customer confidence, HID Global is a global leader in secure card issuance innovation. **As and define product requirements. * Assisting in product design and architecture development. * Designing, developing, and maintaining platform software solutions that satisfy documented requirements. implementation of security protocols and secure implementation of cryptographic techniques, and the documentation of the security aspects of system design and implementation is highly desired * Proven jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud & Platform Security
jobs.description: **Who we are** Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress. Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that. Atoms builds Physical AI— real\-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive. This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale. We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life. If you want to work on hard problems with real\-world impact, join us. **What you'll do** As a Senior Software Engineer focused on Cloud \& Platform Security, you'll work directly with our Infrastructure team to secure the systems that manage and control our fleet. Rather than duplicating the team's existing cloud and Kubernetes ownership, you'll bring deep security expertise across identity, secrets, network segmentation, and the fleet\-management and remote\-vehicle\-control APIs that represent some of the highest\-impact systems in our environment. * Design and enforce least\-privilege access across cloud environments, with a focus on service identities and other non\-human access. * Strengthen secrets and credential management using Vault, cloud KMS, or equivalent systems. * Threat model and review fleet telemetry, dispatch, and remote\-vehicle\-control APIs, including authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and replay protection. * Design and improve network segmentation to isolate fleet\-management, dispatch, and remote\-control systems from corporate and consumer\-facing environments. * Partner with Infrastructure engineers during architecture and design reviews to identify security requirements before services reach production. * Review and improve Kubernetes security controls, including RBAC, network policies, and pod security standards, while partnering with the Infrastructure team that owns the platform. **What we're looking for** We're looking for a hands\-on security engineer who can work as an embedded partner to an experienced Infrastructure team. You should be comfortable going deep on cloud and platform security, influencing technical decisions, and helping engineers build secure systems without operating as a gatekeeper.. **Basic qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or platform security. * Hands\-on experience working with production Kubernetes environments. * Strong understanding of API security, including OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, authentication, and authorization design. * Experience designing or reviewing both coarse\-grained and fine\-grained authorization models. * Experience with secrets\-management systems such as HashiCorp Vault, cloud KMS, or equivalent technologies. * Experience managing or securing non\-human identities and service\-to\-service access. * Strong understanding of network segmentation and access boundaries in cloud environments. * Demonstrated ability to work closely with infrastructure and software engineering teams and influence security decisions through collaboration. **Nice to have** * Experience securing real\-time or low\-latency control\-plane systems. * Familiarity with service mesh security and workload\-to\-workload mTLS using Istio or similar technologies. **Why join us** At Atoms, you'll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what's known and building what doesn't yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it's grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow. **What else you need to know** This role is based in our San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change \- we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That's why all of our office\-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The base salary range for this role is **$167,000 \- $230,000 per year.** Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance\-based bonus. **Benefits Summary (USA Full\-Time Exempt Employees):** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options). * Company\-paid life and disability insurance (short\- and long\-term). * Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity. * Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children. * Pet insurance discount. * 401(k). * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter) * Time Off policies: * + Discretionary vacation days + 8 paid holidays per year + Paid sick time + Paid Bereavement leave + Paid Parental Leave Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion. Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis. **Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?** *\#LI\-Onsite*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **This is Adyen** Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for global customers like Meta, Uber, H\&M, and Microsoft, making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. We create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by a culture that encourages ownership and provides the support to truly own your career. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team, delivering innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. **The Opportunity** Adyen is building a **top\-tier AI engineering team in San Francisco** to drive our next chapter of innovation using AI globally across the entire company. This is a **highly technical, hands\-on role** focused on the **exploration and application of cutting\-edge AI research** within the financial technology sector. As a **Member of Technical Staff**, you will operate with a **high degree of autonomy and responsibility**, delivering **strategic, high\-impact outcomes** that bridge the gap between advanced AI research and production\-grade applications at a global scale, potentially impacting trillions of dollars in transactions annually. **What You'll Do:** * **Innovate and Deploy: Drive the execution of Adyen's AI strategy**, focusing on the **practical application of Generative AI (GenAI) and other AI methodologies in finance**. This includes contributing to Adyen's efforts in key research areas such as **AI agents for data analysis and operational workflows**, **human\-in\-the\-loop for integrity risk**, and **development of foundation models**. For instance, you might contribute to initiatives like the Data Agent Benchmark for Multi\-step Reasoning (DABStep), which evaluates AI agents on real\-world data analysis tasks, including those from the financial sector. * **Build Production\-grade Applications: Bridge the gap between cutting\-edge AI research and production** by implementing research papers into robust, scalable, and production\-ready code. Reduce complexity and dependencies across teams by championing engineering, scientific alignment and setting high quality standards. * **Optimize and Scale: Contribute to defining the long\-term vision for AI at Adyen**, specifically how AI will interact with humans and finance, including consumers, merchants, and financial institutions. This also includes understanding regulation and advocating for safe innovation in the field. * **Think Outside the Box: Drive innovation by challenging the status quo**, introducing transformative ideas and implementing creative solutions to solve real\-world problems. Carry out **flexible, value\-driven assignments**, proactively unblocking teams to maximize organizational impact and drive strategic initiatives. * **Force Multiplier: Provide mentorship and horizontal sponsorship across the organization**, fostering collaboration to share knowledge and best practices, and cultivating a culture of continuous improvement. This includes deeply engaging them in problem\-solving processes and guiding them through execution, fostering their growth through hands\-on involvement. * **Team Player: Actively pair with other engineering teams to solve deep\-rooted technical challenges** and be fully capable of being **hands\-on with the code**, whether creating proof\-of\-concepts or fixing critical performance issues. * **Learn and Lead: Connect with the broader AI community** (including startups, VCs, and AI labs) to stay informed of the latest advancements and identify potential partnership opportunities. **Who You Are:** * You are **consistently tuned into the scientific AI research community** and have a strong understanding of the latest SOTA advancements. * You have **significant experience and a strong understanding of Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs)**. * You demonstrate a **strong engineering mindset** with a track record of writing clean, efficient, and scalable **code suitable for production environments**. * You have demonstrated experience **taking cutting\-edge AI research papers and implementing them into production\-quality code**. * You demonstrate the ability to **think critically and deliver simple and elegant solutions to complex, cross\-team problems**, influencing strategic direction and fostering innovation across the organization. * You excel at **translating complex technical concepts into clear, understandable terms for diverse audiences**, including engineers, executives, and during public events. You adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences. * You thrive in leveraging empathy, influence, negotiation, relationship building, and conflict resolution to **foster strong, trust\-based collaborations**. **Nice to Haves:** * A strong **product sense** and the ability to identify impactful AI use cases. * Experience in **AI\-enabled fintech** companies. * Familiarity with **classical machine learning or** concepts. * Experience with external visibility activities such as **conferences and publications**. * Experience working with **on\-premise infrastructure**. **Why Adyen?** This is an exceptional opportunity to join a solid, established company with a startup mindset, characterized by small teams, direct communication, and work on important challenges. You'll have direct access to massive global datasets (e.g., payments, identity data) and the ability to see your team's work have an immediate impact at scale. We offer an environment of ownership and speed, where a focused research team can make a significant difference. You will be at the forefront of bridging AI and fintech, shaping how these two critical areas intersect. We are looking for individuals who are eager to stay connected to the edge of AI innovation while ensuring we deliver practical value to our global platform. You will also be a key member of the San Francisco AI research team, playing a crucial role in its growth and direction. While this is a San Francisco\-based role, we recognize that global mobility matters—especially for candidates navigating complex situations. Adyen has deep roots in Europe and a strong global presence, and we're open to future relocation conversations to our offices in Amsterdam or Madrid if that better supports your personal or professional goals in the future. Our aim is to build a lasting foundation for you at Adyen—starting in San Francisco, but with the flexibility to adapt as life evolves. *The annual base salary range for this role is $227,500 \- $401,000, plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click* *here**. This position is based out of the San Francisco office.* **Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments** Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them \- voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you're from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! **What's next?** Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don't be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. ### **San Francisco** Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. This role is based out of our San Francisco office. We are an office\-first company and value in\-person collaboration; we do not offer remote\-only roles.

pipelines and evaluation frameworks. * Design and implement new simulation environments and tasks to support training and deployment of control policies. * Develop, design, and test imitation learning methods * Collaborate with Robotics Software and AI engineering teams to develop policies which can be transferred to production **About You** ------------- * 3\+ years of experience developing and deploying learning\-from\-demonstration * Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. * Experience with modern learning\-from\-demonstration tools like DiffusionPolicy * Experience with robot data collection, training, and testing on hardware to perform manipulation tasks. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment to This role works at the intersection of engineering, AI, security, data, and customer success to translate complex requirements into scalable, production\-ready solutions. The ideal candidate brings 7\+ years of security experience and combines deep technical expertise in AI systems, model and data security, and cloud platforms with proven experience developing technical proposals and statements of work, leading cross\-team collaboration, and driving customer\-facing delivery at a principal level. ### **Responsibilities** Customer and Stakeholder Delivery * Serve as the technical engineer for deploying and operationalizing AI security solutions in customer or enterprise environments * Support development technical proposals, statements of work, and solution architectures that scope AI security engagements and support business development efforts * Translate business, operational, and AI security requirements into deployable architectures and implementation plans * Partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned to AI governance, compliance requirements, and long\-term platform strategy * Support engagement gateways, vector databases, and AI\-enabled security tooling * Build and configure cloud\-native data ingestion, normalization, and enrichment pipelines for AI telemetry, model activity logs, and prompt/response data * Integrate APIs, webhooks, message queues, and automation workflows across AI operations, identity, cloud, and application ecosystems supporting AI systems * Develop reusable deployment patterns, templates, and technical assets to accelerate future AI security implementations AI Security Operations * Operationalize security controls and guardrails for AI systems, including prompt injection defense, model access controls, data leakage prevention, and agentic workflow monitoring * Secure non\-human identities (NHI), including service accounts, API keys, tokens, and detection for AI systems * Help define data requirements, feedback loops, and operational guardrails needed to secure AI systems in production environments * Ensure deployed solutions are practical, measurable, and aligned to AI governance and risk objectives Automation and Reliability * Implement secure and governed automation for AI security monitoring, investigation, and response use cases across heterogeneous environments * Support resiliency, observability, performance, and scale requirements for deployed AI security solutions * Troubleshoot integration issues, deployment blockers, and production challenges in partnership with AI, platform, cloud, and security teams * Improve reliability and maintainability through documentation, testing, monitoring, and standardized engineering practices Cross\-Functional Leadership * Lead cross\-team collaboration across AI Engineering, Security Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure, Sales, and product or customer teams * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Mentor and develop engineers and consultants, contributing to best practices for AI secu njection, model theft, data or Bash * Familiarity with APIs and integration patterns including REST, webhooks, and event\-driven workflows * Working knowledge of AI concepts including LLMs, vector search, retrieval\-augmented jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Airbyte:** ------------------ We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700\+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work. We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building. We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you. **The Role** ============ Airbyte is incubating new product opportunities at the intersection of data, AI, and developer infrastructure. Our small team builds tooling and infrastructure for data practitioners and software engineers, leveraging Airbyte's foundation in enterprise connectivity. This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We're looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands\-on with AI applications or infrastructure. You'll own technical explorations, build prototypes, and take promising ideas through to production. We're still early. Some of our work extends existing products, while other projects begin as hypotheses that need validation. There's significant room to influence technical direction, challenge assumptions, and help shape what we build next. **What You'll Work On** ======================= * **Airbyte MCP**: Build infrastructure that lets AI agents configure Airbyte, troubleshoot syncs, and access data directly from connected sources and warehouses. Design reliable, secure, and observable interfaces across the connector ecosystem. * **Semantic Search \& Retrieval**: Build and operate search infrastructure for high\-quality retrieval over enterprise data. Improve relevance, latency, and reliability in production. * **Semantic Models**: Develop systems for defining and maintaining semantic models over enterprise data. Help AI applications use consistent business definitions and produce answers that can be verified against underlying data. * **SaaS Sandbox**: Build realistic, stateful replicas of SaaS systems for developing and testing agents. Reproduce API behavior, failures, and state changes so workflows can be evaluated without using production accounts. **What You'll Do** ================== **Explore New Product Opportunities** ------------------------------------- * Turn product hypotheses into focused technical experiments. Build prototypes that test feasibility and expose important constraints. * Work directly with customers, Product, Design, and customer\-facing teams to understand real\-world problems and incorporate feedback into technical decisions. * Evaluate competing technical approaches and use what you learn to influence product direction. **Build Production\-Grade Infrastructure** ------------------------------------------ * Design and implement backend systems, APIs, and infrastructure for AI, data, and developer products. * Build reliable, observable systems with clear failure handling, debugging, and operational safeguards. * Take promising prototypes into production and improve them based on usage, incidents, and customer feedback. **Lead Technical Direction** ---------------------------- * Own architecture and execution across technical design, implementation, rollout, and iteration. * Lead technical decisions that span teams. Align interfaces and dependencies, and influence architecture beyond your immediate projects. * Communicate priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly, and follow through on commitments. **What You'll Need** ==================== You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has shipped AI\-powered products. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems. * Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing distributed systems. * Experience building complex systems involving APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency, queues, state, retries, or distributed execution. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping AI\-powered products using LLMs, agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, or similar technologies. * Experience with orchestration systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or infrastructure products. * Strong system design skills and the ability to reason about reliability, scale, observability, and failure modes. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction across teams and influence architectural and engineering decisions. * Ability to move quickly from prototype to production without sacrificing engineering quality. * Strong product instincts and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0\-to\-1 environments. * Exceptional written communication skills. * A strong bias toward ownership and shipping. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience building and operating AI agents in production, including debugging, observability, and evaluation. * Experience building agent infrastructure, agent platforms, or evaluation systems. * Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, search infrastructure, or semantic models. * Experience building developer tools, platform infrastructure, or integrations with third\-party SaaS APIs. * Experience with data infrastructure such as Kafka, Iceberg, Postgres, Spark, or modern data warehouses. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Success is not measured by the number of prototypes we build. It is measured by whether we turn promising ideas into products customers use and infrastructure they can depend on. You'll help us: * Take new ideas from prototype to production and improve them through customer feedback and real\-world usage. * Build reliable, observable systems that are easier to operate, debug, and improve over time. * Use technical experiments and engineering judgment to make better product and architecture decisions. * Lead technical decisions that make systems simpler, more reliable, and easier for other teams to build on. **Location** ============ * San Francisco, CA — onsite 4 days/week **Why You'll Love Working at Airbyte:** --------------------------------------- At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market\-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include: * Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually * 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents * 401(k) retirement plan * Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement * Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement * Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office * A collaborative, in\-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements! We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered. Airbyte is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, familial status, domestic violence victim status, veteran or military status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Airbyte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodations due to a disability. Compensation Range: $250K \- $280K

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description: Our client, an innovative Healthtech company, is hiring a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join their team in California. The successful candidate will design, build and own the test automation architecture, develop scalable automation frameworks and embed reliable testing into CI/CD pipelines to ensure new features are secure, dependable and ready for release. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain automation frameworks for UI, API, integration and Model Context Protocol (MCP) testing. * Embed automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, incorporating quality gates, parallel execution, clear reporting and monitoring for unreliable tests. * Automate key user journeys, including registration, identity verification, consent management, health record retrieval and data delivery. * Maintain regression suites, release smoke tests and automated checks of critical production workflows. * Create synthetic patient data, sample healthcare records and mock external services to support reliable testing. * Work closely with Product and Engineering to define requirements, refine acceptance criteria and ensure features can be tested effectively. * Validate authentication, authorisation, consent revocation, access controls and audit trail accuracy. * Build automated evaluations for AI features, checking accuracy against source records, identifying hallucinations and detecting regressions following model or prompt changes. * Investigate test failures, document reproducible defects and report quality metrics to inform release decisions. * Maintain traceable testing evidence to support HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance. **Skillset** * Minimum of 4 years’ experience in software testing and automation, including at least 2 years building or significantly extending automation frameworks. * Strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python. * Hands\-on UI and API testing experience using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, Postman/Newman or REST Assured. * A solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP and OAuth 2\.0/OIDC. * Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines, using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar tools. * Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably AWS, alongside Docker and containerised services. * Strong attention to privacy, security, data integrity and edge cases, with clear communication skills and a collaborative approach. * Experience with healthcare interoperability standards, health information exchanges or EHR integrations would be an advantage. * Experience testing LLM\-powered applications, AI agents or MCP servers would be beneficial. * Exposure to performance testing, observability tools or HIPAA\-regulated/SOC 2\-audited environments would be a plus. **Benefits** * Salary: $140k – $180k.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Forward Deployment Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI\-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production\-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end\-to\-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade\-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short\-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high\-quality code and train new team members. Key job responsibilities Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI\-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel. Build production AI applications. Design and develop production\-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost. Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations. Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high\-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others. Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes. About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. jobs.title: Principal TPM, AI Engineering, AI Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Software engineering is where AI is changing work fastest. Developers everywhere now use AI coding tools, but the organizational gains have not followed, and most enterprises have faster individual developers alongside the same delivery outcomes. AWS AI Engineering exists to close that gap. We help customers systematically build better software with AI across the whole software development lifecycle. AI\-native development is now moving from early adopters into the enterprise, and the hard part is no longer proving that it works. It is making it scale. We are looking for a Principal TPM to help shape how that happens. You will work alongside our engineering teams to bring direction together from two streams of signal: what we learn inside customers' engineering organizations, and where the industry is heading. Customer signal tells you what hurts today. Industry signal tells you what will be table stakes in six months. Connecting the two into a point of view the team can act on, and keeping it current as both move, is the center of this role. Our current work includes an open\-source, AI\-native development lifecycle we created and continue to evolve with customers, along with offerings that give AI agents a deep understanding of large codebases and move customers toward autonomous software delivery. Those offerings will keep changing as the technology does, and the charter behind them will not. Key job responsibilities Bring the direction together Work with our engineering teams to connect customer signal and industry signal into a clear direction for how AWS helps customers become AI\-native across the software development lifecycle. Find where teams are solving the same problem in parallel and bring that work together, so the organization makes one piece of real progress rather than three partial ones. Help sequence work against customer readiness and keep the portfolio coherent as individual offerings come and go. Define the methodology, then make it adoptable Drive the definition, standardization, and adoption of our AI\-native development lifecycle as something customers can run themselves. Build consensus on the practices and standards that make it real, and replace fragmented experimentation with a credible default path that fits each customer's risk tolerance. Own adoption, and scale it Treat adoption as the deliverable rather than the follow\-up, through enablement, documentation, reference implementations, assessments, and self\-service paths that carry customers from first experiment to production\-scale practice. Design the mechanisms that convert individual developer adoption into enterprise standardization and that let the wider AWS field carry this work without you in the room. Account for organizations whose constraints differ from the ones you designed for, and for the long tail where adoption usually stalls. Define how success is measured, and hold us to it Define and track outcome\-based KPIs for the charter, including adoption and depth of use inside customer organizations, persistence of changed behavior long after the engagement, and improvements in delivery speed, quality, and the economics of building software. Insist on rigorous evaluation of the offerings we build, the agents inside them, and our own claims about what works. Build measurement frameworks customers can run on themselves, and recommend stopping work that is not paying off. Build leverage out of engagements Turn lessons from individual customer engagements into repeatable patterns and scalable assets. Productize what was built for one customer when it has broader value, and resist treating every new request as bespoke. Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating patterns and adoption blockers into actionable input for AWS service teams so that what we learn in the field shapes the products customers build on. Lead across the organization and with customers Influence without relying on authority, aligning engineering, field, and regional teams worldwide on shared direction and sequencing. Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and practitioners, solving the business problem rather than only the technical one and investing in the long\-term relationship over the one\-off win. Build the playbook and enablement that lets the wider AWS field carry this work, and represent it externally through open source, conference talks, and technical writing. A day in the life You split your time between setting direction and staying close to the work. On one day you might sit with a customer's engineering team to understand why they abandoned part of the lifecycle after week three, then meet a CTO to agree what success looks like for a 15,000 developer organization. On another you might review adoption data across regions to decide where the next investment goes, work out what a stalled rollout actually needs, or turn a pattern that worked for one customer into something the whole field can run. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - AgentCore, AWS Agentic AI
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is building the foundational services developers use to create, deploy, and operate production\-ready AI agents at scale. AgentCore Harness, launched at AWS Summit New York in June 2026, provides a managed agent loop that enables customers to define an agent through configuration rather than build and operate orchestration infrastructure themselves. Customers specify their model, instructions, tools, skills, memory, and execution limits. AgentCore Harness manages the agent loop, secure execution environment, session isolation, identity, networking, observability, and deployment lifecycle. This allows developers to move quickly from an idea to a production agent while retaining the flexibility to integrate custom tools, models, and environments. As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, implement, test, deploy, and operate core components across the Harness control plane and data plane. You will solve challenging distributed systems problems involving agent execution, session state, tool orchestration, security, scalability, reliability, and low\-latency streaming. You will own features throughout their lifecycle, contribute to technical designs, and deliver high\-quality solutions for customers. Harness sits at the intersection of AgentCore Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Browser, Code Interpreter, and Evaluations. You will collaborate with engineers across these services to integrate capabilities, improve cross\-service APIs, and reduce friction throughout the agent development lifecycle. A central part of this role is making sophisticated agent capabilities dramatically easier to use. You will work backward from customer needs to turn complex infrastructure and orchestration tasks into intuitive configuration, sensible defaults, reusable templates, and guided workflows. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer I, Inference models optimization, AWS Neuron Inference
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators. The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware\-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high\-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine\-tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration. As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers. This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive\-scale large language models like GLM, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Billing Data Services, Billing Data Services
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We make AWS billing data trustworthy at the source. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Billing Data Services (BiDS) team, you will build and operate the foundational systems that capture, store, and serve the billing facts that AWS billing services rely on. Our services sit upstream of bill computation systems. We ingest billing data from across AWS (such as pricing, subscriptions, and entitlements), persist it as a single source of truth, and serve it to the teams and pipelines that join it with usage to synthesize customer\-facing billing artifacts. We operate at the scale of all of AWS, where correctness is non\-negotiable and a single bad record can ripple into thousands of customer bills. As a software engineer on this team, you will develop and improve large\-scale distributed systems built on AWS services. You will learn new technologies, design durable storage and serving paths, and build the data layer that hundreds of AWS teams depend on. Your work will impact millions of external customers and sit on the critical path of Billing. Key job responsibilities * Write high\-quality, efficient, and testable code in Java and other object\-oriented languages. * Build large\-scale, highly available distributed systems for ingesting, storing, and serving authoritative billing data at the scale of all of AWS. * Design storage and serving paths that meet demanding freshness, accuracy, and latency requirements for downstream billing pipelines. * Partner with downstream teams on schema and data contract changes, making sure migrations are backward compatible and do not disrupt their pipelines. * Own and operate the systems you build, holding a high bar for data quality, correctness, and operational rigor. * Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement as a member of a Scrum team. * Collaborate with product managers and engineers across Commerce Platform teams to deliver features and drive the adoption of best practices. A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing ingestion and data quality dashboards before joining a design review for a new storage or serving path. By midday, you are working with a downstream team on a schema or data contract change, making sure the migration is backward compatible and won't disrupt their pipelines. In the afternoon, you are deep in an approach to cut serving latency or raise ingestion throughput, then aligning with a partner team on an upstream event format change. You balance long\-term platform investments with the immediate needs of the teams that depend on your data. About the team We own the systems that hold and serve the authoritative billing facts for AWS Commerce Platform services. BiDS delivers timely and consistent operational billing data to support near real\-time bill computation and cost and usage monitoring for AWS, giving billing teams a high\-performance, queryable, and cost\-effective data layer to store and access operational billing data.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. As a Senior Applied Scientist in Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will build that path from customization to trusted evaluation. You will prove it with customers on their own data. You will help customers decide when and how to customize foundation models, using techniques that range from parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning and distillation to preference optimization and reinforcement fine\-tuning. You will turn that work into reusable recipes, evaluation methods, and open\-source accelerators that let builders customize models reliably and cost\-effectively. The role splits roughly 50/50 between direct customer engagements and building leverage through reusable science assets, open source, and thought leadership. * Customer work: You will partner with customer science and engineering teams on their hardest customization problems. You'll frame the problem, choose the right approach, design the evaluation, and work hands\-on to get customized models into production. * Building time : You will develop reference implementations and training recipes, contribute to open\-source projects, and publish findings that raise the bar for the broader community. You will work closely with AWS service teams to close the loop between what customers need and what AWS builds. You will be the team's scientific bar\-raiser. You will set evaluation standards, review modeling choices, and publish what you learn, internally and externally. You will work closely with the service teams so that the patterns we prove in the field become native features. This is a global role within the Solutions Architect organization. You will maintain deep relationships with AI service and science teams and collaborate with specialists and builder customers across regions to stay current on the state of the art and influence roadmaps. Key job responsibilities * Own the evaluation methodology. Design the evaluation methodology behind every model\-selection and customization decision. Score quality, cost, latency, and safety in a way that is reproducible, statistically sound, and calibrated to each customer's quality bar. * Lead customization engagements end to end. Drive work from data curation and synthetic data generation through fine\-tuning, distillation, continued pre\-training, and reinforcement learning. Re\-score every change against the same harness so customers see exactly what they gained. * Invent where no textbook solution exists. Develop new techniques such as reward design for agentic tasks, simulation\-based evaluation, and efficient serving of small decision models, then package them as reusable code any Solutions Architect can run. * Turn engagement learnings into reusable assets. Build reference architectures, open\-source accelerators, workshops, enablement materials, blogs, and papers that form a repeatable path from evaluation through deployment. * Advise field teams and customers. Act as the scientific advisor on trade\-offs among prompting, retrieval, customization, and frontier models, including knowing when not to customize. * Mentor and influence across teams. Mentor engineers and Solutions Architects in ML methodology. Turn customer evidence into feature requests and proposals for AWS service teams that make field\-proven patterns native product capabilities. A day in the life You start the morning reviewing a customer's distillation results, where a smaller model is closing the gap with a much larger one. The gains cluster in one task slice, so you flag possible data leakage before the design review. Afterward, you add a held\-out evaluation set and a capability\-regression check to the training recipe. In the afternoon, you share engagement findings with a product team to shape how evaluation fits into the customization workflow. You wrap up by refining an open\-source evaluation harness you'll release alongside a customer workshop. About the team Applied AI and Data Architects (AIDA) is a team of specialized AI prototypers with a product mindset. The team builds a portfolio of domain\-specific Tech Field Products in areas such as semantics, data engineering, ML, AI security/governance/agent\-ops, and DevOps. Model customization and evaluation is one of the team's focus areas. Its goal is to make foundation and open weight model customization repeatable, measurable, and accessible to builders. Each product is grounded in customer reality. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Advertising is seeking a Data Scientist II to help measure and improve one of the world's largest advertising identity platforms. You will work with massive datasets to uncover insights that directly influence how Amazon recognizes customers, connects identity signals, and enables advertisers to reach and measure audiences across the global advertising ecosystem. The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers identity resolution across Amazon's owned and operated properties, third party publishers, and the open internet. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans more devices and environments, understanding the accuracy, coverage, and business impact of identity resolution has become increasingly important. As a Data Scientist II, you will develop analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and data driven insights to evaluate the performance of Amazon's identity graph. You will work with billions of identity signals to quantify recognition rates, graph coverage, identity accuracy, and the incremental value of deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution. Your analysis will help identify opportunities to improve advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and revenue. You will design experiments, develop statistical models, and establish measurement frameworks to understand how identity improvements translate into better advertising outcomes. This includes evaluating the precision and recall of identity models, measuring the incremental contribution of individual identity sources, identifying gaps in identity coverage, and quantifying the commercial impact of identity investments. You will partner closely with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Your work will help shape technical priorities, guide investment decisions, and establish the metrics used to evaluate identity performance across Amazon Advertising. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, experimentation, and large scale data analytics. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Build the agentic system that automatically improves campaigns for millions of Amazon advertisers. The Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) auto\-optimization framework uses LLM\-based agents, together with auction simulation, ML models and optimization algorithms, to decide what to change, apply the change within limits the advertiser sets, measure the results and learn from them. You'll own the architecture and production systems behind this loop, and because the system spends advertiser money automatically, you'll also set its safety standards. You'll lead the design and delivery of the core services: the agent execution engine and tool orchestration, the action layer that writes changes to live campaigns, evaluation and experimentation pipelines, model serving and tuning infrastructure, and monitoring. You'll work with applied scientists to turn prototype agent capabilities into production systems that run reliably across millions of campaigns. You'll also partner with science, product and operations to improve the agent architecture, success metrics and tuning loops. You'll work backwards from advertisers: every infrastructure decision should make optimization more effective, safer, or easier for advertisers to understand and trust. What Makes This Role Stand Out * Agents that act, not just advise: the system makes real changes to live campaigns, so it demands real production engineering * 1\.6MM advertisers: small gains in decision quality have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon's retail ecosystem * Current agent stack: tool orchestration (including MCP), reasoning frameworks, RL fine\-tuning and preference optimization * Safety by design: spend limits, rollback, audit trails and automatic safeguards are core to the architecture Key job responsibilities * Own the auto\-optimization platform's scheduling across millions of campaigns * Build the action layer that applies agent changes to live campaigns, with spend limits, advertiser controls, conflict handling, rollback and a full audit designs and agent patterns, use data to decide which go to production, and meet latency, availability and cost targets, including LLM inference cost per advertiser * Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, help with hiring, and own operations (on\-call, COEs) About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through the latest generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. This role is part of an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company's Think Big leadership principle to the next level. We focus on creating entirely new biotechnology products and services with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. If you're interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you. As a Software Development Engineer, you will own features end to end, from the design doc to production: the LLM agents and the tools they call on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, the TypeScript/React application our customers use every day, and the AWS infrastructure beneath it. There is no legacy system to work around and no finished roadmap handed down; you will help set both. You'll work alongside some of the most talented scientists, product managers and designers at Amazon. The scientists own the science and you own the product, so no science background is needed: we need engineers who like to ship, and who want the scope that comes with an early team. Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have thirteen employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We are constantly learning through programs that are local, regional, and global. Amazon's culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust. Our team highly values work\-life balance, mentorship and career growth. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and fulfillment. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects and offer training that will challenge you to become your best. Key job responsibilities * Own major parts of a greenfield product end to end, from design through launch and operation, working directly with product and science partners to understand customer problems and build the right solutions * Build LLM agents and the tools they call on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, and measure their quality with automated evaluations * Build the customer\-facing TypeScript/React application, including the interfaces where people work with AI agents: streaming responses, tool calls, and reviewing and correcting agent output * Design new services while the architecture is still being set, and write the design docs that shape the team's technical direction * Run what you build: take part in operational support, alarming and monitoring, and make sure root causes are found and fixed * Build the mechanisms that let a small team ship fast and safely: CI/CD pipelines, per\-change preview environments, automated evaluations, and a high bar on security and resilience * Earn trust with design, product, science, and engineering partners, demonstrating empathy, candor, and backbone through all levels of communication A day in the life * Taking a feature from a rough idea to production in days, not quarters * Collaborating closely with applied scientists, designers, product managers, and other engineers to turn concepts into high\-quality, scalable code * Working across the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, UX review, code implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance * Designing how people and AI agents work together on screen, and testing it with the people who will use it * Balancing speed of execution with architectural requirements and user experience considerations * Using AI coding agents as an everyday part of how we build, and continuously learning to keep pace with the technology and our customers' needs **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 3\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 3\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language * 2\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience in successful technology product work from ideation through launch * Experience building applications on large language models (LLMs) or AI agents * Experience across the full stack: a TypeScript/React front end, backend services, and AWS infrastructure as code (CDK or jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Are you passionate about sustainable engineering and innovative design? Join our team to shape the future of data center infrastructure while making a significant environmental impact. You'll collaborate with diverse teams to create energy\-efficient solutions that power the digital world. Amazon has a global presence. Travel should be up to 20% of your time and in\-person collaboration efforts in your assigned office location. Key job responsibilities * Design and implement energy\-efficient mechanical systems for next\-generation data centers * Lead cross\-functional teams in developing innovative solutions for complex engineering challenges * Oversee project lifecycle from conception through implementation, including budget management * Foster collaborative relationships with hardware teams to optimize facility\-equipment integration * Guide continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring About the team \*Why AWS\* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. \*Diverse Experiences\* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. \*Work/Life Balance\* We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. \*Inclusive Team Culture\* Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. \*Mentorship and Career Growth\* We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 6\+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field * Knowledge of critical data center/mission critical mechanical and electrical equipment * Experience in data center/mission critical design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance * Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center/mission critical equipment and facilities **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience * Professional Engineering or Architectural License * Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region * Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents * Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
