jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Alexa Shopping
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Alexa Shopping is building toward a world where a customer communicates the intent and we handle the rest — understanding what they meant, finding the right product, and surfacing it at the right moment. We are turning conversation into commerce: agentic AI experiences that let millions of customers capture what they need, organize it, and act on it through Alexa. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that make this real. You'll sit at the center of a fast\-moving effort that spans LLM\-powered content understanding, real\-time inference, multimodal experiences, and autonomous actions that shop on the customer's behalf. You will own shipping across all Alexa endpoints ranging from Echo dot devices to Echo Show to 3P Smartphones and new device formats. This is a builder's TPM role: high visibility, direct customer impact, and the mandate to shape the world of agentic shopping. If you are looking for an opportunity to blend the agentic capabilities in to the world of shopping and ubiquitous computing, this is the place to be. Key job responsibilities \- Own the roadmap and delivery for major Alexa Shopping programs end\-to\-end \- from ambiguous problem to shipped experience across multiple form factors and 15\+ locales. * Drive cross\-functional execution across engineering, applied science, product, and partner orgs, turning a shared vision into sequenced, measurable delivery. * Bring clarity to complexity: define scope, surface dependencies and risks early, and keep a fast\-moving team aligned and unblocked. \- Establish and own the mechanisms \- planning, status, launch readiness, metrics that let the team ship frequently without losing sight of quality or the customer. * Translate between technical and business audiences, and represent the program crisply to leadership. * Use data to make the call on trade\-offs (scope, latency, accuracy, timing) and to know when a bet is paying off. A day in the life You'll spend your time removing ambiguity and unblocking delivery. On any given day you will align your program teams across product, engineering and applied science on a launch plan, drive a design or readiness review, resolve a cross\-org dependency, or reframe a roadmap around what the data is telling you. You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and scientists on approach, keep the program moving, and watch features reach customers quickly. You'll own the mechanisms that keep a small, ambitious team shipping fast. About the team Alexa Shopping – Core builds the experiences that let millions of customers shop through Alexa, from discovery to purchase. We're actively building the next generation of conversational shopping powered by LLMs and agentic AI. Our people own their problem spaces end\-to\-end and have real autonomy to experiment and ship. We're a team that invests in each other's growth \- through mentorship, partnership, and a culture where everyone's voice shapes the product.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience * 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience * 3\+ years of software development experience * 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience * Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience * Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules * Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: AI Software Engineer - Calendar Intelligence
jobs.description: Summary Apple has changed how people live, connect, and work, and the Calendar team wants to rethink what a calendar can do for the people using it. A calendar knows when someone is busy. It knows very little about which of those commitments matter, which ones could move, or when would be a good time for something new. We're looking for an engineer to help answer those questions, on device and privately, for billions of people. The right person has strong machine learning foundations and is just as comfortable writing the software that ships a model as building the model itself. You'll help take ideas from a single sentence to a shipped feature, and you'll bring the evaluation that tells us whether it works. Description In this role you'll drive the modeling and evaluation behind intelligence features in Calendar, from the first framing through launch, as part of a very collaborative team. A request will often start as one line, and you'll work with the team to turn it into a problem we can solve: what signal exists, what a good answer looks like, which approach fits, and how we'll know it's right. You'll design the evaluation before you build the model. That means the metrics, the eval sets, the baselines a model has to beat, and human review for the places where a metric can't tell you enough. You won't always have good data, so part of the job is finding it and getting something useful out of it when there isn't much. You'll need to get real statistical strength out of priors, shared structure, and self\-supervision. You'll also work with a range of large language models, on device and on server, deciding where a model call earns its cost, where a smaller model trained on a larger model's judgments does better, and where a well\-tuned heuristic beats both. You'll join a small team of senior systems engineers who ship this work across Apple's platforms, several of them with deep backgrounds in ML data engineering. There's no hard line between roles, so you'll write production code alongside them in whatever part of the stack the problem needs. Calendar also builds on signals and models from other ML teams across Apple, and a lot of this role is working with them: building on what they have, agreeing on shared interfaces, and recognizing when we need our own. You'll work closely with design and product as well. We need someone who writes clearly, can explain a model's tradeoffs to engineers who aren't ML specialists, and is comfortable driving a problem forward before the path is defined. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, EE, Applied Mathematics, or related field with 2\+ years experience in developing ML / AI driven software. * Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Swift, Objective\-C, or C\+\+ * Experience developing software prototypes and features driven by Large Language Models and designing tool and function\-calling interfaces, constructing context, and validating model output * Fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, with good judgment about where to apply them and how to verify what they produce. * Experience driving an ambiguous problem with cross\-functional partners, including other ML teams, from a loose idea through launch, and getting alignment on shared interfaces along the way. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills, and the ability to drive alignment across teams on shared API surfaces Preferred Qualifications * Experience designing and developing systems that are efficient in resource constrained environments — latency, memory, and power budgets on device * Solid foundation in machine learning, probability, and statistics, with hands\-on experience training and evaluating models in a framework such as PyTorch or JAX * A track record of designing the evaluation for what you ship: metrics, held\-out sets, baselines, and noticing when a metric has stopped measuring what you care about * Proven ability to excel in a fast\-paced development team At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Services Engineering
jobs.description: Summary The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds the container and virtualization runtime technology that powers Apple's next\-generation compute platform. We're a fast\-moving, highly skilled team of systems engineers designing and developing the virtualization\-based runtimes that run Virtual Machines and Linux Containers across our data center, with privacy, security, and performance as first\-class requirements. We're starting a new team focused on one question: how do we patch the node software across our datacenter fleet faster, and more often, with minimal impact to the workloads running on it? We're looking for a domain expert to decide the approach and then build and lead the team that delivers it. Description Today, updating a node's software means choosing between speed and workload impact. This team's job is to remove that tradeoff, so we can patch the fleet faster and more often with minimal impact on users. We have not chosen an approach. Live migration, snapshot and restore, kexec\-based host updates, live patching, and in\-place upgrade of the runtime and VMM are all options, and a different approach may fit better than any of them. We are looking for an expert to decide and guide: which approach, or combination, gets us there, what it costs in workload impact and operational risk, and how we measure the result. You will: \* Define the fleet patching strategy: evaluate the candidate approaches (including ones we haven't listed), choose, and make the tradeoffs explicit, grounded in a model of how each one fails. \* Set the metrics that matter, such as guest\-visible downtime, total migration time, network amplification, abortability, and time to patch the fleet. \* Design and drive the first implementation, building on Cloud Hypervisor and our Linux microVM runtimes on x86 and arm64\. \* Hire and grow the team. Depending on your background and interests this is a technical\-lead role or a people\-management role, and we will decide that together. \* Work with the SRE, Compute, and security organizations on rollout, safety, and fleet operations. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent related experience. * At least 8\+ years of software design and development experience in infrastructure engineering (compute, storage and network virtualization). * Deep, demonstrated experience in one of the following, and working fluency in the other: Operating live migration, live patching, or kexec\-style host updates across a production fleet, including the failures: non\-convergence, aborts and rollback, and fleet\-wide rollout safety. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services (Forge)
jobs.description: Summary Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it! Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it. Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it. Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI\-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits. Description You will work with product owners, infrastructure owners, and partner engineers to turn ambiguous, high\-impact problems into clean solutions. You'll own products that ETS teams depend on every day. You will also help define how AI agents work in production alongside humans, in the same codebases our engineers ship to daily. The role mixes product engineering with hands\-on integration work. You may start closer to one than the other, and you should be comfortable moving between them as the work changes. We are looking for strong full\-stack engineers who have owned work through production, have built something with LLMs or agents, can design securely and for scale, and want to grow into leading designs and mentoring others. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full-Stack AI Applications
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- Our vision is to enable profitable growth to Aramark's Accounts by providing them with analytical assets that meet their needs as effectively and then efficiently as possible. To achieve this vision, Aramark will deliver strategic data assets that enable our operators to maximize the hospitality experience for our consumers and clients. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team as a key technical contributor on the Document Intelligence Worker platform ? a cloud\-native, event\-driven system that ingests, classifies, and processes documents at scale using AI agentic workflows. You will design and operate the pipelines and services that power automated document understanding and downstream analytics and AI\-driven capabilities across Aramark, processing 1000\+ documents per month for 12\+ Lines of Business. You will work across Azure Blob Storage, Event Grid, Service Bus, Container Apps Jobs, AI Search, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry. This is a hybrid role based at our Philadelphia headquarters. Candidates must be local to the area or willing to relocate, and able to work onsite in a hybrid capacity. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, and own components of the Document Intelligence Worker pipeline, including ingestion, classification, extraction, and downstream delivery to consumer applications, making design decisions that account for scalability, cost, and reliability. * Architect and implement event\-driven processing using Azure Blob Storage, Event Grid, and Service Bus, with Container Apps Jobs scaled via KEDA. * Build and productionize AI agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry ? including orchestration, tool use, and multi\-step reasoning over unstructured documents. * Implement and maintain retrieval and indexing layers using Azure AI Search and Cosmos DB to support downstream search, analytics, and agentic retrieval. * Design and build the application layer for agentic AI solutions ? backend services and APIs (including authentication and orchestration between the UI and platform services) and React\-based user interfaces such as chat, document review/approval tools, and agent monitoring dashboards. * Own monitoring, observability, testing, and recovery mechanisms for production pipelines, including on\-call support for critical incidents. * Drive integration and synchronization work between source systems (on\-premises and SaaS) and cloud\-native platforms, working through dependencies across teams. * Contribute to data engineering best practices ? CI/CD for data and services, testing standards, and code and design review norms ? and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers and interns. * Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders on technical trade\-offs, feasibility, and cost, translating requirements into reliable, scalable data and AI services and explaining complex AI and data concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Evaluate and prototype emerging document intelligence and agentic AI techniques, and recommend their adoption where they add measurable value, weighing cost and risk. **Qualifications** ------------------ BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with 8\+ years (or 6\+ with an MS) of professional experience across data engineering and software development (including full\-stack development with backend services), including 3\+ years of hands\-on experience building applied AI, machine learning, or data science solutions, with production experience building LLM\-powered and AI agentic applications, plus experience in document intelligence (OCR, IDP, document classification/extraction). This includes: * Full\-stack development experience, including backend services and API design (e.g., REST, authentication/authorization, service\-to\-service integration) and React frontend development, sufficient to build UIs for agentic AI applications (e.g., chat interfaces, document review/approval tools, agent monitoring dashboards). * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with production experience building and operating data or AI services. * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including object storage, event\-driven messaging, and container orchestration with autoscaling. Experience with Azure services (Blob Storage, Event Grid, Service Bus, Container Apps, KEDA) is preferred. * Experience building or integrating AI agentic workflows and LLM\-enabled applications ? e.g., via Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or comparable frameworks. * Experience with document intelligence / intelligent document processing tooling (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI, OCR pipelines, layout\- or vision\-based extraction models). * Experience with vector search and retrieval\-augmented generation, including Azure AI Search or equivalent (e.g., Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate). * Experience with NoSQL/document databases such as Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, or Firestore, and designing data models for high\-throughput, low\-latency workloads. * Solid grounding in CI/CD practices, version control (Git), automated testing, and production monitoring/observability. * Comfortable working across distributed teams, with a track record of working with both engineers and non\-technical business stakeholders and adapting communication to the audience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with dbt, Snowflake, or Databricks for downstream data transformation and analytics. * Experience with Apache Spark, real\-time streaming, or large\-scale distributed data processing. * Experience designing multi\-agent orchestration systems, including tool\-calling, memory, and agent\-to\-agent communication patterns. * Prior experience in food service, hospitality, retail, or other consumer\-facing industries. **Benefits** ------------ BENEFITS: Aramark offers comprehensive benefit programs and services for eligible employees including medical, dental, vision, and work/life resources. Additional benefits may include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid days off such as parental leave and disability coverage. Benefits vary by location and are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works. For more information about Aramark benefits, click here Aramark Careers \- Benefits \& Compensation. ? There is no predetermined application window for this position, the position will close once a qualified candidate is selected. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including, but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the California Fair Chance Act, and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance to the extent that those laws apply to the opportunity. **About Aramark** ----------------- **Our Mission** Rooted in service and united by our purpose, we strive to do great things for each other, our partners, our communities, and our planet. At Aramark, we believe that every employee should enjoy equal employment opportunity and be free to participate in all aspects of the company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military status, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by applicable law. **About Aramark** The people of Aramark proudly serve millions of guests every day through food and facilities in 15 countries around the world. Rooted in service and united by our purpose, we strive to do great things for each other, our partners, our communities, and our planet. We believe a career should develop your talents, fuel your passions, and empower your professional growth. So, no matter what you're pursuing \- a new challenge, a sense of belonging, or just a great place to work \- our focus is helping you reach your full potential. Learn more about working here at http://www.aramarkcareers.com or connect with us on Facebook, Instagram and Twitter.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, AI Engineering
jobs.description: ### ***Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self\-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee\-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high\-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*** **Job Description** **SUMMARY** Ares Management is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Associate, AI Engineer** to help build and operate the firm's enterprise AI platform and production AI capabilities supporting use cases across investment and corporate functions. This is a hands\-on engineering role within the central Data \& AI organization. The Senior Associate will work with experienced AI engineers, platform engineers, data engineers, product managers, and business\-aligned technology teams to design and deliver production\-quality AI services and applications. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience developing Generative AI and machine learning solutions. They will contribute to shared platform capabilities such as model access, retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation, APIs, observability, and developer tooling, while also helping product and application teams bring AI use cases from prototype through production. This role is well suited for an engineer who wants to work across modern AI technologies while developing deep experience in enterprise\-grade architecture, security, governance, reliability, and software engineering. **REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS** **Reports to:** AI Platform \& Engineering leadership **PRIMARY FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES** **AI Engineering** * Design, develop, test, and operate production\-grade AI services and applications. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested production code using Python and modern software engineering practices. * Develop APIs, services, libraries, and reusable components that support AI applications across the firm. * Participate in technical design, code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and production support. * Work with senior engineers to implement platform architecture, engineering standards, and reusable design patterns. * Own defined engineering components and workstreams from development through deployment and ongoing operation. **Generative AI \& Shared AI Services** * Build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation capabilities using embeddings, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, vector databases, document processing, and structured data retrieval. * Develop reusable services for document extraction, search, retrieval, and AI\-powered workflows. * Build agentic and multi\-step workflows incorporating model reasoning, tools, enterprise data, and application services. * Implement prompt templates, structured outputs, tool\-use patterns, and reusable orchestration components. * Build integrations using Model Context Protocol and other AI interoperability patterns where appropriate. * Contribute to evaluation frameworks for measuring retrieval quality, generation accuracy, workflow performance, and overall AI\-system quality. * Experiment with emerging models, frameworks, retrieval techniques, and AI engineering approaches and help translate successful experiments into production capabilities. **AI Platform Development** * Contribute to enterprise AI gateway capabilities supporting model access, routing, resiliency, usage tracking, and cost management. * Develop common APIs and SDKs that make AI platform capabilities easy for other engineering teams to consume. * Support prompt management, model configuration, model lifecycle, and deployment capabilities. * Integrate AI services with enterprise data products, applications, APIs, and internal systems. * Help build reusable tooling and reference implementations that accelerate development by application and vertical engineering teams. * Support platform capabilities for tracing, observability, usage attribution, and AI FinOps. **Application Enablement** * Partner with AI Product Management, Data Engineering, and business\-aligned technology teams to translate business requirements into working technical solutions. * Develop application\-specific AI workflows and integrations using shared enterprise AI platform services. * Enable secure connectivity between AI applications, enterprise systems, and governed data sources. * Help develop AI capabilities supporting workflows across investment and corporate functions. * Work directly with engineers and product teams to troubleshoot issues, improve solution quality, and move AI use cases into production. * Create documentation, examples, and reusable patterns that help other teams successfully adopt shared AI capabili ng. * Demonstrate a strong ownership mindset and a focus on software quality, simplicity, reliability, and continuous learning. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline. **Experience Required** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or related experience. * Hands\-on experience developing machine learning, Generative AI, LLM, or data\-intensive applications. * Strong Python development skills and experience writing production\-quality software. * Experience designing or consuming APIs, services, and cloud\-based applications. * Experience with a major cloud platform, preferably Azure. * Practical experience with one or more Generative AI techniques such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, structured generation, tool use, or agentic workflows. * Familiarity with modern software development practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and production monitoring. * Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills. * Ability to take ownership of defined technical components and deliver them from design through production. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, MLflow, or Vector Search. * Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI services, OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable enterprise LLM providers. * Experience with LLM application or agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or comparable technologies. * Experience building RAG applications, document\-processing pipelines, semantic or hybrid search, or vector\-search solutions. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol, function calling, tool\-use patterns, or agent interoperability standards. * Experience with model or application evaluation, including automated evaluation or LLM\-as\-judge approaches. * Experience with LLM observability, tracing, production monitoring, or AI cost\-management practices. * Experience building applications against governed enterprise data. * Experience working in financial services or another regulated environment. * Asset management, private equity, investment banking, or alternative investments experience. **COMPANY DESCRIPTION** HR to include. **Reporting Relationships** Managing Director, Head of Data Engineering \& AI Platforms**Compensation** The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance\-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role. $150,000 \- $175,000 The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long\-Term Disability (LTD) and Short\-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit. Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world\-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more. *There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Discovery
jobs.description: **Location** Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States **Job ID** R\-263841 **Date posted** 09/11/2026 Are you ready to dive into the world of transformative therapies and make a significant impact? At EsoBiotec, now part of AstraZeneca, we are setting new benchmarks for biotechnological research. Our collaboration combines AstraZeneca’s global influence and scientific innovation with EsoBiotec’s unique culture of creativity and breakthroughs in cell\-based therapies and immunology. Here, your scientific passion will drive real\-world impact as you contribute to life\-changing treatments. We are seeking a cross\-disciplinary **AI Engineer** to support a highly **wet\-lab\-focused discovery research team** working at the forefront of **CAR\-T**, **in vivo lentiviral delivery**, and **oncology**. This role will help accelerate research by applying **AI, machine learning, and data\-centric engineering** to experimental workflows, biological data, and decision\-making across early discovery and platform development. The position is designed for someone who can work effectively at the interface of **experimental science** and **computational innovation**. The successful candidate will partner closely with bench scientists to understand biological questions, experimental systems, and data\-generation challenges, and then translate those into practical computational approaches that improve insight generation, prioritization, and research efficiency. As a Cross\-Disciplinary **AI Engineer**, you will work alongside researchers developing next\-generation approaches in **cell therapy**, **gene delivery**, and **oncology discovery**. Much of the team’s work is rooted in screening, vector design, cellular profiling, functional assays, and iterative platform optimization. Your role will be to identify where AI and advanced analytics can have real impact, build fit\-for\-purpose models and tools, and help create stronger connections between experimental output and computational decision support. This is not a role focused primarily on medicinal chemistry or small\-molecule discovery. Instead, it centers on the biological and translational challenges associated with **engineered cell therapies**, **viral delivery systems**, and the interpretation of complex experimental datasets in oncology\-relevant systems. **Key Responsibilities** * **Partner with experimental scientists** working in CAR\-T, lentiviral delivery, cell engineering, and oncology discovery to understand key scientific questions, assay workflows, and experimental decision points. * **Translate wet\-lab problems into AI and data science opportunities**, such as construct prioritization, delivery optimization, cell\-state characterization, image\-based phenotyping, multimodal data integration, or prediction of experimental outcomes. * **Build, adapt, and apply AI/ML models** to support discovery activities, including predictive models, classification models, clustering approaches, representation learning, computer vision pipelines, or LLM\-enabled knowledge workflows where appropriate. * **Work across diverse biological datasets**, such as flow cytometry, single\-cell and bulk omics, imaging, functional assay readouts, vector characterization data, metadata, and experimental annotations. * **Develop data pipelines and analytical frameworks** that improve data quality, accessibility, interoperability, and reuse across experimental programs. * **Create practical tools and visualizations** that enable bench scientists to explore data, compare constructs or conditions, and make more informed decisions about what to test next. * **Collaborate cross\-functionally** with biologists, immunologists, gene therapy scientists, bioinformaticians, data scientists, and software/informatics partners. * **Evaluate and communicate model performance** with attention to biological validity, robustness, interpretability, and limitations in real experimental settings. * **Help establish best practices** for reproducible, responsible, and scientifically grounded AI use in discovery research. * **Monitor emerging methods** in AI, computational biology, and multimodal learning, and identify opportunities to apply them meaningfully in CAR\-T and in vivo delivery research. **Required Qualifications** * **Bachelor’s** in **computer science, machine learning, computational biology, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, systems biology, applied mathematics**, or a related field. * At least 5 years' experience developing **AI/ML solutions** in biological, biomedical, or R\&D environments. * Strong programming skills in **Python** and experience with relevant data science and machine learning frameworks. * Experience working with **complex experimental datasets** and building practical analyses or tools that support scientific decision\-making. * Ability to work effectively with **wet\-lab researchers** and communicate clearly across computational and experimental disciplines. * Experience handling ambiguity and translating open\-ended scientific questions into structured computational approaches. * Strong grounding in data quality, model evaluation, reproducibility, and analytical rigor. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree preferred (**Master’s, or PhD)** * Experience in one or more of the following areas: **cell therapy**, **CAR\-T**, **gene therapy**, **viral vector biology**, **lentiviral systems**, **immuno\-oncology**, or **functional genomics**. * Familiarity with biological data modalities relevant to this space, including **flow cytometry, single\-cell RNA\-seq, multimodal omics, imaging, perturbation datasets, and high\-dimensional assay data**. * Experience with **multimodal learning**, **representation learning**, **scientific image analysis**, **active learning**, **Bayesian optimization**, **LLM\-enabled scientific workflows**, or **knowledge graph approaches**. * Understanding of the practical realities of discovery\-stage wet\-lab research, including assay variability, small and noisy datasets, metadata challenges, and iterative hypothesis testing. * Experience developing user\-facing tools, dashboards, or decision\-support applications for scientific teams. * Familiarity with cloud, data engineering, or production\-oriented workflows for research computing environments. *The annual base pay for this position ranges from $124K to $187K. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.* **Date Posted** 10\-Nov\-2026 **Closing Date** 24\-Nov\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us. ABOUT THIS ROLE As a Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools, and systems that you need to succeed. We pride ourselves on our ability to imagine and invent solutions to problems of the future. You’ll be essential in this forward\-thinking approach to development. Together with the team, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice. ABOUT YOU If you’re a dedicated problem solver, this is the role for you. Identifying and overcoming challenges is at the heart of everything you do; whether it’s looking ahead to our listeners problems, or analyzing every inefficiency, you thrive when you strive for perfection. We look for people who take responsibility, who feel the pride in a job well done and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. With a knowledgeable team around you, and opportunities to challenge yourself, it’s a perfect environment to develop and apply your new skills. As a Software Development Engineer, you will... * Develop, test, and maintain software components and applications for the world's largest audiobook creator and provider * Identify and resolve software defects through code review, log analysis, metrics examination, debugging, and other troubleshooting methods * Write maintainable and scalable code for software components as part of an agile engineering team * Collaborate with stakeholders to envision, design, develop, test, and launch customer\-centric software that inspires and impacts users * Apply computer science, engineering, and analysis principles to solve moderate\-scale problems * Continuously enhance testability, operational excellence (OE), and documentation for owned software components * Handle data classification, storage, and management in accordance with company policies * Participate in the interview process and provide mentorship to fellow engineers ABOUT AUDIBLE Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. software, and cloud\-based services. * Drive the integration of QA processes into continuous integration, deployment, and testing (CI/CD/CT) pipelines, ensuring consistency and reliability. * Build and maintain internal tools and dashboards to monitor the health and performance of testing systems, collaborating with the Platform team on shared monitoring infrastructure to provide critical insights. * Identify, document, and track software defects and bugs, working closely with development teams for efficient resolution. * Support field testing and validation of autonomous systems in Desired Qualifications * Experience robustly testing robotic software systems in simulation and data\-replay settings that may not be deterministic. * Experience working with 3D assets as used in simulation software. * Knowledge of computer vision and machine learning testing practices. * Familiarity with safety standards and compliance testing for autonomous systems. * Experience testing hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) systems. * A background in agricultural technology, industrial automation, or outdoor robotics. ### **Perks:** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave RECRUITERS: We are not accepting agency resumes for this position. jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Platform (Context AI) - Austin based
jobs.description: ### **About Autonomize AI** Autonomize AI is the healthcare industry's purpose\-built AI platform for automating the complex administrative processes that consume clinicians, payers, and care teams: prior authorization, utilization management, care management, and claims processing. Backed by Valtruis, Cigna Group Ventures, Asset Management Ventures and top\-tier VCs, we serve 3 of the top 5 U.S. health enterprises and are scaling aggressively. We are not building another AI point solution. We are building the operating system for healthcare administration, a platform of AI agents, clinical workflows, and data fabric that replaces manual processes end to end. Context AI is the intelligence layer of that platform: one governed understanding of healthcare reference data and each customer's own policies, with the source behind every answer, that any agent or model can call.### **Role Overview** This is a hands\-on product role reporting to the VP of Product. You own Context AI: the Healthcare Context Graph, the enterprise extensions customers use to layer in their own terminology, policies, formularies and fee schedules, provenance and freshness, and the APIs, SDKs and MCP access that agents and developers build on. You also own customer discovery for the platform. You are not a backlog manager. You spend real time with health plan and PBM data, analytics and AI teams, you find the decisions where shared context saves them time and money, and you turn that into a product engineers want to build and customers pay for.### **Key Responsibilities** #### **Customer Discovery** * Run a weekly discovery rhythm with payer and PBM data, analytics, architecture and AI leaders * Find the costly decisions where teams each keep their own rules, mappings and retrieval, and rank the opportunities by customer and business value * Bring field signal from Sales, pre\-sales and forward deployed engineers into the roadmap every week #### **Context AI Product** * Own the Context AI roadmap: graph coverage across codes, crosswalks, coverage policy, payment rules and drug data, plus ontology editing, approvals, change history and source connections * Run customer pilots with success criteria set up front, and turn what works into product * Decide what we build next and what we stop doing #### **Platform and Developer Experience** * Define what our engineers, partners and customer builders need to build agents and apps on the platform: APIs, SDKs, MCP access, docs and onboarding * Measure adoption and remove the friction that slows builders down #### **Execution** * Write clear PRDs, acceptance criteria and evals for data quality, retrieval accuracy and freshness * Set the release rhythm with engineering and hold it #### **Go\-To\-Market** * Give Sales and Marketing the positioning, packaging inputs and proof points for Context AI * Join technical customer conversations when a deal needs a product voice ### **What Success Looks Like After One Year** * **Production adoption.** Context AI running in production at multiple customers beyond pilot, on their own policies and terminology. * **Pilot conversion.** Pilots that convert to paid, each with written success criteria. * **Platform pull.** A growing number of our agents and customer\-built agents calling Context AI by default. * **Discovery system.** Every roadmap item traceable to a customer problem. * **Trusted data.** Published accuracy and freshness metrics, with provenance on every answer. ### **Qualifications** #### **Experience** * 5\+ years in product management, with B2B data, AI or platform products shipped to enterprise customers * A track record of customer discovery that changed what a team built * Experience shipping APIs, SDKs or developer platforms that other teams build on * Healthcare payer or PBM experience strongly preferred, especially with reference data such as code sets, coverage policy, formularies or fee schedules #### **AI and Technical Depth** * Working knowledge of knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic layers, retrieval and how LLM agents use context * Familiarity with MCP, REST APIs and data catalogs, and comfort writing SQL * Familiarity with healthcare code sets and data standards such as ICD\-10, CPT/HCPCS, NDC, FHIR and X12 ### **The Right Mindset** * **Driver, not a passenger.** You pick up the problem and lead, without waiting to be asked. * **Embraces the mess.** There is work in progress everywhere and less process than you would like. You move us from chaos to structure without slowing us down. * **Customer curiosity.** You go to the customer first and come back with problems, not feature requests. * **Bias for action.** Ships, measures and iterates. Makes decisions with imperfect information and owns the outcome. * **Simplifies and drives clarity.** You make complicated infrastructure legible to a payer executive and an engineer alike. * **Honesty and humility.** Transparent, low\-ego, customer\-leaned, truth\-seeking. ### **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 401(k), disability insurance, and employee assistance programs * Direct work with experienced founders, engineering leaders and the largest health enterprises in the U.S. * High ownership in one of the most consequential chapters of healthcare AI ### **Location** In person in Austin, TX.### **How To Apply** Send your resume and a brief note to careers@autonomize.ai telling us about a customer insight that changed what you built.

You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the TikTok Business or TikTok Shop APIs, plus other marketing platform APIs (Google Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, affiliate and creator platforms). You have built something real against them, not read the docs. * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the digital marketing industry: how agencies and brands actually operate, where the manual work sits, and what clients pay for. * Extensive hands\-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) and a working command of good coding practice: version control, code review, environment and secrets management, testing, and documentation. A computer science degree is not required. Shipped work is. * Experience leading others who build. You have been a principal engineer, a founder, a lead engineer, a technical team lead, or a leader of product managers, and you have set and enforced a quality bar for a team's work. * Experience building AI agents and automations in production: prompts, tool use, approval gates, error handling, and monitoring, using whatever stack fits (Python or TypeScript, agent frameworks, workflow platforms such as n8n or Make where they are the right tool). * A portfolio of projects or code repositories you can walk us through (see below). * Based in, or relocating at your own expense to, Miami or Orlando. Onsite. **Preferred** * Experience in an ecommerce or performance marketing agency, or on a DTC brand's growth team. * TikTok Shop, creator and affiliate marketing, or influencer campaign experience. * Data work: SQL, BigQuery or a similar warehouse, Looker Studio or similar BI tools. * Shopify app or Shopify API experience. * You have built and sold, launched, or run something of your own. **Critical traits** * Moves fast and learns fast. * Thinks in systems and sees ambiguity as a build opportunity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Benefits** ------------ * Salary: $100k\-$120k * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

jobs.title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Lead the future of flight with BAE Systems!** Are you a highly experienced and visionary embedded software engineer seeking a leadership role in a dynamic and innovative environment? At BAE Systems’ Electronic Systems business, within our Controls \& Avionics Solutions (CAS) sector, we are dedicated to creating cutting\-edge avionics systems that ensure the safety and efficiency of air travel. We’re seeking a talented and motivated Principal Embedded Software Engineer to join our team in Endicott, NY and provide technical leadership in the development of next\-generation flight control and related systems. **Sign\-On Bonus and Relocation Assistance are offered for this position!** **About the Role:** As a Principal Embedded Software Engineer within CAS, you will be a key technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and verification of complex embedded software solutions. You will mentor and guide a team of engineers, driving best practices, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality, safety\-critical software. This role demands a deep understanding of embedded systems, real\-time operating systems, and a commitment to software security and safety. **What You'll Do:** * Lead the software engineering team for complex embedded control systems, considering safety, performance, and security requirements * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to a team of embedded software engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. * Experience leading high performing technical teams. * Participate in all phases of the software lifecycle – from requirements definition and system design, through implementation, integration, and rigorous verification. * Develop and review software designs, code, and documentation to ensure adherence to industry standards (e.g., DO\-178C) and internal quality guidelines. * Evaluate and integrate new technologies and tools to improve software development processes and product capabilities. * Contribute to the evolution of our software development processes and best practices. * Act as a technical point of contact for complex software issues and provide resolution strategies. * Focus on software product security, leading the integration of security features and supporting comprehensive validation efforts. * Perform Control Account Manager (CAM) duties in adherence to sound Earned Value Management (EVM) techniques and practices. **Where You'll Contribute:** Within Controls \& Avionics Solutions (CAS), you will have the opportunity to shape the future of avionics – contributing to fly\-by\-wire flight controls, full authority digital engine controls, power management systems, and other critical aircraft systems. \[Learn more about CAS] **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. * 8\-10\+ years of experience in embedded software development, with a significant focus on aerospace or defense applications. * Deep understanding of real\-time operating systems (RTOS) – \*experience with LynxOS, VxWorks, or INTEGRITY is highly desirable\*. * Expert proficiency in C/C\+\+, Python programming languages and software development tools. * Extensive experience with software architecture, design patterns, and software modeling techniques including Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE). * Strong knowledge of software security principles and best practices. * Comprehensive understanding of aerospace software standards (e.g., DO\-178B/C). * Proven leadership skills with the ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills. **What We Offer:** * A dynamic and challenging work environment with opportunities for growth and advancement. * The chance to work on cutting\-edge projects that impact the future of flight. * A competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. * Professional development opportunities to stay at the forefront of technology. * A flexible hybrid work schedule, balancing on\-site and remote work. **Ready to lead the way in avionics innovation? Apply today!** **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Associates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field with strong embedded software development background. * 8\-10\+ years of experience in embedded controls development with at least 3 years leading high performing distributed teams. * Experience in full software lifecycle including requirements, design, coding, integration and verification. * Experience integrating on real\-time, safety\-critical electronic control systems that include hardware, software and programmable logic devices. * Experience with implementing cybersecurity capabilities leveraging features/components including any of the following; secure boot, cryptographic accelerators, Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) or Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). * Understanding of purpose and usage of; cryptographic objects: Keys, Certs, CRLs; algorithms: SHA, AES, RSA, ECC, HMAC, GMAC, etc., and protocols: TLS/DTLS, IPSec, etc. * Solid knowledge and hands\-on experience with C/C\+\+, Python and assembly language programming * Experience performing static/dynamic code analysis. Technical writing skills: capable of creating clear and concise engineering documentation. * **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Master’s Degree in related engineering field * 10\+ years of experience in avionics or electronic controls embedded development, including familiarity with systems such as flight controls, engine controls or mission systems, with at least 3 years of leading high performing distributed teams. * Experience with Multi\-core and ARM processing hardware. * Experience with safety critical development guidelines including DO\-178B/C, DO\-254, ISO\-26262 or equivalent safety process requirements. * Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership * Team player with a proactive attitude and the ability to be productive in a dynamic/collaborative environment * Strong oral and written communications skills * Motivated self\-starter with good problem solving skills, judgment, and analytical capability, with good planning and organizational skills **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $107359 \- $182510 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Web3 Core Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Web3 Core Engineer** **Remote** #### **About Brave** Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We've built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a *truly* independent index, a browser\-native crypto wallet, and a private ad network (opt\-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. And we're just getting started. Already 125 million people have switched to Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month. The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what's true and what's not. Brave is fighting back. Join us! #### **Summary** Brave is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a focus on blockchain integrations with Brave. You'll work on our Brave Wallet. This is a high profile and impactful, hands\-on position. Work together with our product designers, developers and privacy/security experts to help us take our wallet to the next level. Your responsibilities: * Work closely with the backend team to understand intricacies and help iterate on components used to build our wallet libraries. * Integrate new features in brave\-core that help our front\-end team connect prototypes to live data. * Be up\-to\-date with upcoming protocol upgrades, BIPs, EIPs, etc. * Be involved in investigating bugs around blockchain edge cases. #### **Requirements** * 5\+ years experience with application development. * Strong C\+\+ development skills required. * Some JavaScript / TypeScript development skills are a plus. * History of open source contributions. * Good understanding of blockchain protocols (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, etc.) and the DeFi ecosystem are a plus. * Familiarity with cryptocurrency wallet stack (mechanics, UX, etc.). * Experience with software development via distributed development teams. * Comfortable working in an open source setting. * A passion for helping protect users' privacy and security. * Written and verbal communication skills in English. * Proven record of getting things done. #### **Working at Brave** * Industry\-leader in privacy, with a research and engineering team that's innovating everyday to keep people safer online and beat Big Tech * Highly competitive salaries \& benefits, and generous home\-office stipends * Fully remote team (no office, no commute) * Welcoming, humble, ridiculously smart teammates, and a truly flat org structure * Opportunity to get in early at a hyper\-growth company, and revolutionize the web * Oh, and did we mention Brendan, our CEO \& co\-founder, *invented* JavaScript?

jobs.title: Lead, Full-Stack Data Scientist
jobs.description: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH You'll join our Data Science \& Machine Learning Engineering experts within the Applied Technology \& AI team. This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data\-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human\-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results. THE ROLE As a Lead, Full\-Stack Data Scientist, you will leverage your experience to design, implement and refine algorithms to extract and use actionable information from multi\-modal data across a wide range of industries and business problems. You bring a strong generalist foundation across core data science methods (e.g., statistics, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning) that lets you move fluidly across problem types rather than specializing narrowly in one. You’ll develop and deploy analytical and machine learning models that power production systems such as dynamic personalization and pricing engines, predictive maintenance and always\-on forecasting and optimization capabilities. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. WHAT YOU’LL DO * Develop data, technology and AI solutions, leveraging a spectrum of techniques including data science, machine learning, AI algorithms to address large\-scale enterprise challenges and enable production systems * Develop and maintain long\-lasting models, algorithms, and tools that support internal or client needs * Collaborate closely with and influence general consulting teams to identify analytics solutions for client business problems and to execute those solutions * Leverage AI tools with guardrails to accelerate and amplify design, development and implementation phases across the life cycle * Evaluate where generative AI offers a better path to a client solution, and apply techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and model fine\-tuning where appropriate * Collaborate with technology leaders to develop and advocate for cutting\-edge data science concepts to both technical audiences and business stakeholders * Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data pipelines and platforms support modeling, experimentation, and analytics use cases * Support data transformations at scale, including cleaning, enriching, de\-duping, joining, and correlating structured, semi\-structured, or unstructured data for modeling and analysis * Define and implement new and innovative modeling techniques, experimentation strategies, and analytics workflows within Bain's full model development life cycle, including documentation, unit/integration testing, and reviews * Support model deployment and operationalization in collaboration with engineering teams, ensuring scalable data science solutions * Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders; lead working sessions, present recommendations, and write crisp technical documentation * Collaborate with client data engineering and analytics teams and, when needed, contribute to data acquisition, extraction, and preparation to ensure data is fit for modeling
