jobs.title: Director, Partner Technical Integrations - Rentals
jobs.description: New York Growth \& Strategy In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. **What’s your role?** As Director of Partner Technical Integrations, you’ll be the technical voice of Bilt in the room with our housing partners. You’ll join partner managers and sales on calls, workshops, and on\-sites to speak with confidence about how Bilt integrates with property management systems and how data, payments, and workflows move between both sides. You’ll learn how each partner actually operates, then shape solutions inside our product: sometimes by scoping an enhancement request that engineering can build, and often by solving the root problem with what we already have in place rather than building something new. This is an experienced, partner\-facing role, closer to a sales engineer or forward\-deployed engineer than a back\-office integrations manager. You’ll sit between partner asks and our product and engineering teams and translate in both directions, so partners get clear, credible answers and engineers get well\-scoped requirements that solve what the partner actually needs. If you like being the technical expert in a customer conversation, moving between partner operations and system architecture, and seeing your work land across partners and millions of residents, this is the role. **In this role, you will...** * **Be the technical voice with partners.** Join partner managers and sales on discovery calls, demos, technical deep dives, and on\-sites. Answer integration, data\-flow, and payments questions live, then follow up in writing. * **Support new sales.** Assess a prospect’s property management system, workflows, and requirements; map them to what Bilt does today; flag gaps early and set realistic expectations on scope and timeline. * **Understand how partners operate.** Learn partner processes end to end (rent collection, ledger and accounting workflows, onsite operations) so you can see what a request is really trying to solve. * **Solve the root problem.** Start with what we already have in place: configuration, workflow changes, or process fixes. When a build is warranted, write enhancement requests with the partner context, options considered, and clear success criteria. * **Bridge partners and internal teams.** Work with product and engineering to scope, prioritize, and push back where needed, and carry technical constraints and tradeoffs back to partners in plain language. Follow items through launch. * **Own the technical side of partner setup and launch.** Lead configuration, test planning, end\-to\-end validation, go\-live, and post\-launch monitoring so partners are confident using the product. * **Be a senior escalation point.** Diagnose complex production issues with partners, especially during peak rent periods, using SQL and API testing tools to find root causes and drive fixes to resolution rather than just escalating. * **Make the whole team more technical.** Work with our onboarding team to build reusable assets such as integration one\-pagers, solution playbooks, FAQs, and flow diagrams, and coach partner managers and sales on talking about integrations. Use AI tools like Claude to automate recurring work. * **Be the voice of the partner.** Spot patterns across partners and bring them to product to shape the roadmap. **In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:** * 5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role, such as sales engineer, solutions engineer or architect, forward\-deployed engineer, technical account manager, or senior implementations or integrations lead * Track record of joining sales or account teams in front of customers and speaking credibly about APIs, system integrations, and multi\-system workflows * Ability to translate partner needs into clear, well\-scoped requirements that product and engineering can act on, and to influence priorities without direct authority * Strong instinct for solving the root problem with existing capabilities before defaulting to a new build * Working proficiency with APIs and API specifications, Postman or similar tools, and SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) to validate data and diagnose issues independently * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the poise to present to partner executives and the clarity to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences * Proven record of driving issues from identification to full resolution * Comfortable in ambiguity and a fast\-paced environment; self\-starter with an ownership mindset * Willingness to travel occasionally for partner on\-sites (infrequent, no set schedule) * **Nice to haves:** + Experience at a proptech company or a property management company (strongly preferred), on the vendor or operator side, which gives us credibility with partners + Hands\-on experience integrating with property management systems such as Yardi, Entrata, AppFolio, RealPage, or MRI + Background in payments, fintech, or accounting workflows tied to rent collection + Experience supporting complex sales cycles, including RFPs, security reviews, and technical due diligence + Light scripting ability beyond SQL for data monitoring and troubleshooting + Familiarity with AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Claude) for documentation and workflow automation **Benefits:** * **Compensation \-** We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one \-** Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match \-** Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs \-** We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO \-** Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points \-** We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. * **Team Events \-** We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you can grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Director, Partner Technical Integrations is $150,000 \- 165,000** and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R359

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (AI Products)
jobs.description: **About BizzyCar** BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines. We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. BizzyCar is a fast\-paced, results\-driven company with an experienced leadership team skilled in building high\-value businesses. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture. **About the role** As BizzyCar’s founding Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE), you will help our customers implement, adopt, and maximize our most cutting edge solutions. We're hiring a curious professional to own product launches on the ground: configuring the product to each dealership's systems and operations, training their staff, and being the calm, credible presence in the building when a brand\-new AI product starts automating processes at the dealership. In this role, you will be assigned to and become a subject matter expert on a specific product being rolled out to dealerships. Your training will make you comfortable with the automotive retail industry, customer processes, BizzyCar, frontier AI technology, application layer AI technology. follows. **(\*Please Note: This role is Hybrid requiring being in office a few days a month as well as 50\-70% travel to client dealerships.)** **What you'll do*** Own dealer implementations end\-to\-end — from kickoff through go\-live and early hypercare * Configure solutions to each rooftop: translate a dealer's actual service\-drive workflow and tech stack into product configuration through structured discovery and engineering team collaboration * Validate that customer, availability, recall, and RO data flow correctly across systems before go\-live * Train non\-technical dealership staff to full adoption, and manage the change along the way * Run the implementation like a project — own the timeline, the stakeholders, and the go\-live date * Troubleshoot live: reproduce issues, read logs, tell a configuration problem from a product bug, and write clean repro steps * Know what to fix yourself versus what to escalate, and package escalations cleanly for engineering * Write the runbooks and SOPs that let this be repeatable — for the next dealer, and for the support team that eventually takes over steady\-state * Be the feedback loop — route what you learn on\-site back to product, reliably and specifically **What You'll Need****Required*** **Hands\-on integration \& configuration experience** — you've wired a product to external systems via APIs, webhooks, or config tools and validated it end\-to\-end * Troubleshooting \& log diagnosis — comfortable reproducing issues, reading logs, and isolating a config problem from a product bug * Experience delivering customer training or enablement, ideally to non\-technical audiences * Implementation or deployment project management — you've run a kickoff\-to\-go\-live timeline and owned the stakeholders in it * Comfort validating and verifying data across systems (e.g., confirming records, statuses, or availability sync correctly) **Preferred** * Discovery and workflow\-mapping experience — translating a customer's process into product configuration * Issue triage and escalation experience in a customer\-facing technical role * Light scripting or SQL — enough to query data or script a quick validation (a plus, not a requirement) * Experience writing runbooks, SOPs, or setup documentation for handoff to a support team **Helpful Background** *You don't need deep expertise in all of these on day one, but familiarity with several will help you ramp fast:* * SaaS implementation and deployment methodology — onboarding lifecycle, go\-live, hypercare * APIs and integration patterns — REST, webhooks, authentication, and how systems talk to each other * Automotive retail or fixed\-ops experience — the service drive, repair orders, recalls, and the dealership's daily rhythm * The DMS and scheduling ecosystem — e.g., CDK, Reynolds, Tekion, Xtime, myKaarma * Data structure and validation concepts * Support and escalation processes — tiers, SLAs, and clean handoffs * Change management or adoption principles * Security and compliance basics — PII handling, call\-recording consent **Who You Are*** **Ownership** — you see things through to go\-live, not just to the end of your task list * Bias to action and resourcefulness — you unblock yourself on\-site instead of waiting on someone else * Learning agility — you can ramp fast on a product that's still being built and changing under you * Adaptability — you're comfortable with ambiguity; this is an early product, there's no playbook yet, and things will break * Structured and detail\-oriented — implementations are checklists, and a missed step can cause a go\-live to fail * A calm troubleshooting temperament — you can debug live in front of a customer without losing the room * Empathetic change management — you can move skeptical service staff toward trusting an AI to take their calls * Feedback\-loop discipline — you reliably route what you learn in the field back to product * Low\-ego collaboration — you work easily across engineering, support, GTM, and our partner team **Benefits*** **Competitive base salary** $80,000\-$110,000 plus commission renewals and expansion revenue (OTE $150,000\) * **Comprehensive health benefits** — medical, dental, and vision coverage * **401(k) plan** and equity * **Paid time off**, including vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays * **Career growth opportunities** within a growing Sales and Customer Success organization * **Ongoing training and development**, including access to sales enablement tools and enterprise account strategy resources * **Supportive, collaborative team culture** with cross\-functional partnerships *BizzyCar, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits.* *At this time, the company does not provide sponsorship for U.S. visas or immigration benefits, and does not provide financial, legal, or administrative support for employment\-based U.S. immigration benefits. In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, all employees must complete Form I\-9 and present unexpired documents showing they are legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States.*

Bring yours to Block. #### **The Role** The Data Enablement team builds the platforms and frameworks that move and serve data across Block. We support four core capabilities—online and offline data projections, third\-party data integration, and graph data stores—for customers across the company, including Risk, Compliance, Data Engineering, and Data Science. As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will design, build, and operate backend systems that make data easier to acquire, process, and use. You will help shape technical direction, own projects from design through production, and build shared capabilities that other teams can use. We’re looking for a strong systems engineer who brings sound architectural judgment, takes ownership of outcomes, and is eager to learn across the backend and data engineering worlds. jobs.title: DSP Engineer - Audio Tech
jobs.description: Location: Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29301 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: November 10th 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer\-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. **Job Description** =================== Bose Corporation is dedicated to developing breakthrough audio technologies that enrich people’s lives. While Bose is well known for its first\-party consumer and automotive products, an increasingly important part of our future is enabling **partners around the world to deliver differentiated audio experiences through licensed Bose technologies**. The Audio Tech organization focuses on developing scalable, portable, and high\-performance audio technologies that can be deployed across a wide range of partner platforms and products. **Role Overview** We are looking for a **hands\-on DSP engineer** to join our **Audio Technology engineering team**. This role is well suited for a junior\-to\-mid level engineer who enjoys applying strong DSP fundamentals while learning how to design algorithms that must scale across **multiple platforms, partners, and use cases**. Success for the Audio Tech DSP team emphasizes **algorithm robustness, portability, and partner enablement**, while still offering deep technical ownership and exposure to real\-world production systems. You will work closely with senior DSP engineers, platform teams, and external partners to deliver licensable audio technologies that meet demanding quality and performance requirements. **DSP Engineer Role** DSP engineers in the Audio Technology Licensing group work in **cross\-disciplinary, highly collaborative teams** to develop and deploy signal processing algorithms that improve audio experiences for our technology partners and their customers. You will contribute to a broad set of technologies including **audio signal processing, speech and voice processing, noise reduction, and microphone array systems**, and gain experience adapting algorithms to different hardware and software environments. This role provides strong opportunities for technical growth while maintaining clear ownership of deliverables. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and test **DSP algorithms** to solve technical challenges for licensable audio technologies. * Contribute to delivering new customer and partner benefits using technologies such as **active noise reduction, voice pickup, spatial audio, and speech enhancement**. * Work with senior engineers to ensure algorithms are **robust, portable, and scalable** across multiple platforms and partner products. * Support the integration and validation of DSP algorithms on embedded, real\-time systems. * Assist in adapting and tuning algorithms for different hardware, software, and system constraints encountered in a licensing environment. * Participate in technical evaluations of third\-party technologies and contribute to **make\-vs\-buy analyses** when appropriate. * Collaborate with internal teams across engineering, systems, software and product management to support partner delivery and long\-term platform goals. **Skills \& Qualifications** The ideal candidate will have a strong subset of the following: **Technical Skills** * Solid foundation in **digital signal processing**, with experience in audio and/or speech processing. * Experience developing DSP algorithms for **embedded or real\-time systems**. * Proficiency programming signal processing algorithms using **C, Python, and Matlab**; exposure to fixed\-point or optimized implementations is a plus. * Familiarity with **acoustics and acoustic measurements**, including microphones and audio transducers. * Experience debugging embedded systems and working with audio lab equipment. * Ability to evaluate and integrate third\-party algorithms and libraries. **Desirable (Not Required)** * Exposure to **applied machine learning techniques for audio systems**, such as ML\-assisted noise reduction, speech enhancement, or audio classification. * Familiarity with Bluetooth audio systems and their constraints. * Interest in understanding how DSP algorithms scale across different platforms and partner implementations. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Effective communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical topics with engineers from different disciplines. * A collaborative, self\-directed working style suited to small, highly technical teams. **Education \& Experience** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a signal\-processing\-related field; MS preferred. * **3\+ years of relevant industry experience** in DSP, audio, or related embedded systems development. At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $97,600\-$134,200\.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic\-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

jobs.title: Diving Supervisor
jobs.description: Short Description: Bowman has an opportunity for a Diving Supervisor to join our team in Glen Mills, PA. At Bowman, we believe in creating opportunities for aspiring people to thrive and achieve ambitious goals. That’s why a career at Bowman is more than a job. It is an opportunity to be part of a diverse and engaged community of professionals, to be treated as a respected and valued member of a motivated team and to be empowered to do exceptional work that advances the best interest of everyone involved. We recognize the importance of creating a work environment that is both rewarding to our employees and supportive of our unwavering commitment to provide unparalleled service to our clients. Overview: Build and lead a nationwide practice in marine inspections, leveraging company investments in vessels and technology to provide an industry leading service that deploys traditional diver\-led inspections as well as technology\-based data collection (e.g. ROVs, scanning equipment, etc.) to deliver products to both internal and external customers. In the early phases of the service line’s development, the Dive Supervisor will serve as the Designated Person in Charge (DPIC) and supervisor of a dive team for performance of underwater inspections, data collection and cataloguing, report writing, design, and construction inspection support for marine and waterfront projects while ensuring safety, integrity, and compliance with engineering and diving standards. The Dive Supervisor will be part of a team that is responsible for bringing the service to market, and is expected to participate in technology deployment, marketing, and business development activities. Upon maturity of the service, the Dive Supervisor will have the opportunity to lead an offering that has national scope. The position contributes to the development and review of Dive Project Plans, Hazard Identification and Risk Assessments (HIRAs), emergency response plans, and other operational planning documents. Prior to commencing diving operations, the Diving Supervisor shall review and accept the approved Dive Project Plan and associated controls for execution in the field. The Diving Supervisor is responsible for directing and coordinating the mobilization, execution, and demobilization of diving operations. The position identifies hazards, evaluates risks, and ensures appropriate controls and mitigations are implemented and maintained throughout the duration of the work. The Diving Supervisor serves as the primary field representative of the Diving Services Division and coordinates with project personnel, vessel masters, worksite supervisors, foremen, contractors, and other parties whose activities may affect or be affected by the diving operation. The position has the authority to suspend or terminate diving operations whenever unsafe conditions or unacceptable risks are present. Responsibilities: **Leadership and Direction** * Collaborate with Ports and Harbors group leadership to build a nationwide practice, including participation in marketing and business development efforts. * Collaborate with leadership to procure equipment and vessels. * Prepare operating and capital budgets. * Lead the recruitment, development, and mentoring to junior divers and engineering staff as needed. **At the Operational and Company Level** * Work under the direction of internal and external Project Managers to execute engineering and underwater inspection projects, including the planning, coordination and leadership of underwater inspections. * Ensure quality and safety standards are met. * Ensure compliance with commercial diving regulations and maintain diving equipment and certifications. * Prepare operational and safety manuals / protocols for company’s field work activities. * Track, update and ensure all certifications, registrations and maintenance are current for divers, dive boats and equipment. **Do the Work** * Schedule, coordination, and conduct topside and underwater inspections and condition assessments of piers, seawalls, bridges, dams, and other marine structures. * Exercise direct operational control of assigned diving operations. Lead safety meetings, dive briefings, and project reviews to assess risks and ensure adherence to company safety policies. * Develop and complete project specific dive safety plans, JSAs, and work permits. * Ensure diving operations are conducted in accordance with applicable regulations, company procedures, project requirements, and approved Dive Project Plans. * Direct, supervise, and coordinate assigned divers, diver\-engineers, diver tenders, and support personnel. * Perform data collection and underwater surveys using non\-destructive testing, sonar, photogrammetry, and other inspection technologies. * Ensure dive team personnel maintain required qualifications, certifications, medical fitness, and first aid training. * Maintain required operational records, reports, logs, and documentation. * Stop, suspend, or termin ng program. * Valid commercial diving supervisor certification recognized by the company (e.g., ADCI, IMCA, or equivalent). * Successful completion of a recognized commercial diving supervisor training course. * Current First Aid, CPR, and Oxygen Administration certification. * Successful completion of OSHA 30\-Hour Construction Safety and Health Course or equivalent. * Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred. * Proficiency with operating a boat and dive equipment, sonar systems, underwater surveying tools, and material testing/sampling tools. * Familiarity with ROV/AUV, side scan sonar, LIDAR systems preferred. * Familiarity with ASCE 130 MOP preferred. Physical Demands and Working Environment: * Primarily outdoor work environment, which may include being on watercraft, adverse weather conditions, varying temperatures, excessive noise, and/or potential hazards. * Successfully complete a company\-required occupational health screening program. * Successfully complete a United States Coast Guard Merchant Mariner Physical Examination, when required. * Successfully complete and maintain compliance with DOT drug and alcohol screening requirements. * If assigned diving duties, maintain a valid annual diver medical fitness examination issued by a qualified Diving Medical Physician. * Must be able to lift, carry, and maneuver diving and inspection equipment. * Tolerance for cold, low\-visibility, and confined underwater environments. * Travel and fieldwork in various marine and coastal locations may be required. \#LI\-BJ1 About Bowman: Are you ready to build a career that makes a lasting impact? At Bowman, our people are at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, while helping to shape the infrastructure of tomorrow. A career at Bowman means being part of a collaborative, forward\-thinking organization where innovation, inclusion, and growth are encouraged at every level. We offer competitive compensation, a supportive work environment, and benefits designed to help our employees succeed. Salary and eligible variable compensation (if any) commensurate with experience. Range $97,000 \- $123,000 and includes a comprehensive benefits package. **Our comprehensive benefits package includes:*** Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance * 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match * Paid time off, sick leave, and paid holidays * Tuition reimbursement and professional development support * Discretionary bonuses and other performance\-based incentives * Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness initiatives, and employee discounts Eligibility for certain benefits may vary based on position, location, and employment status. Job Description Disclaimer: Note: While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, it is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary at any time with or without notice. Bowman is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you’d like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. jobs.title: FEA Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** The FEA Engineer II develops and applies finite element analysis (FEA), nonlinear material modeling, and engineering automation to support footwear development and improve engineering decision\-making at Brooks. This role independently owns well\-defined simulation studies, from problem definition and model development through material calibration, validation, result interpretation, and communication of engineering recommendations. The engineer applies established simulation methods, develops and improves models for assigned applications, and contributes to expanding trusted simulation capabilities across footwear development. Working closely with Design, Materials, Testing, Run Research, and other engineering partners, the engineer translates product and performance questions into technically sound simulation studies and actionable engineering insights. The role also contributes to automation, design exploration, and emerging capabilities that connect physics\-based simulation with optimization, machine learning, and AI\-enabled design workflows. Your Responsibilities **Modeling \& Simulation (ModSIM)** * Apply established modeling practices and develop or improve material models and simulation methods for assigned footwear engineering applications * Develop, calibrate, and validate nonlinear material models for footwear materials, including foams, elastomers, polymers, and composite systems using established modeling approaches and validation practices. * Implement and maintain validated material models across appropriate simulation platforms and solvers such as Abaqus, OptiStruct, and Radioss. * Define appropriate model assumptions, contacts, boundary conditions, load cases, and solution methods for well\-defined nonlinear footwear simulations using established modeling practices. * Contribute to the development and improvement of digital test methods that reproduce relevant physical tests and enable quantitative simulation\-to\-test correlation. * Use experimental data to assess simulation accuracy and identify opportunities to improve material models, boundary conditions, and existing modeling methodology. * Document modeling assumptions, calibration methods, validation results, applicability, and limitations to enable consistent application and reuse of simulation methods. * Apply appropriate implicit and explicit finite element methods based on the engineering problem and loading conditions. * Apply established geometry preparation, meshing, and model\-build workflows to efficiently create high\-quality finite element models. * Consult with senior engineers or technical leaders when simulation problems require significant changes to established methods or involve unusually high technical uncertainty. **Footwear Simulation and Engineering Applications** * Own assigned simulation studies and translate engineering questions into actionable product\-development recommendations * Execute FEA and engineering analyses to support footwear development, innovation, and athlete\-related engineering projects * Translate well\-defined design and performance questions into appropriate simulation studies, engineering metrics, and measurable engineering outputs. * Evaluate material, geometry, and structural design alternatives across footwear components, including sockliners, midsoles, outsoles, and plates, using established simulation methods to understand engineering and performance trade\-offs and inform design decisions. * Integrate physical testing and experimental data into assigned simulation studies to assess model accuracy and support engineering conclusions. * Collaborate with Design, Materials, Testing, Run Research, and engineering teams to execute simulation studies and support footwear performance decisions. * Clearly communicate actionable findings, engineering implications, assumptions, uncertainty, and model limitations to technical and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Manage assigned simulation activities to deliver technically sound results within agreed project scope and timing. **Simulation Scale, Standardization, and Automation** * Improve simulation efficiency and consistency by contributing to reusable methods, workflows, and engineering tools. * Contribute to development and refinement of FEA templates, methods, and workflows for recurring footwear simulation applications. * Reuse and adapt validated material models, simulation methods, and model assets across projects to reduce duplicated engineering effort. * Develop Python and other engineering automation tools for preprocessing, model generation, simulation execution, post\-processing, data analysis, and reporting. * Automate repetitive or high\-volume simulation tasks to improve engineering efficiency, consistency, and throughput. * Contribute to geometry, material and simulation asset libraries with appropriate documentation and traceability. * Support the implementation of validated methods across appropriate sim -experiments, parameter studies, optimization studies, and automated design\-exploration workflows. * Support the exploration and evaluation of methods for rapidly evaluating geometry, material, and structural design alternatives while maintaining appropriate physics\-based constraints. * Support the integration of physics\-based simulation and validated experimental data into AI\-enabled prediction and design workflows. * Independently execute assigned proof\-of\-concept studies to assess predictive accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and engineering usefulness of AI\-enabled methods. * Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to evaluate promising applications for these methods. * Contribute to transitioning successful technical explorations into documented, validated, and reusable engineering workflows. **Work Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or a related engineering discipline. * 5\+ years of professional experience developing finite element models using Abaqus, Altair OptiStruct, Radioss, or comparable FEA solvers and preprocessing tools such as HyperMesh, including meshing, contact definition, boundary conditions, and model quality assessment. * Experience independently developing and executing nonlinear FEA to footwear, sporting goods, soft materials, consumer products, or similarly complex products. * Experience developing nonlinear material models for foams, elastomers, composites, or other nonlinear material systems. * Strong understanding of solid mechanics, nonlinear material behavior, contact mechanics, boundary conditions, and interpretation of simulation results. * Experience connecting material\-level behavior to component\- and system\-level product performance. * Experience with both implicit and explicit finite\-element methods. * Experience with design optimization, design of experiments, parameter studies, or automated design exploration. * Experience with material calibration, experimental data interpretation, and simulation\-to\-test correlation. * Programming or scripting experience, preferably Python, for engineering automation, data processing, simulation workflow development, or user\-defined subroutines. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Ability to translate physical engineering problems into appropriate computational models and clearly communicate results and limitations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or a related discipline * Experience with surrogate modeling, physics\-informed machine learning, or other data\-driven computational methods. * Experience developing reusable simulation workflows, material libraries, or automated engineering tools. * Familiarity with CATIA and 3DEXPERIENCE **Benefits** Brooks is proud to offer a robust benefits package to our employees and their families! * Benefits\- including medical, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, disability insurance, HSA and employer contribution, FSA, family \& fertility assistance, 401K Savings Plan and match, employee assistance program, and transportation assistance. * Paid Time Off\- Brooks offers generous time off including five weeks of paid time off, eleven paid holidays, paid sick and parental leave. * Bonus\- in addition to base pay, Brooks employees may also be offered an annual bonus based on company performance. * Perks\- including product discounts, employee recognition, fitness discounts, volunteer and donation benefits. * Location\- You will spend 4 days per week in our Seattle offices, as we believe our organization flourishes when connections, collaboration, creativity, problem\-solving, and celebrations happen in person. **Compensation:** The pay range for this position, based out of the Brooks Seattle HQ, is $104,217 \- $156,325 per year. Base pay offered will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer In Test
jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world\-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective – this enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have a growing triple digit fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. Reporting to the Director of Software Platform \& Integration, we are seeking a highly motivated **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test** with experience in robotics and autonomous systems to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our robotics software, working closely with our User Acceptance Testing, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to ensure seamless development, testing, simulation, and deployment workflows, and helping to design, build, and deploy cutting\-edge agricultural and industrial autonomous robots. We are looking for a teammate who shares our enthusiasm for working with collaborative robots made to handle the tedious and physically demanding parts of agricultural work, has a passion for delivering a high\-quality end\-to\-end user experience, and maintains a collaborative attitude that supports and uplifts everyone they work with. ### **Responsibilities:** * Extend and maintain simulation\-based testing frameworks with Isaac and Gazebo, creating scenarios for our virtual fleet in industrial and agricultural environments. * Create and maintain ROS\-based testing frameworks for C\+\+ and Python robotics software applications, including functional, regression, integration, performance, acceptance, and stress testing on amd64 robotic platforms in both simulated and real\-world environments. * Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate software functionality and performance across robotic systems, including embedded software, and cloud\-based services. * Drive the integration of QA processes into continuous integration, deployment, and testing (CI/CD/CT) pipelines, ensuring consistency and reliability. * Build and maintain internal tools and dashboards to monitor the health and performance of testing systems, collaborating with the Platform team on shared monitoring infrastructure to provide critical insights. * Identify, document, and track software defects and bugs, working closely with development teams for efficient resolution. * Support field testing and validation of autonomous systems in agricultural and industrial settings. * Collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and other cross\-functional teams to understand product requirements and specifications, to define and validate user acceptance criteria, and to provide timely feedback. * Advocate for overall product quality and promote best practices across the engineering organization. * Conduct periodic on\-site physical testing of robots (a few days per month), involving physical activity and requiring year\-round presence at both the Philadelphia office and the outdoor Phoenixville test farm. Serve as backup for the User Acceptance Technician as needed. ### **Requirements:** Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or test engineering, preferably in robotics, embedded systems, or autonomous systems. * Strong experience designing and implementing software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills and a keen attention to detail. * Experience with robotic simulation tools such as NVIDIA Isaac or Gazebo. * Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a dynamic team environment. * Familiarity with ROS (Robot Operating System) or similar robotics middleware. * Proficiency in Python, Typescript/Javascript, C\+\+, and shell scripting for test automation. * Proficiency with Linux\-based development environments. * Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git). * Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. Desired Qualifications * Experience robustly testing robotic software systems in simulation and data\-replay settings that may not be deterministic. * Experience working with 3D assets as used in simulation software. * Knowledge of computer vision and machine learning testing practices. * Familiarity with safety standards and compliance testing for autonomous systems. * Experience testing hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) systems. * A background in agricultural technology, industrial automation, or outdoor robotics. ### **Perks:** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave RECRUITERS: We are not accepting agency resumes for this position. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Pretraining Data
jobs.description: Engineering · Full\-time · Palo Alto, CA SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. **SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PRETRAINING DATA** We're looking for Senior Software Engineers to build and own the data systems behind our frontier models' initial training. You'll work on large\-scale crawling, data platform, and pipeline infrastructure, turning raw dumps into the datasets our models train on, and making iteration with researchers fast and reliable. As a senior engineer, you'll set technical direction for these systems, lead projects across teams, and mentor other engineers as our pretraining data scales. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Data Platform:** Design, build, and scale the distributed infrastructure that transforms raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training\-ready datasets for frontier model pretraining. Own high\-throughput data pipelines, orchestration systems, and tooling that enable fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible data processing at massive scale, with end\-to\-end visibility into data lineage, freshness, and pipeline health. * **Data Quality:** Build and deploy high\-performance models and algorithms to classify, rank, deduplicate, filter, and clean training data at extreme throughput. Design and execute rigorous experiments across data mixtures, sampling strategies, and quality thresholds to quantify their impact on training loss, downstream evaluations, and model capabilities, translating research findings into production systems. * **Crawling:** Build and optimize large\-scale web crawling infrastructure spanning URL discovery, prioritization, host scheduling, fetching, parsing, and content extraction. Improve crawl coverage, efficiency, and reliability through intelligent scheduling, anti\-bot resilience, robust extraction systems, and automated recovery, ensuring high\-quality web data flows seamlessly into downstream training pipelines. * **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration:** Lead complex engineering initiatives across Data Platform, Data Quality, Crawling, Acquisition, and model training teams. Influence technical direction, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and translate improvements in data infrastructure, coverage, and quality into measurable gains in model performance. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems and/or large\-scale data infrastructure ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Strong infrastructure or data platform background, ideally with a spike of outlier depth * High\-slope engineer who has moved unusually fast (e.g., staff\-level ownership within a few years) or brings relevant domain experience * Able to architect and ship end\-to\-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents * Strong intuitions about large\-scale distributed systems, including running them reliably at frontier scale * Track record of leading technical projects across teams and mentoring other engineers * Excited to learn how pre\-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs ### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Palo Alto office **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. **Annual Salary:** $220,000 \- $357,000 USD Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job\-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.description: Applied Researcher 5 At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real\-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world\-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. * Leverage a broad stack of technologies; Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, and more, to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. * Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. * Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. * Lead cross\-functional research threads that bridge prototype model development and deployment with ML engineering partners, ensuring scientific insights translate to production impact **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. jobs.description: **Career Area:** Engineering**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. You will pioneer an 'Agentic IDE' concept tailored for our unique, offline\-first, embedded systems environment. This isn't about plugging into a simple cloud API, it's about fundamentally re\-imagining the developer workflow for a world of hardware and electrical design, controls, embedded C\+\+, and heavy machinery. The CTCT division (a joint venture between Trimble and Caterpillar) develops positioning, control, and automation products for earthmoving and paving machines in the construction and mining industries, using technologies such as GNSS, optical total stations, lasers and sonics. The products are used in a range of applications where the operator of the machine benefits from having accurate horizontal and vertical guidance. For more information on currently developed products, see https://www.cat.com/en\_US/by\-industry/construction\-industry\-resources/technology/grade.html or http://construction.trimble.com/earthworks. With CTCT being a globally distributed group, travel to New Zealand and India will also be a requirement from time to time. **What You Will Do:** * **Architect the Vision:** Define and champion the roadmap for our AI\-powered developer tools, creating an 'agentic' experience where the IDE acts as an expert partner to our engineers. * **Lead \& Build:** This is a hands\-on role. You will design, prototype, and build the core components of these new tools, from custom IDE extensions and CLIs to intelligent code generation and analysis services. * **Deeply Collaborate:** Work side\-by\-side with our hardware, electrical, controls, and software engineers. You will live in their world to understand their deepest pain points and build the solutions they truly need. * **Integrate \& Optimize:** Evaluate and integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), static analysis tools, and other AI techniques into our existing CI/CD pipelines and development environments (e.g., VS Code, OpenCode, MATLAB/Simulink, etc.). * **Mentor \& Evangelize:** Act as the subject matter expert, advocating for best practices and mentoring other engineers in the art of the possible with AI\-driven development. **What You Will Have:** Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Extensive Experience: * Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances. * Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation. * Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research. * Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action. * Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts. * Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Extensive Experience: * Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching. * Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience. * Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position. * Communicates well downward, upward, and outward. * Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement. * Maintains focus on the topic at hand. Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and vario i\-component failures. * Creates and oversees policies and procedures to ensure alignment with product and service requirements. * Builds standards to design and support troubleshooting situations and maintain cost effectiveness. * Develops and demonstrates an extensive knowledge base and best practice on how to troubleshoot non\-recurring and performance\-related problems. **Skills and Experience You Should Bring:** We know 'Senior Developer Experience Engineer (Agentic IDE)' isn't a common title, and you may not have heard it before, so please don’t be put off! We're looking for a seasoned engineer with a track record of building exceptional developer tools and a deep curiosity for the potential of AI. * **A Proven Platform Builder:** You have solid experience and a history of architecting and building complex developer platforms, infrastructure, or sophisticated tooling from the ground up. * **Polyglot Programmer:** You are an expert in high\-level languages like Python or TypeScript (for tooling and services) and are comfortable diving into, or at least deeply understanding, the complexities of C\+\+ and its build systems, and MATLAB/Simulink toolchains. * **Pragmatic AI Practitioner:** You have demonstrable experience applying AI/ML to software development. This could include: + Integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and/or running smaller, local models (e.g., Llama, Mistral). + Familiarity with frameworks like LangChain, or experience building custom AI agentic workflows. + A strong understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and fine\-tuning. * **Systems Thinker:** You excel at understanding complex, interconnected systems—from electrical and hardware design and MATLAB/Simulink control models to the embedded C\+\+ firmware running on our custom hardware. * **Empathetic Communicator:** You have an exceptional ability to listen, synthesize needs from diverse engineering groups, and articulate a clear, compelling vision that gets others excited. You build consensus, not just code. **Top Candidates Will Have Skills:** * Direct experience building IDE extensions for tools like VS Code, OpenCode, or MATLAB/Simulink. * A background in compilers, static/dynamic code analysis, or working with Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs). * Experience with embedded systems, model\-based design/code generation, or hardware/electrical engineering toolchains. * Contributions to open\-source developer tools or AI frameworks. **Additional Information:** * Location is onsite in Mossville, IL five days per week * Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Caterpillar policies. * Sponsorship is not available for this position. * Travel is 20% \#LI **Summary Pay Range:** $128,470\.00 \- $192,710\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Applied ML
jobs.description: ### **About Circuit** Circuit is the AI execution layer for the physical economy. Industrial and manufacturing enterprises run on expertise: the hard\-won knowledge of how complex products are engineered, configured, sold, and supported. That expertise is scarce, slow to transfer, and walking out the door as a generation of experts retires. It lives in PDFs, spreadsheets, and the heads of a few people, and the hardest technical decisions wait on whoever happens to know. Circuit puts expert judgment in everyone's hands. We capture how the best people make critical technical decisions and turn it into agents that do the judgment\-heavy work, so anyone, regardless of skill level, can make the right call, from quote to install and support, with the accuracy these environments demand. Circuit is built by operators. Our leadership team has built and scaled real industrial companies, and we are already live in production with category\-leading manufacturers. We are not bolting AI onto an old playbook. We are building the layer that runs the last mile of how the physical economy executes. ### **The Role** As a Staff Engineer, Applied ML at Circuit, you’ll join Product Engineering and build the machine learning capabilities that power our product. You’ll work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), Product Engineers, and directly with design customers to understand real\-world challenges and turn them into robust, scalable solutions. A core part of your role is recognizing where a customer need points to a broader product capability, then building it to work across customers and use cases. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on solving current product and customer problems. You’ll use advances in ML where they help, exercise judgment about what is ready to ship, and own solutions end to end, with attention to accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. Success means delivering capabilities that make Circuit’s product more useful, reliable, and broadly applicable. You’ll draw primarily on LLMs, alongside traditional NNs and statistical models, choosing and combining approaches based on the problem. Your work will span understanding customer use cases and how users interact with the product, data and process modeling, understanding what exists today and how to build on it, evaluation, production implementation, and, where it pays off, model training and fine\-tuning. Most importantly, you’ll work end to end with our design customers, building solutions for them. Beyond individual features, you’ll help build shared capabilities such as Circuit’s evaluation framework, improving how we measure quality and catch regressions across the product. As priorities evolve, you’ll apply your engineering judgment wherever it can make the greatest impact. Product Engineering builds the core platform and works directly with customers and design partners. Our FDE teams own solutions architecture and technical demonstrations. You’ll work alongside them on what gets built, and partner with Core ML engineers when a customer problem calls for deeper work on our document models or the agent loop. Your teammates range from full\-stack engineers to applied ML researchers. **This position is based in Austin, TX, onsite 3 days/week.** ### **What Is in Production Today** Our core product includes a long\-running agent loop written in Go. Frontier model APIs drive the loop, while specialized tools handle retrieval, extraction, and agent execution. These tools let us solve industrial problems that general\-purpose agent harnesses struggle with. We use a combination of open\-source and internally fine\-tuned models, particularly vision\-language models (VLMs), hosted on KServe. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Core ML
jobs.description: ### **About Circuit** Circuit is the AI execution layer for the physical economy. Industrial and manufacturing enterprises run on expertise: the hard\-won knowledge of how complex products are engineered, configured, sold, and supported. That expertise is scarce, slow to transfer, and walking out the door as a generation of experts retires. It lives in PDFs, spreadsheets, and the heads of a few people, and the hardest technical decisions wait on whoever happens to know. Circuit puts expert judgment in everyone's hands. We capture how the best people make critical technical decisions and turn it into agents that do the judgment\-heavy work, so anyone, regardless of skill level, can make the right call, from quote to install and support, with the accuracy these environments demand. Circuit is built by operators. Our leadership team has built and scaled real industrial companies, and we are already live in production with category\-leading manufacturers. We are not bolting AI onto an old playbook. We are building the layer that runs the last mile of how the physical economy executes. ### **The Role** As a Staff Engineer, Core ML at Circuit, you’ll join Product Engineering and own the ML capabilities at the center of our product: understanding complex technical documents, and keeping the long\-running agents that work with them reliable. Our customers’ knowledge lives in blueprints, CAD files, spec sheets, and scanned PDFs that mix text, vector geometry, and raster content. You’ll build the models and algorithms that turn those documents into structured information, and the tools that let our agents use it. You’ll also improve the agent loop itself: how agents plan, choose tools, recover from failure, and behave consistently from one run to the next. Most of your time goes into the algorithms and models behind the product rather than individual customer projects. Product engineers and FDEs work closest to customers and bring you the failure patterns they see. You analyze how our models and agents perform, decide where better algorithms, data, or training will pay off, and set the evaluation bar that tells us whether a change worked. You’ll join customer conversations when a problem needs your depth. This is an applied role, not a research one. You’ll adapt and combine proven approaches, measure them against real customer data, and ship them. Your teammates range from full\-stack engineers to applied ML researchers, and success is measured by what reaches production, not papers published. **This position is based in Austin, TX, onsite 3 days/week.** ### **What Is in Production Today** Our core product includes a long\-running agent loop written in Go. Frontier model APIs drive the loop, while specialized tools handle retrieval, extraction, and agent execution. These tools let us solve industrial problems that general\-purpose agent harnesses struggle with. We use a combination of open\-source and internally fine\-tuned models, particularly vision\-language models (VLMs), hosted on KServe. Our customer data includes technical documents, high\-resolution blueprints, raster images, vector geometry, CAD, and structured data. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop algorithms that extract meaning from complex technical documents containing text, vector geometry, CAD, and raster content, spanning vision models, geometric algorithms, and language understanding. * Build those document understanding capabilities into the tools that power Circuit's long\-running agentic systems. * Improve the reliability, determinism, and effectiveness of agentic systems, including agent planning, tool use, and failure recovery. * Build and extend training and evaluation pipelines for our core models and agents, so every change is measured against real customer data before it ships. * Analyze how our algorithms perform in production, find where and why they fail, and turn that into the next improvement. * Find gaps and bias in our datasets, and close them through curation, labeling, or synthetic data. * Track new research and techniques, and make the promising ones work in production. * Mentor and elevate other engineers on the team. ### **Examples of Work You Could Own** * **Fix a failure class.** Trace why extraction breaks on a class of drawings, such as dense electrical schematics, fix it with better data, a better model, or a better algorithm, and show the lift in the evals. * **Fine\-tune a specialized model.** Fine\-tune a LoRA on an in\-house model to extract a specialized artifact from a high\-resolution blueprint page. * **Bring a new algorithm to production.** Take an approach from a recent paper, such as a new layout or table\-structure model, prove it beats what we run today on our data, and make it fast and reliable enough to ship. * **Improve retrieval.** Improve retrieval quality, relevance, or latency across document types and customers. * **Make agents more deterministic.** Find why the same task produces different result ization You do not need to be an expert in every area. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to lead technical decisions matter more than familiarity with our exact stack. Beyond that, we look for: * Hands\-on AI/ML engineering experience, with a track record of shipping models in production. * Experience training and fine\-tuning models for production, including the datasets and pipelines behind them. * Experience building and operating ML evaluation pipelines, including datasets, metrics, and regression testing for models and agents in production. * Experience profiling data distributions, identifying gaps and bias, and curating high\-quality datasets for training and evaluation. * Experience with vision and multimodal models, especially on technical documents (PDFs, CAD) with text, vector geometry, and raster content. * Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles. * Proven expertise with LLMs, deep learning systems, and applied ML. * Experience debugging production ML systems using AI observability tools (e.g. Langfuse, Opik, etc.), tracing failures to root cause. * Proficiency in Python and relevant ML frameworks (PyTorch, vLLM, etc.). * Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools. You write effective prompts, iterate when output is wrong, and reliably tell working code from code that only looks right. * Bonus: Computational geometry, or experience with vector drawing formats such as CAD and vector PDFs. * Bonus: Go, the language our agent loop is written in. * Bonus: Familiarity with construction, civil engineering, or related industries where interpreting complex technical drawings and specifications is central to the work. ### **Human Skills** * Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering working systems in production. * Strong product judgment, with an understanding of how system behavior impacts user experience and trust. * Rigorous reviewer of agent instructions, skills, and documentation, ensuring they’re clear, unambiguous, and reliable for agents to act on. * Curiosity about how systems behave in practice and how customers use them. * Bias toward shipping. You take ambiguous problems and drive them to working solutions without needing the path fully defined for you. * Judgment about what is ready to ship, and the willingness to push back to keep the work grounded in customer outcomes. * Clear communicator. You explain ML tradeoffs to engineers, FDEs, and product stakeholders in plain terms, and share progress early. * Critical evaluation of AI output. You spot hallucinated APIs, incorrect logic, and subtle bugs before they reach production. * Systems thinking, including attention to correctness, determinism, and failure modes in long\-running agents. * Rigor about measurement. You measure before you claim an improvement, and you can tell a real gain from noise in an eval. * Raises the bar for the team through design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring. * Low ego, with a focus on team outcomes. ### **What We Offer** * High\-caliber team of seasoned manufacturing and AI leaders * Help create a category\-defining platform transforming how manufacturers sell, support, and innovate * Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and employer\-paid benefits * Flexible PTO and access to the latest AI tools * A values\-driven culture that rewards ownership, curiosity and velocity ### **Who Should Apply** If you want to own the models and algorithms at the center of our product, from understanding complex technical documents to keeping long\-running agents reliable, and you measure success by what reaches production rather than what gets published, we want to talk. You don’t need to check every box. ### **Equal\-Opportunity Employer** We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Data Integration & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Citrin Cooperman offers a dynamic work environment, fostering professional growth and collaboration. We’re continuously seeking talented individuals who bring a problem\-solving mindset, fresh perspectives, and sharp technical expertise. We know you have choices, so our team of collaborative, innovative professionals are ready to support your professional development. At Citrin Cooperman, we offer competitive compensation and benefits and most importantly, the flexibility to manage your personal and professional life to focus on what matters most to you! We are actively building a Data Operations team to establish and scale our foundational enterprise data platform using Microsoft Fabric. We are looking for a self\-directed **Data Integration \& Automation Engineer** to design, build, and own the integrations and automated workflows that connect our business systems to that platform and to the people who rely on it. In this role, you will be a key part of our operational core, focusing on the integration and automation work that keeps data moving reliably between systems. You will work across Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, and Notebooks), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, and Dataverse), and Azure Integration Services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Service Bus) to connect enterprise systems and legacy on\-premises systems, third\-party APIs, and business teams. Working closely with our Data Engineers, you will take ownership of integrations from design through daily operation, meet directly with business stakeholders to turn their process needs into technical designs, and exercise independent judgment in choosing tools and design patterns. The ideal candidate is an experienced builder who can explain technical trade\-offs in plain business terms, works well without close supervision, and treats every integration as a system someone will have to support long after go\-live. **Responsibilities are, but not limited to:** * **Integration Design \& Development**: Design, build, and deploy integrations between business systems, Dataverse, Azure, and Microsoft Fabric using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and Fabric Data Factory, choosing between real\-time, event\-driven, and batch patterns based on business need. * **Process Automation**: Turn manual, error\-prone business processes into automated workflows using Power Automate, Power Apps, and Dataverse plugins, with proper error handling, logging, and retry logic. * **Data Migration**: Plan and carry out data migrations from legacy and on\-premises systems, including source analysis, field mapping, data cleansing, reconciliation, and cutover planning. * **Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements**: Work directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, map current processes, and recommend solutions. Explain design options, costs, and risks in plain language, and set realistic expectations on scope and timelines. * **Operational Monitoring \& Support**: Take ownership of the health of integrations and automated workflows. Monitor runs, troubleshoot failures, find root causes, and ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for data delivery are consistently met. * **Data Security \& AI Readiness**: Apply data governance, security, and access controls (including Microsoft Entra ID and role\-based access) to all integrations and automations. Help prepare governed, well\-documented data that Copilot and other AI tools can use safely. * **Standards, Version Control \& CI/CD**: Set and follow design and coding standards for integration and automation work. Manage solutions in Git and Azure DevOps, use automated deployments across environments, and review the work of other engineers. **The ideal candidate must have:** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. * Preferred Certifications: + Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL\-600\) + Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL\-400\) + Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ\-204\) + Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\) * 5\+ years of professional experience in software development, systems integration, or data engineering, including at least 3 years building integrations or automation on Microsoft Azure or Power Platform. * Hands\-on experience integrating ERP systems (such as Dynamics 365, SAP, or similar) with cloud platforms, including at least one data migration project from start to finish. * Strong proficiency with Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, and Azure Integration Services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Service Bus). * Working experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or Azure Synapse Analytics, along with strong SQL skills. * Development experience in C\# / .NET and REST APIs, including Dataverse plugins or custom connectors. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders: gathering requirements, presenting design options, and managing scope. * Familiarity with source control (Git), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD for Power Platform and Azure solutions. * Preferred: experience with data governance and security for AI and Copilot solutions, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. * The following personal attributes: + **Self\-Directed**: Takes a loosely defined business problem and turns it into a working solution without needing step\-by\-step direction. Knows when to make a decision alone and when to bring others in. + **Clear Communicator**: Explains technical options, trade\-offs, and risks to non\-technical stakeholders in plain language, and pushes back when a request will cause problems later. + **Reliability\-Focused**: Values stability and predictability. Understands that the best integration is one nobody has to think about because it runs, alerts, and recovers as designed. + **Detail\-Oriented**: Cares about field mapping, error handling, and naming conventions, knowing that a small mistake in one integration spreads to every system downstream.
