If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Commure's data warehouse platform end\-to\-end. You'll design, build, and operate every layer of the stack: * CDC pipelines * Streaming transport * Schema governance and data contracts * Query and serving layer * Analytics platform The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands\-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and establish the patterns and conventions on the data platform. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the data warehouse platform end\-to\-end: CDC pipelines, data lake, query layer, transformation layer, and the analytics\-facing tooling that sits on top. * Design and operate CDC pipelines with Debezium (and Kafka, Redpanda, or an equivalent streaming backbone) that move data from operational databases into the warehouse with low latency and high fidelity. * Architect the data lake on object storage using an open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) with Parquet, enabling both batch and streaming workloads and clean separation of storage from compute. * Run and scale StarRocks (or adjacent MPP/lakehouse engines) as the query and serving layer \- schema design, materialized views, ingestion patterns, tuning, and cost/performance trade\-offs. * Build the transformation layer with dbt: modeling standards, tests, documentation, and a semantic layer that gives every team a single source of truth for metrics. * Stand up orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) and the CI/CD, observability, and data\-quality tooling that make the platform trustworthy day\-to\-day. * Partner with Security and Compliance on PHI/PII handling, access controls, lineage, and auditability so the platform meets HIPAA and SOC 2 bar by default. * Collaborate with product and analytics teams on schema contracts, ingestion patterns, and self\-serve tooling so they can build on the platform with confidence. **What You Have** ----------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building or operating data platforms at scale. * Experience across the modern data stack: CDC (Debezium or equivalent), streaming (Kafka, Redpanda), data lake formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), an MPP or lakehouse query engine (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, Databricks), and dbt. * Fluent in SQL, schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about cost and latency trade\-offs on large datasets. * Experience running production data infrastructure (orchestration, observability, on\-call, data quality, and incident response). ### **Preferred** * Direct experience with Debezium, StarRocks, and dbt in production. * Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs / lineage (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen). * Experience with HIPAA\-regulated data (PHI handling, de\-identification, and access governance). * Experience powering AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training\-set curation, embedding pipelines, or retrieval systems. * Experience across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes controllers. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Curve Dental:** Curve Dental builds cloud\-based practice management software for dental offices. More than 8,000 practices across North America run on our three brands — Curve, Flex Dental, and DentalHQ — along with our embedded payments products, Curve Pay and Flex Payments. **The role** ------------ We are looking for a full\-time Data Engineer to own the data platforms that finance, sales, and customer success run the business on. This position will report directly to the CFO and work closely with leaders across the company. Snowflake is our warehouse and Tableau our reporting layer. We are modernizing how data gets in and how it is transformed, and you will help lead that work. Your job is to make the platform reliable, extend it to every core system, and deliver a single trusted view of each customer. Occasional travel may be required to one of our Corporate office locations (Georgia and Utah)**What you'll do in year one** ------------------------------ **Build Customer360\.** Design and deliver a unified customer model in Snowflake that ties together contracts, billing, payments, product usage, support, and sales activity. Every team should be able to answer "what is happening with this practice?" from one source. **Harden the warehouse.** * Modernize ingestion and stand up a transformation layer, then make the pipeline reliable: automated testing, alerting, and documented recovery when a load fails * Own data models and metric definitions so finance and operating reports tie out * Manage Snowflake performance and credit spend; report usage and cost monthly * Set up access controls, environments (dev/prod), and version control practices **Integrate core source systems.** Bring and maintain, modeled data from Salesforce, Maxio, Stripe, Gong, and NetSuite into Snowflake, and resolve customer identity across them. **Support reporting.** Partner with finance and RevOps to ensure dashboards and board metrics run on governed, tested data. **What you bring** ------------------ **Required** * 3–6 years in data engineering, with at least 2 years running production workloads on Snowflake * Strong knowledge and skills in SQL and Python * Hands\-on experience with a modern transformation framework such as dbt: modeling, testing, documentation * Experience with managed ELT tools (such as Fivetran or Airbyte), including migrating pipelines between tools * A track record of building dimensional or entity models that business users trust * Comfortable working directly with non\-technical stakeholders and translating business questions into data design **Nice to have** * SaaS data: subscriptions, billing, ARR, churn * Salesforce data model experience; exposure to Maxio, Stripe, or NetSuite data * Snowflake cost management (warehouses, resource monitors, query tuning) * SnowPro certification * Experience as the first or only data engineer at a growing company **How we work** --------------- This role sits at the center of how the business runs, so responsiveness and clear communication matter as much as technical skill. We are explicit about what that means: * **Dedicated role.** This is a full\-time position with Curve Dental as your sole employer; no concurrent client or consulting work. * **Core hours.** Available 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday through Friday, regardless of your home time zone. * **Response times.** Be a responsive, reliable partner to Sales, Account Management, and Finance: acknowledge requests promptly, follow up the same day, and treat production issues as a top priority. * **Visible work.** All work lives in a shared backlog with status kept current. Changes go through version control and code review. * **Weekly cadence.** A 30\-minute priorities meeting with the CFO each week, plus a short written status update. * **Written first.** Document and explain the logic behind every model and report you build: the assumptions, data sources, definitions, and calculations, so others can understand, trust, and maintain it * **Raise issues early.** If a deadline is at risk or a request is unclear, say so the same day rather than at the deadline. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- We offer a competitive base salary and annual bonus, benchmarked to the market for this role and level. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols. * 2 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling. * 2 years of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages. * Experience utilizing Agentic AI frameworks or developer kits to build and deploy autonomous AI systems. * Experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, incident response, SOC analyst, incident response, malware research, threat analysis). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 5 years of experience in security engineering, detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting. * Experience investigating security events across Linux, containerized or sandboxed environments, cloud infrastructure, or corporate endpoints. * Experience building or tuning behavioral detections, LLM\-based evaluators, or multi\-agent workflows, and measuring detection effectiveness. * Experience operating in an on\-call capacity, managing security escalations, and working with cross\-functional teams. * Experience with internal security, data, or AI ecosystems. * Knowledge of frontier AI and agentic security risks, sandbox escape, prompt injection, or training environment tampering. **About the job** ----------------- Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities. As a Security Engineer on DeepMind Agentic Detection and Response in New York, you will be at the intersection of security operations, trajectory forensics, and AI\-powered detection engineering. Because autonomous agents operate at machine speed, we practice "agent\-first" defense: our automated pipelines and multi\-agent workflows absorb Tier\-1 volume and trigger containments, freeing our engineers to manage high\-ambiguity investigations, hunt for novel agentic behaviors, and build the detections and agentic tooling that keep pace with rapidly evolving frontier models. In this role, you will have a true operational and engineering split in a fast\-moving, 0\-to\-1 environment where models, agent harnesses, sandboxes, and telemetry evolve weekly. Because operational security is core to safeguarding continuous frontier training and evaluation runs, this position includes rotational on\-call support, including weekday daytime triage and periodic weekend on\-call coverage. You might reconstruct multi\-step Chain\-of\-Thought and tool\-call trajectories to determine whether an anomaly is benign specification gaming or a real sandbox escape, coordinate live containment and blast\-radius scoping between DeepMind teams and PSS Detection and Response, and build new AI agent skills, detection rubrics, or automated forensic pipelines in Python and SQL. You will deliver substantial technical and investigative contributions across interconnected components with minimal assistance, owning scoped end\-to\-end investigations, detections, and engineering artifacts, and codifying every catch into durable guardrails. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Analyst, Data Science
jobs.description: Data Science is about breaking new ground so businesses can answer their most urgent questions. We’re pioneering Generative AI that turns structured and unstructured data into trusted, AI\-ready data products. Our mission is to build new approaches to knowledge and context engineering that ground AI in accurate, governed enterprise information, and to deliver them reliably at scale. We work with technical experts and skilled engineers so our customers can get insights from data that was once out of reach. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Data Science Analyst on our Data Science Team in **Round Rock, Texas.** **What you’ll achieve** As a Data Science Analyst, you will help build the data and context foundation behind our GenAI capabilities. You will design pipelines that prepare structured and unstructured data for AI, using retrieval, embeddings, metadata and knowledge models to give AI systems the right context. You will help turn these assets into data products that are documented, monitored and supportable, with quality checks and evaluations that let them scale with confidence. You will also partner with business leaders, engineers and technical experts to deliver solutions that drive measurable decisions and outcomes. **You will:** * Work with internal and external teams to understand business partner needs and turn them into AI\-ready data and context requirements * Apply techniques from GenAI, machine learning, statistics and knowledge engineering to prepare structured and unstructured data for trusted, actionable insights * Build and run evaluations of retrieval, context and model quality (accuracy, groundedness, latency, cost) across different GenAI use cases * Own end\-to\-end delivery of data products, from build to monitoring and documentation, while building expertise in context engineering **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * Working knowledge of SQL and Python from coursework, projects or self\-study * Curiosity about GenAI, shown through classes, personal projects or hands\-on exploration of tools like LLMs, prompting or retrieval * Enjoy working with others, asking questions and learning from teammates and mentors * An optimistic, problem\-solving mindset and clear communication, with a focus on helping business partners **Desirable Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree **Who we are** We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. jobs.title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I (PxE A&A)
jobs.description: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high\-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost\-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering\-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio\-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high\-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and support the admission of systems into production with confidence. **Work You'll Do:** * **Outcome\-Driven Accountability:** Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service\-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability\-ensuring high\-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. * **Technical Leadership and Advocacy:** Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, participate in the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and support the admission of systems into production\-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre\-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability\-codified, version\-controlled dashboards and SLO\-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient\-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks\-operating as an infrastructure\-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high\-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co\-defining service\-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. * **Incremental and Iterative Delivery:** Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements\-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement\-rather than big\-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Integration:** Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co\-define service\-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and support the admission decision into production\-holding the segregation\-of\-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. * **Advanced Technical Proficiency:** Develop expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering\-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering\-together with applied  ith excellence. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. **Qualifications** Required: * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. * 2\+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native systems in production, with experience in some of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C\#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks. * 1\+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large\-scale systems\-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on\-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging\-e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre\-production and production; and segregation\-of\-duties controls (least\-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. * 1\+ years of experience with cloud\-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP\-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI\-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure\-as\-code, networking, and multi\-environment management. * Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production\-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. * Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). * Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI\-augmented spec\-driven development. * Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi\-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high\-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $69,400 to $127,900\. EA\_ExpHire EA\_ITS\_ExpHire PXE\_JOBS

jobs.title: Microgrid Application Engineer (Energy Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Who We Are: Founded in 1971, Delta is a global leader in power electronics and energy\-efficient solutions, delivering advanced switching power supplies, thermal management systems, and critical infrastructure technologies. With operations across five continents and nearly 200 global locations, Delta supports industries including data center infrastructure, industrial automation, telecom power, renewable energy, and EV charging. Guided by our mission — *“To provide innovative, clean, and energy\-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow”* — Delta combines engineering excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability and long\-term value creation. **Position Overview****Location:** Plano, Texas, United States **Target Compensation:** $90,000 – $120,000 base salary (commensurate with experience)**Bonus:** Eligible**Work Authorization:** This position is **not eligible for visa sponsorship.** Candidates **must be authorized to work in the United States** on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. The **Microgrid Application Engineer** is responsible for supporting the development, design, and deployment of microgrid and distributed energy solutions, including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), renewable energy integration, power conversion systems (PCS), and microgrid control platforms. This customer\-facing role serves as the technical bridge between customers, sales, engineering, and project teams to develop optimized solutions that meet technical, operational, and commercial requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong power systems knowledge with application engineering and field support experience, helping drive projects from concept development through commissioning and operation. jobs.title: Autonomy Simulation Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last\-mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you! **About the Role** ------------------ The Simulation team builds software, models, and environments to test on\-road autonomous robot behavior and evaluate autonomy changes before deployment. We are hiring an Autonomy Simulation Engineer to improve simulation fidelity and accelerate the development and validation of autonomous delivery robots. You will develop production simulation software and models of robot behavior and interactions with the environment, using real\-world data and repeatable experiments to calibrate and validate them. Working closely with autonomy and robotics engineers, you will own projects from design through validation and report to the Simulation Lead. We expect this role to be hybrid, with some time in\-office and some time remote. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Develop and maintain the simulation engine and supporting software. * Build and improve simulation models of robot behavior, other participants, and their interactions. * Calibrate and validate simulation models against real\-world behavior using controlled, repeatable experiments. * Develop parameterized environments and synthetic scenarios to test conditions and interactions that are difficult to capture in the field. * Investigate differences between simulated and real\-world behavior, identify contributing model assumptions and parameters, and implement improvements. * Improve simulator reproducibility, reliability, usability, and debuggability. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * You have strong production C\+\+ and Python experience. * You can translate real\-world behavior and physical systems into practical software models. * You have experience building closed\-loop or interactive simulation software, with depth in areas such as robot dynamics, physics, road\-user behavior, synthetic scenario generation, or probabilistic modeling. * You have used real\-world data and controlled, repeatable experiments to test, calibrate, or validate software models. * You have experience debugging complex systems and delivering reliable production software using Linux, Git, automated testing, and CI. * Experience applying machine learning to simulation modeling and validating learned models against real\-world data is a plus. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** **Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools:** To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview. **How it works:** Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support \- rather than replace \- human decision\-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI\-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law. **Data Retention, Privacy \& Bias Audit:** Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en\-us/legal/article/ax\-privacy\-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden\-ai.com/metaview/application\-review.

jobs.title: Embedded Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Eagle** --------------- Eagle is on a mission to re\-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K\+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it. This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error\-prone, and slow. We're embedding deep inside the firm and building the Iron Man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment. Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Tom Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. **The Opportunity** ------------------- As an **Embedded Product Manager**, you’ll report to Tom (CTO) and own strategic objectives across our partners. You’ll co\-author our product roadmap, and collaborate with a team of software engineers and civil engineers to define how we reinvent this industry with AI. You get a front\-row seat to building a company within a problem domain that's barely been touched by modern technology. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Be the owner for a specific strategic objective across our partners (e.g., reduce opex by minimizing the administrative burden, expand project margin by accelerating deliverable production) * Embed onsite with our partners to build trust, deeply understand their work, and drive change * Work with a team of forward deployed engineers to deliver outcomes within your objective * Partner with Tom on long term product strategy * Create systems to quantify the impact of our work on the business **Our Values** -------------- * **Ask Why:** We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better. * **Read the Room:** We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another. * **Get on a Flight:** We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed. **Potential Profiles** ---------------------- 5\+ years of experience in the following roles: * **Former founders** who want high ownership and extremely high leverage outcomes. * **Former engineers** who are drawn towards scaling their impact in a more product\-forward role (while still being able to build the 0 1 prototype on occasion) * **Ex\-consultants** who enjoy strategy but crave less red tape and more rapid and iterative implementation * **Product managers** who want to work on ambitious problems with high\-charisma, generative engineers The list is not exhaustive. Do not limit yourself if you don't fit neatly into any of these buckets. **Compensation** ---------------- * Competitive cash compensation ($200K–$250K depending on experience) * Founding equity, scaled to scope **Benefits** ------------ * **Health Insurance:** Full healthcare, medical and dental * **Retirement:** 401(k) * **PTO:** Flexible time off * **Travel:** Company\-paid * **Office:** HQ in New York City **Process** ----------- Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60\-minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer (New Grad 2027)
jobs.description: **Join the Sleep Fitness Movement** ----------------------------------- At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well\-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data\-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health\-conscious consumers in over 34 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2025, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high\-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger. Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting\-edge technology, collaborate with world\-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive \- it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up. **High Standards. No Apologies.** --------------------------------- We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next\-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9\-to\-5\. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60\+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it. **The opportunity** We’re looking for mechanical engineers to help develop products from concept through to production. You’ll be part of a small, mission\-driven team and have significant ownership over decisions. We’re growing quickly so there are ample opportunities for career growth. This role is based out of our San Francisco office 5 days/week, targeting **June/July 2027** start. **How you’ll contribute** * Design, build \& test complex electromechanical systems, including plastic, metal, and soft goods components integrating with novel sensors and actuators. * Help drive designs across the entire development lifecycle, including brainstorming, CAD, prototyping, testing, and ramp into high\-volume production in Asia. * Collaborate with electrical engineering, industrial design, manufacturing, and product team members to develop products from early stage concepts to mass production. * Perform various testing and analyses to ensure designs meet product goals, including thermal, fluid, and structural analyses. **What you need to succeed** * Experience with concept development, feasibility studies, and hands\-on prototyping. * Proficiency with 3D modeling (eg. Solidworks, NX, Creo, etc.). Bonus points for simulation experience. * Familiarity with high volume manufacturing processes, DFM, DFA, tolerance analysis, functional dimensioning and GD\&T. * Familiarity with root cause analysis, DOE, and quality measuring techniques. * BSME or equivalent. MS preferred. * Willingness and ability to travel to Asia as needed. **Why join Eight Sleep?** ------------------------- **Innovation in a culture of excellence** Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged \- it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness. **Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth** From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast\-paced environments aiming for high standards. **Collaboration with exceptional talent** Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast\-paced environment. **Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment** We extend equity participation to every full\-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. **Your own Pod \- and other great benefits** Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod, along with: * Full access to health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents * Supplemental life insurance * Flexible PTO * Commuter benefits to ease your daily commute * Paid parental leave * Lunch in the office At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Compensation Range: $100K \- $130K

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)
jobs.description: **Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)** **Location:** This role requires associates to be in\-office 1\-2 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work\-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Ideal candidates will be able to report to our Pulse Point location in Atlanta, GA. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office. Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law. The **Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)** will build and scale intelligent systems that improve healthcare outcomes. You will design, build, and deploy machine learning and LLM\-based systems, taking models from experimentation to production within assigned client group, business unit or corporate department and utilizing various customer technology platforms. Also responsible for delivery of end\-to\-end application, system development and maintenance on complex multi technology platforms within assigned client group, business unit or corporate department and utilizing various customer technology platforms. **How you will make an impact:** * Maintains active relationships with product, data, engineering, architecture, and business teams to translate business problems into scalable AI/ML solutions. * Applies AI/ML capabilities and modern AI tools to solve meaningful business problems, improve healthcare outcomes, and enable practical adoption across business workflows, digital products, and enterprise applications. * Owns the change request process and may coordinate with other teams as necessary. * Provides technical advice and weighs in on technical decisions that impact cross\-functional teams, including AI/ML and advanced analytics solutions. * Researches and proposes new technologies, keeping abreast of developments in AI and applying them to enterprise use cases where relevant. * Designs, builds, and deploys end\-to\-end ML and LLM\-based systems (data pipelines, models, prompts, APIs, and monitoring). * Develops, evaluates, deploys, and monitors machine learning models for predictive, classification, optimization, personalization, and decision\-support use cases. * Builds applied AI solutions such as semantic search, RAG pipelines, and embedding\-based systems. * Develops production\-ready AI/ML services, APIs, pipelines, and reusable components; improves performance, scalability, reliability, usability, and operational readiness in production. * Performs technical design reviews and code reviews; provides technical leadership through solution design, best practices, troubleshooting, and mentoring junior team members. * Assesses status and supports data information planning. * Coordinates on\-call support and ensures effective monitoring of systems, including AI/ML model performance and reliability. * Mentors others and may lead multiple or small to medium\-sized projects. * Influences engineering standards and technical direction. * Identifies and proposes strategies around technical problems affecting the team, communicates standards, and gains buy\-in on solutions. **Minimum Requirements:** Requires a BA/BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field of study and a minimum of 5 years related experience; experience working with multi\-dimensional platforms, and business and technical applications also required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background. **Preferred Skills, Capabilities and Experiences:** * Masters or PhD preferred. * Advanced Python skills for machine learning and data processing preferred. * Experience across the full ML lifecycle (development, deployment and monitoring) preferred. * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, or modern NLP techniques using vector search technologies like OpenSearch preferred. * Experience building production AI systems (APIs, pipelines, microservices) preferred. * Experience designing evaluation frameworks for ML/LLM systems preferred. * Familiarity with responsible AI principles (fairness, explainability, privacy) preferred. * Experience with cloud\-based ML platforms and scalable architectures (AWS Bedrock, or equivalent AI model cloud providers) preferred. * Healthcare domain experience, including familiarity with data privacy and regulatory requirements preferred. * Multi database and/or multi language preferred. * Experience mentoring others, leading multiple small projects and providing troubleshooting support preferred. Please be advised that Elevance Health only accepts resumes for compensation from agencies that have a signed agreement with Elevance Health. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Elevance Health. Who We Are Elevance Health is a health company dedicated to improving lives and communities – and making healthcare simpler. We are a Fortune 25 company with a longstanding history in the healthcare industry, looking for leaders at all levels of the organization who are passionate about making an impact on our members and the communities we serve. How We Work At Elevance Health, we are creating a culture that is designed to advance our strategy but will also lead to personal and professional growth for our associates. Our values and behaviors are the root of our culture. They are how we achieve our strategy, power our business outcomes and drive our shared success \- for our consumers, our associates, our communities and our business. We offer a range of market\-competitive total rewards that include merit increases, paid holidays, Paid Time Off, and incentive bonus programs (unless covered by a collective bargaining agreement), medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, stock purchase plan, life insurance, wellness programs and financial education resources, to name a few. jobs.title: Physical AI Engineer - Lilly Medicine Foundry
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Lilly is entering an exciting period of growth, and we are committed to delivering innovative medicines to patients around the world. LRL has increasing needs for in\-house manufacture of material for clinical supplies and will therefore construct a new campus to manufacture Clinical Trial (CT) Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) to meet needs for an expanding portfolio (more and new areas), to accelerate development timelines, and to enhance supply chain robustness. The brand\-new facility also known as Lilly Medicine Foundry (LMF) will utilize the latest technology to augment the current clinical supply chain for small molecules (SM), oligonucleotides, peptides, and Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs), monoclonal antibodies and bioconjugates, and add new capabilities including mRNA. The new site will be built using the latest high\-tech equipment, advanced highly integrated and automated manufacturing systems, and have a focus on minimizing the impact to our environment. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Job Description:** As a Physical AI Engineer, in partnership with other teams you will deploy advanced AI models into robotic, computer vision and sensor\-based systems that make the Lilly Medicine Foundry safer, faster and more resilient. You will build and integrate edge\-to\-cloud pattern that connects cameras, sensors, AGVs, co\-bots, drones and quadrupeds to the Foundry data platform, manufacturing execution and closed\-loop quality systems, and you will use simulation and digital twins to validate those systems before they reach GMP areas. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including AI researchers, hardware engineers, OT/IT and automation engineers, Quality, HSE and safety experts, and technology and integration partners (e.g., NVIDIA, AWS), to ensure that our systems are not only high\-performing but also safe, secure, compliant, adaptable, and scalable within dynamic production environments. Initial pilots will run in existing space and labs before moving to the Foundry site. **Key Responsibilities:** * AI Integration: Lead the deployment and integration of advanced AI models (such as machine learning, computer vision, generative AI and agents, and reinforcement learning) into robotic and sensing systems, including cameras, AGVs, co\-bots, drones and quadruped robots, to enhance decision\-making, task execution, and adaptability in real\-world manufacturing environments. Priority use cases include vision\-based changeover, cleaning and dryness verification; spill, lockout/tagout and intrusion detection; predictive maintenance; and site and lab environment monitoring. * Edge\-to\-Cloud Platform and Orchestration: Design, build and operate the reference architecture from sensor to decision (edge, connect, data, intelligence, experience): GPU edge inference on site, models trained in the cloud on AWS, data ingestion through OT/IT integration layers (e.g., Ignition, MQTT, AWS IoT Greengrass, Aveva PI, Azure IoT Hub), and data landed in the Foundry data platform, with orchestration and an ontology spanning all layers. Evaluate build, buy and hybrid options for edge hardware and edge\-to\-cloud software. * System Optimization: Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to optimize AI algorithms and models for real\-time performance on edge hardware in robotics and vision applications, ensuring minimal latency and robust behavior under varying conditions. Manage the model lifecycle, including training, versioning, performance monitoring, drift detection and retraining. * Digital Twins and Simulation: Build and maintain sim\-ready asset libraries from CAD data and the equipment registry, and use simulation platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim) to progress from static to dynamic digital twins of process areas, generate synthetic data for model training, and test robot, co\-bot and AGV behavior and safety rules before deployment. Support twin\-based use cases such as lockout/tagout and SOP guidance, wayfinding to equipment, virtual tours and XR training, and smart P\&ID and maintenance. * Closed\-Loop Quality Integration: Integrate vision and sensor outputs with manufacturing execution and quality systems so that detections flow into an exception queue with an audit trail of Quality judgment on every AI flag, including cleaning verification and chang lation and digital twin tools (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, OpenUSD, CAD) and synthetic data generation. * Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs and agent frameworks (including MCP) applied to operations, quality or safety use cases. * Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and a problem\-solving mindset, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize both hardware and software components of robotic systems. * Safety Knowledge: Familiarity with industry safety standards and risk mitigation strategies in robotics and automation (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO 13482, ISO 3691\-4 for driverless industrial trucks and AGVs, ISO 13849, EN 61508\), and with OT cybersecurity practices (e.g., IEC 62443\). * Soft Skills: Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with a customer\-centric approach to solving technical challenges, and the ability to collaborate with external partners and bridge IT, OT, Quality, HSE and facilities teams. * Solid knowledge of Computer System Validation process and GxP requirements (e.g., GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11\), including validation of AI\-enabled systems. * Experience in pharmaceutical or biologics manufacturing operations (e.g., changeover, cleaning verification, API processes) and with integrating to quality and validation systems. * Demonstrated ability to analyze, anticipate, and resolve complex issues (technical, operational, or business\-related) through sound problem\-solving skills * Effectively prioritize and escalate issues. * Familiarity with data governance and AI risk\-management practices for image, video and sensor data. * Demonstrated learning agility and curiosity. jobs.title: Vice President, Go to Market
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Eliza is a technology services company and Advanced\-tier OpenAI partner that's dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **The Shape of the Role** ------------------------- You're a go\-to\-market leader building Eliza's direct channel: finding, qualifying, shaping, and closing new logo engagements, then carrying them through phased scopes that grow. You carry a full book across direct outbound, private equity portfolios, and the OpenAI channel. You report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work alongside the Growth and Strategic Partnerships team, who open the doors. Ultimately, you hunt strategically and focus heavily on relationship building within the OpenAI Services Partnership, the private equity relationships, the brand and the events. Your job is what happens after the door opens. Today that work is carried by the Chief Commercial Officer and the VP of Growth and Strategic Partnerships on top of their own mandates, and the pipeline the partnership motion produces has outgrown what two executives can personally qualify, scope, and close. Deals move slower than they should, and good opportunities don't always get the discovery they deserve. That's the gap this role fills. A few things are unusual here. This is a flat team, not a hierarchy. No one reports to you and there's no SDR bench feeding you. You source, you run discovery, you write the scope, and you share what works with the people around you doing the same job next to you. The deal doesn't end at signature either. You co\-author the statement of work with the engineers who will deliver it, and you're accountable for whether it lands on time and on margin, because at Eliza the person who sells the work is on the hook for whether it was the right work to sell. Two things to know: First, we're an AI\-native firm and we work that way internally. This team is built with talent density, not a large quantity of quota carriers, because we expect you to use AI tools aggressively across everything you do, from account research and proposal drafting to SOW writing, pipeline reporting, and deal prep. If AI isn't already core to how you work, this role will feel impossible. Second, this is a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment. You'll get outcomes, not instructions. Priorities shift quickly, ambiguity is constant, and the bar is high. If you want a structured role with a predictable rhythm, this isn't it. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Direct\-Channel New Logo Acquisition** * Own go\-to\-market execution for new logos across your book in the direct channel: build and work your target account list, run outbound, and convert inbound and partner\-sourced interest into qualified opportunities. * Run the full deal cycle from first conversation through signed statement of work, and own your forecast. * Set the qualification bar. Kill opportunities that don't fit how Eliza delivers before they consume engineering time. ### **2\. Private Equity Portfolio Development** * Partner with private equity firms to map business development opportunities across their portfolio companies: which companies, which operational problems, and in what sequence. * Turn portfolio maps into active pipeline: sponsor\-introduced conversations with portfolio company executives that lead to discovery and scoped work. * Build repeatable plays for how Eliza shows up to a sponsor's operating partners, and for how a win at one portfolio company becomes the reference for the next. ### **3\. OpenAI Channel Opportunity Advancement** * Work closely with Eliza's OpenAI channel partnership to qualify and advance the high\-value opportunities it surfaces. * Own each opportunity that lands with you: joint discovery with the partner's team, the commercial path, and the scope. * Feed signal back into the partnership on which opportunities fit, which didn't, and why, so the channel gets sharper over time. ### **4\. Discovery and Use Case Definition** * Drive process discovery with prospective clients so Eliza commits only to high\-signal opportunities that fit the Eliza way of delivery. * Work cross\-functionally with AI deployment and Forward Deployed Engineering counterparts to define use cases, assess feasibility, and agree on what will be built before it's sold. * Act as the executive voice in the room with client sponsors while your engineering counterparts go deep on the workflow. ### **5\. Scoping and Statements of Work** * Co\-author statements of work with delivery counterparts, with best\-in\-class technical writing and well\-defined project components, deliverables, assumptions, and success measures. * Hold every scope you sell accountable to on\-time and on\-margin delivery: price it right, sequence it right, and write it so the engineers who pick it up don't have to guess. * Raise the bar on scope quality with your two peers over time, with shared templates, language, and pricing logic that make the next SOW faster and tighter than the last. ### **6\. Phased Engagements and Account Expansion** * Structure phased scopes of work: enablement engagements that build client fluency and trust first, followed by custom solution builds as the relationship earns them. * Own upsell and cross\-sell within the accounts you've opened. Identify the next use case, shape it, and scope it while the first phase is still delivering. * Keep an active view of expansion potential across your book and prioritize it alongside net\-new work. **To be successful, we expect someone to have…** ------------------------------------------------ * 10\+ years selling complex services or solutions to enterprise buyers, with a track record of closing six\- and seven\-figure engagements with new logos, ideally in technology consulting, systems integration, or AI and data services. * Real experience working with private equity firms and their portfolio companies. You know how sponsors think about value creation and how to get from an operating partner introduction to a scoped engagement. * Experience working a partner channel (a platform, hyperscaler, or ISV partnership) to source, qualify, and co\-sell opportunities, and the judgment to know which ones to pursue. * Statements of work you've written yourself. Best\-in\-class technical writing is a requirement here, not a nice\-to\-have: scope language precise enough that engineers can build from it and procurement can sign it. * Enough technical depth to run discovery credibly with engineers and client operators. You understand what LLMs, agents, and automation can and can't do in a real workflow, and you can spot a bad\-fit use case early. * AI tools embedded in how you work. Show us how you use them to research accounts, draft and sharpen proposals and SOWs, prep for discovery, and run your pipeline, and how they let you produce more, faster, at higher quality. * A track record of owning outcomes, not tasks. You've carried a number, you've missed one and fixed it, and you don't need a playbook handed to you to go build pipeline. * Comfort with travel for client, partner, and sponsor meetings. This role is remote in the US. **And maybe…** -------------- * Time on the delivery side. You've been a consultant, solutions architect, or forward deployed engineer, and you know what a bad scope feels like from the inside. * An existing network across private equity operating partners or portfolio company executives. * Prior experience inside an OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, AWS, or Google partner program. * You've built a go\-to\-market motion from zero at a boutique or early\-stage services firm. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive base salary, variable compensation tied to what you close and what we deliver, and equity. * Remote work anywhere in the US, with travel when a deal or a partner needs you in the room. * A direct seat with the Chief Commercial Officer and the executive team, and a real voice in how Eliza goes to market. * An Advanced\-tier OpenAI partnership that is a live channel, not a logo on a slide. * A Forward Deployed Engineering bench that builds what you sell, so the scope you write becomes something you can point to. * Full ownership of your book from day one, and a hand in defining how go\-to\-market at Eliza works alongside two peers doing the same.

jobs.description: **Empowerly** (empowerly.com) personalizes college and career counseling with data\-driven technology and former Admissions Officers. Our Empowerly Score™ is a predictive model that evaluates each student across academics, essays, and extracurriculars. We are a fully remote, venture\-backed team, and this hire will shape what our platform looks like next. **About the Role** Empowerly helps students and families navigate college admissions, pairing data\-driven technology with counselors who are former Admissions Officers. As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will work closely with counselors, operations, and product partners to understand what slows them down, then build the software that fixes it, from React front\-end to backend services, APIs, and AI features. This usually means a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, EECS, or a related field, or equivalent depth you can show us * The ability to sketch a simple system design for a feature, explain the tradeoffs, and go into detail when asked * Solid React and TypeScript, with strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals * Working knowledge of the backend: APIs, databases, and third\-party integrations * Hands\-on experience using AI APIs or LLMs inside an application, beyond using AI coding assistants to write code * Comfort with Git, code review, and writing tests * A methodical approach to debugging: you find the root cause instead of guessing * Clear communication: you can explain technical decisions to people who are not engineers, and you follow problems through to done **Nice to have** * Experience building Agentic AI workflows * Experience building internal tools or working directly with non\-engineering teammates or customers * Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD * Time at a startup or in a fast\-moving environment **The pay range for this role is:** 125,000 \- 145,000 USD per year(Remote, US)

jobs.description: **ModelCat \| Remote from Europe** **About ModelCat** ------------------ ModelCat is transforming how companies develop AI models for embedded, edge, and IoT devices. Our innovative platform uses AI to build AI — turning model architecture selection, training, optimization, and validation into a single powerful step. ModelCat takes what was previously a 12–24 month process requiring highly skilled AI professionals and reduces it to a 24–48 hour AI\-powered job that can be run by developers, data scientists, and product owners. Trusted by industry leaders like NXP and Silicon Labs, ModelCat is a venture\-backed startup headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. **The Role** ------------ We're seeking a motivated ML Engineer to help advance our AutoML platform. You'll play a key role in expanding its capabilities, onboarding new ML use\-cases across vision, time\-series, and beyond, and improving the product as we scale. This role offers meaningful growth potential toward a technical leadership track. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **AutoML Platform Development** * Contribute to the development and enhancement of our AutoML system for Edge AI, including pipelines that combine deep\-learning and conventional algorithms for embedded devices. jobs.description: EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. RCM is at the heart of how our customers get paid, and we are building a new generation of RCM tools that pair modern workflow software with AI agents to help billing teams work smarter, resolve issues faster, and collect more of what they’ve earned. Zoomed in, that means the worklist where billing teams and AI agents work side by side: the user experience, the backend services and event\-driven workflows behind it, and the API layer that connects it to the systems around it. Zoomed out, it means the automation foundation that lets AI agents pick up, carry, and hand back work that people do today, so we can automate more of the revenue cycle over time. This is a product engineering role. The right person cares as much about the problem as the technology: understanding how billing teams actually work, learning from end users and business leaders alongside our product and design partners, and shipping outcomes that measurably improve their day. You will own features end to end and work closely with our Lead Software Engineer, who owns cross\-cutting design and technical direction, as well as our forward deployed engineers and RCM product and design partners. You will use AI throughout the development lifecycle to move quickly without cutting corners. As the platform matures, the scope will grow with it, and so will the opportunities to take on more ownership and technical leadership. **How this role fits:** Our software engineers, including this role, build the RCM worklist and the shared automation foundation that agents run on. **Responsibilities:** * Build and ship features across a full\-stack RCM worklist platform, from the user interface through backend services, APIs, and the data model * Develop event\-driven services and workflows that route, prioritize, and track work across people and AI agents * Help build the shared automation foundation: the queues, state, and handoff logic that let an AI agent pick up a work item, finish it, or hand it back to a person, along with audit history, approval gates, and access controls for agent actions * Build and maintain integrations that connect the platform with EverHealth products, our clearinghouse, and third\-party systems * Build the platform services that run, coordinate, and monitor AI agents, including guardrails, human review steps, and observability * Contribute to data modeling and schema design, writing performant SQL and making effective use of ORMs * Work with end users, product, and operations partners to understand workflows and validate that what you ship solves the problem * Participate in design discussions and code reviews, and help onboard and support newer engineers * Use AI\-assisted development across planning, design, coding, testing, review, and operations * Build secure, reliab  operational practices **Technology Environment:** * Cloud Infrastructure: AWS * Frontend: TypeScript and React (MUI) * Backend: Python (e.g., FastAPI or Django) or Go * Architectural Patterns: API\-first services and event\-driven architectures, such as SQS and EventBridge * Data Platforms: modern relational databases such as Postgres, MySQL, and MSSQL * AI: LLM and agent\-based capabilities, including AWS Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore * Security \& Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST, with PHI kept within our AWS environment **Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Solid full\-stack engineering skills in TypeScript/React and Python or Go, or equivalent languages, with a track record of shipping production features across UI, backend, and APIs * Experience building or working with event\-based systems, such as message queues, event streams, and asynchronous workflows * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with modern databases, ORMs, and schema design * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding and agent tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) across the development lifecycle in your own work * A product engineering mindset focused on solving problems and delivering outcomes, not just technology * Ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders and turn their needs into working software * Comfort working on a small team with high ownership and an evolving scope * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Nice to Have:** * Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into production software, including orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Experience with AWS Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore * Healthcare/RCM experience, such as claims, EDI 837/835, eligibility, denial and A/R workflows, and HIPAA **Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. **This role can be based anywhere in the United States.** Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. **Benefits and Perks:** * Hybrid or remote work, depending on location * Continued investment in your professional development * Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend * 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting * Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off * Employee Stock Purchase Program **Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $130,000 to $160,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Data Science Engineer III
jobs.description: * Engineering * Miami * Full\-time ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI\-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e\-commerce, and beyond. **About the Role** This is not a pure research role but one that is actively involved in building our product. You will be joining a team of Data Science Engineers and you will be directly contributing to code. You will own well\- scoped modeling problems end to end, from exploring market data and designing features to validating models and getting them running in production, so that our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engines make better decisions in real time. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of applied AI and production software, working directly with other data scientists, ML and data engineers, and product teams. **What you will do:** * Develop, validate, and iterate on demand forecasting, pricing, and optimization models using large\-scale, high\-velocity market data. * Explore and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources to uncover signals, define features, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and business impact. * Design and run offline experiments, backtests, and online evaluations to measure model performance and profit uplift. * Write production\-grade Python code and work with ML and data engineers to productionize models, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. * Monitor deployed models for drift, accuracy, and data quality issues, and troubleshoot and fix problems quickly. * Keep our glass\-box principles front and center: build models whose logic and outcomes can be explained to commercial teams and customers. * Partner with product and commercial stakeholders to translate business problems into clear modeling approaches and communicate results. * Contribute to the technical direction of the modeling stack as Fetcherr scales across new customers, verticals, and product lines. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-time experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role building models that run in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part\-time experience does not count toward this requirement. * Strong programming skills in Python, with production\-grade coding practices (testing, code review, version control). * Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and time\-series forecasting, with sound judgment on model validation and experiment design. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational and non\-relational datasets. * Experience and comfort with AI\-assisted software development, along with the ability to write and reason about code yourself. * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse and lakehouse technologies. * Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD practices for ML and data pipelines. * Strong analytical mindset and a pragmatic, get\-it\-done approach. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross\-functionally with engineering and product teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience with dynamic pricing, revenue management, or optimization problems. * Experience in travel, e\-commerce, logistics, or other real\-time decisioning domains. * Exposure to MLOps practices such as model registries, monitoring, and automated retraining. * Experience with real\-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse. * Experience in a Software\-as\-a\-Service environment.
