jobs.title: Applied Robot Learning Engineer / RL Specialist
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Applied Robot Learning Engineer/RL Specialist** **Focus: Reinforcement Learning \& Policy Optimization** **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced applied robotics/robot learning engineer with strong reinforcement learning expertise and hands\-on experience deploying learning\-based policies for complex manufacturing tasks. The role primarily focuses on improving the performance of VLA/world models, addressing sim\-to\-real challenges, and developing robust and scalable policies for manipulation, failure recovery, and optimal execution. This is a hands\-on role requiring real\-world deployment experience, comfort working directly with robotic hardware, and the flexibility to support broader engineering and experimental tasks as project priorities evolve. The ideal candidate combines strong RL fundamentals with practical robotics engineering experience and some exposure to bimanual manipulation. Approximately 80% of the role will focus on applied engineering, policy implementation, robot experiments, evaluation, and deployment, with 20% dedicated to research and technical exploration. The emphasis is on translating RL methods into measurable improvements on physical robots rather than pursuing research in isolation. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, fine\-tune, and evaluate VLA models and learning\-based policies on physical robotic systems. * Apply reinforcement learning to improve manipulation success rates, execution efficiency, robustness, and recovery from failures. * Implement and evaluate appropriate approaches such as PPO, SAC, residual RL, policy adaptation, or learned recovery policies. * Design reward functions and success detectors, including learned or VLM\-based reward models, for real\-world manipulation tasks. * Apply sample\-efficient methods for real\-world training, such as RL from demonstrations, offline\-to\-online RL, and human\-in\-the\-loop corrections. * Set up safe real\-robot RL, including action limits, workspace constraints, automated resets, and supervised exploration. * Diagnose sim\-to\-real gaps and improve real\-world performance using techniques such as domain randomization, system identification, and real\-world fine\-tuning. * Apply learned policies to manipulation tasks, including tasks involving bimanual setups and coordinated robot execution. * Design evaluations, analyze failure modes, and measure improvements in success rate, cycle time, generalization, and repeatability. * Work directly with robotic hardware to run experiments, debug policies, and validate improvements. * Supervise data collection, identify data\-quality issues, and coordinate corrections to demonstrations or datasets. Collaborate with the simulation team and contribute to benchmarking, model evaluation, and other hands\-on engineering tasks as needed. * **Required Qualifications** * Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics or a related discipline or Master’s with 3 or more years of industry experience. * Strong applied expertise in reinforcement learning for robotics, including policy optimization, reward design, training, and evaluation. * Experience deploying or validating learned policies on physical robots; simulation\-only experience is insufficient. * Experience with sim\-to\-real transfer and diagnosing discrepancies between simulated and real\-world execution. * Experience with Git, Python, PyTorch, and ROS/ROS 2, combined with hands\-on familiarity with edge compute platforms (NVIDIA Jetson) and robotics MLOps ecosystems (experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and visualization tools like Foxglove). * Experience with sensor calibration (eye\-in\-hand/eye\-to\-hand camera calibration), force\-torque sensors, or teleoperation data collection setups. * Understanding of imitation learning, robot kinematics, control interfaces, and manipulation workflows. * Comfort working directly with robots and taking ownership of experiments, model training, evaluations, data quality, debugging, and deployment. Adaptability and willingness to contribute beyond core model development when required to meet project goals. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience combining RL with pretrained VLA policies or imitation learning. * Experience with residual RL, online policy adaptation, failure recovery, or contact\-rich manipulation. * Experience with VLA models such as Pi0/Pi0\.5, OpenVLA, Groot, or comparable architectures. * Experience with industrial or collaborative robots and real\-world manufacturing applications is a plus. Hands\-on experience with Fanuc/UR robots is a plus. * **Collaboration \& Working Style** * **Ownership and Accountability:** Take ownership of assigned tasks from problem identification through implementation, testing, and deployment. Proactively identify issues, follow through action items, and communicate blockers early. * **Teamwork:** Work effectively with cross\-functional teams. Share knowledge, provide constructive feedback, and contribute toward shared project goals. * **Passion for Experimentation:** Enjoy testing ideas rapidly, working directly with robots, debugging failures, and turning promising approaches into working solutions. Be willing to iterate repeatedly and learn from unsuccessful experiments. * **Adaptability:** Be willing to take on responsibilities beyond core model development, including evaluation, data quality checks, debugging, benchmarking, and experimental setup, based on project priorities. **On\-site 5x days per week, Mountain View, CA** **Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Testing
jobs.description: **About Glasslake** Glasslake is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people’s heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Glasslake solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We’re a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including Delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You’ll own some of the hardest problems in applied AI: making agents reliable, fast, and trustworthy on enterprise systems where being wrong is expensive. Testing is one of the most critical and labor\-intensive parts of any SAP transformation. Our AI agents plan, execute, and validate tests of business processes inside real customer SAP landscapes, work that has traditionally taken teams of consultants weeks to do by hand. Making agents perform at that level is an open frontier. You’ll take on problems with no off\-the\-shelf answers, explore them, define what success looks like, and carry the solution all the way to production with real customers. **What You’ll Do** **Explore and define the problem** * **Frame the problem.** Turn observed agent behaviors into a clear problem statement, backed by evidence and your own experiments. * **Define success.** Set the metrics, benchmarks, and evals that measure agent performance. **Build and own the solution** * **Ship end to end.** Design and ship agent and LLM features, from prompts and orchestration to the infrastructure behind them. * **Own the results.** Watch how your work performs in production and keep improving it. **Work with experts and raise the bar** * **Validate with experts.** Work with SAP domain experts and present findings and decisions clearly. * **Raise the bar.** Review code and designs, and help shape the team’s AI engineering practices. **What We’re Looking For** * **6\+ years of engineering experience**, including building AI agents or LLM features from scratch and shipping them to production with full ownership. * **A research\-like approach.** You set hypotheses, run experiments, and verify results before you build. * **Evaluation rigor.** Experience measuring agent performance through evals, benchmarks, or regression suites, and acting on what they show. * **Strong Python and SQL**, with hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks. * **Infrastructure ownership.** Comfortable running the workflow orchestration and cloud services behind your features. * **Production investigation.** You query databases and read logs and traces to find out what actually happened. * **Self\-direction and clear communication**, including with domain experts who aren’t engineers. * **AI native.** You use AI tooling daily as a force multiplier. **Nice to have** * **Experience with computer\-use or browser\-automation agents.** * **Software testing background**, such as test automation or QA for complex systems, or familiarity with SAP testing. * **Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems** (SAP, ERP, CRM). * **Ability to work in TypeScript** when a feature needs it. * **Early\-stage startup experience** where you owned a problem with no playbook. * **Experience mentoring engineers** or acting as a technical reference on a team. **Why Join Glasslake Now** * Own open\-ended agent problems end to end, from the first exploration to results in production. * Time to explore a problem and test ideas before committing to a solution. * Your agents run inside multi\-million dollar transformations at the largest SAP integrators in the world, in a category being defined right now. * Direct access to the founding team, customers, and SAP domain experts.

policy checks, audit logs, fallback paths, and protection against prompt injection or tool misuse. * Hands\-on experience with Node.js, TypeScript, SDKs, developer tooling, sandbox environments, jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Globus Medical, we move with a sense of urgency to deliver innovations that improve the quality of life of patients with musculoskeletal disorders. Our team is inspired by the needs of these patients, and the surgeons and healthcare providers who treat them. We embrace a culture of exceptional response by partnering with researchers and educators to transform clinical insights into tangible solutions. Our solutions improve the techniques and outcomes of surgery so patients can resume their lives as quickly as possible. **The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:** * Designing and developing software applications for robotic medical devices. * Assess the existing C\+\+/QML application, its workflows and dependencies; identify functionality and behavior that must be preserved during migration. * Design, implement and maintain C\+\+ services and API interfaces that support the web application, following established architecture and communication patterns, including gRPC where appropriate. * Build accessible, responsive and maintainable user interfaces using Svelte and modern JavaScript or TypeScript. * Package and configure the application as a containerized solution that can be installed and run on a dedicated server or a local PC. * Work across the application stack to integrate the UI, API, services, configuration and deployment; diagnose and resolve issues from development through release. * Write and maintain automated tests, participate in design reviews, and contribute to software verification and validation activities to ensure designs meet requirements * Managing all aspects of assigned work packages to ensure timely completion of tasks while remaining in full compliance with Globus software development environment (version control, tool chains, documentation tools) and quality system. * Periodically attend surgical cases to understand context, workflows with integrated capital equipment and end\-user (i.e., surgeon) requirements. * Adhering to the letter and spirit of the company Code of Conduct, the AdvaMed Code, MedTech Code, and all other company policies. Ensure Compliance with applicable governmental laws, rules, and regulations, both in the United States and internationally, by completing introductory and annual training and maintaining knowledge of compliance as it applies to your role. Representing the company in a professional manner and uphold the highest standards of ethical business practices and socially responsible conduct in all interactions with other employees, customers, suppliers, and other third parties of Globus. * **In order to be qualified for this role, you** ***must possess*** **the following:** * Proactive and autonomous mindset supported by problem solving skills. * Bachelor’s Degree with 5\-7 years or a Master’s degree with 3\-5 years of hands\-on software development. Titles matter less to us than what you have personally designed and shipped. * Professional experience building web user interfaces with a modern component framework (Angular, React, Vue or similar) and solid TypeScript, HTML and CSS. Svelte experience is a plus; we expect you to pick it up quickly. * Substantial back\-end experience in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or later), with a working command of ownership and lifetime, concurrency, and modular design. Rust experience is a strong plus. Back\-end experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js does not meet this requirement: this is not a pure web\-development role. * Experience designing or integrating APIs and working with client/server applications; familiarity with gRPC or Protocol Buffers is a plus. * Experience with CMake\-based C\+\+ builds, containers (Docker) and running applications on Linux and Windows. Qt and Python experience are a plus. * Demonstrated architectural judgment: you can explain why a service boundary sits where it does, and you have refactored or migrated a sizeable existing codebase without breaking what already worked. * Disciplined engineering practice: you analyze the problem and write down the design before you code, you test as you go, and you document what you shipped. Comfortable with lightweight modeling (C4, a UML subset). * A track record of owning features end to end rather than contributing to them. We will ask what you personally designed and built, and we expect you to say so when you do not know something. * Medical devices or life sciences experience is an asset. * Ability to travel up to 5% of the time and attend cadaver labs and surgeries. **Other Duties:** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. **Company Summary:** At Globus, we move with a sense of urgency to deliver innovations that improve the quality of life of patients, inspired by the surgeons and healthcare providers who treat them. Our world\-class engineering works to transform clinical insights into tangible musculoskeletal solutions. We are constantly in pursuit of better patient care, and we understand that speed is critical because life cannot wait. Join us! *Globus Medical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.* **Our Values** **:** Our Life Moves Us philosophy is built on four values: Passionate About Innovation, Customer Focused, Teamwork, and Driven. * **Passionate about Innovation** : Improving patient care by delivering advanced technology to our customers is at the core of what we do. We are passionate in our role in improving the lives of patients by continuously developing better solutions. * **Customer Focused** : We listen to our customers’ needs and respond with a sense of urgency. * **Teamwork** : Working together, anything is possible. We value every person on our team and treat each other with respect. We are accountable to one another and support each other. Together, we make each other stronger. * **Driven** : We pursue our mission with energy and passion. We are nimble, results\-oriented and decisive. We overcome obstacles that arise in our quest to deliver solutions that will improve the lives of our customers and patients. **Equal Employment Opportunity** **:** Globus Medical is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: The Core Engineering, Software Engineering, Legal Engineering Associate
jobs.description: **ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING** The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high\-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user\-facing, workflow, data and AI\-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well\-informed decisions. Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross\-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment. YOUR IMPACT As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code. HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL * Design, develop, test, deploy and support full\-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data\-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. * Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day\-to\-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience. * Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end\-to\-end solutions. * Participate in a spec\-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation. * Write clean, maintainable and well\-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI\-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery. * Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI\-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved. * Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks. * Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns. * Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade\-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field. * Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing. * Hands\-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role. * Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs * Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts. * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping. * Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes. * Knowledge of API design, event\-driven architectures, search platforms or real\-time processing. * Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval\-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering. * Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus. * Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE * You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation. * You use AI\-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards. * You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade\-offs visible to stakeholders. * You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices. CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: **TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.** Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential. We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits Healthcare \& Medical Insurance We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance. Holiday \& Vacation Policies We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year. Financial Wellness \& Retirement We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities. Health Services We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices. Fitness To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount). Child Care \& Family Care We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available. Benefits at Goldman Sachs Read more about the full suite of class\-leading benefits our firm has to offer. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Remote 400K \- 550K Permanent Our client is an elite proprietary trading firm founded by MIT and Harvard alumni, consistently delivering 40%\+ annual returns across equities and futures. Sitting at the intersection of top\-tier academia and high\-performance trading, it’s one of the most intellectually rigorous environments in the industry. Nearly half of the firm’s roughly 40 people hold PhDs from the world’s leading institutions, and that academic depth is matched by cutting\-edge execution. They’re now growing across engineering and research to build the next generation of their trading platform and strategies. This is a lean, high\-density team where the code you write and the models you build run in production, and your decisions show up directly in PnL. **What you’ll do** *Software Engineers \& Quant Developers* * Build and optimize the computational infrastructure behind core research and portfolio construction * Work side by side with researchers to turn new ideas into production trading systems * Design custom software to process large\-scale market data in distributed and single\-machine environments * Write high\-performance, multi\-threaded code using locks and lock\-free primitives *Machine Learning Engineers* * Build and scale the pipelines that train, evaluate, and deploy models on large volumes of market data * Turn research prototypes into fast, reliable models running in live trading * Optimize training and inference performance, from data loading to GPU and CPU efficiency * Develop tooling that helps researchers experiment faster and more rigorously *Researchers* * Develop and test predictive signals and models across equities and futures * Apply statistics, machine learning, and optimization to noisy, real\-world market data * Design rigorous experiments that separate real effects from overfitting * See your ideas go from hypothesis to live strategy, with clear feedback on what works *Across every role*, you’ll own problems end to end with no layers between you and the result. **What you bring** *Software Engineers \& Quant Developers* * Around 3\+ years of software development experience, with strong C\+\+ skills, low\-level debugging, and resource optimization * Experience working in large, complex codebases behind critical systems *Machine Learning Engineers* * Around 3\+ years building and deploying ML systems in production * Strong Python skills and experience with a framework such as PyTorch; C\+\+ is a plus * A solid grasp of ML fundamentals and how to make models fast and robust in practice *Researchers* * A strong background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, or operations research * Hands\-on experience with statistical modeling or machine learning on real data * Comfort coding in Python or a similar language to test your own ideas *Everyone* * A genuine love of hard technical problems: performance puzzles, clean abstractions, and understanding systems all the way down * Intense intellectual curiosity, whether that shows up in mathematics, chess, research, or building things for fun **Nice to have** * A PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field (more common among researchers, though not required) * Strong results in competitions such as IMO, IPhO, IOI, Putnam, or competitive programming; many on the team have them, but it’s not a requirement * An exceptional academic or professional track record, wherever you earned it * Prior experience in trading, finance, or working with market data **Why this role** * Rare talent density: a team of about 30, founded by MIT and Harvard alumni, where nearly half hold PhDs * Proven performance: a privately funded firm compounding at 40%\+ per year * Direct impact: a flat structure with no middle management, where great work shows up immediately in results * Exceptional compensation: base salaries up to $550k, with fully guaranteed bonuses bringing total cash to $1\.5M or higher. Don’t tick every box? Please apply anyway. Outstanding engineers and researchers come from many paths, and we’d rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out. Interested? Reply and Goliath Partners will be in touch. The team is small, so openings are limited.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer, Multimodal Agentic AI for Glasses
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * 3 years of experience with end\-to\-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging). * Experience with Generative AI. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience with Multimodal Machine Learning. * Experience with large\-scale infrastructure. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Our team is at the forefront of building the next generation of conversational AI. We are developing multimodal, agentic AI solutions for smart glasses, to create a unique, proactive, and trusted multimodal experience. This technology delivers instant, natural conversational intelligence directly to the user's eye and ear, allowing them to navigate and interact with their physical world more immersively than ever. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will play a technical leadership role at the forefront of developing groundbreaking multimodal agentic AI solutions for smart glasses. You will architect and ship trusted, real\-time conversational experiences that seamlessly blend voice, streaming vision, and physical\-world context. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Play a technical leadership role at the forefront of developing groundbreaking multimodal agentic AI solutions for smart glasses. * Take ambitious, ambiguous AI capabilities from initial research and rapid prototyping to flagship production launches. * Own the end\-to\-end technical direction and quality of core pillars, driving model and agent quality improvement through data optimization, evaluation benchmarks, system prompting, skill and tool use, Agent harness, and model post\-training to deliver an instant, natural, and immersive experience for users. Boulder, CO, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Thornton, CO, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures (including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems) and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. jobs.description: **Senior Enterprise Account Executive** ======================================= **Location:** Mountain View, CA — Onsite **About Granica** ----------------- Granica is an AI research and systems company building the **efficiency and intelligence layer for enterprise AI**. We help enterprises operate massive data environments more efficiently while pioneering new approaches to how AI learns from structured enterprise data. Our products and research include: * **Crunch** — continuous table maintenance and optimization for enterprise lakehouses, dramatically reducing storage and compute costs. * **Large Tabular Models (LTMs)** — cutting\-edge research into foundation models that learn from structured and relational enterprise data, with the ambition to unlock an entirely new category of enterprise intelligence. * **Myelin** — stateful infrastructure for long\-running AI agents. Our research is led by **Stanford Professor Andrea Montanari**, with groundbreaking work on generative modeling accepted to **NeurIPS 2026**. Backed by NEA and Bain Capital, Granica works with companies including Snap, Pinterest, and Lyft, delivering approximately **$200K in annualized value per petabyte** with measurable results in weeks. We're not building another incremental AI application. We're building foundational technology for the next generation of enterprise AI. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for an exceptional **Senior Enterprise Account Executive** to help build Granica's enterprise business from our Mountain View HQ. This is a true **new\-logo hunter role** for someone who thrives on opening strategic accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, navigating sophisticated technical buyers, and closing large, complex enterprise agreements. The opportunity is REAL, as evidenced by our most recently **closed multimillion\-dollar enterprise deal**, demonstrating the scale of what exceptional execution can achieve at Granica. You'll sell **Crunch**'s proven infrastructure value today while helping introduce enterprises to Granica's broader AI vision, including our pioneering **LTM research**. You'll work directly with our Head of Sales—an early Snowflake sales leader—alongside our founders, researchers, engineers, and forward\-deployed teams. You'll help define the sales motion, not inherit a finished playbook. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * Build a strategic Bay Area enterprise territory from the ground up. * Personally source and close net\-new enterprise opportunities. * Develop relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and senior data, platform, and AI infrastructure leaders. * Lead complex technical discovery, evaluations, and proofs of value alongside engineering. * Build compelling economic cases around infrastructure efficiency, performance, and AI readiness. * Navigate multithreaded enterprise sales cycles, including security, procurement, legal, and executive negotiations. * Close large, multiyear platform agreements and help shape Granica's evolving GTM strategy. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **7\+ years of quota\-carrying enterprise sales experience**, with consistent overachievement. * Demonstrated success personally sourcing pipeline, winning new logos, and closing complex, high\-value enterprise deals. * Strong technical credibility selling sophisticated infrastructure or platforms to engineering and executive buyers. * Proven ability to navigate long sales cycles, technical evaluations, and multiple stakeholders. * Entrepreneurial mindset, commercial creativity, and the resilience to succeed without a mature sales machine. * High ownership, exceptional work ethic, and genuine excitement about building a category\-defining company. * Experience selling data infrastructure, databases, lakehouse technologies, cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, or AI/ML infrastructure strongly preferred. **Why Granica** --------------- Granica combines **real enterprise traction, frontier AI research, and the opportunity to build something from the ground up**. Crunch is already delivering measurable value at petabyte scale, with multimillion\-dollar enterprise deals demonstrating the commercial opportunity. Meanwhile, our LTM research under Professor Montanari is exploring a fundamentally different approach to enterprise intelligence: learning the structured\-data world rather than building a separate model for every task. You'll join a small, ambitious team with direct access to founders and technical leadership, meaningful early\-stage equity upside, and the opportunity to help build the sales organization behind what could become a defining enterprise AI infrastructure company. **Compensation \& Benefits** ============================ * Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and performance bonus for top performers * 401(k) with company match, comprehensive health coverage, and unlimited PTO * Daily catered meals in our Mountain View office * Support for research, publication, and conference participation **At Granica, you'll help build the next generation of enterprise AI**—from **exabyte\-scale data infrastructure**, **Large Tabular Models (LTMs)**, and **stateful AI agents**. Together, we're creating the infrastructure that enables enterprises to **own their data**, **own the intelligence built on it**, and **scale both efficiently**.

jobs.title: Strategy & Product Lead
jobs.description: **Mission** =========== The US healthcare system is complex, error\-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn't be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we're building the one solution every American can turn to for help. Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate bills, and make coverage easier to understand, saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the \#1 platform that empowers all Americans to take charge of their healthcare. **About Us** ============ Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we're a seed\-stage company backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well\-funded for the next few years. **About the Role** ================== We're hiring a sharp, AI\-native builder to work one of our highest leverage areas. Healthcare Advocates and AI agents work cases together. Your job is to make that system smarter, faster, and more scalable. This role flexes to the person. If you come from product, you'll own strategy, KPIs, and roadmap for how our agents handle case work end to end. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Unconventional Technology - Landmark
jobs.description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. **About Landmark** ------------------ Landmark, a Halliburton business line, provides the industry’s most comprehensive suite of digital solutions for exploration, drilling, and production optimization. Its software and data platforms empower customers to model subsurface assets, manage drilling risk, and accelerate decision\-making through cloud, AI, and advanced analytics. **About the Role** ------------------ The Engineering Manager leads the team that builds Landmark’s production engineering and optimization software, the tools engineers use to monitor well performance, optimize artificial lift and surface facilities, and forecast production. This role owns people management, predictable delivery, and technical direction, and applies expertise in delivery leadership, architecture, and AI\-enabled engineering. Working closely with senior engineers, architects, and Product Management, the successful candidate will build a high\-performing team and use AI to build software faster and create AI\-powered systems. This position suits an experienced engineering manager, or a senior engineer or technical lead ready to move into people management. Domain knowledge is valuable but not required. The team’s stack includes Java, C\#/.NET, C\+\+, Python, Rust, TypeScript (Angular, React, Node.js), Azure and AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, and databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, and Databricks. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the team delivering production engineering and optimization software through complex, multi\-quarter work, owning predictable delivery and the outcomes the team commits to. * Shape the architecture and technical roadmap of the products you own, partnering with senior engineers and architects on decisions that hold up across multiple releases. * Drive the use of AI to build software faster, infuse AI into the team’s engineering processes, and design and build AI\-powered features and systems. * Scope major technical work by validating estimates, identifying risks, and defining the delivery approach; challenge the process when it produces slow feedback, unnecessary risk, or poor outcomes. * Serve as the escalation point for architectural disagreements, production issues, and deep technical unknowns, bringing in the right expertise and driving resolution. * Partner with Product Management and architects to design new applications and major enhancements, translating product goals into concrete technical plans. * Evaluate architecture and implementation for performance, scalability, and security weaknesses, and see improvements through to resolution. * Set and enforce code quality, security, and architectural standards, and own technical debt by deciding what matters and getting it into the delivery plan. * Manage and mentor engineers through performance reviews, development plans, career conversations, and honest feedback, developing senior engineers and emerging managers into stronger leaders. * Define how teams work and coordinate, including delivery cadence, ownership boundaries, and the bar for hiring and promotion, and staff teams by matching people to work based on skill, growth need, and delivery priority. Manage stakeholder relationships and communicate delivery status, technical trade\-offs, and risks upward, while staying current on tools and technologies, including AI\-assisted development tools and Databricks, and leading adoption where they improve the product. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. * 10 or more years of software development experience, including 5 or more years managing people (performance, development, hiring) and leading the technical delivery of a software team. * Deep proficiency in at least one of Java, C\#/F\# (.NET), C\+\+, Python, Rust, or TypeScript (React, Angular, or Node.js), with a track record of delivering production software in that stack. * Experience designing and owning the architecture of a complex software system or major subsystem, with technical decisions that held up across multiple releases. * Demonstrated experience using AI to build software, infuse AI into engineering processes and workflows, and design or build AI\-powered systems or features. * Strong communication skills for discussing delivery outcomes with business stakeholders, architectural trade\-offs with engineers, and career development with team members, with the ability to lead distributed, cross\-time zone teams. **Preferred** * Experience leading multiple teams that together deliver a single product or technology. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure automation, and cloud\-native or data engineering technologies such as Azure, AWS, and Databricks. * Experience leading teams in production engineering, reservoir engineering, or other technically complex or scientifically demanding application domains. * Experience integrating machine learning, generative AI, or LLM\-based components into production systems. * Experience developing other engineering managers and senior engineers into stronger leaders. **World Class Benefits** ------------------------ At Halliburton, we’re committed to supporting you and your family with a comprehensive and affordable benefits package that covers your physical, emotional, financial, and parental needs — now and in the future. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a wide range of programs designed to help you thrive at work and at home. Click here to review a summary of the benefits available once you join. **Core Competencies** --------------------- Engineering Management \| People Management \| Software Delivery Leadership \| Software Architecture \| Technical Roadmap \| AI\-Assisted Development \| Generative AI \| Production Engineering Software \| Java \| C\# / .NET \| Python \| C\+\+ \| TypeScript / React / Angular \| Azure / AWS \| Docker / Kubernetes \| CI/CD \| Databricks \| Hiring \& Performance Management **Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation**. **Location** 3000 N Sam Houston Pkwy E, Houston, Texas, 77032, United States **Job Details** **Requisition Number:** 212727 **Experience Level:** Experienced Hire **Job Family:** Engineering/Science/Technology **Product Service Line:** Landmark Software \& Services **Full Time / Part Time:** Full\-time **Additional Locations for this position:** **Compensation Information** Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview: Hamilton Company is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacture of manual, semi\-automated and robotic products for precision fluid measuring. We specialize in the development, manufacturing and customization of precision measurement devices, automated liquid handling stations, and sample management systems. For more than 60 years, Hamilton has been satisfying customer needs by combining quality materials with skilled workmanship, ensuring the highest level of performance of every precision fluid measuring device we manufacture. Responsibilities: The software engineer position is responsible for development potentially in any and all layers of architecture (from UI to data and everything in\-between). Tasks include development of new features/tools including design, documentation, implementation, and testing for primarily desktop\-based applications. Broad knowledge of how UI concepts and UX design mesh with architecture, business logic and data are critical pieces to being successful in this position. Candidate may be responsible for UI layout and design along with interface development and architectural changes as necessary for new features. Other responsibilities include analysis and resolution of software defects, effective communication with other departments and disciplines, and developing project estimates and timelines. **This position is onsite located in Reno, NV.** Qualifications: * Fluency in either C\# or C\+\+ with understanding of fundamental object\-oriented design principles. * Desire to work in the Microsoft technology stack including .NET, MSSQL, and C\#. * Experience creating and/or maintaining architectural interfaces such as, but not limited to, RESTful APIs and WCF contracts. * Solid SQL database design principles and experience with Entity Framework. * Experience with JavaScript, Typescript, and/or Angular 5\+. * Familiarity with CI/CD build processes and version control (preferably Git). * Experience with agile development methodologies or frameworks such as SCRUM. * Must be able to analyze and further develop provided requirements. * Must have the ability to anticipate customer and/or product need. * Must be able to communicate and interface with other business verticals. * Must be able to work on both individual and team projects. * Must have familiarity with the software development lifecycle. * Must be able to use opportunity cost evaluation as part of decision making. Education/Experience: * Bachelor’s degree from regionally accredited university in computer science, software engineering or related field. * Experience with deploying and supporting software on standalone robotics platforms a plus. About Hamilton: * Diverse portfolio of exciting and innovative design projects. * Tremendous opportunities for professional growth. * Commitment to sustainable design. * Competitive compensation. * Excellent benefit package includes medical, dental, vision insurance, paid vacation time, paid sick time, disability insurance, 401k, tuition reimbursement and more. * Solid stable company. * Must pass drug and background screens. * May be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (provided by employer). **Equal Opportunity Employer** It is the policy of this organization to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age 40 \& over, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, citizenship status, religious preference, or veteran status in all phases of the employment process \& in compliance with applicable federal, state, \& local laws \& regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote (US) · **Type:** Full\-time · **Reports to:** Head of Engineering · **Comp:** $150k\-165k ### **About Harness** Harness Giving (goharness.com) is a fundraising platform for nonprofits. Thousands of organizations have used us as a donor CRM and to take donations, sell event tickets, manage donors and run email and SMS campaigns. Hundreds of millions of dollars have flowed through the Harness platform. We're continuing to build out our CRM, but also building out Harness Intelligence. It's a set of AI agents and deterministic rules that analyze a nonprofit's fundraising data, identify opportunities to raise more money, recommend actions, and then execute those actions with the fundraising team's approval. ### **What you'll do** * Build and run NestJS services and APIs: the CRM, communications and the endpoints the product and agents call. PostgreSQL schemas, gRPC contracts, SQS/SNS messaging. * Build on the Snowflake data layer with our data engineer: Airbyte ingestion from Postgres, MySQL and Stripe, curated views, data quality, freshness and cost. * Build a normalization layer that ingests data from third\-party systems through their APIs and custom\-built connectors, runs the ETL, and maps different source schemas into one clean data layer. * Shape where the data platform goes next. We run Snowflake today and may move toward a data lake or lakehouse. You'll help make that call and lead the work if we do. * Make production boring. Remove single points of failure. Add monitoring and alerting on services, syncs and data freshness. Share on\-call. * Own multi\-tenant data security: per\-organization isolation, least\-privilege service roles, secrets management and PII handling. * Build and harden the APIs and data our AI agents depend on, including the gateway that handles auth, tenant scoping, permissions, approvals and audit. * Build the tools agents call: reliable queries over structured data, structured outputs, and evals that check answers against real numbers. Work across model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini). ### **What we're looking for** * You drive a collaborative culture. You pair with teammates, review generously, document what you build and share ownership instead of holding it close. You make the people around you better. * 8\+ years in backend engineering, including real time running data systems in production. * Strong TypeScript / Node.js. NestJS preferred. Python for data work. * PostgreSQL and MySQL in depth: schema design, query tuning, replication and change data capture. * Expert SQL. You can tell when a query is right by checking it, not by trusting it. * Production experience with a cloud data warehouse, including access controls, query performance, data modeling and cost management. * Data lakes and lakehouses: object storage (S3\), Parquet, Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, catalogs and query engines. You know the trade\-offs against a managed warehouse. Hands\-on BigQuery or Databricks is a plus. * ELT tooling (Airbyte, Fivetran, dbt or similar). You've debugged a broken sync under pressure. * AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager) and Terraform. * Multi\-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, PII and audit trails. * You've built and shipped AI systems in production: LLM features with tool calling, retrieval or text\-to\-SQL over structured data, structured outputs and evals. You don't need to be an AI specialist, but you know how these systems fail and how to test them. ### **How you'll use AI to build** We expect AI in your daily workflow. Not as a novelty. It's how the work gets done here.* You use agentic coding tools daily (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) and can show us your setup. * You use AI to accelerate development, but you remain accountable for the architecture, implementation, quality and security of everything you ship. * You use AI to write and explain SQL, profile unfamiliar datasets, map external CRM fields onto our schema, generate test fixtures and draft evals. * **You validate before you build.** Every query, AI\-written or not, gets run and checked against real numbers before it ships. * You know where these tools fail on data work: invented column names, wrong grain, silent double counting, joins that look right and aren't. In the interview we'll hand you a real dataset and a question. You'll answer it with your own tools while we watch.### **Nice to have** * Nonprofit CRM data experience. * Snowflake experience: roles and grants, secure views, row access policies, warehouse sizing and cost, streams and tasks. * The Stripe data model: charges, payment intents, subscriptions, refunds, payouts. * Deeper AI work: agents with tool calling, evals, guardrails, MCP. * Semantic layers: Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics or Cube. * Analyst tooling: Metabase, Jupyter. ### **What success looks like** * **30 days:** You know the services and the warehouse cold: every source, every view, every role and grant. You've shipped a fix to production. * **60 days:** You own pipeline monitoring and alerting. The first external CRM import is running in production. * **90 days:** You carry a full share of backend and data ownership, on\-call included. You've hardened at least one service or pipeline the product depends on. An eval suite on agent answers runs on every change.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote (US) · **Type:** Full\-time · **Reports to:** Head of Engineering · **Comp:** $150k\-$170k ### **About Harness** Harness Giving (goharness.com) is a fundraising platform for nonprofits. Thousands of organizations have used us as a donor CRM and to take donations, sell event tickets, manage donors and run email and SMS campaigns. Hundreds of millions of dollars have flown through the Harness platform. We're continuing to build out our CRM, but also building out Harness Intelligence. It's a set of AI agents and deterministic rules that analyze a nonprofit's fundraising data, identify opportunities to raise more money, recommend actions, and then execute those actions with the fundraising team's approval. We're a small team building on a modern stack: TypeScript, NestJS and Next.js on AWS, gRPC between services, with PostgreSQL and Snowflake underneath. ### **The role** You'll own features end to end, from the React screen through the NestJS service to the database and back. You'll work across both the new AI platform and the existing CRM experience, including the services behind them.### **What you'll do** * Build product in our Next.js / React / TypeScript Nx monorepo: the AI application experience, the donor CRM, segmentation, and email and SMS campaigns. * Build and extend NestJS services, gRPC contracts and Postgres schemas behind those screens. * Build the human\-in\-the\-loop side of our agents: previewing what an agent drafted, approving or rejecting it, execution history and manual override. * Build UI for AI output that people trust: streaming responses, structured answers with clear next actions, loading and error states that don't hide what happened. * Ship behind feature flags, with logging, monitoring and a rollback plan. * Write a short design doc before big builds. Review other people's. * Get on calls with customers and customer success. Small team, so you'll hear the feedback directly. ### **What we're looking for** * You drive a collaborative culture. You pair with teammates, review generously, document what you build and share ownership instead of holding it close. You make the people around you better. * 7\+ years building production web applications, with 3\+ years in TypeScript on both front end and back end. * Deep React and Next.js: App Router, server components, state management, performance. * Strong Node.js back end. NestJS preferred. You design APIs other people want to use. REST required; gRPC / Protocol Buffers a plus. * PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations, query tuning. * You've shipped on AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS/SNS) and are comfortable with Terraform or similar infrastructure as code. * You've integrated payments and messaging: Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid or equivalents. * You've built and shipped at least one user\-facing AI feature to production. * Product judgment. You make good calls without a PM writing every detail down. ### **How you'll use AI to build** We expect AI in your daily workflow. Not as a novelty. It's how the work gets done here.* You use agentic coding tools daily (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) and can show us your setup. * You use AI to accelerate development, but you remain accountable for the architecture, implementation, quality and security of everything you ship. * You use AI to generate tests, to scaffold services and screens, to draft design docs and to review pull requests. * You own the output. You read every diff. You know where these tools go wrong: confident wrong code, invented APIs, stale library versions, quiet security holes. You have habits that catch it. * You write the context that makes the tools useful for everyone: specs, repo instructions, prompts, reusable patterns. * We already use AI agents internally, you make that tooling better. In the interview we'll ask you to work a real task with your own tools while we watch. Bring your normal setup.### **Nice to have** * Nonprofit, fundraising, CRM or fintech experience. * Nx monorepos, Cloudflare Workers and Pages. * LaunchDarkly and Datadog. * Design systems (shadcn/ui) and accessibility. ### **What success looks like** * **30 days:** Code in production by week two. You know how the CRM service, the communications service, the agent gateway and the front\-end monorepo fit together. * **60 days:** You own a feature area end to end. * **90 days:** You've shipped a meaningful piece of the Advisor or CRM that customers use every week. The rest of the team uses something you built to make our AI tooling work better, like repo context files or test patterns.

jobs.title: Airport Senior Data Engineer
jobs.location: Harry Reid International Airport, NV, US
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- The Clark County Department of Aviation is seeking qualified candidates to apply for the Airport Senior Data Engineer position. This position provides project and program leadership to professional and technical staff and is responsible for professional support in leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of Clark County Department of Aviation’s data analytics infrastructure, focusing on cloud\-based solutions. **This position is confidential and excluded from membership in the union. Also, this classification is designated exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), and is therefore, not eligible for overtime.** This examination will establish an Open Competitive Eligibility list to fill current and/or future vacancies that may occur within the next six (6\) months at either level or may be extended as needed by Employee Services. resolves errors and interface problems and ensures integrated systems in accordance with development standards. * Composes program documentation and user procedures and instructions and assists user departments and staff in implementing new or modified database applications; tracks and evaluates project and systems progress. * Serves on a variety of committees, project teams and task forces and provides customer service support as required. * Prepares a variety of technical, statistical and narrative reports, letters, memos and other written materials. * Contributes to the efficiency and effectiveness of the unit's service to its customers by offering suggestions and directing or participating as an active member of a work team. jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Company Description By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world\-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. **Why join Harvard University Central Administration?** Harvard University's Central Administration (CADM) is a 5,000\+ employee organization that supports the university's overall excellence by understanding and serving the needs of its schools, students, faculty, staff, alumni, and surrounding communities. Through dynamic and collaborative partnerships, CADM provides high\-quality and efficient services to the schools to help them achieve their goals. Job Description **Job Summary:** Independently support the IT infrastructure environment and/or facilities. Role may focus on maintenance, support and documentation/troubleshooting. Typically work as part of a team to implement IT solutions to business problems. Participate in projects. **Job\-Specific Responsibilities:** The IT Operations Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, systems administration, network administration, and infrastructure support for the Credit Union’s headquarters, branches, remote users, and technology environments. This position reports to the Senior IT Operations Manager and works closely with the IT team, business units, vendors, and management to maintain secure, reliable, and efficient technology services. The IT Operations Engineer supports end\-user computing, Microsoft Windows environments, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, network connectivity, firewalls, switches, wireless networks, servers, cloud\-based applications, and business\-critical Credit Union systems. The position also assists with technology projects, disaster recovery testing, vendor coordination, cybersecurity initiatives, and the evaluation and implementation of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-enabled tools and automation solutions. **Infrastructure and Systems Administration** * Administer, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows servers, workstations, virtual environments, storage systems, printers, and related infrastructure. \- * Support Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file and print services, user accounts, security groups, and access permissions. * Assist with administration of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, and related security and collaboration tools. * Install, configure, test, upgrade, replace, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and software. * Maintain system documentation, configuration records, asset inventories, network diagrams, and support procedures. * Oversee the management of security technologies, including EDR, IAM, DLP, vulnerability and patch management and cloud security platforms. * Support branch technology, including teller workstations, printers, scanners, network equipment, digital signage, video conferencing systems, and other business\-critical devices. **Network Administration** * Monitor and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, VPN, wireless, internet, and branch connectivity issues. * Assist with administration and configuration of firewalls, routers, switches, wireless access points, network segmentation, VLANs, and remote\-access technologies. * Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPN, wireless, and network performance issues. * Assist with network security initiatives, including firewall rule reviews, secure remote access, network access controls, logging, monitoring, and incident response. * Work with telecommunications, internet service providers, managed service providers, and other vendors to resolve service interruptions and maintain reliable connectivity. * Participate in network upgrades, branch openings, office moves, technology refreshes, and infrastructure improvement projects. **Cybersecurity, Privacy, and Compliance** * Assist with implementation and maintenance of security controls, including multifactor authentication, endpoint protection, encryption, access controls, patch management, and secure configuration standards. * Promptly report suspected phishing, malware, unauthorized access, lost devices, data exposure, or other security incidents. **Emerging Technology and Automation** * Establish AI security architecture standards aligned with the Credit Union’s AI governance framework. Support the responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled productivity, analytics, AI security, and automation tools. * Partner with business leaders to evaluate AI and automation tools. * Identify opportunities to automate recurring IT support, monitoring, reporting, provisioning, and maintenance activities. * Assist with maintaining the Credit Union’s technology roadmap and identifying infrastructure improveme oft Power Automate, or other scripting/automation tools. * Relevant certifications are preferred, including: + CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Security\+, or similar certifications; + Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, or endpoint\-management certifications; + Cisco CCNA or comparable networking certification; + ITIL Foundation; or VMware certifications * Ability to lift, move, install, or remove technology equipment weighing up to 50 pounds and work in equipment closets, branch locations, and other technology\-support environments. **Certificates and Licenses:** * Completion of Harvard IT Academy specified foundational courses (or external equivalent) preferred Additional Information **Standard Hours/Schedule:** * 35 hours per week **Visa Sponsorship Information:** * Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position **Pre\-Employment Screening:** * Identity, Education, Criminal, Credit, Certification/License, Motor Vehicle Record, Drug Test, DOT Physical, CORI, Employment, Prohibited Parties, Not Applicable **Other Information:** *Onsite Requirements:* * This role is required to be on site at least 2 days per week. * Must also participate in on\-call rotation and provide after\-hours, weekend, and holiday support as needed. * Travel to branch and office locations in Cambridge, Somerville, and Boston as needed to support Credit Union operations. * Please provide a cover letter and resume as one document with your application. * This position has a 90\-day orientation and review period. **Work Format Details** This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non\-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard\-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information. **Benefits** Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work\-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes. Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non\-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non\-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Health Plan Systems
jobs.description: HealthPartners is hiring a **Software Engineer – Health Plan Systems** . The position is part of a dedicated team of developers providing application design, development, testing and support for a Healthcare Claims application. The Claims platform is a complex, in\-house grown IRIS/Mumps application, and is a critical application within the organization. The role will primarily involve development using (Cache) ObjectScript and MUMPS, with opportunities to expand into Java, PrimeReact, and other modern technologies over time. We are seeking a curious individual who has a strong analysis, design, and development background in any language/technology (Ex: Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, MUMPS, ObjectScript etc.) and has the aptitude and willingness to learn a new platform/technology. You will work with cross\-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to build AI\-powered solutions that solve real enterprise problems. Shape the end\-to\-end user experience with design, since enterprise adoption lives or dies on usability. * **Delivery and execution:** Drive the build from prototype to production and own the backlog, sequence the work, make scope and tradeoff calls as models and constraints shift, unblock the team, and keep momentum from first demo through launch and iteration. * **Evaluation and quality:** Own how quality is defined and measured. Build golden sets and ground truth, run offline and live (production) evals, choose appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, task success, hallucination rate), apply LLM\-as\-judge where it has been validated, and turn results into launch decisions and readouts for leadership. * **Support Solution architecture:** Support high\-level architecture and feasibility discussions with engineering, while owning the required prompt engineering and/or skill creation components of the AI harness. * **Cross\-functional leadership:** Lead engineers, data scientists, designers, and business partners without direct authority. Author reusable playbooks, skills, and solution patterns that make AI delivery faster and more consistent across the organization. * **Governed delivery:** Move solutions through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council), owning the product documentation, scorecards, and stage\-gate reviews. * **Communication and mentorship:** Communicate strategy, requirements, roadmap, ROI, and eval results clearly to executive and technical audiences. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work.
