jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Experienced Technology New York **Machine Learning Engineers** at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large\-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open\-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy. This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities. As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: **ML Research Engineering**, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and **ML Performance Engineering**, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low\-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members. **Your Core Responsibilities** *The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.* **ML Research Engineering** * Develop large\-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models. * Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining. * Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost. **ML Performance Engineering** * Build and optimise low\-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real\-time predictions in production systems. * Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries. **Across both areas** * Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open\-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads. * Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high\-volume trading data and delivering real\-time, high\-accuracy predictions. * Evaluate and roll out third\-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities. **Your Skills and Experience** **Core, regardless of focus area:** * 3\+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems. * **Production software engineering —** Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship. * **Machine learning fundamentals —** you understand modern ML workloads beyond high\-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise. * **A systems mindset —** you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build\-versus\-buy decisions. * **Strong collaboration —** comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it. **Depth in one or more of the following:** * **Distributed training and large\-scale systems —** parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX. * **GPU performance and low\-level optimisation —** reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent). * **Production inference systems —** hands\-on experience building and hardening real\-time, low\-latency prediction pipelines in high\-performance environments. * **Numerics and correctness at scale —** low\-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit\-exact. *Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.* **Also a plus:** * Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools. * A track record of contributing to open\-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems. **Not sure this is the one?** If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML\-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles. \#LI\-DNP **About Us** *IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.* We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist our recruiting team review applications (for example, to help match applications against job criteria and organize large volumes of submissions). All hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We continuously monitor our AI tools to ensure they are used responsibly, with appropriate human oversight. Your personal data will be handled in line with applicable privacy and data protection laws. For more information, please see the IMC Privacy Statement. Where legally required, you may have the right to request human review of any AI\-assisted decision, to object to the use of AI in your application, or to obtain further information about how your data is processed. To exercise these rights, please contact us at uscvreview@imc.com. We use Tofu AI Resume Review as part of our hiring process for jobs in certain locations. The Tofu tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: AI Assurance Dashboard \- Tofu. The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full\-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits \- US \| IMC Trading for more comprehensive information. ##### **Salary Range** $175,000 \- $250,000 USD Get Notified about the latest career opportunitiesSign up to receive weekly updates on vacancies at IMC.

jobs.title: Junior CPU Verification Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- **Who We Are** At Intel, we are shaping the future of computing. Our engineering teams develop the technologies that power billions of devices worldwide, from personal computers and cloud infrastructure to edge computing and artificial intelligence applications. Join Intel's CPU Design team and become part of a world\-class engineering organization responsible for designing and verifying next\-generation processor technologies. As a Junior CPU Verification Engineer, you will work alongside experienced architects, designers, and verification engineers to ensure the quality, functionality, and performance of Intel's future CPU products. **The Role** As a CPU Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for verifying complex processor designs before they reach silicon. You will develop verification environments, create test plans, debug failures, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure Intel CPUs meet functional, performance, power, and quality objectives. **What You’ll Do** Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: * Performs functional verification of CPU logic to ensure design will meet specification requirements. * Develops IP verification plans, test benches, and the verification environment to ensure coverage to confirm to CPU microarchitecture specifications. * Executes verification plans and defines and runs system simulation models to verify the design, analyze power and timing, and uncover bugs. * Replicates, root causes, and debugs issues in the presilicon environment. * Finds and implements corrective measures to resolve failing tests. * Collaborates with CPU architects, RTL developers, and physical design teams to improve verification of complex architectural and microarchitectural features and to meet functional, performance, and power goals. * Documents test plans and drive technical reviews of plans and proofs with design and architecture teams. * Maintains and improves existing functional verification infrastructure and methodology. Participates in the definition of architecture and microarchitecture features of the CPU being designed actively. * **Behavioral traits that we are looking for:** * Strong analytical thinking and a passion for solving complex technical challenges. * Curiosity and eagerness to continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Effective collaboration and teamwork across multidisciplinary engineering organizations. * Ability to balance attention to detail while understanding broader system impacts. * Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-paced technical environment. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. A growth mindset and openness to feedback and continuous improvement. * **Why Intel** At Intel, your work will have real\-world impact from day one. You'll collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, gain mentorship from technical experts, and contribute to cutting\-edge processor technologies that enable the next generation of computing. Whether you're passionate about computer architecture, hardware design, verification methodologies, or emerging AI technologies, Intel provides an environment where you can grow your career while solving some of the industry's most challenging engineering problems. If you're excited by complex technical challenges and eager to help shape the future of computing, we encourage you to apply. Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. * See Intel Benefits for more details. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Experience in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Perl, or Tcl), C\+\+, and System Verilog. * **Preferred Qualifications and Experience** : * Use of AI agents in your projects, college classes, or software development. * Experience with RTL development. * Proficiency with C/C\+\+, System Verilog coding and debug. * Knowledge and experience with x86 or any other computer architectures. * ASM skills. * Familiarity with version control software (GIT). modelling. * Experience designing, building, or securing authentication, authorization, identity, or enterprise security capabilities. * Experience conducting architecture reviews and security assessments for complex systems. * Hands\-on security incident response experience, including leading investigations and remediation efforts. * Strong programming skills and experience building tools, automation, or developer\-focused solutions. * Comfortable using modern AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering effectiveness. * Ability to comm to work in the United States is required. jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit is a global technology platform that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. bring out the best ideas from the best engineers by empowering them and leading by example. * Champion engineering best practices \- code quality, testing, and architecture reviews while staying hands\-on enough to guide technical decisions and unblock the team. * Drive AI\-Native Engineering: Lead the adoption of GenAI platforms and AI\-assisted workflows within your teams to accelerate delivery, optimize code quality, and build intelligent, agentic service experiences directly into the Assisted Services platform. * Scale and Direct Multi\-Pod Teams: Lead, structure, and scale a large engineering organization (across multiple pods, tech leads, and geographically distributed sites including matrixed teams), fostering operational excellence, team health, and high execution standards. **Qualifications** * 4\+ years of experience as a people manager or established technical leader of software engineering teams that have delivered customer\-facing or compliance\-critical software products. * 8\-12\+ years of hands\-on software development experience, with a track record of building reliable, scalable experiences and services; experience in marketplace, expert\-network, customer support, or other regulated/compliance\-driven domains is a strong plus. * Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, empower engineers, and cultivate a strong team culture while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines. * Expertise in the Software design/architecture process. * Hands\-on experience while managing. * Experience with Frontend and Backend technologies * Experience with Agile development and methodologies and SaaS technologies. * Possesses strong verbal and written communication skills. * Preferably \- experience working with global teams, including matrixed and multi\-site organizations. * Deep Platform Domain Expertise: Proven experience building and operating high\-availability, fault\-tolerant platforms in real\-time service delivery, workflow orchestration, or tax and financial compliance ecosystems where data integrity, service continuity, and customer trust are non\-negotiable. * Team Leadership: Demonstrated success managing large engineering organizations (including managing team/tech leads) through complex, multi\-system initiatives. * Experience leading mission teams and forward deployed engineers to support platform growth, capability investments, and integrations into established products. * AI\-First Mindset \& Execution: Practical experience leveraging AI technologies (e.g., LLM integrations, agentic workflows, AI\-driven development tools, automated testing models) to drive engineering efficiency and product innovation. * Strong Technical Architecture Background: Deep technical grounding in distributed backend systems, microservices, and SaaS architecture, with the ability to participate in high\-level system design and evaluate complex technical trade\-offs. * BSc/MSc in Computer Science or equivalent work\-related experience. jobs.description: Remote Full Time Engineering Mid Level **Senior Frontend Engineer** **Company:** Invaluable, an LSI Company **Location:** US, remote **About Us** ============ Invaluable, an LSI Company, is one of the world’s largest online live auction marketplaces for antiques, fine art and collectibles. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description: **JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. **Senior Cloud Network Engineer** **What this job involves** JLL is seeking a Senior Cloud Network Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate enterprise network services across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP. Azure is the primary focus, with responsibility for standardized connectivity and network architecture across our multi\-cloud environment. You will combine deep Azure expertise, hands\-on AWS and GCP skills, and infrastructure automation to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure solutions. Working with global network, cloud platform, cybersecurity, architecture, application, and operations teams, you will improve service reliability and support JLL’s business requirements. **What your day\-to\-day will look like** * Design and operate regional and multi\-region cloud networks, including landing zones, virtual networks, subnets, routing, DNS, private endpoints, and load balancing. Establish consistent patterns for application onboarding, availability, and disaster recovery. * Engineer connectivity among Azure, AWS, GCP, enterprise data centers, branches, and partners using ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Cloud Interconnect, VPNs, and software\-defined networking services. * Implement firewalls, segmentation, ingress and egress controls, secure routing, and zero\-trust services. Integrate enterprise security platforms and support vulnerability remediation, audit requests, and compliance assessments with cybersecurity teams. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and Git\-based CI/CD workflows to automate provisioning, configuration validation, and compliance checks. Apply policy\-as\-code and configuration standards to prevent drift and reduce manual changes. * Monitor network health and performance; troubleshoot routing, BGP, DNS, firewall, latency, packet\-loss, and application\-connectivity issues using cloud observability tools and packet captures. Lead major\-incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Support change management, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and disaster\-recovery testing. jobs.title: Data Engineer I (Epidemiology)
jobs.description: Affiliated Office Address Baltimore, MD, United States Requisition ID 122940 Date Created October 30, 2026 Job Family Data Management Job Subfamily Data Management Job Function Information Technology Exempt Status Exempt Shift Type Full Time Schedule Monday to Friday: 9:00am – 5:00pm Worksite 05\-MD:School of Public Health Work Modality On\-site: 90\-100% of hours worked on\-site We are seeking a ***Data Engineer I*** who will assist with the creation and maintenance of complex data pipelines from raw acquisition of data to visualization. The Data Engineer I will support the design, production, and maintenance of software infrastructure to automatically extract, transform, and load data from diverse sources. The Data Engineer I will help input/output data from databases and realize complex queries. The Data Engineer I will support the creation of scripts for data manipulation, cleaning, filtering, and preparation of data outputs to be used for data visualization or web display. This will also include creating parts of systems to monitor and guarantee data quality, perform daily data quality assurance tasks, maintain, and troubleshoot the infrastructure, and audit data sources. The Data Engineer I will help explore and analyze data to answer policy\-related questions as needed. The Data Engineer I will lead the development of mathematical and statistical models of infectious disease transmission including a focus on the analysis of epidemiological and molecular data sets about infection dynamics. The Data Engineer I will develop statistical tools to analyze infectious disease dynamics. This project will focus on the use of various data sets (human behavior, genomics, serological status, and epidemiological information) to predict the spatial and temporal dynamics of vector\-borne (malaria, dengue) and vaccine\-preventable (SARS\-CoV\-2, measles, rubella) diseases. The position will require the development, evaluation, and investigation of statistical frameworks to understand disease transmission and ultimately inform public health policy. **Specific Duties \& Responsibilities** * Assist with the design, production, and maintenance of data pipelines for data acquisition, management, and transformation, and back\-end code development to power data web applications and convert raw data into usable information. * Contribute to writing and maintenance of ETL/ELTs that operate on a variety of structured and unstructured sources. * Assist with the development and maintenance of web data scraping systems for automatic data acquisition. * Assist design data architecture and provide ongoing support. * Assist with input/output data from databases and perform queries. * Assist in the creation of scripts to clean, transform, and analyze data. * Contribute to production data pipelines using data warehousing systems. * Create and implement production software to monitor data quality and detect data anomalies. * Perform daily manual data quality assurance tasks. * Support, maintain, and troubleshoot the software infrastructure. * Source data, conduct analyses, visualize data, and generate insights to support ongoing research projects and other requests across the organization. * Assist developers, analysts, data scientists, researchers, policy experts, and other partners. * Communicate with division leadership, and others on the team. * Collaborate with external partners, contractors, and vendors. * Other duties as assigned. *In addition to the duties described above* * Develop infectious disease models. * Integrate molecular and epidemiological data into computational frameworks. * Create reproducible analyses and code. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree. * Three years of related experience. * Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in infectious disease modeling is essential, particularly those related to vaccine\-preventable, vector\-borne diseases, and/or general infectious disease epidemiology. * Experience in advanced biostatistical and mathematical methods. * Experience with coding in R and management of ‘big data’. * Experience working on spatial transmission models and working on the epidemiology of vaccine\-preventable diseases. * Knowledge of infectious disease epidemiology. **Technical Skills \& Expected Level of Proficiency** * Data Pipeline Architecture \& ETL/ELT Development \- Intermediate * Database Querying \- Intermediate * Data Tools and Platforms \- Intermediate * Data Validation and Quality Assurance \- Intermediate * Data Warehousing \& Architecture \- Intermediate * Project Management \- Intermediate * Programming Languages \- Intermediate * Troubleshooting \- Intermediate * Web Scraping and Data Acquisition \- Intermediate *The core technical skills  yees' health, life, career and retirement. More information can be found here: https://hr.jhu.edu/benefits\-worklife/. ***Education and Experience Equivalency*** Please refer to the job description above to see which forms of equivalency are permitted for this position. If permitted, equivalencies will follow these guidelines: JHU Equivalency Formula: 30 undergraduate degree credits (semester hours) or 18 graduate degree credits may substitute for one year of experience. Additional related experience may substitute for required education on the same basis. For jobs where equivalency is permitted, up to two years of non\-related college course work may be applied towards the total minimum education/experience required for the respective job. ***Applicants Completing Studies*** Applicants who do not meet the posted requirements but are completing their final academic semester/quarter will be considered eligible for employment and may be asked to provide additional information confirming their academic completion date. ***Background Checks*** The successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre\-employment background check. jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. **What You'll Do** ------------------ The Business Intelligence Analyst builds and maintains the data foundation behind the spares supply chain organization's analytics, from data pipelines and models to the trusted metrics and data products teams rely on for insights and decision making. Working directly with planning, procurement, and technical stakeholders, the role turns complex, disparate data into analytics and data driven solutions that improve customer experience and lower inventory cost. The ideal candidate is a curious, analytical early career professional who enjoys the complexity and nuance of real world data, likes building data products, is comfortable with ambiguity, and communicates effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Define business metrics and build the analytics and data driven tools that help teams understand what is driving results and where to focus. * Build and maintain new dashboards end to end, including ETL data pipelines, semantic models, measures, and visualizations. * Maintain and improve existing dashboards and data products, from bug fixes to new enhancements. * Test changes thoroughly and validate data quality so reporting is accurate, consistent, and reliable. * Document data models, measures, business definitions, and the end\-to\-end flow from source data to visuals, and create work instructions that support maintainability and self\-service. * Dig into the data behind the metrics to explain what is driving results and turn findings into actionable recommendations. * Partner with planning, procurement, and technical teams to understand the business context of a problem before shaping the right solution. * Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Information Systems or a related field. * Hands\-on experience developing analytics, reporting, or data products through professional work, internships, academic projects, or research. * Experience with BI or data visualization software such as Power BI or Tableau (Power Query and DAX a plus) * Proficiency writing SQL to query and transform data. * Understanding of data modeling and ETL concepts, such as star schemas, joins, and data transformation. * Experience working with large, complex, or disparate data sources and turning imperfect data into analytics and insights. * Working understanding of basic probability and statistics. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining data, methodology, and findings to non\-technical audiences. * Coursework, internship, project, or professional experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing. * Experience with a cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar is a plus. * Familiarity with Git or GitHub for version control is a plus. * Familiarity with LLM\-assisted analytics development, such as Claude Code or Codex, is a plus. **Minimum Qualifications** * Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $70,400\.00 \- $119,700\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-MI\-Ann Arbor\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description: **What is Kalshi?** ------------------- Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. * Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. * Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. **ROLE ROADMAP** ---------------- We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help Kalshi’s Growth team move faster. You’ll build tools, automate workflows, ship experiments, and solve the technical problems that stand between an idea and a launch. You’ll work directly with growth and marketing to turn loosely defined requests into working software. Some days you’ll build something new. Other days you’ll debug an integration, fix a broken workflow, or ship a small improvement that saves the team hours. You’ll own the details and follow through until the work is live and working. This is an opportunity for an exceptional and fast\-moving early\-career engineer who loves building and learns quickly. We’re scaling fast, and your scope will grow as you demonstrate what you can own. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ * Build and maintain tools, integrations, and automations that help the Growth team execute faster. * Turn growth and marketing ideas into working prototypes, experiments, and production tools. * Troubleshoot broken workflows and integrations, resolve urgent issues, and address recurring problems at the source. * Connect APIs and data sources to reduce manual work and make existing tools work better together. * Use AI coding tools to accelerate development while taking responsibility for code quality, testing, and reliability. * Work directly with teammates to clarify requests, prioritize competing needs, and communicate progress. * Translate spontaneous business needs into verifiable technical solutions, with a short turnaround time. * Own projects from initial request through launch, monitoring, and iteration. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ * Must have a Bachelor’s Degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, plus 2 years of experience working on production systems. * Strong coding fundamentals and evidence that you can build and ship working software. Demonstrated ability developing, testing, and maintaining production software. Used languages like Python, Go (Golang), JavaScript to write polished production code. Some mobile development experience with Flutter is a plus. * Demonstrated ability working with both relational and NoSQL database systems, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling. * Demonstrated knowledge of APIs, databases, version control. * Ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and processes quickly and in a hands\-on, feet\-first fashion. * Resourcefulness in problem\-solving – knowing when/how to ask questions while primarily acting independently. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools, with the judgment to understand, debug, and improve what they produce. Your ability to multitask here is important. * Resourcefulness when requirements are incomplete. You ask good questions, find a practical path forward, and keep moving. * Strong follow\-through and attention to detail. You care whether the thing you shipped actually works. * Comfort managing several requests at once and adapting when priorities change. * Readiness to put out daily fires and respond to frequent changing requests. * Curiosity about how software can help a business reach more users and grow. * Clear communication and the ability to work independently while asking for help when needed. New graduates and engineers in the first few years of their careers are encouraged to apply. We care about what you’ve built, how you think, and how quickly you learn. **Bonus Points:** * You’ve built and launched a product, side project, or business that people actually use. * Experience with marketing technology, analytics, tracking, or experimentation tools. * Experience running online advertisements, dropshipping, sneaker botting, restaurant reservations, video game servers, etc. You have a knack for niche applications of software and care a lot about shipping fast at scale. * Experience building web applications, internal tools, or workflow automations. * Interest in prediction markets, finance, or consumer technology. **NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE** ----------------------------------- Salary Range: 115,000 and up annually, plus equity and benefits. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title. If your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out. We’re always happy to discuss. **Our Culture** --------------- Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1\. **Commitment to Equal Opportunity** ----------------------------------- Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Semantics Engineer (Ontologist)
jobs.description: **Location:** 4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio**JOB DESCRIPTION:** The Semantics Engineer (Ontologist) plays a critical role in designing and maintaining the enterprise information architecture essential for cataloging KeyBank’s data for self‑service understanding and enabling AI‑ready data and knowledge usage. This role defines and enforces standards for data modeling, taxonomy, semantic structures, and knowledge representation to ensure consistency, interoperability, and clarity across the organization. The Semantics Engineer (Ontologist) partners closely with business and technology teams to develop and maintain the enterprise data domain model and ontologies that support governance frameworks, trusted analytics, and downstream consumption across business intelligence (BI), applied AI/ML, and Large Language Model (LLM) use cases. Success in this role requires the ability to translate complex theoretical concepts into scalable, governed information structures that drive adoption of the data catalog, support emerging AI capabilities, and deliver measurable value to colleagues. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Lead the development and maintenance of the enterprise data domain model, taxonomy, and ontologies to ensure shared understanding, semantic consistency, and discoverability of data and knowledge assets. * Design and evolve information and semantic models that make enterprise data AI‑ready, supporting use cases ranging from traditional analytics and BI to applied machine learning and LLM‑based experiences (e.g., search, retrieval‑augmented generation, and copilots). * Operationalize data models, taxonomies, and semantic structures through the Enterprise Data Catalog (Alation). * Define and enforce standards for data modeling, taxonomy, nomenclature, and semantic structures to ensure consistency and interoperability across business domains and downstream consumption patterns. * Provide authoritative guidance on semantic conflicts—resolve definition discrepancies, harmonize terms, and mediate cross‑domain dependencies to establish trusted, reusable business meaning. * Contribute to the enterprise data product framework by defining domain boundaries, shared dimensions, and semantic contracts that enable cross‑domain interoperability and AI consumption. * Confirm and document prioritized metadata elements for key business processes, analytical use cases, and AI‑enabled workflows, ensuring alignment with governance standards and risk expectations. * Identify simplification opportunities—reduce redundancy, converge overlapping datasets, and promote canonical sources to improve trust, efficiency, and reusability across analytics and AI platforms. * Partner with analytics, data science, and AI engineering teams to ensure information architecture, metadata, and semantic context are sufficient to support explainable, governed, and trustworthy AI outcomes. * Serve as a thought partner, provide insights from modeling, catalog adoption, and AI enablement to shape governance strategy and roadmaps. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:** * 10\+ years of experience working with data, metadata, and reference data frameworks, including experience in metadata management and/or data quality monitoring * Experience leading the development of enterprise business glossaries, domain models, and ontologies to enable semantic consistency, shared understanding, and AI ready data usage. * Demonstrated experience with data management concepts including data governance, data quality, master data management, data lineage, and metadata management. * Proven ability to establish and operationalize metadata governance functions, including policies, standards, roles, and controls. * Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills, with strong data, metadata, and governance storytelling that drives adoption and influences stakeholders. * Hands on experience implementing and scaling an Enterprise Data Catalog or metadata repository (Alation or equivalent), answering, and decision support. * Strong business acumen in relating data to business process drivers and performance management, with a value delivery mindset. * Collaborative, team focused delivery experience that drives outcomes across enterprise data, analytics, and technology organizations. * Strategic thinker with the ability to translate enterprise objectives into actionable plans and measurable outcomes. * Excellent knowledge of data and metadata management principles, business analysis, and process engineering. **TECHNOLOGIES:** **Knowledge Graphs** Neo4j Stardog Amazon Neptune / Azure Cosmos DB (Graph) **Ontology \& Semantic Modeling** OWL / RDF / SKOS Protégé TopBraid Stardog Studio **Enterprise Data \& Knowledge Catalogs** Alation Collibra Microsoft Purview DataHub Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search) Graph \+ vector retrieval (hybrid RAG) Metadata‑driven prompt context COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $96,000\.00 \- $181,000\.00 annually. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: The Product Engineer plays a critical role in advancing platform capabilities through a combination of building new, next\-generation solutions and evolving existing technology. This role is responsible for translating complex operational workflows into intuitive, reliable, and production\-ready software. Working across the stack, this individual partners closely with Product, Engineering, and domain Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to gain a deep understanding of user needs and rapidly turn that understanding into high\-quality product experiences that feel innovative, natural, and trustworthy. This role contributes to the development and evolution of core systems, spanning net\-new capabilities and enhancements to existing technology across frontend, backend, data, and cloud infrastructure within a regulated, high\-stakes environment. Success requires strong product instincts, sound technical depth, and the ability to move quickly from ambiguity to prototype to production. The Product Engineer ensures that what is delivered is not only technically sound but also aligned with business intent, operational realities, and user expectations, raising the bar for product quality, system reliability, and velocity as the platform continues to evolve. This is ideally a hybrid position that would be onsite 2 times each week in either our NYC or Toronto Ontario office. Candidates local to either location will be expected to be onsite each week. However we can fully support remote candidates in other locations in the US and Canada. This position offers a competitive salary range of $140,000 to $180,000 USD, plus an annual bonus depending upon experience. You will also receive our excellent benefits package, which includes medical coverage starting on day one and a company\-matched 401(k). Compensation may vary based on experience, location, and other job\-related factors. Responsibilities: ***End\-to\-End Product Development*** * Design, build, and deliver product capabilities across the full stack (frontend, backend, and infrastructure) * Contribute to solutions from initial concept through production deployment and ongoing iteration * Balance speed, quality, and scalability through thoughtful engineering tradeoffs ***Product \& Domain Translation*** * Partner closely with SMEs to understand workflows, edge cases, and operational constraints * Translate complex domain knowledge into simple, intuitive, and user\-friendly product experiences * Ensure system behavior aligns with real\-world operational use and applicable requirements ***Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** * Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to scope, prototype, and deliver capabilities * Contribute to shaping product direction through technical insight and user\-centric thinking * Communicate effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholders ***Technical Execution \& Systems Thinking*** * Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, React/Next.js, and related tooling * Build backend services, APIs, and platform capabilities with a focus on scalability and security * Contribute to architecture and design decisions as systems evolve * Work across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability, datastores, and data pipelines ***Iteration \& Continuous Improvement*** * Use customer feedback, internal feedback, and product data to refine and improve delivered capabilities * Identify opportunities to enhance performance, reliability, and developer velocity * Operate with a strong bias toward action and iterative delivery ***Culture \& Craft*** * Contribute to a culture of ownership, curiosity, pragmatism, and engineering excellence * Maintain high standards for code quality, maintainability, and system design Qualifications: * 2\-4\+ years of experience building and shipping high\-quality, production software * Strong experience with a modern frontend stack, including TypeScript, React, and/or Next.js, styling systems/libraries, and modern build tooling * Strong product instincts, great design taste, and a clear sense for building products that feel natural and intuitive to end users * Experience with rapid prototyping and tools/workflows that enable fast iteration cycles * Experience building modern backend systems using Python, Go, Rust, or similar languages, including APIs, middleware, ORMs, authentication, authorization, and security\-minded application design * Experience building and shipping software on major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure * Experience working in a modern software development environment and shipping quickly, with high degrees of ownership * Comfort navigating and iteratively improving on shared CI/CD, Observability, Reporting, Analytics, and Data\-heavy Systems * Good judgment in ambiguous environments where the problem is not fully defined yet, where we need to go from zero to one * The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical teammates * A bias toward action: you thrive in an environment where you are learning quickly, shipping thoughtfully, and improving through iteration **Preferred Experience:*** Experience building workflow\-heavy products, internal tools, or systems for operational teams * Experience in fintech, mortgage, lending, payments, insurance, or other regulated domains * Experience working closely with operators, domain experts, or customers * Experience improving product quality, performance, reliability, or developer velocity as a system grows * Experience working across the stack, from polished UI to backend services to production operations **A Note to Candidates:** You do **not** need prior fintech or finance experience to succeed in this role. If you’re a strong engineer with product sense, good judgment, and excitement for learning a complex domain, we’d love to hear from you. server thermal, power, airflow, and performance validation testing. * Experience using CFD and thermal simulation tools such as ANSYS Icepak, FloTHERM, or similar industry\-standard platforms. * Demonstrated ability to analyze thermal sensor data, power measurements, system telemetry, performance metrics, and test logs to drive engineering decisions. * Proven experience troubleshooting complex thermal and system\-level issues and leading root\-cause investigations. * Strong technical documentation skills, including development of engineering specifications, simulation models, validation plans, and qualification reports. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering organizations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience designing and qualifying liquid cooling solutions for high\-density server, AI, or HPC deployments. * Experience supporting rack\-level thermal solutions for cloud, hyperscale, or enterprise data center environments. * Familiarity with GPU\-intensive platforms and interactions related to thermal management and system cooling controls. * Experience working directly with suppliers, ODMs, manufacturing partners, and customers on thermal design and qualification activities. * Exposure to embedded systems, power electronics, PCB design, hardware validation, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and advanced thermal management technologies. * Proven ability to Analyzes and designs sequence of operations, layout, and material flow to improve efficiencies and equipment for Distribution Center operations; and establishes methods for maximum utilization of Distribution Center personnel to include transportation/logistics. Conducts studies pertaining to cost control, cost reduction, inventory control, and warehousing record systems. On the basis of these studies, develops and implements plans and programs for facility modifications and revisions to operating methods. May assist facilities engineers in the planning and design of facilities. This position will work closely with the Production sites the DC supports to help continuously improve packaging inefficiencies for POU. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Bachelors in Industrial Engineering or related field * Proficient in Microsoft office suite tools, Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint * Experience in Material Flow **Desired Skills** ------------------ * Experience with Warehousing/Distribution Center slotting * Experience with Simio Simulation software * Experience with Transportation/Logistics operations **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $63400\.00 \- $117800\.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our customers are world\-wide and so is our reputation for creating innovative solutions with the latest technologies. Our products keep our customers safe and bring them home to their families at night. We provide the resources, inspiration, and focus \- if you have the resourcefulness and perseverance to work hard, then we want to create a better tomorrow with you. **WHO YOU ARE** You possess manufacturing knowledge, are adept at using hand tools, can proficiently read technical drawings to ensure an accurate and efficient assembly processes. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. * Strong knowledge of mechanical assembly manufacturing processes, including equipment, materials, and quality control methods. * Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies * Ability to walk up and down stairs, as well as stand for long periods of time, in order to access and troubleshoot equipment on the production floor * Physical ability to lift, bend, and stretch in order to perform equipment maintenance and repairs * Ability to work in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment with frequent interruptions and changing priorities **Desired Skills** ------------------ * Electronics or manufacturing assembly experienceCertification in Lean, Six Sigma, or a related field * Knowledge of industry\-specific regulations and standards, such as IPC\-A\-610, J\-STD\-001 and MIL\-STD\-130 * Experience with automation, robotics and AI * Proficiency in CAD design tools, such as Creo or SolidWorks **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $70500\.00 \- $130900\.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. jobs.title: Software Engineer Lead
jobs.description: #### **About Lumenalta** At Lumenalta, we partner with forward\-thinking organizations to build technology solutions that scale, delight users, and accelerate business growth. Our global teams bring curiosity, commitment, and technical excellence to every project. We value transparency, autonomy, and impact, empowering every team member to do their best work. #### **About the Role** We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Tech Lead for an ongoing modernization project with a major enterprise organization. In this role, you will help architect and deliver distributed systems that operate at high scale and carry high business complexity, built with Java, Spring, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and React on AWS. This engagement calls for a leader who excels at wearing multiple hats: establishing technical vision, delivering production code, owning the reliability of the systems in production, unblocking engineering efforts, and serving as a key technical advisor for our client. This is a client\-facing role. You will work directly with client stakeholders on demanding, high\-pressure deliveries, and you will be the one driving the team through them. If you are a seasoned engineer who thrives on active building while leading teams through challenging deliveries, this opportunity is ideal for you. #### **What You'll Be Doing** * **Technical leadership.** Own the technical direction of the platform, making sound architecture and design decisions for distributed systems at scale and keeping the team aligned on standards, patterns, and quality. * **Hands\-on development.** Design and build high\-throughput backend services with Java and Spring Boot, and contribute to React frontend work when the team needs it. * **Event\-driven architecture.** Design and build event streaming with Kafka, including topic design, partitioning, consumer patterns, delivery guarantees, and handling of failures and replays. * **Reliability and observability.** Own the reliability of the systems you build: define SLOs, put metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting in place, and make performance and capacity visible before they become problems. * **Incident ownership.** Lead incident response for the platform, drive root cause analysis, and make sure follow\-up fixes land so issues do not repeat. * **Data design.** Model and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and queries that support complex business workflows at high volume. * **Team enablement.** Lead code reviews, mentor engineers, break down complex work into clear tickets, and help the team deliver predictably sprint over sprint. * **Client partnership.** Work directly with client product and engineering stakeholders to refine requirements, explain tradeoffs, and set realistic expectations on scope and timelines, staying steady and clear when deliveries are under pressure. * **Delivery ownership.** Partner with QA, DevOps, design, and product to move features from idea to production with strong testing, observability, and release practices. * **Continuity.** Ramp up quickly on an established codebase and team, absorb existing context, and keep momentum high through the transition. #### **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years leading development teams as a tech lead or engineering lead. * Deep, hands\-on expertise in Java and the JVM, including concurrency, memory management and garbage collection, and performance profiling and tuning in production. * Strong experience with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security) for building production APIs and services. * Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems at high scale, including the tradeoffs around consistency, latency, and failure handling. * Hands\-on production experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming platforms. * Hands\-on production experience with AWS and cloud\-native deployment. * Experience owning reliability and observability for production systems, including monitoring, alerting, tracing, and leading incident response. * Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, and data migrations. * Solid experience building modern frontends with React and TypeScript or JavaScript. * A track record of making architecture decisions on complex business applications and documenting them clearly. * Experience in client\-facing roles, working directly with client or business stakeholders in a consulting or product\-driven setting. * Comfort navigating challenging, high\-pressure deliveries while driving a team, balancing leading, coding, and coordinating. * Advanced English and the ability to communicate clearly with engineers and non\-technical stakeholders in a distributed, remote team. * Based in Latin America, with full overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours. #### **Nice to Have** * Experience modernizing or replacing legacy systems, including data migration strategies. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code. * Experience with observability tooling such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. * Experience with automated testing practices across backend and frontend, such as JUnit, Jest, or Cypress. * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. #### **Why Lumenalta is an amazing place to work at** At Lumenalta, you can expect that you will: * Be 100% dedicated to one project at a time so that you can innovate and grow. * Be a part of a team of talented and friendly senior\-level developers. * Work on projects that allow you to use leading tech. #### **Location** This is a fully remote position open only to candidates based in Latin America; candidates must be able to work with full overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours to ensure effective collaboration with client and team schedules. #### **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted until **November 23, 2026**. Candidates can expect feedback by **November 27, 2026**.

jobs.title: AI engineer with Agentic experience
jobs.description: ##### **Project description** Luxoft is initiating the development of a solution designed to generate investment insights based on sales and research materials. The solution will leverage advanced Agentic AI capabilities to significantly reduce the time required to prepare for client meetings and improve quality of the insights. ##### **Responsibilities** Work closely with business team, business analysts, and architects and be able to quickly understand the new requirements and helps to identify the changes to the system. Work closely on a day\-to\-day basis with development team, designers, copy writers and other IT teams. The role develops and presents recommendations from analysis of current solution. Assist in design peer reviews, code peer reviews, build and unit test functional enhancements. Identify areas for code refactoring. Review and contribute to development process and procedures to assist in the continual improvement of the development team activities. Be able to offer solutions and designs to solve process, project or program issues; provides recommendations to improve the efficiency and effectiveness. Defends a recommendation and can confidently support it. Strong organization, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate with business and technical audiences and produce design documents suitable for multiple audience types, both client\-facing and internal Must be able to exhibit technical thought leadership and excellent problem solving ability, with an aptitude for technical innovation. ##### **Skills** Must have Mandatory Skills Description: 8\+ years of professional software development experience. Strong backend development experience with Python with a track record of clean, maintainable, testable production code. Production API design \& delivery (FastAPI preferred), including versioning, documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), and observability. Cloud experience (AWS preferred) beyond core compute/storage/DB—e.g., eventing, queues, serverless, logging/monitoring, secrets. Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines Debugging \& problem\-solving skills with strong ownership across the SDLC. Generative AI \& ML Requirements Experience building agents Vector databases and RAG patterns (indexing, chunking, embeddings, retrieval). LLM integration (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or open source models) with prompt design, safety/guardrails, and cost/perf tuning. Nice to have Highly desirable: experience with AgentCore, AWS Neptune, Amazon API gateway Familiarity with ML fundamentals relevant to content generation (embeddings, tokenization, evaluation, fine tuning/LoRA, prompt\+retrieval evaluation). Frontend development with React (TypeScript preferred) to build the application's UI (state management, routing, API integration, component testing). Understanding of event\-driven architectures ##### **Other** Languages English: B2 Upper Intermediate Seniority Senior Irvine, United States of America Req. jobs.title: Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: MACOM (NASDAQ: MTSI) is a global leader in the design and manufacture of advanced semiconductor products across a diverse range of end markets, including Data Centers, Telecommunications, Industrial and Aerospace and Defense. We develop innovative, cutting\-edge technologies and products across the spectrum of radio frequency (RF), microwave, millimeter wave, photonics and high\-speed analog technologies. Our solutions support critical network infrastructure applications like artificial intelligence, high performance computing, satellite communications, radar, unmanned aerial vehicles, medical equipment, test and measurement and advanced wireless networks. MACOM has more than 75 years of expertise in semiconductor process development, wafer fabrication, circuit design, advanced packaging, systems architecture and applications engineering. We are committed to our customers’ success. We partner with customers to help solve their most challenging problems by providing semiconductor solutions that are at the forefront of the highest power, highest frequency and/or highest data rates. Leading technologies, innovative products and driven employees. Come be a part of MACOM and help advance the next generation of connectivity infrastructure! **About the role** We're hiring a Vulnerability Management Analyst to own our CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management platform and help engineering and IT teams fix what matters most first. This is an early\-career role on the MACOM Information Security Team, reporting to the Manager of Vulnerability Response \& BCDR. You'll keep our exposure data accurate and complete, then turn it into clear, prioritized work for the teams who own the assets. Half the job is the platform; the other half is partnering with people. You don't need to have done this exact job before, but you should be curious about how attackers find weaknesses and motivated to help others close them. **What you'll do** **CrowdStrike Exposure Management administration** • Configure and maintain CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management, including asset groups, tags, filters, dashboards, and saved views. • Monitor sensor and asset coverage, identify unmanaged or missing assets, and work with IT to close coverage gaps. • Tune prioritization settings (such as ExPRT.AI ratings, asset criticality, and internet exposure) so risk scores reflect our environment. • Maintain integrations and data flows between Falcon and other tools, such as ticketing (e.g., Jira / ServiceNow) and reporting. • Keep platform documentation, runbooks, and user access up to date, and stay current on new Falcon features and release notes. **Vulnerability review and prioritization** • Run recurring vulnerability reviews with engineering, infrastructure, and IT teams to walk through their open findings. • Help teams decide what to fix first based on exploitability, asset criticality, exposure, and business context, not just CVSS score. • Track remediation against our SLAs, follow up on overdue items, and escalate when needed. • Validate fixes, investigate false positives, and help document and track risk exceptions. • Watch for newly disclosed, actively exploited vulnerabilities (e.g., CISA KEV) and help teams respond quickly. Reporting • Produce regular metrics on open vulnerabilities, remediation trends, SLA performance, and coverage. • Translate technical findings into clear summaries for both engineers and leadership. **What you'll bring** • 1–3 years of experience in IT, security operations, systems administration, help desk, or a related role (internships, labs, and homelab work count). • A working understanding of vulnerabilities and common terms like CVE, CVSS, patching, and misconfiguration. • Familiarity with Windows, macOS, and Linux at a basic administration level. • Basic networking knowledge, such as ports, protocols, DNS, and firewalls. • Comfort with spreadsheets and dashboards for filtering, sorting, and summarizing data. • Clear written and verbal communication, and the confidence to follow up with teams on deadlines. • Strong organization and attention to detail when tracking many open items at once. **Nice to have** • Hands\-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon, especially Exposure Management (formerly Spotlight), or similar tools like Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7\. • An entry\-level certification such as CompTIA Security\+, Network\+, or a CrowdStrike Falcon certification. • Exposure to risk\-based prioritization frameworks such as EPSS, CISA KEV, or SSVC. • Basic scripting in Python or PowerShell, or experience with APIs, to automate reports or data pulls. • Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira or ServiceNow. • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP). **What success looks like** First 90 days: You know our environment and the Falcon Exposure Management console well enough to answer most day\-to\-day questions on your own. You've reviewed asset coverage, cleaned up tagging and asset groups, and started running vulnerability reviews with at least a few teams. First year: Teams see you as their go\-to partner for vulnerability questions. Coverage gaps are known and shrinking, reporting runs on a regular cadence, and remediation within SLA is measurably better than when you started **EEO:** MACOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse workforce. MACOM will not discriminate against any worker or job applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, military service, marital status, or any other category protected under applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodation:** MACOM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you have a disability and are in need of a reasonable accommodation with respect to any part of the application process, please call \+1\-978\-656\-2500 or email HR\_Ops@MACOM.com. Provide your name, phone number and the position title and location in which you are interested, and nature of accommodation needed, and we will get back to you. We also work with current employees who request or need reasonable accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of their jobs. **RSU Eligible**This position is eligible to receive restricted stock unit (RSU) awards and cash bonuses, solely at MACOM’s discretion, subject to individual and company performance. **Salary Range**The Salary Range for this position is $64,000 – $113,000\. Actual salary offered to candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, work location, relevant candidates’ experience, education, and specific knowledge, skills, and abilities. **Benefits:** This position offers a comprehensive benefits package including but not limited to: • Health, dental, and vision insurance. • Employer\-sponsored 401(k) plan. • Paid time off. • Professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION DESCRIPTION** The Network Security Engineer designs, implements, and operates the company’s Zscaler environment and related network security controls. This hands\-on role applies zero\-trust, secure access, traffic inspection, data protection, identity, cloud, and segmentation controls across enterprise users, applications, and workloads. The position partners with Network Engineering, Security Operations, Cloud Platform, Identity, Application Security, and business technology teams. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * 2\+ years of network, cloud, or security engineering experience, including significant production experience with Zscaler ZIA, ZPA, and Client Connector. * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, certificates, proxies, GRE, IPsec, identity federation, device posture, CASB, and DLP. * Experience designing secure internet, SaaS, private\-application, and cloud\-workload connectivity in at least one major public\-cloud platform. * Experience integrating network security platforms with identity, endpoint, certificate, SIEM, and incident\-response systems. **Preferred** * Experience with Zscaler Cloud Connector, Zero Trust Gateway, ZDX, Browser Isolation, Cloud NSS, or related Zscaler capabilities. * Experience with Terraform, Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Git, or CI/CD automation. * Zscaler, cloud, networking, or security certifications. **Skills** * Advanced troubleshooting of routing, authentication, certificates, proxies, application connectivity, traffic forwarding, and performance issues. * Ability to translate security and connectivity requirements into practical, identity\- and risk\-based policies. * Strong documentation, project ownership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. Ability to balance security, user experience, application performance, and business needs. * **OFFICE AND TRAVEL** * Work is primarily performed in an office or remote\-work environment using standard computer and collaboration tools. Periodic after\-hours support, on\-call participation, and up to 10% travel may be required. * **RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS** **Main Job Duties (50% of time)** * Design, implement, administer, and troubleshoot ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, App Connectors, traffic forwarding, TLS inspection, secure web gateway, firewall, threat protection, CASB, and DLP controls. * Secure employee access to internet, SaaS, and private applications using identity\-, device\-, risk\-, and data\-aware policies. * Design secure connectivity and segmentation for on\-premises and cloud workloads, private applications, administrative services, and machine\-to\-machine communications. Integrate Zscaler with identity, endpoint, cloud, certificate, SIEM, and incident\-response platforms. * **Strategy Management (15% of time)** * Develop and maintain the target architecture and roadmap for Zscaler, zero\-trust networking, secure access, and cloud workload protection. * Partner with business and technical stakeholders to assess user and application access, traffic and data flows, availability needs, performance, and security requirements. **Policy Administration (20% of time)** * Develop, test, document, and maintain access, data\-protection, traffic\-inspection, segmentation, and exception policies. * Govern internet, SaaS, and private\-application access and protect source code, credentials, intellectual property, customer information, and other sensitive data. **Reporting \& Analysis (10% of time)** * Monitor Zscaler logs and develop alerts for threats, sensitive\-data exposure, policy bypass, anomalous traffic, and administrative changes. * Report on platform health, traffic trends, policy effectiveness, exceptions, incidents, and remediation progress. **Other Duties as Assigned (5% of time)** * Automate configuration, validation, reporting, and compliance activities using APIs, scripting, or infrastructure\-as\-code tools. Maintain architecture diagrams, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and incident\-response runbooks. * **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** The physical requirements listed here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Position involves sitting for extended periods of time at employee’s workstation and during meetings as well as while traveling, either by plane or car. Employee needs to be able to lift to 20 pounds as frequently as needed to move objects; dexterity to write and manipulate computer keyboard and mouse; ability to hear and speak clearly; and ability to distinguish between colors on graphs and charts. Occasionally, employee will be required to visit construction jobsites which may expose the employee to dirt, dust, uneven surfaces, outdoor weather conditions and extreme temperatures. \*\*\* In alignment with our commitment to pay transparency, the base salary range for this position is $95,000 to $110,000, excluding fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you join McGough, your final base salary will be determined by several factors, including geography, location, skills, education, and experience. Furthermore, we place significant value on pay equity among our current team members as part of any final job offer. Please note that the range provided above reflects the hiring range for this role. Hiring near the top end of this range would be atypical, as we aim to allow room for future salary growth. Additionally, McGough offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. This includes insurance coverage for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability. We also provide generous retirement plans, voluntary benefit plans, parental leave, substantial paid time off, and holiday pay.

jobs.description: Overview: MasTec Civil is hiring a Field Engineer in Charleston, SC The role of a Field Engineer is to assist the Project Manager, Project Engineer, and Superintendents to engineer, plan, and schedule construction operations to ensure safe, efficient, profitable, and timely performance. The Field Engineer provides primary oversight on assigned field operations in a manner consistent with Company policies and procedures. The role requires thorough knowledge of project plans and specifications, preliminary and temporary work design, field layout and drawings, field operations planning, forecasting, cost and quantity tracking, operations scheduling, and interaction with field and office personnel. **COMPANY OVERVIEW:** Founded in 1987, MasTec Civil (formerly known as Condotte America), a MasTec Company, is a heavy highway contractor specializing in the construction of complex transportation projects that include roadway, bridges, interchanges, mass transit, and tolling facilities. In short, we build the roads and bridges connecting our families, communities, and nation. In doing so, client satisfaction is of primary importance to us, and our record reflects our emphasis on understanding our client needs in order to exceed their expectations. MasTec Civil is part of the MasTec Clean Energy \& Infrastructure (CE\&I) business segment. The CE\&I segment generates over $4\.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our renewables, industrial, infrastructure, and general building operating groups. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority\-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.
