jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best\-in\-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed. **Job Summary** --------------- In line with 49 CFR 625, 630, and 673 requirements, the Reliability Engineer will assist in the Reliability and Asset Management program to monitor and manage public transportation capital and operating assets to enhance safety, reduce maintenance costs, increase reliability, and improve performance. The successful candidate for this role will report to the Senior Manager of Reliability Engineering under Engineering, Planning, and Asset Management. The candidate will play a pivotal role in determining maintenance and engineering priorities within all modes of transportation through failure analysis and help develop a Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) program. This role will act as the primary liaison to the Engineering and Maintenance Department (E\&M) and Vehicle Maintenance (VM) to integrate reliability engineering efforts into an existing Preventative Maintenance Inspection program. This position will also be responsible for the development of the RCM branch of the Reliability Engineering department (interviewing, onboarding, forecasting, and establishing departmental policies for a new segment of the business). **Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Serves as the lead on programs related to improving reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety for all Infrastructure and Fleet asset classes. * Apply maintenance, technology, and innovation strategies for equipment, utilities, and facilities that minimize risks to levels of service. * Cultivate strong relationships with all individual asset class owners under E\&M and Vehicle Maintenance. * Collect asset performance data, verify and document as part of the Asset Management Program. * Apply Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) methods to guide MBTA departments in maintaining assets using best practices. * Leads efforts in determining root causes of failure of MBTA revenue and non\-revenue assets to ensure problems are identified at the correct level so appropriate solutions can be implemented. * Serves as a champion for all asset classes to ensure critical assets are monitored consistently for failure trends and performance. * Utilizes analysis tools and methods to independently develop performance reports on a daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly basis as required to ensure timely and relevant performance reporting is published to asset owners. * Analyzes projected product utilization and calculates the cumulative effect on final system reliability. * Drafts failure mode and effect analysis reports, and formulates mathematical models to identify assets posing excessive failure risks * Propose changes in design and develop work/maintenance plans to implement actions based on data analyses. * Supports the implementation of the Enterprise Asset Management system (EAM), Asset Configuration Management (ACM), and the management of data across numerous databases to ensure the quality and integrity of the data. * Advises and confers with engineers in design review meetings to give reliability findings and recommendations. * Assist with the development and documentation of condition\-based assessments for each individual asset type. * Document determining inspection criteria for verifying the condition of assets and monitor maintenance practices and procedures. * Establish criteria for component removal, refurbishment, and preventive maintenance cycles based on data\-driven metrics. * Measure the effectiveness of asset (both class and individual) maintenance programs. * Prepare, author, and develop periodic detailed reports to Senior Managers, Directors, Managers, Superintendents, and Supervisors based upon data derived from the EAMS to identify instances requiring engineering improvement. * Review inspections, test samples, reports, and other data to determine the Maintenance Condition of assets and components. * Create, analyze, and interpret EAM reports and data to assist with engineering and budget decisions. * Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or co\-worker professionally and courteously. * Support the Asset and Quality Management division policies and procedures by monitoring that policies and procedures are followed as they relate to assets, audit requirements, and other MBTA manuals and directives. * Uphold the rights and interests of the Authority while building and maintaining an effective relationship with employees. * Assist in the management of a workforce by ensuring th he duration of their program. **Disclaimers and Definitions:** * **General Disclaimer:** The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe a summary, general nature, and complexity of typical job functions and do not represent an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities required of staff assigned to this position. * **Application Completion:**It is each applicant’s responsibility to ensure application details are entered completely and correctly, including updated work and education histories (past and current). ***Incomplete applications may not be considered.*** Attachments ***do not*** substitute for application fields. The recruitment team ***does not*** have access to existing employee data / history. * **Application Deadlines:**Applicants should apply as soon as possible, as the MBTA may stop considering applicants after a sufficiently large applicant pool is established. * **Work Environment:**The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here\-in are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. See job description for role\-specific requirements. * **Work Eligibility:** All employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States and on an unrestricted basis. The MBTA does not have an employer work sponsorship program. However, if you have unrestricted work authorization, or are sponsored by a separate entity, you are welcome to apply. Further, all persons hired will require a U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting the position and employees will be required to complete a Form I\-9 to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the U.S. * **Interviews:**Candidates should ensure they arrive on time, are prepared, can remain for the duration, and if remote, are in a quiet place without distraction, for the interview. Candidates who do not attend their interview without advance authorization, including an email confirmation of a rescheduled time/date from Human Resources, will be considered a no\-show and disqualified from consideration for the position. Related to rescheduling, on a one\-time basis, and due to something emergent, you may be allowed to reschedule the interview. In addition, Human Resources may require documentation supporting the request. However, should you need to reschedule, you will need to contact your Recruiter directly by email. * **Safety Sensitive Positions:** Employees working in this classification will be subject to periodic physical examinations plus random drug and alcohol testing. * **On\-call or 24/7 Positions:** Employees working in this classification must be available to respond to page / text / call and report to work as determined by assigned department or the Authority. * **Essential / Emergency Staff:**During declared "states of emergency," employees working in this classification are required to report to work for their assigned work hours or as directed by management. * **ADA Accommodations:** The MBTA makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during this process, please contact the MBTA's ADA Unit at 617\-222\-5751 or hradaaa@mbta.com. * **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:** The MBTA is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. For terms, descriptions, and definitions related to diversity, equity, inclusion, veteran status, and immediate family members that you may find on the application form, please visit mbta.com/careers\-app\-definitions. * **Intern / Co\-Op Benefits:** Employees taking part in an internship or co\-op at the MBTA are eligible to receive accrued paid sick leave as well as a monthly transportation pass, based on the city from which the intern / co\-op commutes to work, at no cost. However, no additional benefits are currently offered for interns or co\-ops.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Lead AI Engineer Overview: Mastercard is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to join a small, focused AI technology team led by one of Mastercard's Distinguished Engineers. The team will initially focus on delivering agentic technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at scale and the use of open weight AI models. The team works in partnership with key technology stakeholders across the organization. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will design and build the platform capabilities that let Mastercard adopt MCP and open weight models safely and at scale, working alongside more senior engineers who set the broader technical direction. We are looking for someone with strong knowledge of modern AI technology, solid software engineering and MLOps skills, good cloud platform experience, familiarity with identity technologies such as OAuth and a practical grasp of model evaluation. In this role, you will help build the platform patterns through which Mastercard teams expose tools and data to agents over MCP, and through which the enterprise services, evaluates, and governs open weight models. You will contribute to the key technical decisions — gateway and connectivity patterns, identity and access controls, model\-serving infrastructure, and evaluation — and turn them into working, well\-engineered, production\-grade services. You will work across the MCP estate and the OW model working group, partnering closely with the team's senior engineers and with central technology, security, and governance stakeholders. About The Role: * Contribute to the design and build of the components of Mastercard's enterprise MCP deployment, such as the security gateway, the MCP registry that governs what exists and who owns it, and reference server implementations that teams build from. Take these from design through to running production services. * Implement the identity, authentication, and authorization patterns for MCP across the estate, working with the team's senior engineers and central security and identity teams so that agents, tools, and data are accessed securely and are auditable end to end. * Help set and apply the standard for internal and external MCP servers — how tools and data are exposed, discovered and versioned, and the inspection, data\-protection, rate\-limiting, and kill\-switch controls the gateway must enforce. * Build and operate open weight model serving — stand up and scale self\-hosted inference, package models for deployment, and help enable switching workloads across models and providers for cost, flexibility, and resilience. * Build the evaluation and testing tooling that benchmarks candidate open weight models for quality, cost, latency, and safety, and produces the reproducible evidence that governance and security reviews need. * Apply the MLOps practices that keep the platform reliable — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and model and service monitoring — so that what the team builds is maintainable and operable in production. * Partner with central security, privacy, legal and AI governance teams, and with the MCP SIG and OW working group, implementing their requirements correctly for the platform's architecture. * Keep current with a rapidly evolving landscape, such as new MCP developments, frontier open weight releases, and related agentic protocols, and help the team decide what to adopt, prototype, or wait on. All About You: * Strong knowledge of modern AI technology: LLMs and foundation models, agents, and the tooling and protocols (such as MCP) that connect them to enterprise systems. * Good software engineering skills: you write production\-quality, well\-tested code and build services others can depend on, not one\-off scripts or prototypes. * Solid MLOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, containers, observability, and monitoring for models and services in production. * Good cloud platform knowledge (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP valuable). Familiarity with a modern data/AI platform such as Databricks a bonus. * Practical experience with model evaluation, including building benchmarks and tests that measure quality, cost, latency and safety, and producing reproducible results others can rely on. * Hands\-on experience serving or operating open weight models, self\-hosting, and scaling inference, and ideally some fine\-tuning or adaptation to proprietary data and workflows. * Working knowledge of API security, identity, and access control, enough to implement MCP authentication and authorization correctly and partner effectively with security teams. * Awareness of the governance context that shapes enterprise AI, such as model provenance and licensing, data sovereignty, and financial\-services regulation. * A clear communicator and collaborator who works well with senior engineers, hands\-on peers, and specialist governance and security partner teams. * Intense curiosity about technology in general, and AI in particular, and who can demonstrate their learning agility outside the bounds of a specific function. * Lastly, a self\-starter: once you have a clear guidance and direction, you don’t need to be hand\-held to get to a solution or deliverable. \#AI1 Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations. THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 02/07/2027\. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible. **Pay Ranges** Purchase, New York: $161,000 \- $266,000 USD Arlington, Virginia: $161,000 \- $266,000 USD New York City, New York: $168,000 \- $277,000 USD O'Fallon, Missouri: $140,000 \- $231,000 USD

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Matter Health** Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission\-driven professionals who thrive in fast\-paced, people\-centered environments. **We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.** **About the Role** Matter Health is seeking a hands\-on, mission\-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI\-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field\-based teams—helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most. Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day\-to\-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role—not a platform architecture or people management position. This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non\-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in\-person meetings or team offsites. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field\-based teams to understand day\-to\-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI\-driven automation * Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly * Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field\-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations * Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting\-team leadership to define priorities * Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI\-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field\-based teams * Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day\-to\-day tasks * Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance * Monitor day\-to\-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team * Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations—including those handling protected health information (PHI) * Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI\-driven workflows * Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization * Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams * Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: **About Megaport** We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia\-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun. **Our Team Culture** We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. ### **Your Role** The Datacenter Operations team at Latitude.sh keeps the physical infrastructure behind our bare\-metal cloud running: servers, racks, power, cabling and structured connectivity across our global data center footprint. A fast\-growing part of that footprint is high\-density GPU infrastructure: multi\-GPU AI servers (8x SXM\-class NVIDIA platforms) drawing well above typical enterprise rack densities, with demanding power, cooling and cabling requirements. These systems run production AI workloads for our customers, so precision, uptime and hardware discipline are non\-negotiable. We are looking for a Field Engineer to act directly on this physical infrastructure. This is a hands\-on role: you will deploy, maintain, troubleshoot and repair GPU servers and their supporting infrastructure, travel between data centers in your region, and act as the on\-site focal point for new deployments, including overseeing remote hands teams at partner facilities. We are hiring at a senior level; mid\-level candidates will be considered when they bring solid, demonstrable GPU server hardware experience. **We are seeking four Field Engineers to join our team in Minneapolis, MN.** ### **What You'll Be Doing** * GPU Server Maintenance \& Break Fix + Diagnose and repair hardware failures on multi\-GPU servers (SXM baseboards, GPU trays, NVLink components, PCIe risers, NICs, DIMMs, NVMe drives, PSUs, fans); + Perform component\-level replacement following vendor procedures and ESD\-safe handling practices; + Run and interpret hardware diagnostics (BMC/IPMI logs, vendor diagnostic tools, GPU health checks such as nvidia\-smi, DCGM and field diagnostics) to isolate faults before intervention; + Execute firmware updates (BIOS, BMC, GPU, NIC) as part of maintenance windows and break\-fix workflows. + Manage the full RMA cycle: fault evidence collection, vendor ticket handling, part logistics, replacement and validation. + Validate repaired systems back to production standards (burn\-in, stress tests, link and thermal checks) before customer handover. * Deployments, Racking \& Cabling + Rack, stack and cable GPU servers and supporting equipment (switches, PDUs), respecting weight, airflow and power\-density constraints of high\-density racks. + Perform structured copper and fiber cabling: run, terminate, label, test and certify links (including high\-speed interconnects such as 400G/NDR\-class fabrics). + Verify power distribution readiness (PDU capacity, circuit balancing, redundancy) before energizing new GPU racks. + Execute server installations and decommissions end to end, including physical audit and inventory updates. + Support the Deploy \& Implementation team by confirming switch, PDU and cross\-connect availability prior to activation. * New Deployment Oversight \& Remote Hands Coordination + Act as the on\-site focal point for new GPU deployments in your region. + Plan, brief and oversee remote hands teams at partner facilities: define work scopes, validate execution quality and sign off on completed work. + Ensure deployment work follows Latitude.sh standards for cabling, labeling, documentation and safety. + Report deployment progress, blockers and quality issues to Datacenter Operations leadership and coordinate corrective actions. * Operations \& Documentation + Respond to physical infrastructure incidents within agreed SLAs, including on\-call escalations. + Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date documentation: rack elevations, cabling maps, asset inventory, maintenance records and runbooks. + Perform preventive maintenance and inspection routines on servers and rack\-level infrastructure. + Follow and improve c uipment (GPU servers routinely exceed 100 kg per chassis, handled with lifts and team procedures), working in hot/cold aisles. ### **Nice to have, but not essential traits and experience** * Experience with direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems for GPU servers: cold plates, quick disconnects, CDUs, manifolds, leak detection and coolant handling procedures. * Hands\-on experience with high\-density AI platforms from Supermicro, Dell, NVIDIA (HGX/DGX\-class) or similar OEMs. * Familiarity with InfiniBand/NDR fabrics and their physical layer (OSFP optics, splitter cables, fabric cabling patterns). * Certifications such as CompTIA Server\+, NVIDIA\-Certified (hardware/AI infrastructure tracks), BICSI Installer/Technician, or vendor hardware certifications (Dell, Supermicro, HPE). * Experience working in or coordinating with colocation/partner facilities and their remote hands processes. * Basic Linux command\-line skills for hardware validation and diagnostics. * Background in bare\-metal, hyperscale, HPC or AI infrastructure environments. ### **Working Model \& Scope** * Reports into the Datacenter Operations team. * Business hours with on\-call rotation for after\-hours physical infrastructure incidents. * Regional scope: based near one of our data center locations, with regular travel between nearby facilities for deployments, maintenance and incident response. * On\-site presence is essential to the role. ### **What We Offer** * Flexible working environment – a remote\-first culture with coworking options available * Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program * Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives * Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave * Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes * Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent * Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos award ###### **\#LI\-DNI** If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com **NOTE:** ***All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".*** *All applications will be treated in confidence.* *Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy\-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: There’s a particular satisfaction in finding the clue that helps everyone breathe again. You follow it. You make sense of what happened. Feel the pride of seeing a fix hold because you stayed with the problem long enough to prove it worked. Help build a team where people feel comfortable saying, “Something feels off,” and know they’ll be heard. Imagine a colleague pausing just before giving a new tool access to something sensitive. Assign owners and deadlines, maintain policies and runbooks, and report progress and unresolved risks to leadership. * Lead technical incident response from triage through recovery validation. Integrate code, dependency, and secret scanning into development workflows, prioritize exploitable findings, coordinate authorized testing, and verify remediation. * Build security automation with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or comparable tools. Document ownership, failure alerts, audit trails, and rollback procedures. * Assess vendor security, data flows, and third\-party access. Maintain security evidence for applicable contractual, privacy, and compliance needs, and coordinate security awareness and specialist support. MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS * Hands\-on experience in security engineering, incident response, or security operations, with examples of taking issues through investigation, remediation, and verification. * Practical experience securing hybrid environments across Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, cloud services such as AWS, endpoints, and networks. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience with Microsoft Defender or comparable endpoint protection, security information and event management (SIEM), or managed detection services. * Experience with Azure DevOps, application or API security testing, cloud or container security, or governance of AI coding tools and MCP integrations. * Relevant certifications or a degree are welcome. The organization aims to bring artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, automation, and AI\-powered engineering capabilities into the spaces where Micron engineers invent and develop memory and storage products. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. The **MDASH team** is reimagining how organizations identify and remediate vulnerabilities in source code. Using AI agents and models, MDASH analyzes code to determine whether potential vulnerabilities are real and reachable, provides developers with actionable fixes, and helps verify that vulnerabilities have been successfully addressed. We’re looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to help build and evolve the MDASH scanning engine as we work to advance agentic code scanning. In this role, you’ll design and build systems that coordinate AI agents and models to analyze complex codebases, scale across programming languages and frameworks, validate security findings, generate high\-quality fixes, and deliver reliable, efficient performance in production environments. You’ll work closely with security researchers, applied scientists, model teams, and product managers to turn new techniques and evaluation insights into product capabilities. We’re looking for an engineer with experience building complex, large\-scale systems, foundational knowledge of application security, and excitement about using AI to solve challenging problems in software security. **Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.** **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and evolve the MDASH scanning engine, including agent orchestration, multi\-model routing, code understanding, vulnerability detection, reachability validation, and fix generation and verification. * Extend the engine's coverage across vulnerability classes, programming languages, frameworks, build systems, and codebase sizes, from single services to large monorepos. * Integrate program analysis techniques into agent workflows to make detections more precise and grounded. These include static and dynamic analysis, taint tracking, call\-graph and data\-flow analysis, fuzzing, and sandboxed execution. * Improve the engine's precision, recall, consistency, and fix quality, working from evaluation results, research findings, and production feedback. * Optimize scan performance, scalability, cost, and latency so MDASH works well on enterprise\-scale codebases and in CI/CD workflows. * Build a secure, reliable, observable engine, with strong isolation for running untrusted code and clear telemetry for diagnosing agent behavior. * Work with security research, applied science, model, and product teams to bring new techniques and models into the engine quickly and safely. * Track the agentic security and code\-scanning landscape, and bring forward ideas that make MDASH stand out against competitors. * Write high\-quality, well\-tested code. Lead design reviews, take part in code reviews and on\-call rotations, and help raise the engineering bar for the team. Mentor other engineers and model Microsoft values to help build an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements**: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. classes such as memory safety, injection, authentication and authorization, deserialization, path traversal, SSRF, and business\-logic flaws. * Experience with program analysis techniques such as taint analysis, data\-flow and control\-flow analysis, code property graphs, fuzzing, or symbolic execution. * Experience building distributed, high\-scale cloud services on Azure, including containerized or sandboxed execution. * Familiarity with multiple software ecosystems and build systems across C/C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and cloud\-native applications. * A jobs.title: Technical Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **Reports To:** Chief Technology Officer **Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:** Full Time/ M\-F, 8:00 AM\-5:00 PM. About Us: Mid\-States Distributing is the leading Farm, Ranch, and Home Retail Organization. Our 72\+ year old company is owned by 29 independent Farm, Ranch \& Home retailers (“Members”) who operate approximately 700 stores across the US with combined annual sales in excess of 7\.5 billion dollars. Our member/owners retail items such as agriculture parts \& supplies, petroleum products, hardware \& tools, pet food, lawn \& garden, animal health supplies, apparel \& footwear, sporting goods, and various other products for the Farm, Ranch, and Home. We are looking for enthusiastic people who like to win! We place a tremendous amount of emphasis on creating a dynamic and positive company culture. Most of our employees will tell you that Mid\-States is the best place they’ve ever worked. We value high\-energy people with positive attitudes who believe in the concept of “serving to wow”! Our consumers are primarily rural people raising kids, pets, cows, and crops so traditional values like God, family, and patriotism are important virtues. So, if you are enthusiastic, competitive, have a great attitude, have excellent written and verbal communication skills, like to build strong relationships, like to win, and refuse to eat meat grown in a lab – Mid\-States may be the place for you! If you are not, please apply with our competitors! **POSITION** **OVERVIEW:** ========================== Mid\-States Distributing is looking for a versatile Technical Operations Engineer to work directly with the Chief Technology Officer across a wide range of technology initiatives. This is not a narrowly defined infrastructure, development, database, or project management position. The person in this role will work across all of those areas depending on the needs of the department. One day you may be investigating and fixing database performance, writing a PowerShell script, or troubleshooting an Azure issue. The next day you may be coordinating a technology project, working with a vendor, reviewing a network configuration, documenting a process, or helping solve an issue within Dynamics 365\. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning unfamiliar systems, and taking ownership of projects from initial investigation through implementation. The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist who may not know every technology on day one but knows how to research, troubleshoot, test, document, and ultimately solve technical problems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Responsibilities will vary based on current projects and business needs and may include: **Microsoft Azure and Cloud Infrastructure** * Assist with administration and optimization of Microsoft Azure resources. * Work with the network team to troubleshoot Azure infrastructure, networking, application, and configuration issues. * Assist with Azure SQL databases and other database services. This could mean fixing performance issues, finding and fixing bugs, maintenance schedules, etc. * Review resource configurations, performance, security, and costs. * Help implement infrastructure improvements and cloud\-based solutions. * Assist with identity, permissions, access control, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Help document and maintain the company's cloud environment. **Database Administration and Optimization** * Investigate database performance problems and identify potential improvements. * Write and review SQL queries. * Analyze slow queries, indexes, execution plans, and database workloads. * Assist with database maintenance and optimization. * Support data integrations between internal and external systems. * Help troubleshoot data\-related issues across applications. **Automation and Scripting** * Develop PowerShell scripts and other automation tools. * Automate repetitive IT and business processes. * Build scripts for system administration, reporting, monitoring, data movement, and maintenance. * Improve existing scripts and internal tools. * Identify opportunities where automation can reduce manual work. **Dynamics 365 and Business Systems** * Assist with the administration and support of Microsoft Dynamics 365\. * Troubleshoot Dynamics\-related issues involving users, integrations, workflows, applications, and data. * Assist with data imports, exports, transformations, and integrations. * Support projects involving Dynamics 365 and related Microsoft technologies. * Work with internal users and external vendors to resolve system issues. **Networking and Infrastructure** * Assist with troubleshooting switches, firewalls, VPNs, network connectivity, and other infrastructure. * Review network configurations and troubleshoot performance or connectivity problems. * Assist with infrastructure upgrades and technology deployments. * Coordinate with third\-party providers when needed. **Troubleshooting and Technical Operations** * Investigate technical issues across a wide variety of systems. * Perform root\-cause analysis rather than relying solely on temporary fixes. * Research unfamiliar technologies when necessary. * Work independently to develop and test potential solutions. * Escalate issues appropriately while providing clear documentation of what has already been investigated. **Documentation** * Create and maintain technical documentation. * Document systems, configurations, scripts, processes, and troubleshooting procedures. * Create implementation and rollback plans for system changes. * Help improve internal IT procedures and standards. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND EXPERIENCE: Candidates do not need deep expertise in every technology listed below. Experience across several of these areas is preferred. * Microsoft Azure * Microsoft 365 * Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Active Directory * Microsoft Dynamics 365 * SQL Server and Azure SQL * T\-SQL * PowerShell * REST APIs and system integrations * Windows Server * Networking fundamentals * Firewalls and switches * VPNs * DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and related network technologies * Git or other source control systems * Scripting or software development * Data transformation and migration * Monitoring and logging systems Experience with additional programming languages, cloud platforms, databases, networking technologies, or enterprise applications is a plus. **Qualifications** * Strong technical troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies. * Strong understanding of general IT and systems concepts. * Experience with scripting, programming, system administration, database administration, or a combination of these disciplines. * Ability to manage multiple unrelated projects simultaneously. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical users. * Strong organizational and documentation skills. * Ability to identify when additional expertise or vendor support is required. * Comfortable working directly with senior technology leadership. * Willingness to take ownership of problems and drive them through resolution. A specific degree or certification is less important than demonstrated technical ability, problem\-solving skills, and professional experience. **TRAVEL:** =========== Some travel involved. **OTHER** **DUTIES:** ===================== Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **A few words from our** **COO:** --------------------------------- I have had the pleasure to work for some incredible companies during my career, but Mid\-States is truly the best company I have ever worked for. Lead by our dynamic CEO, Tom Mahlke, our team strives to provide a unique, exciting, fun, and fulfilling work environment for our staff. Things like drama, laziness, and entitlement have no place in Mid\-States, which makes Mid\-States a refreshing place to work. We offer competitive salaries, have a fantastic benefits package, and believe in rewarding those who produce. We serve a wonderful industry, and we are financially sound and growing rapidly. If you are an enthusiastic, high\-energy person with a positive attitude and the skills described above, you may have just found the last job you will ever apply for! I look forward to meeting you. – Jeff Rash, COO

jobs.title: AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 4 Dec 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== MiniMed is building a lean, high\-leverage AI \& Data Science team that designs, builds, and runs AI agents and models across the business. We are looking for a Manager, AI Engineering to lead our AI Agent Engineering team, including Principal AI Engineers, Senior AI Engineers, and contract engineers, and to turn a growing portfolio of AI use cases into reliable production systems. This is a player\-coach role. Most of your time goes to leading the team and its delivery. You also stay close to the work, spending about a quarter of your time reviewing designs and code, prototyping, and working on hard production problems, so your technical decisions reflect how the systems actually work. Principal AI Engineers set the team's technical standards; you make sure the team has the people, plan, and quality bar to deliver against them. What success looks like A strong, growing team. Engineers are hired well, developed, and retained, and Principal AI Engineers have room to lead technically. Predictable delivery. AI use cases move from approved idea to production on a plan the business can rely on. Reliable systems. What the team ships passes the readiness bar and holds up in production after handoff. This is a hybrid position based in Atlanta, GA or Northridge, CA **A Day in the Life** Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. *Lead the team and its delivery (about 45%)* * **Build and grow the team.** Hire, onboard, and develop AI engineers; run performance and career conversations; give Principal AI Engineers the support and room to set the technical standard for the team. * **Run delivery.** Turn the team's part of the AI roadmap into a sequenced, predictable plan; run sprint planning and backlog prioritization; manage capacity across concurrent initiatives; raise risks with leadership early. * **Work with product managers and the business.** Partner with AI product managers, the enterprise transformation team, and business leaders to choose what to build, size the effort, and decide when a prototype is ready for engineering hardening. * **Represent the team.** Report progress, risk, cost, and value to the Data Science \& AI Lead and business stakeholders in clear, plain terms. *Own production readiness and standards (about 30%)* * **Set the production\-readiness bar.** Define what an agent needs before it ships: evaluation evidence, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop where required, fallback behavior, monitoring, and an incident plan. You own this release gate for everything the team builds. * **Own escalation and shape the handoff.** Serve as the escalation point for production issues in the team's systems. As our platform and operations functions take shape, help define how capabilities move from build to steady\-state operation, including ownership, service levels, and runbooks. * **Set development standards.** With the Principal AI Engineers, define testing, documentation, versioning, and release practices, and make sure agents built by enablement engineers inside the business follow the same standards. * **Build in security and compliance.** Partner with AI governance and security on access controls, data flows, and prompt\-injection safeguards. Turn the safety, privacy, and compliance requirements of a medical\-device company into engineering controls, including auditability, documentation, and evaluation records. *Stay hands\-on (about* *25%)* * **Review designs and code.** Review high\-risk or cross\-cutting work before it ships. * **Prototype selectively.** Build proofs of concept and reference implementations on our internal AI platform (Databricks, LangGraph/LangSmith, and enterprise agent platforms) to de\-risk new patterns, while critical\-path delivery stays with the engineers who own it. * **Work the hard problems.** Triage and debug production issues alongside the team when a system is failing and the stakes are high. * **Use AI in how the team works.** Make AI coding and agent tools part of the team's standard workflow, and use them in your own management work. **Must Have: Minimum Requirements** To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident in your applicant profile. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 5\+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including 2\+ years managing engineers (hiring, performance management, and career development). * OR Advanced degree and 3\+ years of the experience above, including 1\+ years managing engineers. * Delivered LLM\-powered or agent systems to   perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer and communicate with peers and co\-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role. **Benefits \& Compensation** ============================ **MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package** At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$138,000\.00 \- $234,000\.00 This position is eligible for a short\-term incentive called the Short Term Incentive (STI). At MiniMed, we are committed to supporting the well\-being and financial security of our employees. Regular employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for a robust benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, as well as access to a Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, life insurance, long\-term disability leave, and a dependent daycare spending account. In addition, all regular employees enjoy incentive plans, a 401(k) plan with company match, short\-term disability coverage, paid time off and holidays, participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and access to our Employee Assistance Program. Eligible employees may also benefit from our Non\-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement and Capital Accumulation Plan, subject to IRS minimum earnings requirements. Please note that “regular employees” refers to those who are not temporary staff, such as interns, and some benefits may not apply to employees in Puerto Rico. For further details about our comprehensive benefits, we encourage you to visit the link below. MiniMed Benefits Overview **About MiniMed** ================= MiniMed is a full\-stack insulin delivery company dedicated to supporting people living with diabetes through every step of their journey — when and how they need it. For more than 40 years, we’ve been committed to redefining what’s possible: intelligent dosing systems designed for real life, predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and always on support when it’s needed most. Working in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Databricks with the AI Architect, Sr. AI Solution Engineer, and AI Engineer, make enterprise data AI\-ready, measurable, and trustworthy, so every AI answer can be traced to its source. **The Impact You'll Make:** --------------------------- * Retrieval (RAG) Data Pipelines — Build and operate ingestion, parsing, chunking, enrichment, embedding, and vector / hybrid indexing pipelines (e.g., Azure AI Search, Databricks Vector Search) that ground Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agentforce, and custom agents; enforce permission\-aware retrieval that respects source\-system security. * Semantic Layer \& Grounding Context — Design and maintain Power BI / Fabric semantic models, business glossary, and entity relationships (e.g., customer, product, and distributor across Salesforce, SAP, and BI) that give AI agents and Fabric data agents a shared, accurate understanding of the business. * AI Data Readiness Assessment \& Remediation — Assess source data for each AI use case (coverage, quality, freshness, sensitivity, and bias); score AI readiness; and drive remediation with source owners before AI build begins. * AI Data Access via MCP \& APIs — Expose curated, zero\-copy data in Microsoft Fabric / OneLake and Databricks to AI agents through governed interfaces (e.g., MCP servers, SQL endpoints, APIs) with least\-privilege access. * Retrieval Quality, Observability \& Feedback — Monitor index freshness, data drift, and retrieval quality (relevance, groundedness, citation accuracy); feed agent logs and user feedback back into data fixes; publish AI\-readiness key performance indicators (KPIs) in Power BI. * Metadata, Lineage \& AI Data Governance — Register AI data assets in Microsoft Purview or Collibra; apply sensitivity labels; maintain lineage from source to index, agent, and answer; partner with Legal, Privacy, and Security on personal data, retention, EMEA data residency, and AI regulatory requirements. * Evaluation \& Ground\-Truth Datasets — Curate golden question\-and\-answer sets, labeled ground truth, and test data that measure AI accuracy; prepare data for fine\-tuning or model customization when needed, including LLM\-generated synthetic data with appropriate controls. * LLM\-Assisted Data Engineering \& Standards — Use OpenAI and Claude models and AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor) to automate metadata enrichment, entity matching, documentation, and pipeline code; contribute AI data standards, templates, and playbooks. **Who You Are:** ---------------- * Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Statistics, or related. * 3\-5 years of experience in data engineering (pipelines, data modeling, SQL, Spark), including work on Microsoft Azure / Fabric or Databricks * 1\-3 years of experience in building data pipelines specifically for AI or generative AI use cases (RAG, embeddings, vector search, semantic models, evaluation datasets) * Computer Skills Desired: Languages / query: SQL (advanced), Python (data tooling, PySpark), Spark (intermediate) * Platforms: Microsoft Fabric / OneLake (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, data agents), Azure data services, Databricks, or equivalent * AI data tooling: Azure AI Search and vector / hybrid search, OpenAI embedding models via Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, LangChain or similar for ingestion, MCP servers for data access * Models: OpenAI GPT\-5\.6 / GPT\-6 and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5\.5 / Haiku 5\.5 for enrichment, classification, and evaluation * Metadata / catalog: Microsoft Purview, Collibra (or similar); Git for versioning * Modeling / orchestration: dbt, Azure Data Factory / Fabric pipelines, or Airflow * Dashboards for AI\-readiness KPIs: Power BI * AI\-assisted development: Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot * Preferred Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\), which replaces the retired Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP\-203\) * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Generative AI Engineer Associate * Microsoft AI\-103: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure (desirable) * Collibra or Microsoft Purview practitioner training / certification * Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Strong collaboration with the AI Architect, Sr. AI Solution Engineer, AI Engineer, data engineering, governance, and security teams; ability to turn business concepts into semantic models, entity relationships, and retrieval\-ready data; treats retrieval quality and data trust as measurable outcomes Monster Energy uses AI\-powered tools, including Greenhouse's Talent Matching feature, to help evaluate applications for this role. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Benefits Platform
jobs.description: **About River Health** River Health is a healthcare benefits company. Employers offer River plans to their teams, members enroll and get care through our apps, and our clinical team coordinates visits, labs and follow\-up. One Go backend runs all of it: member, employer, broker, provider and admin apps, plus the partners that issue cards, take payments, run vision benefits and receive our eligibility files. We're hiring a senior backend engineer to own the riskiest parts of that backend. You'll be the person who says yes or no on changes that touch billing, eligibility, member health data and scheduled jobs. Most of our code is written with AI agents, and your judgment is what makes it safe to ship. **What you'll own** ------------------- * **The core API.** A Go service on Postgres. You co\-own it with the engineering lead and are the reviewer of record for billing, eligibility, partner integration and member data changes. * **Plans, enrollment and billing.** Plan configuration, employer contributions, plan years, Stripe subscriptions, and the path from an employer's eligibility file to an active member. Getting dates and dollars right. * **Partner integrations.** Eligibility exports over SFTP, a card program for in\-person visits, lifecycle email and SMS, vision benefits, e\-prescribing, video visits and HR data. When a partner's records and ours disagree, you find out why. * **Scheduled jobs.** Workers that pause, top up, reconcile and sync. You make them idempotent, observable and safe to rerun. * **Production health.** Structured logs, traces and alerts. You work the production errors queue down and keep it down. You're part of the on\-call rotation: \[rotation length, how often, and whether pages come outside business hours]. * **Member data protection.** Access scoping, audit logging and HIPAA data handling across every endpoint. * **Agent guardrails for billing, eligibility and member data.** The skills, guidance, evals and guardrails that let agents, and the people using them, work safely in these areas. You and the engineering lead decide what an agent does on its own and where a person signs off. **How we build** ---------------- * **Small pods.** Cross\-functional pods own outcomes. You sit in the Clinical Pod, which owns the patient and provider experience, and review backend work for every pod. * **AI\-first, end to end.** Agents plan, build, review and test. Engineers spend their time on judgment: scoping, review, data correctness and production calls. * **You own QA for what you ship**. End to end ownership of projects is typical \- plan, build, test and rollout. An automation partner covers regression. * **Product ships code too.** Product makes light\-weight code changes and design in front\-end code. **What you bring** ------------------ * **Health and Benefits industry and/or System of Record experience.** US health benefits experience: enrollment, eligibility files, benefits administration, TPA, payer, ICHRA or digital health company. Or the same kind of work in payroll, insurance or fintech, where records have effective dates, eligibility rules and partner files. * **Experience working with coding agents and check what they claim.** You hand them whole tickets, run several at once, and can show us your setup. Before you approve, you ask what the agent searched and which test fails without the change. * **6\+ years building backend systems in production.** Go in production, or deep experience in another typed language and ready to work in Go from week one. * **Strong Postgres.** Data modeling, migrations on live data, and reviewing queries for scope and cost. * **Shipped code that moves money.** Stripe or similar: subscriptions, proration, failed payments, webhooks. * **Partner integrations with messy data.** File feeds, SFTP, webhooks, retries and reconciliation. * **You make the engineers around you better.** You step in to unblock teammates, pair when it helps, and guide or mentor as needed, without waiting to be asked. * **Clear writing for non\-engineers.** A clinical ops lead should understand your release note. **Nice to have** ---------------- * LLMs in a regulated setting: PHI handling, evals * HIPAA programs, BAAs and audit logging * OpenTelemetry, Axiom or similar observability tools * TypeScript and React * Card issuing or other fintech programs * 834 EDI or carrier eligibility feeds **This role isn't for you if** ------------------------------ * You want a separate QA team to catch your bugs. * You want finished specs before you start. Here you help write them. * You don't use AI coding tools, or you trust them without checking. * You'd rather not talk with ops and clinical teams. **Compensation and how to apply** --------------------------------- * **Compensation:** $175,000 to $210,000 base, plus equity * **Benefits:** * + Medical, dental, and vision coverage (through ICHRA up to $600 is our policy, Vision XP, and River Essentials for everyone) + Paid time off and company holidays + Training and professional development + Transportation stipend + 401k w/ company match In addition to sharing your resume and please respond (under 350 words) to the below via cover letter: Answer the first question, then pick one of the other four. **Everyone answers:** Tell us about an agent\-written backend PR you sent back even though its tests passed. What was wrong, how did you catch it, and did you change anything so the agent wouldn't make the same mistake again? **Then pick one:*** A time production data was wrong: dates, dollar amounts, a record your system and a partner's system disagreed on (such as a customer your system showed as cancelled who was still active with the partner), or a bulk edit or migration that didn't do what you expected. How did you find it, and how did you fix the records that were already affected? * A job, import or webhook that ran twice or stopped halfway. What did it do to the data, and what did you change so it was safe to run again? * A backlog of production errors or noisy alerts that you worked down. What did you fix first, and why? * A backend change you had to explain to people outside engineering, such as an operations or support team. What did they need to know, and how did you make sure it landed?

The work combines deep systems engineering, rapid experimentation, and close collaboration across technical disciplines. We are looking for a browser engine specialist who enjoys turning difficult systems questions into working experiments. You will investigate browser behavior, implement changes deep in the engine, and establish which ideas produce meaningful improvements. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of engine\-level investigations and implementation, working closely with the team’s technical lead. The work suits someone who has built or substantially changed browser internals, understands the tradeoffs embedded in those systems, and enjoys applying that knowledge to unfamiliar problems. Your experiments will help inform technical direction. **What you'll do:** * Design and implement experiments within browser engine subsystems. Investigate how internal data structures and execution behavior affect performance, correctness, and the interfaces exposed to developer tools. * Evaluate ways to represent and expose browser state efficiently and accurately. Identify the tradeoffs in each approach, including information loss, implementation complexity, and compatibility with dynamic web content. * Prototype engine capabilities that support reliable programmatic interaction with web content. Investigate how document structure, layout, navigation, and event handling affect correctness and performance. * Instrument browser behavior and evaluate changes against repeatable tasks. Measure performance and correctness, isolate the effect of each change, and document unsuccessful experiments as clearly as successful ones. Check that gains hold beyond the workloads used to develop the prototype. * Profile the overhead introduced by new capabilities and pursue improvements where measurements justify them. Use AI tools to accelerate coding and analysis, and verify their output through debugging, tests, and measurement. **What you'll bring:** * Deep hands\-on expertise in at least one browser engine subsystem, such as DOM and Web APIs, layout and rendering, accessibility, JavaScript runtimes, or networking and process architecture. You have implemented substantial changes and can trace their effects into neighboring subsystems. * Strong proficiency in C\+\+ or Rust, experience navigating a large systems codebase, and practical knowledge of memory ownership, concurrency, object lifetimes, and performance debugging. You can build the JavaScript and scripting tools needed to exercise and measure your work. * A demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar code, form a precise hypothesis, construct a useful prototype, and interpret the results. You can separate the effects of your implementation from variability in websites, workloads, or model behavior. * A strong understanding of web platform behavior and compatibility. You can reason about how document structure, script execution, rendering, and user interaction relate, including cases where the browser’s internal state is difficult to expose accurately to another system. * Experience with profiling, tracing, regression tests, or conformance tests, and a habit of grounding performance claims in reproducible evidence. You can explain both the benefit of an optimization and the circumstances in which it fails. * Curiosity about AI agents and a willingness to work directly with agent harnesses and coding tools. You can connect a low\-level implementation choice to the information an agent receives and the work it must do next. **Nice to have:** * Contributions to Gecko, Servo, Blink, WebKit, or another browser engine * Experience maintaining an open\-source project * Technical leadership in a small team building a new product * Experience with accessibility infrastructure, browser security, profiling, or automated evaluation of agent workflows **What you’ll get:** * Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all eligible employees \- we share in our success as one team * Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) * Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together * Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday * One\-time home office stipend * Annual professional development budget * Quarterly well\-being stipend * Considerable paid parental leave * Employee referral bonus program * Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country) **About Mozilla** Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. jobs.title: AI Factory Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: NVIDIA owned the way in accelerated computing to address problems beyond the reach of standard computers. Its creation of the GPU in 1999 ignited the expansion of PC gaming and transformed modern computer graphics. Now, NVIDIA drives AI forward as a full\-stack computing firm. Its data center platforms fuel the upcoming industrial revolution, where intelligence is the product. Our efforts cover accelerated computing, AI, robotics, and the vital data center infrastructure. NVIDIA is now creating AI factories: custom facilities that generate intelligence at unmatched scale and density in data centers. These are not typical data centers; they require power\- and cooling\-heavy production setups with innovative mechanical systems, new build standards, and fresh engineering leadership. As NVIDIA expands, we seek outstanding engineers who continuously learn, are passionate about their work, and aspire to perform at their highest level. The growth of NVIDIA's accelerated computing and AI infrastructure surpasses historical data center development and operation speeds. We want a highly motivated AI Factory Mechanical Design Engineer to take charge of next\-generation liquid cooling and thermal systems for AI factories. Your responsibility will cover all phases, from concept to construction and commissioning, at a scale rarely seen before. This position is not about reviewing others' designs; you will be the engineering authority for systems lacking an established guide. You will join a small, high\-impact team where your choices directly influence what is developed. You will set technical direction across hydronic, airside, and facility heat\-rejection systems, mentor engineers across the organization, and drive programs that bring real megawatts of AI compute capacity online. Current focus areas include the technical roadmap for advanced mechanical systems, programmatic facility plans, owner\-furnished equipment strategy, and adapting standardized plans to local site conditions. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Lead data center product and facility builds, balancing cost, energy efficiency, schedule, and sustainability while integrating new technologies. * Own mechanical systems strategy and development, including liquid cooling, chiller plants, heat rejection, CDUs, and airside/hydronic systems, from concept through construction administration and commissioning. * Deliver design documentation and lead execution across all project phases (SD, DD, CD, CA) for greenfield, leased, and retrofit projects. * Partner with civil/structural, electrical, connectivity, controls, and hardware engineering to align rack\-level thermal requirements with facility design, optimized for cost, speed, efficiency, and flexibility. * Drive prefabricated and modular construction strategies and build\-to\-break\-ground schedules to accelerate deployment. * Act as NVIDIA’s owner’s representative: hold engineer\-of\-record teams accountable, prepare RFPs, manage contracts, and review change orders, submittals, RFIs, and value\-engineering proposals. * Participate in factory witness testing, commissioning, and quality verification, and support handover and knowledge transfer into live operations. Evaluate emerging technologies, standards, and sustainability targets (energy and water modeling), support site selection and master planning, and advance reliability and availability practices. * **What We Need to See:** * Possession of a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years of mechanical engineering experience supporting critical facilities or large\-scale data centers. * Proven expertise in liquid cooling systems, chiller plant development, and/or hydronic system development. * Experience leading large\-scale mechanical infrastructure programs from concept through construction and commissioning. * Experience across all phases of design delivery (schematic design, design development, etc.). Strong ability to communicate technical concepts in writing and presentations to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including build reviews and executive briefings. * **Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:** * Experience with prefabricated and modular construction (build for manufacturing and assembly), plus operations and deployment handover for data center mechanical systems. * Hardware thermal engineering background, including thermal build validation and product reliability, with deep expertise in availability and reliability engineering for critical infrastructure. * Proficiency in controls systems (BMS/EPMS integration, mechanical controls logic), electrical and MEP integration, and acoustics/noise engineering and regulatory compliance for mechanical equipment. * Familiarity with advanced simulation, modeling, or AI\-driven build optimization tools. * Professional Engineer (PE) license in Mechanical Engineering required; track record of mentoring engineers and representing owner interests on large capital programs. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 5; and 216,000 USD – 345,000 USD for Level 6\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compute Scheduling
jobs.description: NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high\-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help design solutions that power some of the world's most advanced computing workloads. The MARS Scheduling team decides how NVIDIA's AI research compute gets used. That fleet spans many of the largest GPU clusters in the world, across multiple clouds and partners, running everything from frontier\-model pretraining to reinforcement learning and agentic workloads. We run Slurm and Kubernetes at large scale. Our scheduling is coordinated and topology\-sensitive on rack\-scale systems. We manage fair sharing and quotas for hundreds of research teams. We support preemption and reservations. Elastic jobs recover from failure without losing progress. You will own real parts of the scheduling stack, and the opportunity to ship code into our open\-source and internal platform code, and see the result in GPU\-hours returned to researchers within days. The researchers training NVIDIA's own models are your users, and they will tell you quickly what works. **What you'll be doing:** * Design and build scheduling for large GPU fleets on both Slurm and Kubernetes. That covers queueing, gang and topology\-aware placement on rack\-scale NVLink systems, preemption, reservations and backfill that reaches the end of very deep queues. * Build the policy layer: fair share, quotas and allocations across many research teams, driven from a central allocation system and enforced the same way on every scheduler. * Run Slurm as a cloud\-native service on Kubernetes, and extend Kubernetes batch scheduling (Kueue and its ecosystem) for training, reinforcement learning, sandboxes and inference. * Build services around the scheduler: reservation automation, node\-health\-aware placement, workflow orchestration across clusters, and APIs that let other platforms submit and track work. * Measure and raise goodput: GPU occupancy, waste, fairness and time to start for large jobs. Use the data to choose what to build next. * Own reliability for the components you build: on\-call, incident analysis and fixes that remove whole classes of failure, so problems are found before researchers hit them. Work upstream and across teams: contribute to Slurm, Kubernetes and related open\-source projects, and partner with platform, storage, networking and research teams. * **What we need to see:** * BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 6\+ years building production systems software. * Deep experience with at least one batch or cluster scheduler, such as Slurm, Kueue, Volcano, KAI, YuniKorn or a scheduler you built. You should be able to explain its internals, not only its configuration. * Strong programming in Go, C or C\+\+, plus Python for tooling and analysis. * Hands\-on Kubernetes experience: controllers or operators, CRDs, scheduling and resource management. * Solid Linux systems knowledge: containers (Docker, Podman, Enroot or Apptainer), cgroups, networking basics and debugging under load. * A track record of owning a service in production and making it measurably better. Clear written and spoken communication with engineers and researchers. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience scheduling large\-scale AI training: thousands of GPUs, NVLink and InfiniBand or RoCE topology, multi\-node jobs that must start together. * Contributions to Slurm, Kubernetes SIG Scheduling, Kueue, Volcano, KAI or similar open\-source schedulers. * Experience running Slurm on Kubernetes (Slinky or similar), or building Kubernetes operators for batch or HPC workloads. * Familiarity with RL, agentic or inference workloads and what they need from a scheduler: heterogeneous jobs, sandboxes, elastic scale and fast restarts. * Experience with workflow orchestrators such as Flyte, Airflow, Ray or Kubeflow at scale.
