jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Data
jobs.description: NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high\-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help build solutions that power some of the planet's most advanced computing workloads. The MARS AI Data team owns how NVIDIA's AI research uses data: many petabytes of training data, checkpoints and datasets across multiple clouds and partners. We build the layer between storage and the workload. That covers data placement across file systems, object storage, and local NVMe. It also includes streaming loaders and caches that supply tens of thousands of GPU cores. Efficient checkpoint management. Quotas remain fair throughout numerous research groups. This is a builder's role on a team that is redefining what it does. You will help design MARS' data platform on Kubernetes from the ground up, working directly with the researchers training NVIDIA's own models. The work shows up as faster training steps, shorter restarts and fewer runs lost to complete storage volumes. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * Design and build the AI data layer for a multi\-cloud GPU fleet: how datasets, checkpoints and scratch data are placed, cached, tiered and moved between different storage backends. * Build high\-throughput data paths for training and RL. That means streaming loaders from object storage, distributed caches, and checkpoint save and restore at thousands of GPUs, including peer\-to\-peer and local\-first restore. * Make data a first\-class part of the compute platform. Build Kubernetes\-native APIs, operators and storage integrations so a job declares the data it needs, and the platform mounts, caches and accounts for it, on Slurm and on Kubernetes. * Own quotas, capacity and data lifecycle across hundreds of research teams: usage attribution, quota enforcement, retention, clean\-up of stale data, and forecasting capacity before it runs out. * Measure how workloads use data. jobs.description: NVIDIA is hiring engineers to build and operate the governed infrastructure platform behind our Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and hardware engineering organization, giving teams a self\-service path from source code to production that runs in the cloud and at each physical site. Our team solves complex challenges across datacenter hardware, networking, distributed systems, and software deployment. We collaborate closely to design and deliver leading infrastructure solutions. jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test 5 - Discovery & Viewing Experiences
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. We’re hiring a senior Software Engineer in Test to lead how Netflix tests the experiences members use on their TVs and phones. You’ll define what quality means for complex, fast\-moving features, build the tools and automation that prove it, and help every engineer around you ship with confidence. **The Teams** **Live UI** The Discovery and Viewing Experience (DVX) Live team owns the UI engineering and architecture that powers Live viewing experiences across TV, iOS, and Android. Members show up for live events once, with no second airing and no patch mid\-show, so every feature we build is a promise that it will work at that moment on every device that tunes in. As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show. **What we’re working on:** * The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi\-match sport tournaments. * Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter. * Real\-time voting , which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment. **Mobile Core** The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams. **What we’re working on** : * Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross\-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android. * Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale. **The Role** **Problem you’ll help solve:** * Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live\-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone. * Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way. * Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change. * Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross\-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions. **What you’ll do:** * **Lead testing for complex features across platforms.** Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward. * **Build automation that people trust.** Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable. * **Make tricky live moments easy to test.** Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire. * **Make large migrations safe.** Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members * **Own quality metrics.** Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly. * **Make sure bugs only surprise us once.** When a bug reaches members, make sure it comes back as a test, using agents to turn each finding into several, and document how to test each feature so the knowledge doesn’t live in one person’s head. * **Build and leverage AI tools.** Act as a force multiplier to flag unwanted behaviors before they reach members, and apply agents to test authoring, failure triage, and bug analysis. * **Shape testability from the first commit.** Partner with engineers on architecture and code that are easy to test, and help them write better tests themselves. * **Test where teams meet.** Agree with partner teams on the contracts between our features and theirs, so end\-to\-end tests verify where teams meet and rehearse what members experience, rather than retesting every team’s systems. * **Collaborate beyond the team.** Work with partner teams on shared test data, environments, and tools, and with teams that run live event ort working across platforms.** You’ve tested consumer apps on more than one platform, and you’re eager to learn the platforms you haven’t used yet. * **Strong coding skills,** with experience designing and building test frameworks and tools, not just writing test cases. * **Experience or strong interest in using AI for testing** , such as writing tests, triaging failures, or finding gaps in coverage, with clear ways to check its results. * Deep experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky tests, infrastructure failures, and dependency issues. * Experience with mocking, test data, or other ways to make hard\-to\-reproduce situations repeatable in tests. * A practical, risk\-based approach to quality: knowing where to invest in tests, which risks are acceptable, and when more testing isn’t the answer. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining quality risks and trade\-offs to engineers, product managers, and partners in terms they can act on. * Alignment with Netflix's culture and values. **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with live streaming, video playback, ads, or other systems where split\-second timing matters. * Hands\-on experience with testing frameworks on several platforms, such as Jest, Puppeteer, Espresso, or XCUITest. * Experience driving shared testing infrastructure or quality strategies adopted by multiple teams. * Experience testing how systems behave when things go wrong, such as chaos testing or failure drills. **Growth opportunities:** We’re hiring a senior engineer, and we see this role growing into one that sets the standard for how Netflix tests its Live experiences and mobile apps at scale. Over time, you can: * **Lead testing strategy across teams** , creating the practices and tools that other teams adopt. * **Shape client architecture for testability** across platforms. * **Influence partner teams' tooling and roadmaps** , so our experiences are easy to test for everyone. * **Mentor and grow** engineers and SDETs across the organization. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $266,000\.00 \- $442,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.description: **Location: Remote \| Type: Fulltime** **About Newpage Solutions** Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real\-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human\-centered practices. We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives. **Your Mission** We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in. You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end\-to\-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder\-first individual\-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python. **What You’ll Do** **Problem / Opportunity Discovery** * Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable. * Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week. * Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships. * Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision. * Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques. **Build (fast) with AI** * When the brief is clear, head down and produce. * Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain\-driven design. * Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono. * Architect and ship production\-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer. * Integrate frontier and self\-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open\-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors. * Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 \+ similarity search. * Work across relational, document, key\-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event\-driven patterns where they fit, not by default. * Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub\-agents—with discipline and review. * Fine\-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it. **Test, Deploy, Productionize** * Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users. * Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless—chosen for fit, not preference. * Treat evals as a first\-class discipline: hands\-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear\-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short. * Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). * Own what you build end\-to\-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running. * Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices. **What You Bring** * Minimum 7\+years of Experience and 3\+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches—fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more. * Hands\-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi\-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration. * Active, structured use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub\-agents, skills, and innovative approaches. * Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12\-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar. * End\-to\-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses. * Cloud\-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel—with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. * A no\-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost. * A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave—and where they break—and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost. * Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them. * A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions. * A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high\-impact technical challenges. * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. **Bonus Skills / Experience** * Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI. * MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker). * Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue). * Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure. * AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications. **What We Offer** At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer: * A people\-first culture \- Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging * Smart, purposeful collaboration \- Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges * Balance that lasts \- We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life * Room to grow \- Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you * Meaningful rewards \- Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential **Ready to Apply?** Let’s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to: shilpa.shetty@newpage.io #### **More about Newpage** Newpage is a digital health solutions company. We devote ourselves to advancing the quality of life by enhancing health and optimizing the longevity of people. We do this by, passionately building futuristic technologies for global organizations across the healthcare ecosystem. We partake at every stage from problem definition, strategy \& service design, user research, UX design, and agile software development – utilizing lean practices to deliver and validate highly innovative digital health solutions that drive user value and business transformation. Newpage is recognized by ‘CIO’s Review’ as “Top 50 Promising Healthcare Solution Providers” and Great Place to Work Certified (GPTW) 2023 \& 2024\.

jobs.description: Staff AI Engineer, Security Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3148 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Recent incidents, like an AI model under test breaking into another company's infrastructure, show the new kinds of risk: agents acting outside their intended scope, models and tools pulled from public hubs, and normal automation becoming an attack path. You'll make sure our systems are built to contain all of that, and that the secure option is also the easy one. You'll work closely with News Corp's global cybersecurity team, bringing AI security depth to Realtor.com while aligning with group\-wide standards. We are looking for a rigorous practitioner who advocates for software engineering excellence across the full Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). Use frameworks like STRIDE, the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP ASVS. Turn the findings into clear design requirements and release criteria. * Review pull requests, architecture designs, and release\-readiness for everything from apps to agent fleets, and make concrete suggestions that move work forward instead of blocking it. Build paved\-road frameworks, reference architectures, and secure\-by\-default templates that rule out whole categories of risk, instead of catching them one PR at a time. * Build security into CI/CD: secrets scanning, SAST/SCA, GitHub Actions hardening, and policy\-as\-code in Terraform. * Build an ongoing red\-team and evaluation program for our models, agents, and LLM apps, and test new AI features before launch. Use AI to do security work * Build agents that help do the security work: triage findings, investigate alerts, audit IAM for least privilege, and open tested, secure\-by\-default fix PRs. * Use Claude Code, Devin, and MCP to make the security team faster, and share those patterns with other engineerin pt injection defenses, retrieval and data\-boundary risks, agent identity, and model or tool supply\-chain integrity. * Experience doing threat modeling for products and platforms, not just infrastructure. Strong code\-review skills in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, and comfort with Terraform/IaC. * Experience with zero trust, least privilege, SSO/OIDC/OAuth, secrets management, and vulnerability management. * Experience working within a larger security organization, such as a parent company, central security team, or federated model. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer — Risk & AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: *We Before Me*, *Do the Right Thing*, and *Get Things Done*. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK\-er. **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on\-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions—signals that very few organizations can analyze together. The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience. This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real\-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration. You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM\-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI\-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team's daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production\-ready AI practices. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You'll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work. * Build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for fraud and risk detection. * Improve data quality, features, and model performance, balancing fraud detection with customer experience. * Develop AI agents to support investigations, summarize cases, retrieve evidence, and automate routine workflows. * Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging while reviewing and validating their output. * Work with engineering, product, and risk teams to deploy solutions and monitor their impact. **What We Look For In You** --------------------------- * A strong foundation in machine learning, with hands\-on experience in deep learning and tree\-based models such as XGBoost or LightGBM. * Strong Python skills and experience training, evaluating, and deploying models. * Some practical experience building AI agents or LLM applications, including tool calling, retrieval, or workflow automation. Prototypes and personal projects are welcome. * Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to understand, test, and improve generated code. * Familiarity with databases and data pipelines for preparing training data and supporting ML workflows. * Good problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience in account takeover (ATO), scam detection, or other fraud and risk use cases. * Experience with LLM training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and alignment. * Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and their practical implementation. * Experience with real\-time ML systems, imbalanced datasets, or model explainability. * Prior fraud or risk experience is helpful * Fluency in Mandarin **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * Competitive total compensation package * L\&D programs for employees' growth and development * Various team building programs and company events * Wellness and meal allowances * Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants * More that we love to tell you along the process! **OKX** **Statement:** OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non\-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. The salary range for this position is $214,666 to $321,999 The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
jobs.description: Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans. Key Responsibilities System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability: –Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to support hyper\-scale systems. –Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. –Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down). –Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. –Design performance and load testing. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design: –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting. –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance: –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health.. System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability: –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness. –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management: –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. Compliance \& Security: –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. Automation \& Change Management: –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. Core Responsibilities Planning \& Execution: –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. Collaboration \& Partnership: –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. Problem Solving: –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. Continuous Learning: –Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. Continuous Improvement: –Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. Performance and Development: –Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

and requires an onsite presence.** Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications:* BS/BA gram. The role provides opportunities to build practical skills across .NET applications, web technologies, integrations, and GCP workloads. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Contribute to analysis, coding, testing, deployment, and support of POS integrations and custom applications using C\#/.NET, APIs, SQL, and related technologies. * Resolve scoped defects and implement enhancements and maintenance changes with guidance and code review from experienced engineers. * Contribute to front\-end and application improvements across the supported environment, including exposure to React/JavaScript, Node.js, and MongoDB. * Investigate application and integration issues using logs, dashboards, queries, and documented procedures; record findings and escalate when needed. * Perform QA by creating and executing test cases, reproducing defects, validating fixes, and documenting results for applications and integrations. * Contribute automated tests and testing tools with senior guidance; validate fixes and prepare testing evidence for senior engineers to review and approve releases. * Assist with GCP workloads using Kubernetes, Apigee, Cloud SQL, service mesh, Pub/Sub, and Gemini AI; complete monitoring work identified by the SRE with engineering guidance. * Provide tiered support to stores and associates and work with Help Desk partners to document troubleshooting steps and escalation guidance. * Participate in code reviews and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles; apply feedback and established engineering standards. * Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business partners on requirements, incident resolution, and POS lab testing. * Support Salesforce as part of the team’s application portfolio. Use ServiceNow as the primary incident management and ticketing system, and Jira and Confluence for project management, work tracking, and documentation. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Foundational programming skills and an understanding of object\-oriented programming, APIs, and the software development lifecycle. * Ability to investigate technical problems, communicate findings, and document work for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Willingness to learn unfamiliar applications, follow established procedures, seek guidance, and apply code\-review feedback. * An organized, dependable approach to assigned development, testing, and production\-support work. * Relevant coursework, projects, internships, or equivalent experience may demonstrate the required foundation; prior professional C\#/.NET experience is not required. **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent cloud platform is highly desired. * Exposure to C\#/.NET, SQL, and APIs; experience with React or JavaScript, Node.js, or MongoDB is highly desired. * Exposure to functional or regression testing, test automation, messaging platforms, or application monitoring tools. * Experience with retail technology or POS systems, including NCR. **Location and Work Schedule** ============================== This role is remote within Costa Rica. Primary working hours align with Mountain Standard Time (MST) in Phoenix, Arizona. On\-site attendance is required as needed for POS lab testing and during visits by company vice presidents; there is no fixed on\-site schedule. Participation in a rotating on\-call schedule is required, providing 24/7 coverage for one week, currently estimated at approximately once per month. A manager and product\-team engineering resources will provide backup during each on\-call scenario. Additional after\-hours work may be required based on business needs. Opportunities to work voluntarily on holidays will be offered. **About Technology Operations** =============================== This role is part of Technology Operations, which keeps PetSmart’s systems within our area of responsibility reliable, available, and running efficiently so store and home office associates can do their work. You will navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and help teams move issues toward resolution. At times, you will contribute to discussions about unfamiliar systems or problems, ask focused questions, and coordinate assigned issues with guidance from experienced team members. You will work with internal teams and external partners with urgency. Restoring service may require occasional work outside regular hours, including evenings, weekends, and participation in the required on\-call rotation. **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. Our Costa Rica office offers outstanding amenities in a fun and rewarding workplace including: * You will be able to bring your pets to work! * Free access to UltraPark gym facility * Learn more about \#Life AtPetSmart here: https://www.lifeatpetsmart.com/life\-at\-petsmart/ * Check out Associate stories and share in some celebrations at PetSmart: https://www.blog.lifeatpetsmart.com/ * Will have medical, dental \& vision benefits for all associates * Offer paid time off including holidays and discretionary days PetSmart provides an equal opportunity for all associates and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description: **ROLE SUMMARY** Engineering Activation \& Tooling is responsible for the tools, access, and onboarding experience that let engineers across Pfizer's eight platforms start delivering from Day One — and for making sure the estate of tools they rely on keeps pace with a wave of new developer and AI capabilities We are seeking an experienced Tooling Evolution Lead (individual contributor, principal\-level) who will own the evaluation, industrialisation, and lifecycle of engineering and AI developer tools across the organisation. In this role, you will run the governed intake process new tools and proofs\-of\-concept go through, score them against a shared evidence framework, and decide — on evidence rather than instinct — what earns a fast, contained pilot, what graduates to the supported core estate, and what gets retired once usage data says it is no longer earning its place. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Creative Experiences
jobs.description: Open to full\-time hires and interns. **About the role** ------------------ At Pika, we're looking for a creative, hands\-on AI researcher who can turn the latest models, APIs, and emerging ideas into compelling experiences people want to try and share. You'll combine models across image, video, audio, and language to build workflows, demos, and features that bring people to Pika and contribute to revenue growth. This is a goal\-driven applied research role, open to both full\-time hires and interns. You'll take ideas from an initial opportunity through experimentation, implementation, and delivery, then use feedback and results to decide what to improve next. Strong creative judgment, resourcefulness, and fast execution are central to the role. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Find promising opportunities. Stay close to new models, tools, creative formats, and cultural trends. Identify ideas with a clear audience, use case, and potential to drive interest, website traffic, or revenue. * Build end to end. Combine existing models, APIs, and tools into working multimodal workflows. Own the path from a rough concept to a usable demo, creative asset, or product experience. * Choose the right amount of research. Test practical approaches quickly. Use lightweight LoRA fine\-tuning or targeted post\-training when it meaningfully improves the result and fits the project's time budget. * Deliver frequently. Work in short iteration cycles, set a clear scope for each experiment, and get strong first versions out quickly. Make thoughtful trade\-offs between additional research, output quality, cost, and time to delivery. * Create work ready to share. Produce compelling demos and creative outputs that the team can use for social media, launches, and other growth efforts. Personally posting on or managing social channels is not required. * Learn from results. Use audience response, product feedback, and relevant traffic or revenue signals to decide which ideas to refine, expand, or stop. * Make successful work reusable. Leave working workflows, examples, and concise documentation so the team can reproduce and build on what you deliver. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience building with generative AI models, APIs, or creative workflows, with examples of work you have taken from idea to a working result. * Strong prototyping and coding skills: you can connect tools, debug a pipeline, and make an end\-to\-end experience work. * A creative, entrepreneurial mindset and good judgment about what makes an output compelling, useful, and worth sharing. You enjoy the pace and resourcefulness of a hackathon: testing ideas quickly and getting a working result into people's hands. * Curiosity across modalities and the ability to learn unfamiliar models and tools quickly. * Ownership and comfort with tight timelines: you can prioritize, simplify an approach, and recognize when shipping and learning is more valuable than further polishing. * A clear connection between technical choices and the intended user or business outcome. **Helpful experience** ---------------------- * Experience as a startup founder or early\-stage startup team member, or actively building and testing startup ideas. * Hackathon wins or standout hackathon projects that demonstrate rapid prototyping, resourcefulness, and end\-to\-end execution. * LoRA fine\-tuning, lightweight model adaptation, or other targeted post\-training. * Combining image, video, audio, or language models in a single workflow. * Building creative demos, interactive prototypes, or AI experiences that reached real users. **What success looks like** --------------------------- You deliver a steady stream of compelling, usable experiments; turn the strongest ideas into repeatable workflows; and use each release to learn what attracts users and contributes to Pika's growth. Success depends on the quality, speed, and impact of what you deliver.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ At Pika, we're looking for a technically strong, client\-facing AI researcher who can turn customer feedback into models and workflows that solve real business needs. You'll work directly with clients to understand what they want to achieve, identify where current model outputs fall short, and fine\-tune or post\-train models for their use cases. When the solution calls for more than model adaptation, you'll build the supporting workflow. This is a full\-time, hands\-on, revenue\-driven applied research role. Clear communication, professional client service, reliable delivery, and independent execution matter as much as technical ability. You'll help clients get value quickly, build their confidence in working with Pika, and help turn successful technical work into closed engagements and ongoing business. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Understand the client's needs. Listen carefully, ask focused questions, and translate requests and feedback into a clear problem, practical scope, and agreed success criteria. * Adapt models for real use cases. Fine\-tune and post\-train models to address client needs. Prepare relevant examples and evaluation criteria, diagnose gaps, and verify that each iteration improves the outcomes the client cares about. * Build the complete solution. Create or adapt workflows around models when needed, connecting APIs, tools, and processing steps into a usable solution that fits the client's deployment needs. * Iterate quickly with clients. Share working results early, gather specific feedback, and make focused improvements in short cycles. Balance quality, complexity, cost, and delivery speed to keep projects moving. * Communicate professionally. Explain technical options and limitations clearly, set realistic expectations, respond thoughtfully to requests, and keep clients informed about progress and next steps. Build a relationship that makes them want to continue working with Pika. * Own execution and coordinate with the team. Drive day\-to\-day work with independence while keeping teammates aligned on requirements, priorities, progress, and blockers. Ask for input or escalate risks early when needed. * Deliver for deployment. Help move successful experiments into usable deployments, with clear evaluation results, reproducible workflows, and the documentation needed for handoff. * Help close client engagements. Demonstrate the solution's value, address technical concerns, and work with the team to turn successful iterations into client commitments and revenue. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning or post\-training generative AI models, with the ability to diagnose model behavior and evaluate whether an adaptation solves the intended problem. * Strong coding and practical ML skills: you can implement experiments, work with data, debug model pipelines, and build supporting workflows. * Excellent listening and communication skills. You can understand an ambiguous request, clarify what matters, and explain technical work to clients with different levels of expertise. * Professional judgment, reliability, and a service mindset. You handle feedback constructively, communicate limitations honestly, take ownership of commitments, and build trust through consistent follow\-through. * Independence and ownership, combined with strong communication and collaboration within the team. * The ability to work in fast feedback cycles, prioritize the highest\-impact improvements, and connect technical decisions to client value and commercial outcomes. **Preferred experience** ------------------------ * Prior professional experience in a similar client\-facing AI or ML role, with end\-to\-end delivery from requirements and model adaptation through evaluation, integration, and deployment. This experience is strongly preferred. * Delivering reliable AI solutions for external clients or users and supporting them through feedback and iteration. * LoRA fine\-tuning, other parameter\-efficient adaptation methods, or feedback\-driven post\-training. * Building model evaluation pipelines, API integrations, or workflows used in a deployed product. * Participating in customer demos, technical pilots, or the delivery of paid projects. **What success looks like** --------------------------- Success is measured by how well you serve clients, how quickly you turn feedback into useful improvements, and how reliably your work meets their deployment needs. Strong performance builds client trust, helps close engagements, encourages continued collaboration, and contributes to revenue.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Engineer, Fullstack
jobs.description: **Pinwheel \- Building the future of financial services in partnership with the biggest brands** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ "I love my banking app!" said no one, ever. Pinwheel is on a mission to change that. We believe banks and financial service providers represent the greatest opportunity to build 10x better experiences, especially in the AI age. We're building the next generation of financial products alongside some of the biggest names in the market including Robinhood, DoorDash, Chime, Cash App, Credit Karma, American Express, Discover, Intuit, Acorns, Visa and more. If you're excited by the idea of having your work touch and impact the lives of hundreds of millions of consumers, Pinwheel is the place for you. If you get stoked about building products alongside the biggest brands in the world, Pinwheel is the place for you. If you want to join a scrappy, hustling team that is obsessed with defining the future of financial services, Pinwheel is the place for you! Pinwheel has raised $77M from top\-tier investors such as Coatue, Notable, First Round, Upfront, Primary, American Express, Franklin Templeton, Indeed, Semper Virens and more. \*\*This role is hybrid with 3 days a week in our NYC office. \*\*This position does not offer visa sponsorship now or in the future.\*\* **Who are we looking for?** --------------------------- We're hiring a senior full\-stack Product Engineer for our Product Engineering team. The PE team builds all the things our customers and their users use: public APIs, embedded SDKs, customer management dashboard, and more. Our Product Engineering team is lean and works very closely with Product to ensure we're evolving Pinwheel's product in ways that bring maximum value to our customers. We are a high\-velocity team where we balance four main workstreams: support of customers, deliver the roadmap, proactively improve the product and keep\-the\-lights\-on. **What will you do?** --------------------- Here are some projects you might work on in your first six months: * Help us build our Bill Switch product that helps our customers drive account primacy through migrating their users' subscription spend to their new accounts * Contribute to a new API version that improves our contracts and formalizes recent product direction in our platform's code * Help us firm up and improve our tax product for next tax season * Clean up old code that no longer serves our current product direction and leave the codebase better than you found it * Build a new customer dashboard API that aligns with our stack and opens up future expansion possibilities in customer dashboard functionality * Build new integrations with banking platform partners and help us improve existing implementations to make them more effective In general, your responsibilities in this role would include: * Deeply understand our customer needs and design systems to solve them * Build, scale, and evolve the data models, services, and systems that power our APIs * Design and ship impactful new functionality in our products, especially focused on our internal and customer\-facing back\-end APIs * Maintain and improve our Python\-based microservice stack * Create and improve tooling, processes, and engineering standards across the team * Mentor engineers and help the team grow **What qualifications are we looking for?** ------------------------------------------- * 7\+ years of experience building and maintaining full\-stack applications, specifically with data modeling, application logic, and API design * Prior experience working at an early\-stage startup or small tech company * Expertise with modern back\-end languages/frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Django, Rails, Gin) * Expertise with modern frontend web frameworks (React, Vue, etc.) * Played key implementation roles in projects with multiple teams and engineers * Excited by working closely with customers * Responsibly uses AI on top of fundamental skills, doesn't replace them * Maintains a high bar for technical quality and continues to level up At Pinwheel, total compensation is made up of salary \+ equity \+ benefits. We recruit motivated and high performing talent, and work to compensate people in line with the value they can bring to the organization in delivering outsized results. The talent market is competitive, and maintaining our ability to recruit and retain the best team possible is a top priority for Pinwheel. When creating an offer, we consider interview performance, candidate experience, external market competitiveness, and internal equity in thoughtfully assessing compensation. The expected cash salary range for this role is $180,000 \- $225,000 base. **Why join Pinwheel?** ---------------------- **Best time to join** \- Our company is small but well\-funded, meaning you are joining at a time where you can impact and shape the company. **Be a cultural builder** \- You will have an active hand in molding the company culture and being a part of the entrepreneurial journey. **Build something revolutionary** \- Help build the products on the bleeding edge of financial services! **Benefits included:** * Great compensation \& equity packages * Full medical, dental, and vision benefits * Life \& short\-term disability insurance * Flexible PTO policy that prioritizes recharge and balance * Paid parental leave * 401K for retirement planning * Mentorship opportunities * Free Citibike membership * Pet friendly offices and Zoom spaces ### **Diversity \& Inclusion at Pinwheel** At Pinwheel, we are committed to building an environment that is diverse and inclusive. We believe that having people across different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives enables us not only to build the best financial products, but to help us realize the best versions of ourselves. Pinwheel is an equal opportunity employer, and we aim to be an open and supportive place to work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (#d689)
jobs.description: **Benefits You'll Love** Fully remote, for good. No return\-to\-office surprises. Stability. A company with no layoffs and a long track record, at a time when much of tech can’t say that. Lead the AI shift. Help a large engineering organization change how it builds software with AI, and see the impact across the whole team. Real modernization work. Take established products used by financial institutions across the US and make them faster, cleaner and easier to build on. Growth. The company plans to double revenue, and this is its top engineering hire right now. **Become a Key Player as a Senior Software Engineer AI** This company is a long\-established software provider in financial services, and its platform is used by hundreds of lenders across the US. It’s fully remote, has never had layoffs, and plans to double its revenue over the next several years. AI is a big part of that plan, starting with how its own engineers build software. You’ll join as a senior engineer on a new team with two goals. The first is to modernize the company’s core lending products on a strong C\# and .NET foundation. The second is to lead how the engineering team adopts AI in its daily work. You’ll own work from design through production, set practical standards for using AI coding tools well, and help other engineers get real value from them. jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer
jobs.description: Associate Data Engineer **Department:** Data and Analytics **Reports to:** Data \& Analytics Lead **Position Summary** ==================== Pogue Construction is seeking an Associate Data Engineer to help build and maintain the data pipelines, API integrations, and dashboards our teams use to make business decisions. As the third member of our data team, this role will work closely with the Data \& Analytics Lead and our existing technical team member to keep data accurate, available, and useful across the company. The Associate Data Engineer will support the data lifecycle from source onboarding and ingestion through transformation, reporting, monitoring, and retirement. The primary focus is hands\-on data engineering and API management, with ongoing Power BI dashboard support. This is an opportunity to develop engineering skills while learning how project, financial, and operational information moves through a construction business. The role will take day\-to\-day responsibility for assigned integrations and support tasks under established standards and technical guidance. The Data \& Analytics Lead will set priorities and retain responsibility for architecture, governance, and production approval, working with IT, Information Security, and department data owners. **Experience** ============== * 0\-2 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics, software development, or technical application support. Internships, co\-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects will be considered. * Practical experience using SQL and a scripting language to retrieve, transform, validate, or troubleshoot data. **Education** ============= * Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical training and experience. **Primary Responsibilities** ============================ **Data Engineering and Ingestion** ---------------------------------- * Build and maintain assigned data pipelines using approved patterns to bring information from APIs, databases, and files into Pogue's data platform. * Support new source onboarding by profiling data, documenting field mappings and refresh requirements, and validating initial loads with the team and source owners. * Develop and maintain SQL transformations, notebooks, and dataflows that prepare source data for Silver and Gold tables and downstream reporting. * Support incremental loads, scheduling, dependencies, retries, and controlled reruns or backfills. Investigate missing records, duplicate data, schema changes, and pipeline failures. **API Management and Integration Support** ------------------------------------------ * Develop, test, and maintain API connections for business systems such as CMiC, Procore, and scheduling platforms as assigned. * Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, payload mapping, and error responses using established integration and security practices. * Maintain an API inventory documenting endpoints, system owners, permissions, dependencies, refresh schedules, and support contacts. Track credential expiration and coordinate approved rotation with IT and system owners. * Monitor integration health and vendor API changes. Test version changes, troubleshoot failed requests, and support approved internal APIs that provide curated data to other applications. **Dashboard and Reporting Support** ----------------------------------- * Maintain and enhance Power BI reports using approved semantic models, KPI definitions, report standards, and Pogue branding. * Investigate refresh failures, incorrect results, filter behavior, and access issues. Trace problems through the report, model, pipeline, and source system, and escalate issues outside the assigned scope. * Gather and document user requests, deliver small report improvements, support user acceptance testing, and create practical guidance that helps employees use reports correctly. **Data Quality and Lifecycle Support** -------------------------------------- * Implement and maintain checks for completeness, freshness, duplicate keys, and reconciliation to source totals. Work with department data owners to investigate discrepancies. * Keep mappings, lineage, dependencies, runbooks, and change records current so another team member can support assigned assets. * Use version control, peer review, testing, and established release procedures. Document deployment and recovery steps, communicate service interruptions, and help resolve recurring problems. * Follow approved access, classification, and retention practices. Support archiving and retirement of unused datasets, integrations, and reports after checking dependencies and obtaining the required approval. **Required Skills** =================== * Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and troubleshooting query results. * Foundational Python or comparable scripting skills for data processing and automation. * Understanding of relational databases, data transformation, and the purpose of ETL or ELT pipelines. * Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP requests, JSON, and authentication concepts. * Ability to troubleshoot methodically, validate results, and document work clearly. * Clear communication with technical colleagues and business users, sound handling of confidential information, and willingness to learn through feedback and review. **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, including pipelines, notebooks, lakehouses, warehouses, or dataflows. * Experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, semantic models, and refresh troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, automated testing, monitoring, or deployment workflows. * Exposure to OAuth, service principals, secure credential storage, or API testing tools such as Postman. * Familiarity with CMiC, Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or construction accounting and project operations.

jobs.title: Data Engineer – Mobile Monetization – Big Data, GenAI & Mobile AdTech
jobs.description: **About the Role** PubMatic is seeking for a passionate **Data Engineer** to join our Mobile Advertising Platform engineering team. In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering **Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real\-time analytics**. You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing **billions of mobile advertising events** every day including **ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in\-app events, and auction logs**. You'll build both real\-time event processing and large\-scale batch processing systems on PubMatic's in\-house data centers, leveraging modern Big Data technologies (Spark, Kafka, Hadoop), high\-performance services in Go and Rust, and Generative AI to deliver intelligent analytics and automation solutions. You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next\-generation Mobile AdTech products. **What You'll Do:** * Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of **mobile advertising events** with low latency and high availability. * Design and build ultra\-low\-latency, high\-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — **ad request** **impression** **click** **install** **in\-app conversion event** — including **OpenRTB bid request/response logging**, auction analytics, and win\-rate/bid\-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, and Hadoop on our in\-house data centers. * Architect real\-time **campaign pacing and budget delivery systems**, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds. * Architect and implement real\-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in\-app events. * Build real\-time event processing systems with event\-time semantics, windowed aggregations, watermarking, late/out\-of\-order event handling, deduplication, and exactly\-once or idempotent delivery guarantees across Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming. * Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics. * Develop and tune large\-scale batch processing jobs on Spark and Hadoop (HDFS/YARN) — hourly and daily aggregations, backfills, reprocessing, and data reconciliation between real\-time and batch layers — with strong workflow orchestration, SLAs, and data\-quality checks. * Design large\-scale **Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection** systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules\-based and ML\-driven detection across billions of daily events. * Develop high\-performance backend services and data processors (Java, Go, Rust, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. * Operate and scale data infrastructure in PubMatic's in\-house data centers — Kafka, Spark, and Hadoop clusters — including capacity planning, performance tuning, storage and compute efficiency, and cost optimization on bare\-metal hardware. * Design and develop GenAI\-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks. * Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience. * Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features. * Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning. * Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices. **We'd Love for You to Have:** * 1–5\+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering. * Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles. * Hands\-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases. * Strong experience building distributed real\-time and batch data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, and SQL on on\-premise / in\-house data center infrastructure. * Experience designing and optimizing large\-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Go, Rust, Spark, Kafka, and SQL. Strong understanding of real\-time event processing, distributed data systems, and data warehouse architectures. Familiarity with distributed quer hestration frameworks * Prompt engineering and prompt optimization * AI evaluation and observability * AI agents and workflow automation **Additional Preferred Skills** * Experience building scalable, production\-grade AI or data platforms. * Strong SQL optimization and query performance tuning skills. * Experience running Big Data platforms on\-premise — managing Kafka, Spark, and Hadoop/HDFS clusters, capacity planning, and hardware\-aware performance tuning in a private data center environment. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment on bare\-metal / in\-house data center infrastructure. * Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or similar. * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed environments. * Demonstrated ability to achieve stretch goals in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment. * Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently. **Why Join Us?** * Work on high\-scale data infrastructure processing billions of mobile advertising events every day, directly impacting publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem. * Help shape the future of real\-time analytics, attribution, campaign pacing, fraud/IVT detection, and GenAI\-powered automation for mobile app monetization. * Build modern data platforms with Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Go, and Rust on PubMatic's in\-house data centers at internet scale, with low latency and high availability. * Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, DSP partners, and publisher teams. * Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company. **AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset** We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate development, improve code and data quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking — using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution — will thrive in our high\-scale, data\-intensive environment. **Qualification:** Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university. **Additional Information:** **Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. **Benefits:** Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!. **Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status **About PubMatic** PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.
