and troubleshoot production issues. * Apply software engineering practices to create reliable, maintainable, and testable ML solutions. \#LI\-JB1

jobs.title: Cisco Network Infrastructure Engineer (Remote from anywhere in CO)
jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- **Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado** The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first\-of\-their\-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services. Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado. **Description of Job** ---------------------- **IMPORTANT NOTE:** Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team. As our new Cisco Network Infrastructure Engineer you will provide network engineering services to the statewide enterprise network and all State agencies. You will act as a subject matter expert providing design, implementation, and support of highly complex networks including LAN/WAN, Wireless, data center, cloud technologies. The position acts as the technical lead for the planning, testing, administering, and implementing network solutions and establishing best practices standards. The position makes decisions and provides detailed input that affects the State core network and agencies' network infrastructure. The position performs network architecture design and implementation, which impacts all supported agencies and their locations across Colorado. The position establishes network technology standards to be used within the State network infrastructure. The position interfaces with the network operations, security operations, and telecommunications teams to provide network services to customers. The position supports the strategic interface to other entities, including state, federal, and local agencies; private sector groups; and the public. Some of the day to day tasks include: Designing, configuring, administering, and deploying mission critical network hardware and applications to provide network as a services (NaaS) for State agencies to include wireless, software defined access and wide area networks. Maximize network performance by monitoring performance, troubleshooting network problems, addressing security concerns, responding to and resolving outages, scheduling upgrades, and collaborating with internal and external partners on network optimization. Providing subject matter expertise on network design, solution, and implementation for new network projects. Analyzing performance and comparative costs of products to determine the most cost effective solution. Providing recommendations and solutions to leadership. Partnering with customers and vendors to clarify rationale for technical decisions and concepts so they can understand the basis for the decisions. **Term Limited Position:** This position is term limited with an anticipated end date of approximately two (2\) years from the date of hire. This position is eligible for State employee benefits and may be extended as the situation warrants. This **video** explains the many benefits of working at the State of Colorado on a term limited basis**.** **Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While most salary offers are made within the posted range, occasionally an offer is made below or above the posted range based upon this salary analysis. This is a skills\-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows: **Minimum Qualifications:** A minimum of three (3\) years of hands\-on professional experience designing, implementing, testing, and documenting complex Cisco based network solutions. Expertise in Software\-Defined Access, Cisco DNAC, and Catalyst technologies is highly preferable. **Substitutions:** Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year\-for\-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications. Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit toward cations. If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year\-for\-year basis. **Preferred Qualifications:** Three (3\) years professional engineering experience in network design, architecture, and implementation. The ideal candidate will have a thorough understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and Cisco products, and will work on planning and improving enterprise network solutions. Cisco Professional and/or Expert certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or Cisco Certified Internet Expert (CCIE). Professional networking experience with wireless technologies. Professional networking experience with Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE) application. Professional networking experience with Cisco DNAC. Professional networking experience with data center technologies. Professional networking experience with Software\-Defined Access technologies. Professional networking experience with scripting and automation. Experience in Agile/Scrum Methodologies or Agile/Scrum Methodologies certification(s). **Conditions of Employment:** OIT candidates and employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state entity locations where they might be required to perform work. A pre\-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Positions supporting some agencies such as the Department of Corrections and the Department of Public Safety will also require a pre\-employment drug test. This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed. This position may require on\-call duties as needed by the position. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado. While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date. We know it's important to support each other, and that means having a healthy balance of work and personal time. Visit our benefits to learn more about some of our great offerings that allow us all to have fulfilling lives. Visit our How to Apply webpage to learn more about our application process and what to expect after you apply. The State of Colorado strives to create a Colorado for All by building and maintaining workplaces that value and respect all Coloradans through a commitment to equal opportunity and hiring based on merit and fitness. The State is resolute in non\-discriminatory practices in everything we do, including hiring, employment, and advancement opportunities. The Governor's Office of Information Technology is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our ADA Coordinator at OIT\_HR@state.co.us or call (303\) 764\-7900\. This posting may be used to fill multiple vacancies based upon business need. The Governor's Office of Information Technology does NOT offer sponsored Visas for employment purposes.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer (SDET), Mobile
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States \& Canada **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a QA Automation Engineer (SDET), Mobile to help build and maintain the shared test automation platform that Quo's engineering teams rely on, with a focus on our mobile apps. This is a mid\-level role on our growing Quality Engineering team \- one of two Automation Engineer hires (this mobile\-focused role and a web\-focused counterpart) opening alongside a Quality Ambassador req from the same headcount round. Per our Test Automation Philosophy \& Ownership Framework, feature teams own the tests that validate what they build, at every layer including end\-to\-end; our Automation Engineers own the shared platform underneath \- the frameworks, harnesses, and canonical patterns (Maestro, Playwright, our API contract harness) \- plus the specific cross\-team suites nobody else owns, like smoke tests and the mobile device/OS matrix. In this role, you'll own the mobile side of that platform. You'll help build and maintain it, not absorb test\-writing from feature teams. You'll join a small, fast\-moving Quality Engineering team that's actively redefining how automation and manual QA work together, reporting to our Director of Quality Engineering. ### **Some of the things you'll do:** * Own and extend our shared mobile test platform: the Maestro framework feature teams build their own tests on top of, working alongside our web automation engineer who owns the Playwright side * Own the mobile device/OS matrix, along with mobile smoke tests and other cross\-team mobile suites nobody else owns * Contribute to coverage\-gap audits across mobile and backend API tests, turning findings into real, owned test coverage * Diagnose and drive down flaky tests in CI \- telling the difference between a flaky test, an unstable environment or device, and a real regression * Help maintain and extend tooling that turns customer\-reported bugs into scoped coverage\-gap work * Partner constantly with mobile, backend, and web engineers to embed testing patterns into their workflow, including how shipping mobile differs from shipping web * Help socialize canonical testing patterns and standards to squads as they mature **About You** ------------- * 3\+ years of professional software engineering or SDET experience, with meaningful time spent building and maintaining test automation, not just writing individual test cases * Hands\-on experience with mobile test automation tools like Maestro or Appium (or similar) on native mobile apps * Comfortable owning device and OS matrix testing, and you understand how deploying mobile differs from deploying web (for example, store release cycles and device/OS fragmentation) * Comfortable reasoning about cost/confidence tradeoffs \- which layer of the test pyramid actually earns its cost for a given risk, rather than defaulting to end\-to\-end for everything * Interested in building shared harnesses and canonical patterns other engineers build on top of, not just adding one\-off tests * Able to systematically diagnose and drive down flake rate in CI * Understands how to validate a public or internal API's contract (auth, request/response shapes, error codes) independent of full end\-to\-end coverage * Comfortable working from coverage and defect\-escape dashboards to prioritize what gets automated next * Strong programming skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js * Collaborative by default \- you'll partner constantly with backend, web, and mobile developers ### **Nice to have:** * Exposure to Playwright (web E2E) and Vitest (backend/unit), so you can work closely with your web automation counterpart * Comfort reading someone else's test suite, extending it with new coverage, and debugging why a test broke * Experience working in a fast\-moving, still\-forming engineering organization **Compensation** ---------------- The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $136,000 \- $159,000 USD * All other US Locations: $122,000 \- $143,000 USD * Canada: $124,000 \- $145,000 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. \#LI\-Remote \#PostLI

jobs.title: AI Harness Engineer – AI Chemistry Company
jobs.description: **You've built an agent runtime from the ground up, not just prompts around an API. Own the engine of an AI platform for chemistry.** A Series B company in the San Francisco Bay Area does AI, lab validation and chemical manufacturing under one roof, for more than 100 enterprise customers. Its conversational platform plans how chemicals are made, designs processes and learns from what happens in the lab. You'll build and own the agent harness at its core: the runtime, execution graph, tool contracts, state, evals and reliability in production. It connects scientific engines, reaction databases, simulation software and lab systems, plus the rollout and trajectory plumbing for RL. No chemistry background needed, just the drive to learn it from the experts around you. **What you'll own** * The agent runtime and execution graph * Tool contracts and integrations with scientific software and lab systems * State, concurrency and recovery for long\-running, multi\-step jobs * Evals and tracing that catch failures on real user tasks * Rollout and trajectory pipelines for RL and post\-training **Must\-haves** * You personally created the layer agents run on (an agent harness, orchestration runtime or graph\-based framework); prompt engineering, API wrappers or simple RAG alone won't fit * Solid production Python and real systems experience: managing state, concurrent work, failures, safe retries and jobs that run for hours * 2\+ years of experience, with base salary expectations within the $200k–$300k range * Working from the San Francisco office five days a week, 9 am to 9 pm (no remote or hybrid) **Bonus points** * An agent runtime you owned at an AI lab or an agentic enterprise AI company * RL environments, rollout pipelines or scientific tool integration * Open\-source contributions to agent or workflow frameworks, or publications **What's in it for you** * $200k–$300k base \+ meaningful equity (early\-hire packages lean towards equity) * A founding seat next to AI researchers, chemists and product engineers * Visa sponsorship available **Good to know** * Full\-time, on\-site in San Francisco, 9\-9\-5 Process: profile review technical interview with the AI lead founder conversation technical leadership interview references* offer **When you apply, please include** * Your CV (PDF), your **LinkedIn URL**, and GitHub if you have one * The agent runtime or harness you built: what it does, the trade\-offs you made and what you learned * Your current location, and confirmation that five days a week in San Francisco works for you * Your visa or citizenship status * Your base salary expectation, your notice period, and any other interview processes you're in Does this sound like you? Apply now. If you're a match, we'll be in touch within 3 working days. *RnB Consultancy \| Netherlands \| 3604 AB Maarssen \| KvK 71489703*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer – AI Agents Startup
jobs.description: **You've shipped agents people rely on, and you care about both the infrastructure and the interface. Be the first engineer next to the founders.** A profitable seed\-stage startup in San Francisco, run by two founders, builds a platform that works like an internal workforce: AI agents take over whole tasks, such as accounts receivable via Slack or scheduling via email, and teams build their own internal apps on top. jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Core AI Experience
jobs.description: **ABOUT RETOOL** Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. But most companies don't have the resources to properly invest in these tools, leading to a lot of old, clunky internal software, or worse, teams still stuck in manual and spreadsheet workflows. AI has changed who gets to build software. The definition of "developer" now includes analysts, operators, and domain experts creating solutions directly—and the tools they reach for are multiplying by the week. That's both an opportunity and a challenge: as more people build with more AI tools, the risk of shipping ungoverned software into production grows just as fast. At Retool, we're building the platform that makes all of it safe to ship. Build with any AI tool you want, then deploy into one place that connects to your real business data, enforces enterprise policies automatically, and lets teams create once and reuse everywhere with shared, trusted components. The cost of building software has collapsed. The cost of governing it hasn't—and that's the problem we solve. Developers and domain experts have already automated over 100 million hours of work on our platform, freeing them to focus on creative problem\-solving and strategic work that drives real business value. The people closest to the problem can now build the software to solve it, safely, and within enterprise guardrails. Let's build the future together. **WHY WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU:** We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Retool’s Core AI Experience—the product experiences that help people turn business problems into working software with AI. You’ll shape how users go from an idea to an app or agent connected to real data, and how they test, refine, and confidently put what they build into use. Building with AI changes what users expect from Retool. Getting to a first version should feel quick, but the experience also needs to hold up as requirements become more complex. Users need to understand what AI has built, guide its decisions, and move fluidly between generating software and editing it directly. Your teams will make those interactions intuitive, reliable, and useful for real business work. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, developer experience, and applied AI. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to define the core experience, make technical investments that improve quality and speed, and build teams that learn quickly from customers. We’re looking for someone with strong product judgment, technical depth, and the ability to turn an ambitious direction into focused execution. **WHAT YOU’LL DO:** * Own engineering strategy and execution for Retool’s Core AI Experience, connecting the longer\-term product vision to clear priorities and measurable customer outcomes. * Partner with Product and Design to shape how users build, edit, debug, and iterate on software with AI—from their first interaction through ongoing use. * Partnership and collaboration with GTM teams on product launches, positioning, and sales strategy. * Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, building clear ownership and strong collaboration across teams. * Set a high bar for product quality, including the reliability, responsiveness, and usability of AI interactions. * Guide architectural decisions across the user experience, application state, AI orchestration, and connections to the broader Retool platform. * Build effective ways to evaluate AI behavior, combining customer feedback, product data, and systematic evaluations to understand whether changes improve the experience. * Help teams balance rapid experimentation with the engineering foundations needed to support increasingly complex customer use cases. * Work closely with platform and infrastructure partners to ensure the core experience works within enterprise requirements for data access, permissions, and governance. * Stay close to customers and the work, helping teams resolve ambiguity, make tradeoffs, and ship. **THE SKILLSET YOU’LL BRING:** * Experience leading multiple product engineering teams, with a track record of developing managers and senior engineers. * Strong product instincts and experience partnering deeply with Product and Design to deliver intuitive, technically complex software. * Technical depth in interactive applications, developer tools, or similarly complex products where frontend experience and underlying systems are closely connected. * Experience shipping AI\-powered products and understanding the challenges of model variability, latency, evaluation, and user trust. * The judgment to distinguish where experimentation will help a team learn and where a more durable technical investment is needed. * A track record of turning ambiguous opportunities into clear priorities, helping teams make progress as requirements evolve. * Strong communication and organizational leadership: you create alignment, surface risks early, and make decisions understandable. * A practical, involved leadership style. jobs.title: Application Security Engineer (AI Governance & Cloud Security)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Position:**Application Security Engineer (AI Governance \& Cloud Security) ============================================================================ **Location:** Chicago/U.S. **Reports To:** Director, IT, Info Security and Compliance **Job Overview** Reveal is hiring an Application Security Engineer to secure how we build software and how we adopt AI. This role sits at the point where three things meet: the security of the code and services we ship, the governance of the AI agents and models we put into production, and the posture of the cloud they all run on. You will own the tooling that makes that possible — Onyx Security as the control plane for AI agents and models, and Wiz across our cloud accounts and repositories — and you will be the person engineering teams come to when a design, a pipeline or a new AI tool needs a security opinion. The work is hands\-on: threat modeling, code review, remediation alongside the teams that own the fix, and the policy and reporting that lets leadership and auditors see where we stand. This role follows a hybrid model (4 days in office, 1 day work from home) for candidates residing in Illinois. Candidates based outside of Illinois may be considered for a remote work arrangement. **Responsibilities \& Duties** * Application security: Run threat modeling and secure design reviews for new features, services and integrations. * Application security: Perform manual code review and triage findings from SAST, DAST, SCA and secrets scanning. * Application security: Embed security checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing delivery. * Application security: Lead remediation with engineering teams and track findings to closure against SLAs. * Application security: Support penetration tests, bug reports and customer security questionnaires. * AI governance: Own the Onyx Security platform as the control plane for AI agents and models across SaaS, cloud, endpoints and code. * AI governance: Use Onyx AI Observability to discover sanctioned and shadow AI, and review prompts, responses and agent actions. * AI governance: Write and enforce natural\-language governance policies and real\-time guardrails in Onyx. * AI governance: Manage agent permissions and secure MCP server connections to prevent over\-privileged access. * AI governance: Detect and respond to prompt injection, data exfiltration and AI misuse, and tune Onyx Guardian Agent remediation. * AI governance: Maintain the AI acceptable\-use policy, AI inventory and risk assessments with GRC, mapped to NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\. * AI governance: Evaluate new AI tools, agents and vendors before adoption, and report AI adoption and risk metrics to leadership. * Cloud and code security: Own Wiz configuration, integrations, policies and alert routing across cloud accounts. * Cloud and code security: Triage Wiz Issues and toxic combinations, and drive fixes for misconfigurations, vulnerabilities and exposed secrets. * Cloud and code security: Use Wiz Code and IaC scanning to catch risk in repositories and Terraform before deployment. * Cloud and code security: Use Wiz AI Security Posture Management (AI\-SPM) to inventory AI services and models running in the cloud. * Cloud and code security: Build reports and dashboards on cloud risk trends for Security leadership and audits. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support team, department, and organizational goals. **Characteristics** * Breadth across domains: comfortable moving between application security, AI governance and cloud posture rather than specialising in only one. * Investigative mindset: naturally curious, and inclined to dig into an alert or a finding until the underlying cause is understood. * Proactive problem solver: anticipates security issues at design time rather than discovering them at deployment. * Autonomous and collaborative: takes ownership of the role and works effectively with distributed engineering teams. * Clear communicator: can explain the same risk to an engineer, to leadership and to an auditor, and be understood by all three. including Model Context Protocol (MCP) security. * Ability to read and review code in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java or C\#. * Experience securing AWS, Azure or GCP workloads, containers and Kubernetes. * Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure as code. * Clear written communication for engineers, leadership and auditors. **Preferred Experience** * Experience building an AI governance program: AI inventory, model risk reviews, acceptable\-use policy. * Hands\-on experience with Wiz, including policy tuning, Issue triage and integrations (Jira, Slack, SIEM). * Hands\-on experience with Onyx Security or a comparable AI security and governance platform, including AI discovery, guardrails and agent permissions. * Knowledge of NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act. * Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 or FedRAMP audits. * Background in legal tech, eDiscovery or other environments handling sensitive client data. * Scripting for automation (Python, Bash, Ruby) and experience with the Wiz API. * Certifications such as OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, CCSP or AWS Security Specialty, or the Wiz certifications. **Benefits and Perks include but are not limited to:** * 401k match program * Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and HSA/FSA) * Group Term Life Insurance and Voluntary Life Insurance option * Paid holidays * Paid vacation, sick, and personal days * FSA dependent care benefit * Childbirth recovery and bonding leave policies * Short and long\-term disability benefits * Access to onsite gym and recreational area at our Chicago office * Friendly, collaborative, in\-office work environment with ample opportunity for professional development. For Illinois\-based roles, the budgeted annual salary range is $ 136,000 to $ 160,000\. Reveal offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes the Benefits and Perks set forth above. *This job description reflects the present requirements of the position. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: Front End Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: **About Rewards Network** For 41 years, Rewards Network has been helping restaurants grow revenue, increase traffic, and boost customer engagement through innovative financial, marketing services, and premier dining rewards programs. By offering unique card\-linked offers, we introduce diners to fantastic restaurant experiences, leveraging advanced technology and data analytics to deliver value to restaurants, diners, and our strategic partners' loyalty programs. **Our Culture** At Rewards Network, you'll be part of a driven and diverse team that excels in collaboration, issue resolution, and taking ownership of both personal growth and the company's success. We take pride in partnering with the world's most powerful loyalty programs to drive full\-price paying customers to local restaurants through marketing services and flexible funding options. Our engaging and rewarding environment is designed to help you gain your full potential. **Job Overview** This engineer builds the front\-end applications that serve three audiences: members, internal employees, and restaurant owners. The role exists to ship polished, accessible, well\-tested products on shared foundations: a common design system, a shared API client, and a monorepo that serves many partner brands. **This is a hybrid position that requires in office presence 3 days a week (Tuesday\-Thursday) in Chicago.** ### **What** **you'll** **bring to the table:** **(Responsibilities)** * Design, build, and ship features across the member app, internal operations tools, and merchant portal, from technical approach through production release. * Build reusable components and design\-system primitives that serve consumer, employee, and merchant surfaces, and keep them aligned with Figma designs. * Implement partner theming and configuration so one codebase supports many brands without forking. * Integrate with backend services, including data fetching, caching, error handling, and optimistic updates, and work with API owners on contracts. * Implement authentication and role\-based access in the front end, such as employee SSO and merchant\-user permissions, and design for data\-visibility rules. * Write unit, component, and integration tests, and help maintain strong coverage and CI quality gates. * Build for accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA) and performance, including startup time, bundle size, and rendering on low\-end devices. * Review code, give actionable feedback, and mentor less\-experienced engineers (senior level). * Break down ambiguous requirements with Product, Design, and QA, and write clear tickets, specs, or decision records. * Support releases and deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and use logging and monitoring to find root causes. * Improve developer experience by contributing to shared tooling, templates, and documentation. ### **Do you have the right mix of ingredients****:** * Writes clean, typed, maintainable code and cares about consistency across a large shared codebase. * Translates design files into pixel\-accurate, responsive, accessible UI. * Can reason about cross\-platform differences (iOS, Android, web) and know when to branch and when to share. * Understands how API design, caching, and loading and error states shape user experience. * Communicates clearly in writing and in review, and is comfortable giving and receiving feedback. * Works independently on ambiguous problems and raises risks early. * Senior only: sets technical direction for a feature area, makes trade\-offs explicit, and raises the quality of the team around them. * Bachelor's in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 4\+ years, with a record of owning features or a product area end to end. * Strong TypeScript and modern React (hooks, composition, state, and data\-fetching patterns). * Experience shipping production web applications. ***Preferred*** * React Native and/or Expo experience shipping to the App Store and Google Play, or sharing code across native and web (React Native Web). * Experience with a data\-fetching library such as TanStack Query and with a themeable styling system (e.g., Unistyles). * Experience building admin, back\-office, or B2B portals: tables, forms, filters, permissions, and audit\-sensitive workflows. * Familiarity with OIDC/OAuth and identity providers such as Auth0\. * Monorepo experience (pnpm workspaces or similar), plus Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library, and Storybook. * Background in loyalty, rewards, payments, restaurant, or hospitality products. * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools in a real workflow. ### **What** **you'll** **love about us:** Comprehensive benefits package, which includes: * This is a full\-time, exempt position. The base salary range for this role in Chicago is $120,000–$160,000 annually, depending on level (mid\-level or senior), as well as candidate experience, skills, and other factors. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus target of 10%, bringing total target compensation to $132,000–$176,000\. * Competitive Time Off Benefits: including flexible PTO, 11 company holidays, and parental leave. * Generous dining reimbursement when you dine with our restaurant clients * 401(k) plan with a company match * Two medical plan options\- Standard PPO or High Deductible Health Plan (HSA with company match for HDHP participants) * Partnership with Rx n Go, offering certain prescriptions for free * Two dental plan options and a vision plan * Flexible Spending Accounts and a pre\-tax commuter benefit program * Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance Plans * Short Term and Long Term disability * Company\-paid life insurance and AD\&D insurance, supplemental employee, spouse, and child life insurance * Employee Life Assistance Program * Hybrid working environment in a new office space downtown near the Metra Train stations and catered lunches on Tuesdays. ***Rewards Network is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities! We currently have an opportunity for a **Process Engineer** at our **Manufacturing Facility** in **Appleton**, **WI**. Responsibilities: The **Process Engineer** improves the safety, quality, reliability, throughput, and cost performance of assigned manufacturing processes. This role serves as the technical owner for designated production lines and leads data\-driven process improvements, standardization, equipment optimization, trials, and capital initiatives. The Process Engineer establishes process controls and standard work, leads troubleshooting and improvement efforts, supports trials and scale\-up activities, trains employees on new and revised processes, and communicates findings and recommendations to plant leadership. The role operates with a high degree of day\-to\-day independence, exercising sound judgment within established standards and seeking guidance for unfamiliar, higher\-risk, or strategically significant decisions. The role delivers measurable, sustainable improvements through sound engineering analysis and disciplined execution. **You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!** **Manufacturing \& Process Improvement*** Develop and maintain subject\-matter expertise for assigned production lines and critical assets, with guidance available for unfamiliar or higher\-risk technical decisions. * Coordinate improvement initiatives that address identified safety, quality, productivity, and manufacturing\-efficiency losses within assigned processes. * Develop, standardize, and maintain manufacturing process standards and process controls that improve operational consistency and support future growth. * Develop and deliver training for new and revised processes to improve employee capability, process understanding, and operating performance. * Monitor manufacturing performance data to confirm process stability, detect emerging trends, and identify coaching or corrective\-action needs. * Train operations personnel on fundamental process principles, standard operating responses, and recovery procedures to build capability and promote consistent execution. * Build trusted working relationships with operations personnel through active listening, respectful two\-way communication, and collaborative problem\-solving. **Technical Engineering*** Lead structured troubleshooting of complex process and equipment failures; identify root causes; implement permanent corrective actions; and establish response standards for recurring conditions. * Lead engineering evaluations that optimize equipment performance, process capability, and product consistency. * Develop and maintain process specifications, operating standards, control plans, and engineering documentation that improve process stability, operator consistency, and audit readiness. * Plan and execute the manufacturing implementation and scale\-up of new products, equipment, and processes. **Cross\-Functional Partnership*** Partner with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Research and Development, and Engineering to resolve technical issues, coordinate corrective actions, and improve plant performance. * Provide engineering support for product\-quality investigations, identify process\-related causes, and implement corrective actions that improve process capability and product consistency. * Collaborate with suppliers and technical partners to evaluate manufacturing technologies, document technical findings, and recommend improvements for plant application. * Plan and execute process trials, including design of experiments where appropriate to validate improvements before full implementation. **Continuous Improvement*** Lead structured problem\-solving initiatives to eliminate chronic process, equipment, and design\-related losses using Lean manufacturing methods, Kaizen events, focused improvement actions, and other appropriate root\-cause analysis techniques. * Analyze production losses, downtime, scrap, quality variation, process capability, rate performance, and cost data to identify root causes, prioritize opportunities, and present actionable recommendations to plant leadership. * Quantify improvement results through validated data and performance metrics, and establish control plans, monitoring, and ownership routines to sustain the gains. * Develop engineering recommendations that define the expected operational benefit, implementation requirements, risks, and measures of success. **Capital Projects*** Support capital improvement projects from planning through implementation while meeting project objectives, schedules, and budgets, with appropriate guidance. * Contribute to the successful execution of engineering projects by developing project requests, coordinating assigned actions, and working with internal stakeholders and external suppliers. * Evaluate project feasibility by analyzing process data, defining operating requirements, a documenting anticipated benefits and technical risks. **You Will Love It Here If…** * You listen, learn, and evolve * You thrive in a fast\-paced environment * You put safety first, always * You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals * You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace * You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences Qualifications: **Education/Experience*****Required**** Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. * 2\+ years of engineering experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, or process improvement environments. ***Preferred**** Experience in printing, packaging, nylon film, blown\-film extrusion, or film converting. * Experience supporting continuous improvement or Lean manufacturing initiatives. * Experience supporting capital projects in a manufacturing environment. * Experience with process optimization, manufacturing equipment, or product commercialization. * Experience with manufacturing data\-visualization tools, enterprise resource\-planning systems, CAD software, PLC programming, digital production\-management platforms, or related manufacturing systems; working knowledge of SAP is preferred. **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities*** Demonstrated mechanical aptitude with strong technical, analytical, and structured problem\-solving skills, including experience with root\-cause analysis methods. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. * Knowledge of manufacturing processes, process controls, and Lean manufacturing principles. * Ability to analyze operational data, identify process relationships, and develop practical engineering recommendations. * Ability to apply structured problem\-solving, root\-cause analysis, and basic statistical methods to manufacturing issues. * Effective written and verbal communication skills for documenting technical findings and presenting recommendations across organizational levels. * Ability to organize technical work, maintain accurate documentation, and manage multiple engineering priorities. **Competencies*** **Ensures Accountability** – Takes ownership of commitments, communicates risks, and delivers accurate, timely results. * **Collaborates** – Builds productive partnerships across functions, values frontline expertise, and solves problems with humility, respect, and integrity. * **Drives Results** – Acts with urgency, follows through on priorities, and delivers measurable, sustainable operational improvements. * **Decision Quality** – Uses sound judgment, validated data, and technical analysis to make timely decisions and appropriately escalates higher\-risk issues. * **Demonstrates Curiosity and Continuous Improvement** – Questions assumptions, seeks to understand process behavior, and constructively challenges the status quo. * **Plans and Aligns** – Prioritizes work and coordinates resources to achieve project and organizational objectives. Want to know more? Check out our website or connect with us on LinkedIn! **Apply today to join a fast\-growing innovative company!** Not a good fit but know someone who is? Please refer them! **No unsolicited recruiter or agency inquiries, please.** RCP affords equal employment opportunities to applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, disability status, sex, marital status, protected veteran status, pregnancy, national origin, genetics, genetic information, parental status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. RCP conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations. Posted Salary Range: USD $75,900\.00 \- USD $104,400\.00 /A

jobs.description: Rivian’s Autonomy Eval Infrastructure team builds the software that helps engineers understand and improve the ML models behind our driving systems and gives release teams evidence they can trust. Within Autonomy’s AI Platform organization, we connect model development with evaluation workflows, metrics, triage and visualization across simulation and real\-world vehicle data. As a metrics\-platform engineer, you will build backend services, Python libraries and data pipelines that turn model outputs into reproducible measurements and useful comparisons. Working alongside Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will learn how models behave, investigate regressions and help turn evaluation findings into better models and data, as well as trusted release scorecards. You will own well\-scoped components from implementation through deployment and operation, with support from senior engineers on design and complex trade\-offs. Joining this newly formed team offers the opportunity to help shape a shared platform while developing your software engineering and distributed\-systems skills. * Build and test services, APIs and libraries for registering metric definitions, computing results and retrieving them consistently across engineering tools. * Implement scalable metric\-processing pipelines with safe retries, incremental computation and backfills. Make missing inputs, failed jobs and incomplete results visible. * Capture code, metric, model, dataset and scenario versions so a reported result can be traced to its inputs and reproduced. * Build tools for comparing model versions and exploring results by scenario, geography, vehicle platform and operating conditions, using consistent aggregation and denominators. * Work with model developers to run evaluation experiments, inspect predictions and investigate failure patterns. Help translate findings into targeted evaluation datasets and regression tests. * Integrate metrics into evaluation workflows, CI regression checks and release scorecards, and connect results to recordings and triage tools for investigation. * Improve automated tests, performance, observability and deployment tooling. Debug production issues and document the components you support. * Work with engineers in Palo Alto, London and Belgrade to turn user needs into maintainable software, participate in design and code reviews, and deliver improvements iteratively. * 2\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and maintaining substantial software systems. * Strong Python programming skills and a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design and debugging. * Practical SQL skills, with AI coding tools expected to support writing and refining queries; ability to validate query logic, results and performance. * Experience building backend services, reusable libraries or data\-processing pipelines with automated tests, version control and code review. * Ability to reason about APIs, data models and component design, explain trade\-offs, and identify failure cases such as duplicate, delayed or missing data. * Experience with cloud services, containers and CI/CD, and an understanding of how software is deployed and monitored in production. * Care with data correctness and basic statistical reasoning, including sample sizes, rates and variability; curiosity about how measurements reflect real driving behavior. * Clear written communication and a collaborative approach to gathering requirements, asking for feedback and resolving technical problems. * Bonus Points Hands\-on experience with ML models using PyTorch or similar frameworks, such as running inference or analyzing prediction errors; experience in autonomy, robotics or simulation. * Experience with distributed data processing or analytical storage, such as Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake or comparable systems. * Experience with AWS, Docker and GitLab CI, or with developer tools, experiment tracking, data lineage or results visualization. Prior autonomy or robotics experience is welcome but is not required for this role.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Palo Alto, California **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Technology and InnovationInfotainment and Connectivity **Compensation** ---------------- * $186,000 – $255,750 • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • This role has an annual bonus target of 15% The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location. **About Us** ============ Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. **Role Summary** ================ We are looking for a curious, relentless Integration \& Release Engineer to serve as the final technical gatekeeper for our Infotainment and Connectivity software releases. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Agents
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role** Samsara's AI Experience team builds the Samsara Assistant and Agent Studio, where customers create chat and voice agents that work across their safety, maintenance and operations data. Agent Studio is now generally available, and usage across chat and voice has more than tripled since June 2026\. This is a new role. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead the teams behind the Assistant, Agent Studio and Agent Extensibility. Your job is to turn a fast\-growing product into one customers trust and come back to every day: making answers trustworthy, getting more customers to try agents, and turning first\-time users into daily ones. This team is both a platform and a product. About half the work is helping engineering teams across Samsara, from Safety to Maintenance, build and launch their own agents. The other half is the frameworks those agents run on, used by Samsara teams and customers alike. You'll lead about 10 machine learning engineers, applied scientists and full\-stack engineers through two tech leads. The individual contributor bench is strong, so your first focus is scaling the product. **This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.** **What makes Samsara different** * **Mission\-driven impact.** We improve safety, efficiency and sustainability for the industries that power the global economy. * **A unique data advantage.** IoT data at a scale few companies can match — 30\+ trillion data points a year, 70\+ billion miles driven. * **Hands\-on leadership and builder culture.** Leaders at every level stay close to the product and the code. * **Fast decisions, limited bureaucracy.** Work directly with senior leadership and ship solutions that matter. * **Growth and learning.** Roles grow quickly here as the business grows. We invest heavily in R\&D and in building for the long term. * **Scale with startup energy.** A public company (NYSE: IOT) with the resources and reach of scale, and the agility and pace of a high\-growth technology company. **What makes this opportunity unique** * **Just launched, already growing.** Agent Studio went GA in October 2026\. Chat and voice volume grew from about 100K in June to more than 350K, and power users are up week over week. * **Platform and product at once.** Your work powers agents across every Samsara product line and generates revenue for Samsara. * **A new leadership seat.** This is the first management layer for a team that has outgrown one manager. You shape how it works from day one. **Why this role matters** **Trusted answers for the people who keep the world running** * Operators in transportation, construction, utilities and field services ask the Assistant about their drivers, vehicles and equipment. Your team makes sure the answers are right. **Unique product challenges** * Grow activation with recommended questions and reports generated before the user asks, like a "fuel wastage" view or "vehicles requiring maintenance" page. * Build toward proactive agents that act on a customer's behalf before they ask. * Measure and improve answer quality at scale across many customers, data types and agent templates. * Design frameworks that partner teams can use to ship their own agents quickly and safely. **A data advantage few teams have** * Agents work across real\-world operational data: video, vehicle diagnostics, location, maintenance and safety events. * Access to 30\+ trillion data points a year from connected operations, all owned by Samsara **In this role, you will** * Own Assistant \& Agent Studio and Agent Extensibility, leading about 10 engineers through two tech leads. * Grow activation, so more customers try agents, through recommended questions, automatically generated reports and proactive agents. * Drive answer quality and repeat usage, so customers trust what the Assistant tells them and come back daily. * Set technical direction through RFCs and design reviews for  on. * **You enable and collaborate with other teams.** You enjoy building platforms that partner teams adopt and succeed with. **See Samsara in action** If you like, we would like to invite you to spend ten minutes getting to know us. * **Watch the product.** A short introduction to our business. * **Our platform.** What we build and who we build it for: https://www.samsara.com * **Beyond, our annual customer event.** Fast forward to the Agent Studio section (59:36\) **Ready to make AI agents a daily habit for the world's operators?** **We would love to hear from you.** For more information, contact Grace Chew, Technical Recruiter — grace.chew@samsara.com **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced, technically driven security professional to advance Sinclair's Information Security program. You will serve as a Senior Information Security Engineer focused on Security Operations, incident response, and advanced detection engineering. You will independently investigate complex threats, engineer high\-fidelity detections across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments, and strengthen incident response through security tooling, workflow orchestration, and automation. You will also help evaluate and apply AI\-assisted capabilities where they improve investigation quality and response efficiency. You will partner with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external security providers to improve detection coverage, accelerate response, and reduce enterprise risk. **Responsibilities:** **Processes \& Execution** * Lead technical investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for complex security incidents across on\-premises, cloud, identity, and endpoint environments. * Analyze security telemetry, authentication activity, process execution, network traffic, and threat intelligence to determine root cause, attack scope, impact, and appropriate response. * Perform proactive threat hunting and retrospective investigations; identify gaps in telemetry, detections, and response capabilities. * Own high\-severity incident investigations, document evidence\-based findings, communicate business impact, and coordinate timely remediation with system owners and external partners. * Apply MITRE ATT\&CK and other relevant threat\-informed methodologies to improve investigation quality, detection coverage, and response effectiveness. * Demonstrate independent technical judgment, clear communication, and accountability for outcomes in time\-sensitive situations. **Engineering, Collaboration \& Partnerships** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously tune complex detection mechanisms for multi\-stage attacks, identity compromise, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and other advanced adversary behaviors. * Correlate endpoint, SIEM, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry to create behavioral, contextual, and risk\-based detections rather than relying solely on static indicators. * Develop and maintain detection\-as\-code content, queries, analytics, and validation tests; assess false positives, data quality, precision, and detection gaps. * Design, implement, and maintain automated SecOps and incident response workflows using security platforms, APIs, SOAR technologies, and enterprise ticketing systems to streamline enrichment, investigation, containment, and remediation. * Advance security operations automation by integrating AI\-assisted analysis and agent\-based capabilities, where appropriate, into existing investigation and response processes to improve context, prioritization, and analyst efficiency. * Apply established security engineering controls to automated response workflows, including least\-privilege access, action validation, approval for high\-impact remediation, logging, exception handling, and escalation to analysts. * Integrate third\-party alert and investigation outputs with internal telemetry to support independent validation, deeper investigation, and consistent remediation. * Collaborate with infrastructure, IAM, cloud, endpoint, IT operations, and external security partners to validate detections, remediate threats, and operationalize new capabilities. **Performance Improvement** * Measure and improve detection coverage, fidelity, mean time to detect/respond, investigation quality, automation success, and analyst effort saved. * Continuously test detections and response workflows using attack simulations, adversary emulation, incident lessons learned, and controlled validation. * Document engineering designs, investigation procedures, response decision criteria, automation safeguards, and operational runbooks. * Identify repetitive analyst tasks suitable for automation while preserving human oversight for uncertain, destructive, or business\-disruptive actions. * Mentor engineers and analysts through technical reviews, investigation feedback, and knowledge sharing; promote sustainable engineering standards. * Evaluate new security detection and response technologies, including AI\-assisted capabilities, based on practical operational value, reliability, security, and measurable risk reduction. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, security engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of complex investigations. * Demonstrated experience building and tuning advanced detections in a SIEM, EDR/XDR, or cloud security analytics platform; ability to explain detection logic and validate underlying evidence. * Strong understanding of attacker techniques, Windows and Linux internals, identity\-based attacks, network protocols, cloud security, and incident response methodology. * Hands\-on experience integrating security platforms through APIs, developing orchestration workflows, and implementing automated investigation or response actions using SOAR tools and enterprise IT service management platforms. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted security investigation, agent\-based automation, or LLM\-enabled security workflows is a plus; specialized AI development or production AI\-agent experience is not required. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with the Microsoft Defender security suite (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, or Defender XDR) and related Microsoft security/identity technologies, including Entra ID. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon, Abnormal Security, Tines, Armis, and Splunk, or equivalent platforms; strong experience across multiple tools is expected, but experience with every named product is not required. * Proven ability to investigate incidents and engineer or tune detections directly in EDR/XDR, SIEM, network security, email security, and identity platforms, including querying telemetry, investigating alerts, and operationalizing response actions. * Knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST incident response guidance, and security engineering best practices. * Professional security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or equivalent preferred. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, cross\-functional collaboration, and demonstrated ownership of technical initiatives. *Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H\-1B visa, OPT\-STEM employment, etc.* The base salary compensation range for this role is $111,000 to $147,805\. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates' relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. **About Sinclair:** Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair's AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net . **About the Team** The life\-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal\-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open\-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let's talk.

You will implement, configure, and harden Anthropic’s Claude across enterprise environments; build and secure agentic workflows, tool integrations, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; and write the code, automation, and integrations that turn AI security designs into working, production\-ready capabilities. You will also engineer AI\-enabled cybersecurity operations solutions on Claude, such as agentic vulnerability management, automated triage, and AI\-assisted security testing. Working closely with AI Security Architects and client engineering teams, you will move quickly from proof of concept to production while contributing reusable code, accelerators, and technical expertise to Slalom’s AI security offerings. **Key Responsibilities** * **Claude Implementation \& Hardening:** Deploy and securely configure Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, the Claude API, and cloud\-hosted Claude (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure), including SSO/SCIM, role\-based access, workspace and admin controls, data retention, and audit logging. * **MCP \& Tool Integration Engineering:** Build, deploy, and secure MCP servers and tool integrations, implementing authentication, authorization, least\-privilege permissioning, input/output validation, and secrets management. * **Agent Security Controls:** Implement technical controls for Claude\-based agents, including sandboxed execution, scoped credentials and agent identity, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, rate limiting, and policy enforcement. * **Agentic Security Solutions:** Develop Claude\-powered security automations using the Claude Agent SDK and MCP, such as agentic vulnerability management (discovery, prioritization, remediation guidance, and fix validation), alert triage, investigation, and threat intelligence enrichment. * **Security Tooling Integration:** Integrate Claude\-based solutions with vulnerability scanners, EDR, SIEM/SOAR, ticketing, source control, and CI/CD pipelines through APIs, webhooks, and infrastructure as code. * **AI Security Testing:** Perform hands\-on security testing of Claude\-enabled applications and agents, including prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage, and tool\-abuse testing; build automated test harnesses and evaluations to validate guardrails. * **Logging, Monitoring \& Detection:** Instrument AI usage and agent activity with logging and telemetry, build detections and dashboards in SIEM platforms, and provide visibility into agent actions, tool calls, and connections. * **Secure Code \& DevSecOps:** Embed security into AI solution delivery through secure coding practices, code review (including Claude\-assisted secure code review), dependency and supply chain scanning, and secured CI/CD pipelines. * **Cloud Security Foundations:** Configure the underlying cloud infrastructure that hosts Claude solutions, including IAM, network controls, private connectivity, encryption, key management, and logging. * **Technical Delivery:** Own hands\-on build and implementation workstreams, troubleshoot issues, and translate reference architectures into working, documented, and supportable solutions. * **Pursuit Support:** Build demos and proofs of concept, support technical scoping and estimates, and serve as a hands\-on Anthropic and AI security expert in client workshops. * **Practice Development:** Create reusable code, MCP connectors, deployment templates, and runbooks for Slalom’s AI security offerings; Experience with React or Vue, Python, AWS, Microsoft business systems, document processing, agent runtimes, evaluation frameworks, or CI/CD is especially useful. **How we work** * **Communicate clearly.** Make technical choices understandable, demonstrate progress, and surface uncertainty or blockers early. * **Build as a team.** Bring engineers and operational users into the problem\-solving process. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Spring Fertility?** ---------------------------- We are a passionate, dedicated team of leading physicians and scientists who have trained at some of the world's top research hospitals and fertility centers. The engineer will work directly with clinical, laboratory, patient experience, finance, HR, operations, and executive stakeholders to identify friction, rapidly develop solutions, and deploy technology that creates measurable impact. This is not a traditional engineering role. The ideal candidate enjoys sitting with users, understanding real workflows, building quickly, and seeing solutions drive better outcomes across clinics and corporate operations. ### **Key Responsibilities** ### **Deploy Technology Where It Creates the Most Impact** * Partner directly with clinical and operational teams to understand pain points and opportunities. * Embed within business functions to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for automation. * Translate operational challenges into secure, scalable technical solutions. * Lead initiatives from discovery and prototyping through implementation, adoption, and measurement. ### **Build Internal Products and Workflows** * Design and develop applications, automations, and workflows that improve employee productivity and patient experience. * Build solutions using APIs, cloud platforms, low\-code tools, and custom software. * Connect data across operational, financial, clinical, laboratory, and patient\-facing platforms. * Rapidly prototype ideas and transition successful pilots into reliable production solutions. ### **Accelerate Responsible AI Adoption** * Identify practical uses of AI that reduce administrative burden and improve employee effectiveness. * Build and deploy AI agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, and internal knowledge solutions. * Develop retrieval\-augmented generation solutions using appropriately governed internal information. * Partner with privacy, security, legal, clinical, and operational stakeholders to deploy AI responsibly in healthcare workflows. * Measure adoption, quality, business impact, and return on investment. ### **Integrate Critical Business Systems** * Design and implement integrations across fertility EMRs, clinical and laboratory systems, Microsoft 365 and Azure, Salesforce and patient engagement tools, HRIS and finance platforms, contact\-center technologies (Salesforce AgentForce AI Voice), and other enterprise applications. * Improve interoperability, data integrity, and workflow continuity while reducing duplicate entry and manual handoffs. * Troubleshoot complex issues that span applications, vendors, data flows, and business processes. ### **Drive Data\-Informed Decision Making** * In partnership with the Analytics/Reporting team, build dashboards and reporting solutions for clinical, financial, and operational leaders. * Partner with stakeholders to define useful metrics and performance indicators. * Create reliable data pipelines that make information more accessible and actionable. * Support data governance, security, stewardship, and documentation practices. ### **Operate as a Strategic Problem Solver** * Work with senior leaders on high\-priority initiatives that span people, process, and technology. * Move comfortably between strategy, stakeholder alignment, hands\-on development, and implementation. * Serve as a trusted technical advisor to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Identify high\-value opportunities and take ownership from ambiguity to measurable results. ### **Education and Skills** ### **Required** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation consulting, product engineering, technical operations, or a related role. * Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, or a comparable language. * Experience building and consuming APIs and integrating SaaS or enterprise systems. * Demonstrated ability to deliver business\-facing technical solutions from discovery through adoption. * Ability to work effectively with executives, clinicians, operational leaders, and front\-line users. * Exceptional problem\-solving, written communication, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Strong ownership mentality, sound judgment, and bias toward execution. ### **Preferred** * Experience in healthcare, digital health, fertility care, or another regulated environment. * Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, MS Fabric, Salesforce or related technologies. * Experience building AI\-enabled products and workflows using large language models. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise integrations. * Experience in a startup, consulting, or high\-growth multi\-site healthcare environment. ### \- $180,000 annually.
