jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Federated GraphQL)
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a \#1 team and do some good!**HYBRID:** A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Richardson, TX**SPONSORSHIP: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: The Policy Graph team is building the GraphQL layer that unifies policy data across State Farm's lines of business and policy systems, making it accessible to applications, digital experiences, and AI. We're building this from the ground up, defining the schemas, engineering patterns, and architecture that will support enterprise\-wide access to policy data. The technical challenges are significant. Policy data varies by state, line of business, and underlying system, spanning legacy platforms and multiple generations of modernization efforts. Our job is to bring that complexity into a consistent, modernized data model exposed through a performant and scalable graph. We're currently prototyping in TypeScript, but the production stack is still open. TypeScript, Go, Java, or a combination will be evaluated based on performance, scalability, and engineering tradeoffs. We're looking for engineers who have built and run federated GraphQL in production and want to help shape it at enterprise scale. What you'll do* Bring federated GraphQL expertise to the team: entity design, schema composition and evolution, and patterns other domains can follow. * Design the Policy GraphQL schema with architects and data model stewards. * Work closely with partner teams: architecture, consuming domains, policy administration system teams and the GraphQL platform team. * Build federated subgraphs that read close to the source: straight from databases, policy administration system APIs, or a read model we own. * Own performance against p99 targets: load test, profile and tune. Qualifications: * 6\+ years of software engineering experience. * Production experience with federated GraphQL: designing entities and keys, composing and evolving schemas across teams, for example with Apollo Federation or similar. * Passion for the work and a collaborative approach: you pair, give thoughtful code reviews, and welcome healthy debate with teammates and partner teams. * Backend development in one or more of Go, Java or Node.js/TypeScript. * Picks up new languages and technologies quickly. * Uses AI coding assistants effectively in day\-to\-day work. * Integrated services that call other systems, handling slow or failing dependencies, for example with timeouts, retries and batching. * Builds for the long term: automated unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests that catch regressions and keep the code safe to change. jobs.title: Cisco Network Infrastructure Engineer (Remote from anywhere in CO)
jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- **Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado** The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first\-of\-their\-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services. Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado. **Description of Job** ---------------------- **IMPORTANT NOTE:** Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team. As our new Cisco Network Infrastructure Engineer you will provide network engineering services to the statewide enterprise network and all State agencies. You will act as a subject matter expert providing design, implementation, and support of highly complex networks including LAN/WAN, Wireless, data center, cloud technologies. The position acts as the technical lead for the planning, testing, administering, and implementing network solutions and establishing best practices standards. The position makes decisions and provides detailed input that affects the State core network and agencies' network infrastructure. The position performs network architecture design and implementation, which impacts all supported agencies and their locations across Colorado. The position establishes network technology standards to be used within the State network infrastructure. The position interfaces with the network operations, security operations, and telecommunications teams to provide network services to customers. The position supports the strategic interface to other entities, including state, federal, and local agencies; private sector groups; and the public. Some of the day to day tasks include: Designing, configuring, administering, and deploying mission critical network hardware and applications to provide network as a services (NaaS) for State agencies to include wireless, software defined access and wide area networks. Maximize network performance by monitoring performance, troubleshooting network problems, addressing security concerns, responding to and resolving outages, scheduling upgrades, and collaborating with internal and external partners on network optimization. Providing subject matter expertise on network design, solution, and implementation for new network projects. Analyzing performance and comparative costs of products to determine the most cost effective solution. Providing recommendations and solutions to leadership. Partnering with customers and vendors to clarify rationale for technical decisions and concepts so they can understand the basis for the decisions. **Term Limited Position:** This position is term limited with an anticipated end date of approximately two (2\) years from the date of hire. This position is eligible for State employee benefits and may be extended as the situation warrants. This **video** explains the many benefits of working at the State of Colorado on a term limited basis**.** **Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While most salary offers are made within the posted range, occasionally an offer is made below or above the posted range based upon this salary analysis. This is a skills\-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows: **Minimum Qualifications:** A minimum of three (3\) years of hands\-on professional experience designing, implementing, testing, and documenting complex Cisco based network solutions. Expertise in Software\-Defined Access, Cisco DNAC, and Catalyst technologies is highly preferable. **Substitutions:** Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year\-for\-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications. Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit toward cations. If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year\-for\-year basis. **Preferred Qualifications:** Three (3\) years professional engineering experience in network design, architecture, and implementation. The ideal candidate will have a thorough understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and Cisco products, and will work on planning and improving enterprise network solutions. Cisco Professional and/or Expert certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or Cisco Certified Internet Expert (CCIE). Professional networking experience with wireless technologies. Professional networking experience with Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE) application. Professional networking experience with Cisco DNAC. Professional networking experience with data center technologies. Professional networking experience with Software\-Defined Access technologies. Professional networking experience with scripting and automation. Experience in Agile/Scrum Methodologies or Agile/Scrum Methodologies certification(s). **Conditions of Employment:** OIT candidates and employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state entity locations where they might be required to perform work. A pre\-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Positions supporting some agencies such as the Department of Corrections and the Department of Public Safety will also require a pre\-employment drug test. This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed. This position may require on\-call duties as needed by the position. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado. While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date. We know it's important to support each other, and that means having a healthy balance of work and personal time. Visit our How to Apply webpage to learn more about our application process and what to expect after you apply. The State of Colorado strives to create a Colorado for All by building and maintaining workplaces that value and respect all Coloradans through a commitment to equal opportunity and hiring based on merit and fitness. The State is resolute in non\-discriminatory practices in everything we do, including hiring, employment, and advancement opportunities. The Governor's Office of Information Technology is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our ADA Coordinator at OIT\_HR@state.co.us or call (303\) 764\-7900\. jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Posting Title** AI Software Engineer **Agency** 090 OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT AND ENTERPRISE SERV **Supervisory Organization** IS\-Data **Job Posting End Date** Refer to the date listed at the top of this posting, if available. Continuous if date is blank. Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the day prior to the posting end date above. **Estimated Appointment End Date (Continuous if Blank)** **Full/Part\-Time** Full time **Job Type** Regular **Compensation** **Job Description** **As an AI Software Engineer with OMES you will enjoy:** * Generous leave including 15 days of vacation, 15 days of sick leave and 11 paid holidays annually. A comprehensive Benefit Package with a generous benefit allowance to offset the cost of insurance premiums for employees and their eligible dependents. * **Job Details** * Full\-time 40\-hour work weeks * Support the Information Services Division * Salary is based on education and experience This is an on\-site position located in Oklahoma City, OK * **Position Summary** The AI Software Engineer owns the agency’s custom AI development on Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry). This is a hands\-on engineering role with a clear mandate: turn AI delivery from a series of one\-off projects into a repeatable, industrialized pattern that lets the organization deliver more AI solutions, faster, at a lower cost per solution. The role inherits AI products already running in production. The engineer will take full ownership of them – stabilizing, hardening and supporting the code – while extracting what works into a shared core capability that every future AI solution is built on. Success means each new use case is a configuration of proven components, not a new build from scratch. **Key Responsibilities** Reusable AI Platform \& Delivery Pattern (Economy of Scale) * Design and maintain a reference architecture for AI solutions on Microsoft Foundry, including Foundry Agent Service, Foundry Models, Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search / Foundry IQ grounding. * Build reusable starter templates, shared SDK/libraries and infrastructure\-as\-code modules so new use cases can be stood up in days rather than months. * Standardize common building blocks: prompt and agent configuration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, tool/API connectors, model routing, conversation state and error handling. * Define a repeatable intake\-to\-production lifecycle (discovery, prototype, evaluation, security review, deployment, support handoff) and continually refine it based on lessons learned. * Identify duplicated logic across products and refactor it into the shared core; retire one\-off code wherever possible. Track and optimize unit economics – token consumption, model selection, compute and hosting cost – and design for cost efficiency at scale. * Inherited Product Ownership \& Code Hardening * Assume technical ownership of existing production AI products; perform an early assessment of architecture, code quality, security, dependencies and technical debt. * Develop and execute a prioritized hardening plan: automated unit, integration and regression tests; static and dependency scanning; secrets management; resiliency and retry patterns; rate\-limit and quota handling. * Migrate inherited products onto the shared core capability and standard pipelines as the pattern matures. * Implement automated AI evaluation (groundedness, relevance, accuracy, safety) as release gates, and maintain regression test sets for each product. Deliver enhancements and new features against a prioritized backlog in partnership with product owners and business stakeholders. * Production Operations \& Support * Provide ongoing support for AI products, including participation in an on\-call rotation and incident response for production issues. * Instrument products with telemetry, tracing and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Foundry observability) covering latency, error rates, cost and model quality. * Define service level objectives with stakeholders and monitor model and prompt drift, degradation and anomalous usage. * Perform root cause analysis, write post\-incident reviews and drive corrective actions back into the shared platform. Manage model version lifecycles, deprecations and upgrades with minimal disruption to users. * Security, Governance \& Responsible AI * Apply secure\-by\-design practices: managed identities, least\-privilege RBAC, private networking, key and secrets management, and data protection appropriate for government data. * Implement content safety, prompt\-injection defenses, input/output filtering and human\-in\-the\-loop controls where required. * Support the agency’s AI governance framework, documentation and audit requirements, including model cards, data lineage, risk assessments and records retention. Ensure solutions meet applicable state policy, privacy, accessibility (WCAG / Section 508\) and security standards. * Collaboration, Enablement \& Documentation * Work within an agile delivery model alongside DevSecOps, SRE, Observability, infrastructure, security and data teams. * Produce clear architecture documentation, runbooks and developer guides so the pattern can be adopted by other engineers and vendors. * Coach developers and contractors on the standard pattern; perform code reviews and enforce engineering standards. Translate business problems into technical approaches and communicate trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders and leadership. * **Physical Demands and Work Environment** While performing the duties of this job, this position works in an office setting with a computer for a large percentage of the workday. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Occasional travel may be required. This position participates in an on\-call rotation for production AI services, including occasional after\-hours support. **Minimum Qualifications** Requirements include a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field and 6\+ years of professional software development experience building and supporting production applications, plus 2\+ years developing generative AI or LLM\-based solutions in production, including RAG and/or agent\-based architectures, or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preference will be given to candidates who possess** * Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI\-103\) or predecessor Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\); Azure Developer or DevOps Engineer certifications. * Experience with Foundry Agent Service, Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, multi\-agent orchestration or Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling. * Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, LLMOps practices and prompt/version management. * Background in public sector, regulated industries or environments with strict security and compliance requirements. * Experience with FinOps or IT cost management for cloud and AI workloads. Familiarity with Power Platform, Copilot Studio or Microsoft 365 integration. * **About** **OMES** The Office of Management and Enterprise Services provides excellent service, expert guidance and continuous improvement in support of our partners’ goals. We are a highly qualified workforce committed to serve those who serve Oklahomans and make government run in the most efficient, innovative manner possible. **OMES is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities may be provided upon request.** **Equal Opportunity Employment** The State of Oklahoma is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of genetic information, race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, or disability. Current active State of Oklahoma employees must apply for open positions internally through the Workday Jobs Hub . If you are needing any extra assistance or have any questions relating to a job you have applied for, please click the link below and find the agency for which you applied for additional information: Agency Contact

jobs.title: Senior AI Algorithm Developer
jobs.description: Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award\-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off\-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team. **POSITION SUMMARY:** ===================== The AI Algorithm Developer will work closely with our engineering teams to launch advanced AI features into Stoneridge’s award\-winning product ‘MirrorEye’ and other Camera monitor edge systems. This role will also involve developing and deploying AI features on HiL systems for demo purposes. The system software solution will be included in multiple production projects for commercial vehicles and heavy machines worldwide. This role will focus on the deployment of AI features based on computer vision, machine learning, deep learning, Image stitching, object detection/tracking, etc. Additional responsibilities will include data collection, system simulation, data analysis and in\-vehicle validation. **MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:** =========================== * Work closely with algorithm developers and System / Software teams in the deployment of ADAS features. * Design and optimize multimodal ADAS features based on computer vision, machine learning, and object tracking for commercial vehicles by integrating inputs from Camera, IMU, Radar, LiDAR, Wheel Odometry, GPS and Ultrasonic sensors where applicable, to enhance perception accuracy and robustness. * Develop, deploy, and debug real\-time, safety\-critical embedded software in C/C\+\+ and Python on diverse SoCs and MCUs, e.g. ARM based platforms with HW accelerators and GPUs. * Develop models in RTMaps for data logging and implement ADAS features in same for demo purposes. * Implement and benchmark computer vision algorithms using OpenCV, OpenVX, OpenCL and Vulkan on resource\-constrained embedded platforms. Accelerate deep neural network inference for edge deployment using TensorRT, ONNX, and hardware\-specific optimization techniques to meet real\-time performance constraints. * Author comprehensive technical documentation, validation reports, and calibration procedures, while leading technical reviews and contributing to IP generation initiatives. * Contribute to the development of software compliant with functional safety (ISO26262\) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE21434\) standards within an agile framework using Git, JIRA, and CI/CD pipelines. * Work with System / Software teams to integrate and verify that developed features meet functional requirements on the embedded target environment. * Define test methodology using DoE (Design of Experiments) and join in vehicle validation when needed. Perform data analysis with feature test logs and create test reports. **QUALIFICATIONS:** =================== * Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering or a related field with strong research and development experience in the AI area developing ADAS features. * Knowledge and experience in data recording \& analysis, requirement analysis, verification, customer interfacing and cooperation with other cross functional teams. * Coding, modeling and simulation experience with Matlab/Simulink, C/C\+\+, Python. * Experience shipping Computer Vision and/or sensor fusion systems that fuse multiple data streams (Camera, IMU, GPS, LiDAR, Wheel Odometry) in production environments with high precision and low latency. * At least 3 years of experience with the following: + Programming experience in C/C\+\+, Matlab/Simulink and Python. + Working on ML Frameworks, libraries, data structures, data modelling, and software architecture. + Working with embedded software. + Working with OpenVX, OpenCV, OpenCL and edgeML frameworks. + Working on ADAS components with Applied ML/computer vision. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by the applicable laws in the countries we operate. reliability standards for our services (availability, monitoring, recovery, on\-call, and security), and run the production readiness reviews that hold new services to them + Lead our regional resilience work so critical payment flows keep running through a cloud region outage + Build security and compliance into the platform itself, so SOC 2 and PCI DSS evidence comes from the system rather than from manual collection**Make Production Observable** + Make sure we catch production incidents before customers do, with alerting that reaches the right person at the right time for the right reason, and almost never otherwise + Partner with product engineering to define SLOs and error budgets for critical user journeys, and use them to guide release decisions**Build the Paved Road** + Grow our internal deployment platform into a self\-service, governed path to production that doesn't need a ticket to SRE + Make safe delivery the default, with progressive rollouts, automated rollback, and release controls teams get for free + Replace manual access requests and provisioning with self\-service, least\-privilege workflows + Bring our cloud environment fully under escalation point for major incidents + Run blameless postmortems that fix systems, not people, and see the follow\-up work through to done + Measure toil and automate it away, using AI tools where they make detection, diagnosis, or remediation faster, with guardrails suited to a regulated environment**Raise the Bar Around You** + Be the senior technical voice on cloud architecture and reliability, and write the design docs that turn decisions into shared practice + Mentor engineers on the team and across product engineering, and guide the technical work of partner and contract engineers + Make work and risk visible early; on this team, a slip is okay and a surprise is not **What You’ll Bring:** * **Required** + Spent 6\+ years in SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering, running production systems where downtime had real customer or financial impact + Operated production workloads on Azure in depth, including PaaS compute, managed databases, messaging, private networking, and Entra ID + Written production\-quality code in Go, Python, C\#, or PowerShell, and built tooling other engineers adopted + Managed infrastructure as code at team scale with Terraform or OpenTofu, including modules, state, and pipeline\-driven change + Defined SLOs or equivalent reliability targets and built the monitoring and alerting to back them + Led incidents as commander or senior responder, and run blameless postmortems that produced lasting fixes + Explained technical risk and trade\-offs clearly in writing, to engineers and to non\-technical leaders**Preferred** + Worked in fintech, payments, or payroll, where the availability and correctness of money movement matter + Supported SOC 2 or PCI DSS audits as the engineer whose systems The Tapcheck team is passionate about our mission to improve financial wellness and boost business productivity. jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **CONTROLS ENGINEER \- LOUISVILLE, KY.** **OVERVIEW:** ------------------------------------------------------- The Controls Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining control systems across multiple production facilities to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and efficiency of manufacturing processes. This role provides technical expertise in automation, PLCs, robotics, and other control systems, while supporting continuous improvement initiatives and troubleshooting complex issues. To succeed, you need a strong background in controls engineering, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration in a food manufacturing or similar environment. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** ------------------- ***Control System Design and Implementation:*** ----------------------------------------------- * Design, program, and troubleshoot PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) systems, HMI (Human\-Machine Interface) panels, and SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems. * Develop and implement control system solutions to improve production efficiency, product quality, and equipment reliability. * Lead the integration of new equipment and automation technologies into existing production lines. * Create and maintain electrical schematics, control system documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). ***Technical Support and*** ***Troubleshooting:*** -------------------------------------------------- * Provide on\-site and remote support to multiple production facilities to resolve control system issues and minimize downtime. * Diagnose and troubleshoot complex electrical, mechanical, and software\-related problems in control systems. * Collaborate with maintenance, production, and engineering teams to identify root causes of equipment failures and implement corrective actions. * Conduct regular system audits to ensure control systems are operating efficiently and in compliance with safety and regulatory standards. ***Project Management:*** ------------------------- * Manage controls\-related projects, including scope definition, budgeting, scheduling, and resource allocation. * Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and successful project completion. * Oversee the installation, commissioning, and validation of new control systems and equipment upgrades. * Ensure all projects adhere to food safety regulations (e.g., FDA, USDA, HACCP) and electrical standards (e.g., NFPA 70, NEC). ***Continuous Improvement:*** ----------------------------- * Identify opportunities to optimize control systems and processes through data analysis, automation, and advanced technologies. * Implement lean manufacturing principles and Six Sigma methodologies to drive operational excellence. * Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in controls engineering and automation. ***Training and Development:*** ------------------------------- * Train maintenance and production staff on the operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of control systems. * Develop training materials and conduct hands\-on workshops to enhance technical skills across facilities. ***Compliance and Safety:*** ---------------------------- * Ensure all control systems comply with food safety regulations (e.g., GMP, HACCP) and electrical safety standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA 70E). * Conduct risk assessments and implement safety measures to protect personnel and equipment. * Maintain accurate records of control system modifications, repairs, and compliance documentation. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED:** --------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation, or a related field or equivalent experience * 3\+ years of experience in controls engineering, preferably in food manufacturing or a similar industry. * Proficiency in programming and troubleshooting PLCs (e.g., Allen\-Bradley, Siemens), HMIs, and SCADA systems. * Strong knowledge of electrical systems, robotics, and industrial automation technologies. * Experience with project management, including budgeting, scheduling, and resource allocation. * Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making skills. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple facilities and teams. * Willingness to travel to support multiple production facilities as needed (up to 50% travel). **WHAT WE'D LIKE TO SEE:** -------------------------- * Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification. * Experience with food safety standards (e.g., FDA, USDA, HACCP) and regulatory requirements. * Knowledge of lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. * Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things) and machine learning. ‎ **WHY TEASDALE:** ----------------- *At Teasdale Latin Foods, our People Principles are all about Living LATIN.* What is LATIN, and how do I live it? Let us fill you in. * ***L is Learning***. It emphasizes the importance of continuous learning and development within Teasdale and promotes a culture of curiosity, exploration, and acquiring new knowledge and skills. * ***A is Accountability***. This encourages individuals to take ownership of their actions and responsibilities, promoting a sense of personal and collective accountability and ensuring we understand how to achieve our goals. * ***T is Teamwork***. It emphasizes the value of diverse perspectives, collective problem\-solving, and synergy among team members, enabling us to achieve greater outcomes by leveraging the strengths and expertise of our employees. * ***I is Innovation***. This promotes an environment where we are empowered to think outside the box, challenge the status quo, and seek innovative solutions to problems, fostering an atmosphere of adaptability and openness to change. * ***N is Nurturing***. It emphasizes the importance of supporting and developing our employees' well\-being, growth, and potential, showing that we care and are willing to invest in their long\-term success and satisfaction. We believe in finding the right people for the right roles and helping them to build careers. If this sounds like a place you'd like to be, hit apply! *Still not convinced? What about:* * Day One \- Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits * 401(k) Retirement Plan with Matching Contributions at 60 Days * Career Growth Opportunities and Professional Development *I**f you are passionate about being the right kind of contributor, the point person of a* *fast\-paced, diverse* *organization, and a steward of great tradition, come join the family. We want people who are up for a challenge. Let's live LATIN!*

jobs.title: Principal II AI Platform Engineer, GenAI
jobs.description: **Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.** At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives. Here you will be part of a high\-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens. **Summary of Position** We are seeking a Principal II Data \& AI Platform Engineer to serve as one of the most senior hands\-on technical leaders on our Data \& AI Platform team. This role will architect, build, and scale production generative AI applications and agentic systems, including member\-facing experiences. You will drive technical decisions for AI architecture, agent infrastructure, and integration with our Databricks ecosystem while directly contributing to design and implementation. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in traditional machine learning and deep learning, followed by substantial recent experience engineering production GenAI solutions. This is a highly influential individual contributor role with technical decision\-making authority, cross\-team leadership, and an opportunity to shape how Teladoc delivers reliable, secure AI at scale. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture and hands\-on development of production GenAI applications, including member\-facing AI agents, conversational experiences, and API\-based workflows. * Design and build reusable agent infrastructure, including orchestration, tool/function calling (such as MCP), RAG, vector search, context management, and model integrations. * Architect AI solutions on Databricks, including platform integration, model serving, retrieval, and governance, with secure and reusable patterns for enterprise applications. * Make cross\-team technical decisions on AI architecture, scalability, platform integrations, and build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs, while remaining accountable for implementation. * Establish production AI engineering practices for evaluation, automated testing, CI/CD, model/prompt versioning, observability, and troubleshooting. * Build safe, reliable AI systems with PHI/PII protections, guardrails, access controls, and performance and cost monitoring. * Partner with product, engineering, data, security, and compliance teams to deliver member\-facing AI capabilities and integrate AI into enterprise applications. * Mentor engineers, set AI engineering standards, and communicate technical decisions to engineering leaders and executives while remaining deeply hands\-on. Participate in on\-call support as a senior escalation resource for production AI incidents. * The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs. **Supervisory Responsibilities** No **Qualifications Expected for Position** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 12\+ years of experience building and running production systems (software, platform, or ML engineering). A proven record of setting technical direction for large, multi\-team initiatives and defining architectures and standards used across the company. * 5\+ years of hands\-on Databricks experience at production scale: + Lakehouse architecture, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake + Spark/PySpark performance tuning + Workflows and Databricks SQL + Cost management (cluster policies, serverless compute) * Strong hands\-on foundation in traditional machine learning or deep learning, predating widespread GenAI adoption, followed by recent, substantial agentic GenAI engineering experience. * Proven experience personally building, deploying, and operating production GenAI/LLM applications (ideally 3\+ years), such as agentic APIs, workflows, or conversational products. * Strong knowledge of agent architecture, including orchestration, tool calling, RAG, vector retrieval, context management, evaluation, and observability. * Strong Python skills and experience delivering production AI services or APIs, with CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and operational troubleshooting. Ability to lead through technical authority, mentor engineers, collaborate across teams, and design secure, reliable systems while remaining a hands\-on individual contributor. * **Bonus Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Databricks Mosaic AI, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Vector Search, or Databricks Asset Bundles. * Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Terraform, Spark/PySpark, or broader data lakehouse infrastructure. * Experience with AI applications in healthcare or other regulated environments, including HIPAA or responsible AI frameworks. * Familiarity with complementary AI/cloud frameworks and tools such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry, Docker, or Kubernetes. Relevant Databricks or cloud AI certifications, open\-source contributions, pub s, or conference presentations. * The base salary range for this position is $250,000 \- $300,000\. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for performance bonus, RSU’s, and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026 Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full\-time positions. \#LI\-SS2 \#LI\-Remote We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full\-time positions only. If you are applying for a part\-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details. As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified. **We’ve been alerted that scammers will sometimes impersonate our employees and make fictitious job offers.** The only official email address domain used by Teladoc Health is “@teladochealth.com,” and we are only recruiting for the positions listed below. Additionally, we will never ask you to send any payment to our company or employees, and all Teladoc Health equipment is provided at no charge to our employees. If you have been contacted by any other email domain, offered a position that’s not on our website, or received any other suspicious communication, please do not engage, mark the email as phishing and file a report at https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/ . Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing position responsible for deploying, configuring, and implementing IT infrastructure solutions for clients across the country. From onboarding new clients to installing servers, firewalls, network equipment, and workstations, this role plays a critical part in ensuring successful project delivery. The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail\-oriented, organized, and comfortable working independently in fast\-paced environments. This position requires frequent nationwide travel to client locations, with time between projects spent at our headquarters in Flowood, MS, collaborating with our Projects and Support teams. ### **Key Responsibilities** **IT Infrastructure \& Project Deployment** * Lead technical implementation tasks for new client onboardings, infrastructure upgrades, and IT deployments. * Configure, install, and troubleshoot firewalls, network switches, wireless access points, servers, and workstations. * Deploy and configure Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and virtualization platforms. * Install and configure network equipment, including SonicWall firewalls, Aruba Instant On switches, and wireless access points. * Perform network assessments, wireless site surveys, IP scans, and connectivity testing. * Assist with VoIP system deployments, including phone configuration, call routing, and end\-user training. * Coordinate with internal teams and third\-party contractors to ensure successful installations. **Client Onboarding \& Documentation** * Execute new client onboarding procedures, including deployment of TST's standard security, monitoring, backup, and remote management tools. * Assess existing client infrastructure and identify technical issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement. * Document network configurations, hardware inventories, system credentials, and infrastructure details. * Prepare accurate technical findings and recommendations following client site assessments. * Maintain thorough project documentation in IT Glue and ConnectWise. **Project Coordination \& Communication** * Work closely with the Project Director, Project Manager, and other technical teams to complete projects on schedule. * Participate in project kickoff meetings, client calls, and technical planning sessions. * Provide regular updates on project progress, potential delays, and technical challenges. * Accurately track project tasks, time entries, expenses, and documentation in ConnectWise. * Communicate professionally with clients throughout project implementation. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges during deployments, escalating complex issues when necessary. ### **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * 3\+ years of hands\-on IT infrastructure, systems administration, network engineering, or technical project implementation experience. * Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and routing. * Experience configuring and deploying firewalls, managed switches, and wireless networks. * Hands\-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 environments. * Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting servers, workstations, and network equipment. * Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper\-V, or Proxmox. * Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and technical documentation skills. * Excellent communication and customer service skills. * Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet project deadlines. * Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout the United States. * Valid driver's license. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP). * Experience with SonicWall firewalls and Aruba Instant On networking equipment. * Familiarity with ConnectWise, IT Glue, N\-able, Huntress, or similar MSP management tools. * Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions. * Experience implementing VoIP systems. * Experience supporting healthcare organizations or multi\-location businesses. * Industry certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, Microsoft, Cisco, or SonicWall. ### **What We're Looking For** We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, pays attention to the details, and can confidently represent TST while working directly with our clients. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI-Powered Software Assurance
jobs.description: San Jose Regular R\&D Job ID: A236737A to this job Responsibilities We build an internal software assurance platform that helps engineering and security teams analyze source code, assess vulnerabilities and evaluate compliance requirements. The platform combines agentic AI workflows with code\-analysis tools to investigate complex codebases and produce actionable, evidence\-backed findings. We focus on deep code understanding across languages, rigorous measurement of analysis quality, and reliable execution at production scale. We are looking for a hands\-on software engineer who can expand these workflows’ analytical capabilities and build the reliable, scalable services that run them. Build and improve agentic workflows. Develop orchestration, tool integrations, context retrieval, state management and recovery mechanisms for multi\-step software assurance investigations. Develop deep, multi\-language code analysis. Build tools that navigate large repositories, trace control and data flows, resolve cross\-file references and dependencies, and connect evidence across files, services and languages. Combine LLM reasoning with deterministic analysis where appropriate. Measure output quality rigorously. Build representative evaluation datasets, expert\-reviewed reference cases and repeatable evaluation pipelines. Measure precision, recall, false\-positive and false\-negative rates, evidence correctness and task completion. Use held\-out cases to assess generalization, and maintain separation between development and evaluation datasets to reduce evaluation leakage. Drive evidence\-based improvements. Investigate failure cases, then refine prompts, tools, retrieval and orchestration. Demonstrate measurable improvements through controlled comparisons and regression evaluations. Responsibilities \- Build scalable, production\-grade services. Develop APIs, execution workers, job scheduling and result management that support concurrent workloads, durable execution, retries, cancellation and tenant isolation. \- Improve performance and efficiency. Remove bottlenecks in repository processing, tool execution, context management and model calls. Balance analysis quality against latency, throughput and inference cost. \- Make results observable and auditable. Capture execution traces, tool activity and supporting evidence so teams can reproduce findings and diagnose failures. \- Design secure agent execution. Treat repository content and model outputs as untrusted. Working with the security and infrastructure teams, implement tool permissions, sandboxing and data\-handling boundaries. \- Own features through production. Write tested, maintainable code, contribute to design reviews, work with platform engineers on deployment, and investigate production issues. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Significant experience building backend software or distributed systems, including ownership of production services. Strong Python skills and working proficiency in at least one more language, such as Go, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, C/C\+\+ or Rust. \- Hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-powered applications, including tool use, orchestration, retrieval and systematic failure analysis. \- Ability to understand large, unfamiliar codebases and reason about application behavior, control flow, data flow and dependencies across multiple languages. \- Familiarity with code\-analysis techniques such as abstract syntax trees, symbol resolution, call graphs, static analysis or language\-server tooling. \- Experience evaluating AI systems or other systems with imperfect outputs, including dataset design, meaningful quality metrics and regression testing. \- Solid backend fundamentals (APIs, queues, persistence, concurrency, idempotency and failure recovery), along with automated testing and CI/CD. \- Hands\-on experience building, deploying and debugging containerized services on Kubernetes, including resource configuration, health checks and troubleshooting failed workloads. Ability to communicate uncertainty clearly, separate supported findings from speculation, and work with domain experts to validate results. Preferred Qualifications \- Experience in application security, vulnerability research, secure code review, software quality or compliance analysis. \- Familiarity with LangGraph or comparable agent\-orchestration frameworks. \- Experience with compiler tooling, Tree\-sitter, CodeQL, Semgrep, or code\-search and indexing systems; familiarity with analysis\-result formats such as SARIF. \- Experience evaluating retrieval quality, tool\-call correctness and multi\-step agent behavior. Familiarity with prompt\-injection defenses, agent sandboxing and secure handling of proprietary source code. \- Experience with Helm and GitOps\-based delivery using Argo CD. \- Experience with Redis, including high\-availability setups with Redis Sentinel. \- Experience with OpenTelemetry, LLM gateways or model\-serving systems. al leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Managed AI
jobs.description: **About Titan** --------------- Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7\. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market\-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K\+ tickets across 400\+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. **About the team** ------------------ Managed AI is Titan's program for companies making AI part of how they run. We manage their new and existing AI platforms, advise their leadership on AI strategy and governance, and build custom agents, software and integrations. Our clients range from hedge funds to medical device makers, and each one brings new systems, workflows and problems to solve. Forward Deployed Engineers (Managed AI) are the builders behind it. **About the role** ------------------ Forward Deployed Engineers (Managed AI) take a client workflow from shortlisted idea to an agent running in the client's tenant, usually within a quarter. You own scoping, the build, the deployment and the handover, working directly with client teams and their IT. You'll write connectors into Microsoft 365 and line\-of\-business systems, build agents on Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot, and ship them under the client's own controls. You own and measure success by agents live in production, adoption by the user group each was built for, and delivery inside the fixed fee we quoted. You work closely with vCAIOs, other Forward Deployed Engineers, Product and GTM. This role is remote (US). **In this role you will** ------------------------- * Join vCAIO\-led opportunity assessments and find the workflows where data is spread across systems nobody reads in the same week * Scope each build: the systems it reads, the actions it takes, its user group, its success metric and baseline, and say so when the bottleneck sits outside the client's control * Build the agents, connectors (Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, client APIs, MCP servers) and skills each engagement needs * Deploy into client tenants with least\-privilege access, an entry in the governance register, and documentation that holds up to an auditor or a DDQ * Measure each agent against its baseline, train its users, and hand it into ongoing maintenance under the platform * Turn what works in one engagement into connectors, skills, evals and templates the next one can reuse **A typical engagement** ------------------------ A first agent goes live in month three of a client's program, at a fixed fee, measured against a baseline taken in month two. * **Month 1, platform connected, shadow AI and spend baseline:** review the tenant inventory; note the systems and data you will need * **Month 2, vCAIO\-led agent opportunity assessment:** join interviews, score workflows on value, risk and effort, capture the baseline, write the scope * **Month 3, first agent build:** build, deploy to a named user group, measure, hand over * **Month 4\+, further agents scoped per project:** maintain the live agent; scope and build the next one **Example projects** -------------------- These are the kinds of agents you would build in your first months. * **Medical device manufacturer, customer site activation tracker:** reads the commercial team's Teams channels, account files in SharePoint, Outlook threads and the current tracker; follows each new customer site through contracting, training and first use; flags sites that have stalled or lack a named owner. The commercial team sees every stalled site in one place, every week. * **Hedge fund, investor DDQ responder:** reads past DDQs, policies and the compliance library; drafts answers to a new questionnaire with a source for every line. First draft in hours instead of two weeks of IR and compliance time. * **Industrial manufacturer, supplier quality monitor:** reads supplier certificates, incoming inspection results from the ERP and nonconformance reports; flags expiring certifications and repeat defects; drafts the supplier corrective action request. Quality catches supplier issues before they reach the line, and every request leaves an audit trail. **You might thrive in this role if you** ---------------------------------------- * Bring 4\+ years of engineering experience, including client\-facing work * Have built or shipped LLM\-powered agents and know how model behavior shapes the product experience * Write and review production\-grade code in TypeScript, Python, or a comparable stack * Know Microsoft 365 as a data source: Graph API, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and how app permissions and consent work in a tenant * Can run a scoping session with a business leader, say no to a weak use case, and write a scope a CFO will sign * Would rather put a working agent in front of 10 users in three weeks than a perfect one in front of none in three months * Take extreme ownership of problems and delivery, and handle client data with a security mindset **Bonus** --------- * Forward deployed, solutions or sales engineering experience at a SaaS, AI or consulting company * Built on MCP: servers, connectors, or skills for Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot **Logistics** ------------- * **Location:** NYC * **Travel:** Up to 5%, for on\-site discovery and launch * **Compensation:** $150,000–$200,000 base

This is a hands\-on engineering role where you'll design and ship MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Bedrock\-based agents, and Claude\-powered workflows, and own the AWS\-native infrastructure behind them end\-to\-end (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, CDK). actions, including through Bedrock AgentCore Gateway * Build Bedrock agents and Claude\-powered workflows (using AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Strands Agents, or LangGraph) that automate and beta/gamma/prod environments * Develop data pipelines between enterprise apps, Redshift, and S3, and make that data available to AI agents * Set up monitoring for agents and services (CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, tracing) *Cross\-cutting* * Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI\-driven solutions * Own production systems end\-to\-end, from deployment and monitoring to incident response and iterative improvement * Raise the team's bar through code reviews, docs, mentoring, and promoting AI\-assisted development ### analysis, automation, and problem\-solving * Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs (Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic API, or similar), including prompt design, tool calling, and structured outputs * jobs.title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer** ================================= United States \- New York Investment Banking Investment Bank Job Reference \# 345605BR City New York Job Type Full Time Key responsibilities Turn front\-office problems into governed, production\-grade AI solutions that transform sales workflows. You will own the journey from discovery through implementation: understand how work actually happens, identify where AI can materially improve it, rapidly put solutions in front of users, and partner with senior Global Markets quants and technology teams on governance, productionisation and scale. This is a role for someone who likes interpreting and doing, not consulting and enabling from the sidelines. What you will do * Embed with Distribution desks. Understand how work actually happens, map workflows end to end, identify friction and waste, and prioritise opportunities against the seven pillars of the Global Markets Sales strategy. * Build quickly. Use the bank's existing AI and low\-code capabilities to automate workflows and get useful solutions in front of users in days rather than months. The objective is not to build bespoke software where an existing tool can solve the problem. * Redesign before you automate. Challenge unnecessary steps, hand\-offs and duplication rather than simply using AI to automate an inefficient process. * Own the dependencies. Identify the APIs, data and entitlements required for your solutions, specify what is needed clearly, and drive those requirements through to delivery. * Design for compliant AI. Understand the architectural and governance considerations around AI systems and ensure solutions operate within the bank's AI, data, risk and control frameworks. * Unlock the right data. Recommend how each desk should organise and access its information to enable AI use cases while adhering to the bank's need\-to\-know framework. * Know what not to build. Solve problems directly where the available tools allow it. Where a requirement genuinely needs strategic engineering, route it to Quant or Technology with a well\-defined problem statement, requirements and expected business outcome. * Drive adoption, not just delivery. Train users, observe how solutions perform in real workflows, iterate quickly, spread successful patterns across desks, and make sure what you build is still being used a month later. * Scale what works. Spot recurring problems across products, regions and desks and turn successful local solutions into reusable capabilities. Your Career Comeback We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback. The team This role sits at the intersection of Global Markets Distribution, Quantitative Engineering and regional Sales, with connectivity to the senior leaders responsible for each. It is an embedded, front\-office role. Success is measured not by recommendations or prototypes alone, but by whether better ways of working make it into the hands of users and stay there. Your skills and experience You bring: * Financial markets exposure. At least two years of financial\-services experience, ideally within Global Markets sales, trading or a closely related front\-office environment. * Real curiosity about AI. You actively use today's AI tools and have a practical understanding of where they are powerful, where they fail, and where human judgement still matters. * Hands\-on building ability. Experience with AI and low\-code tooling such as Cowork, Copilot Studio or similar platforms, plus the appetite to master the next tool just as quickly. * A process engineer's mindset. You can take a workflow apart, identify its constraints and inefficiencies, and redesign it rather than simply automating the existing mess. * Strong communication skills. You can earn the trust of busy front\-office professionals, ask incisive questions and explain technology without hiding behind jargon. * Exceptional learning velocity. A new desk, asset class, dataset or tool should take you days to begin understanding, not months. * Technical fluency. You are comfortable working with data, understanding system interactions, scoping an API and building a working prototype. Deep software\-engineering experience is welcome, but it is not the purpose of the role. * Commercial judgement. You can distinguish an interesting problem from a valuable one, prioritise ruthlessly, and say no or redirect work when that is the right answer. You are * Practical, focused and biased toward action. * Comfortable operating on a busy trading floor and communicating with people at every level. * Curious about how the business works, not simply about the technology. * A fast learner who is comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information. * Able to work independently while thriving in a highly collaborative environment. * Comfortable balancing speed and innovation with the governance standards of a regulated institution. * Motivated by seeing something you built change how people actually work. You will know you are succeeding when: 1\. Front\-office users come to you with problems, not specifications. 2\. Useful solutions reach users in days or weeks, not quarters. 3\. You eliminate work rather than simply making existing steps faster. 4\. The things you build are actually adopted and remain in use. 5\. Successful solutions spread from one desk to another. 6\. Strategic engineering teams receive better\-defined problems because of your work. 7\. AI becomes part of how Distribution operates, rather than a separate technology initiative. 8\. You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use. About us UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe. We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers. UBS offers a range of competitive benefits and for further information, please visit ubs.com/employee\-benefits. We may, at our sole discretion, provide additional variable compensation or awards. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: About the Role This role is on the Courier Pricing team within the Marketplace organization. As a Software Engineer II on the Courier Pricing team, you will interact with a wide range of data and analytic events to build a best\-in\-class pricing and incentive system to efficiently price each offer made to Uber delivery partners. This work is continuing to define the courier niche in the global delivery marketplace. We research new models and algorithms and build platforms to serve our insights to customers at Uber scale. You will be working with world\-class talent and surrounded by some of the world's most experienced engineering professionals, data scientists, and research scientists on user\-facing products with global impact. This is your chance to develop groundbreaking technology that will touch every Uber trip! What the Candidate Will Do: * You will design, code, test, and launch backend features, data engineering pipelines, and ML\-based product features at a global scale. * Own important components of the pricing ecosystem end\-to\-end. * Interact with users directly to understand pain points and improve the systems. * Collaborate with other members of the team to ship complex projects fast and with quality. * Solve challenging large scale data problems with cutting\-edge design and algorithms. Basic Qualifications: * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or data engineering. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or functional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+). * Experience with data modeling, query optimization, and translating customer problems into system design. * Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience writing tests to verify functionality and establishing monitoring systems to ensure code stability. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience identifying and reducing code\-level technical debt in high\-load distributed systems. * Understanding of distributed systems and architecture. * Proficiency with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) or real\-time data streaming (e.g., Kafka). * Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment on engineering trade\-offs for complex features. * Adept at communicating and collaborating effectively with others, promoting your ideas as well as being humble when you may be wrong. * Machine learning hands on experience is preferred, however deep ML knowledge is not required For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. jobs.title: Incident Responder
jobs.description: UnderDefense is looking for a proactive, technically skilled Incident Responder (Tier 2\) to join our Security Operations team. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role where you’ll take ownership of real\-world cybersecurity incidents, lead investigations, make critical response decisions, and help enterprise clients navigate complex security threats. You’ll work across diverse environments, investigating everything from sophisticated infrastructure compromises to active attacks requiring immediate containment. As part of a team supporting 70\+ clients, you’ll collaborate with SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and other security specialists while taking the lead when incidents occur. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex security problems, taking ownership under pressure, and making a real impact when it matters most. ### **What You Will Do:** * Investigate security alerts escalated from Tier 1, determine whether they constitute actual incidents, and decide on appropriate response actions. * Review the quality of Tier 1 alert triage, including True Positive and False Positive classifications, and support analysts with complex investigations. * Independently validate findings from our AI agent, MAXI, and Tier 1 analysts against raw security data, documenting your conclusions in incident tickets. * Own incidents end\-to\-end as the assigned Incident Responder, activating incident response procedures, assessing severity, defining investigation plans, and driving the response process. * Lead incident response calls with clients, coordinate with their technical teams, involve relevant security specialists, and assign investigation and remediation tasks. * Maintain incident trackers, provide daily updates to clients during active incidents, and prepare comprehensive incident reports. * Share Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) and affected asset information with the SOC team to support further detection and monitoring. * Respond to client\-reported compromises and security investigation requests. * Conduct proactive and client\-requested threat hunting, including investigations triggered by newly discovered vulnerabilities or emerging threats. * Analyze suspicious files, email samples (.eml), IP addresses, and domains submitted by clients through MAXI. * Perform daily health checks to identify security alerts that may not have been properly ingested into MAXI or Jira. * Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly security reports to assigned clients, including presenting findings and recommendations in English. ### **What We’re Looking For:** * Ability to independently manage security incidents and communicate directly with clients. * Experience investigating complex security incidents involving actual infrastructure compromise and attacker activity within corporate environments. * Windows and Linux forensics. * Hands\-on experience investigating security incidents in at least one cloud environment, such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. * SIEM and EDR expertise. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to explain complex security incidents clearly, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and guide clients through high\-pressure situations. * Strong English communication skills. ### **Nice to Have:** * Knowledge of Kubernetes and experience investigating security incidents in containerized environments. * Experience developing AI agents or AI\-powered workflows for cybersecurity tasks, such as alert triage, phishing analysis, or security investigations, with testing against real\-world data. * Experience with tools and technologies such as LibreChat, MCP servers, Claude, or OpenAI API. ### **What You’ll Get at UnderDefense:** * Real\-world incidents that actually challenge you. * Work across different enterprise infrastructures, security stacks, cloud environments, and attack scenarios, constantly expanding your technical expertise. * A strong team of cybersecurity professionals. * Competitive compensation and challenging projects. * Flexible working hours. * Paid vacation and sick leave. * Continuous learning opportunities, including internal training, workshops, conferences, and professional development activities. * English language courses. * Work\-life balance support, including office activities, foosball, and a workout station. Ready to take ownership when it matters most? Send your CV to ulyana.volynets@underdefense.com and join the UnderDefense team! ##### **About this position** Location Remote/ Office Employment type Full time Department SOC ##### **Got Questions?** **Let Us Help!** ##### **Julia Chalaidiuk** Recruitment Specialist job@underdefense.com

jobs.title: SOC Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Position Summary:** We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Middle SOC Security Engineer. UnderDefense is looking for a motivated and proactive engineer to join our MDR Engineering team. This role focuses on configuring, maintaining, and improving security monitoring infrastructure across multiple client environments. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with at least one SIEM platform, a solid understanding of security technologies, and a willingness to learn new tools and approaches. We value engineers who take ownership of technical challenges, work independently, and collaborate with the team to deliver effective solutions for our clients. ### **Job Responsibilities:** * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SIEM platforms, including Elastic Security, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and other solutions depending on client environments. * Integrate log sources from Windows, Linux, network devices, cloud services, Microsoft 365, and EDR/XDR solutions. * Configure and maintain log collection through agents, connectors, APIs, and Syslog. * Troubleshoot log ingestion, parsing, indexing, and integration issues. * Develop and maintain parsers for different log sources. * Create, test, and optimize detection and correlation rules to improve threat detection and reduce false positives. * Configure SIEM indexes, retention policies, and manage log ingestion volumes. * Maintain integrations between SIEM/EDR/XDR solutions and the MAXI platform. * Support technical onboarding of new clients and ensure proper integration into SOC monitoring. * Monitor the health and performance of existing security solutions. * Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions. * Communicate directly with clients’ IT and security teams to understand technical requirements, discuss challenges, and provide solutions. * Prepare technical documentation, configuration guides, and troubleshooting instructions. * Collaborate with other engineers to improve existing processes, automate repetitive tasks, and support the scalability of MDR services. ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with at least one SIEM platform, preferably Elastic Security, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or a similar solution. * Practical experience with log collection, processing, analysis, or security integrations. * Understanding of Windows, Linux, networking fundamentals, and common network protocols. * Familiarity with Syslog, APIs, JSON, and log formats. * Experience writing SIEM queries and working with detection or correlation rules. * Understanding of EDR/XDR technologies and their role in security monitoring. *
