jobs.title: Applied Scientist
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** Upstart’s Machine Learning team applies machine learning and statistical methods to improve how we evaluate risk and make lending decisions. The team combines scientific research, experimentation, and engineering to develop models that support Upstart’s mission of expanding access to affordable credit. As an Applied Scientist at Upstart, you will develop and evaluate machine learning models that address meaningful business problems. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, and cross\-functional partners to translate complex data into modeling improvements and measurable outcomes. **How you’ll make an impact** * Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models to improve predictive performance and support lending decisions. * Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, develop features, and inform modeling approaches. * Design and execute experiments to assess model performance, validate hypotheses, and identify opportunities for improvement. * Collaborate with scientists and engineers to implement, monitor, and refine models in production environments. * Document methodologies, communicate findings, and contribute to reproducible scientific workflows. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–2 years of experience in machine learning, applied statistics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience developing or evaluating machine learning models using Python. * Experience applying statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, regression, or predictive modeling, to quantitative datasets. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree, ideally a PhD, in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field. * Knowledge of supervised learning techniques, model evaluation, and feature engineering. * Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn. * Experience working with large\-scale datasets using SQL or distributed data processing tools. * Ability to communicate modeling approaches and experimental results to technical and nontechnical audiences. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $141,500—$196,000 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.title: Operations Engineer
jobs.description: 15000 Valmont Plaza Omaha Nebraska 68154 ***Why Valmont*** **We’re Here to Move the World Forward.** Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better. Join a *Fortune* 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today . *We are the modern workforce* . Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now. **A Brief Summary of This Position:** ------------------------------------- The Operations Engineer provides hands\-on Tier 1 and Tier 2 support for Valmont employees in Omaha and participates in the Nerve Center's day\-to\-day operations. This individual contributor troubleshoots end\-user hardware, software, and connectivity; fulfills service requests; monitors and triages operational events; and coordinates timely escalation. The role combines responsive on\-site support with reliable Nerve Center processes, documentation, and handoffs. It is essential to embody Valmont’s core values of Passion, Integrity, Continuous Improvement, and Delivering Results while cultivating a workplace where employees feel valued, trusted, understood, and respected. **Essential Functions:** ------------------------ * This individual contributor works with the Nerve Center team and has no direct or indirect reports. * This position provides hands\-on support in Omaha. Work hours and coverage expectations will be confirmed before posting. * Any travel between Omaha, Valley, or other locations is subject to confirmation of the support scope. * Collaborate with Valmont staff and external partners to restore reliable technology services and support employees' day\-to\-day business needs. * Monitor assigned Nerve Center queues and alerts, perform initial diagnosis, resolve routine operational events, and coordinate timely escalation when specialist support is required. * Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 troubleshooting for desktops, laptops, operating systems, approved applications, printers, peripherals, mobile devices, and common network or remote\-access connections. * Develop and maintain accurate standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, equipment records, and knowledge articles for assigned support services. * Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve end\-user issues and improve the consistency and quality of local support. * Support major incident responses by gathering evidence, performing assigned checks, supporting communications, and documenting actions and outcomes. * Prepare, deploy, replace, and retire end\-user equipment using approved standards and asset\-management practices. * Identify recurring support issues and recommend practical improvements to reduce repeat incidents and improve service. * Provide first\-line conference\-room audio/video and collaboration support, coordinating with specialists for complex problems. * Ensure support activities comply with approved security controls, standards, procedures, and change\-management requirements. * Develop trusted relationships with employees and translate reported symptoms and service needs into actionable support requests. * Keep users informed of progress, next steps, and resolution or escalation status throughout the support process. * Use approved remote\-support, monitoring, endpoint\-management, and IT service\-management tools for assigned duties. * Maintain complete ticket and resolution records, including business impact, troubleshooting steps, actions, and outcomes. * Coordinate effectively across IT Shared Services and provide reliable handoffs between local support and global Nerve Center teams. * Own assigned tickets through resolution or documented handoff; escalate issues beyond the role's authority or capability. * Provide practical guidance to employees on approved devices, applications, collaboration tools, and common self\-service procedures. Complete all organization\-required training and pursue learning relevant to end\-user support and Nerve Center operations, while sharing useful troubleshooting knowledge and participating in Omaha office\-specific and Nerve Center process training. * **Required Qualifications of Every Candidate (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities):** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Preferred Bachelors Degree with 5\+ years relevant experience or Associates Degree with 7\+ years relevant experience or 9\+ years of relevant experience. * Continuously learn, apply, and share approved artificial intelligence (AI) tools responsibly to i ving skills, including the ability to gather evidence and recognize when to escalate. * Clear written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and next steps to nontechnical users. Ability to prioritize work, provide responsive customer service, and collaborate with local and distributed support teams. * **Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications:** ----------------------------------------------------------------------- * Highly effective customer\-service, written, and oral communication skills. * Self\-motivated, collaborative working style across desktop support, infrastructure, application, security, and service teams. * Experience with monitoring, alert triage, incident escalation, and Nerve Center or network operations workflows. * Experience applying ITIL practices, particularly incident, request, problem, change, and continual service improvement. * Record of improving support procedures, knowledge articles, equipment deployment, or other repeatable service activities. * Practical understanding of enterprise desktops, laptops, peripherals, business applications, and common network connectivity issues. * Experience with ticketing, endpoint\-management, remote\-support, conference\-room, reporting, and collaboration tools. * Relevant technical training or certifications in end\-user computing, service management, or related technologies. Experience working in a corporate or manufacturing environment with coordinated handoffs between local and global support teams. * **Working Environment and Physical Efforts:** --------------------------------------------- Work is typically performed in an office setting in Omaha. The role includes desk\-based troubleshooting, telephone and online support, in\-person conversations and meetings, and hands\-on setup and support of computer equipment. The successful candidate has experience developing data pipelines using cloud services, designing data structures that support data products and reporting systems, and applying DevOps/CI\-CD practices to keep those systems secure, observable, and repeatable to operate. In this hands\-on role, he/she will be responsible for collaborating with product owners, tackling technical problems, helping define best practices, and contributing in design/code reviews. In addition, the candidate will help create innovative solutions to satisfy the growing needs of internal and external customers. •Pipeline Development \- Design and develop data pipelines using cloud serverless/container services (e.g., managed functions, batch compute, container orchestration, and workflow/orchestration frameworks) in conjunction with cloud data warehousing platforms. •Data Table Design – Design, review, and build dimensional/Kimball style data models for data products and business intelligence reporting systems. •Platform Operations \& DevOps – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for data pipelines and infrastructure, following version\-controlled, repeatable release practices. •Access \& Governance Operations – Support access provisioning/lifecycle management, role\-based permissions, and audit/compliance controls across data platforms in line with security and governance standards. •Integration – Build and consume REST APIs and integrate with web services/gateways as part of pipeline or platform automation. •Collaboration – Work closely with product owners to understand and refine new feature requests. understand. •Best Practice \- Ensure standard practices are followed for logging, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and data security. •Data Security – Understand Verisk data security policies and controls and design and implement ways to comply with the policies. **About You and How You Can Excel in This Role** • BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. • 2\+ years of experience designing and developing cloud data pipelines (ETL/ELT solutions). • 2\+ years of Data Warehousing experience. • Proficient in writing SQL for aggregating and transforming data as part of a data pipeline. • Experience using Python for automating processes, working with APIs, and/or transforming data. • Working knowledge of dimensional/data modeling methods used to support business intelligence tools. • Experience building data pipelines using a variety of data sources (RDBMs, NoSQL, REST APIs, message queues, and files). • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse platform (e.g., Snowflake or equivalent). • Experience with cloud serverless/container technologies (e.g., functions\-as\-a\-service, managed batch compute, container orchestration) and workflow orchestration frameworks. • Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals and CI/CD practices (build/release pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated deployments). • jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer- Systems Engineering
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing…** Verizon continues to innovate in the 5G space, deploying products and services to enable Enterprise Customers and broad network initiatives to achieve incredible outcomes. Our Neutral Host, Private Wireless Networks, and In\-Building solutions are an integral part of Verizon’s 5G strategy. Recognized as the industry leader in this space, Verizon's Engineering Teams deliver these cutting\-edge solutions with the quality and robust features our Customers demand. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be responsible for providing nationwide technical leadership and support for Private Wireless Networks, Neutral Host Systems, In\-Building Systems, Macro, Small Cell, and Radio technologies. You will support regional and headquarter teams, working cross\-functionally with multiple internal groups, and Hardware vendors. You will be responsible for the testing, certification, and technical leadership of applications, hardware solutions, and services during planning, staging, first office application (FOA), commercial deployment, and continued maintenance to fulfill complex business requirements. You will be responsible but not limited to the following: * Providing technical leadership for the company regarding radio, in\-building system solutions, Neutral Host, and Private Wireless Networks. * Participating in and leading technical discussions with Vendors, Engineering, Planning, and Design teams to develop new network solutions and architectures. * Maintaining functional and technical requirements, analyze hardware/software features, and understand and troubleshoot system architectures, system operations, end\-to\-end designs, and device\-system interactions. * Managing internal groups and vendors to test and refine new hardware/software before approval for installation in the production environment. * Using your 4G and 5G RAN, Core, and Transport knowledge to identify, collect, and evaluate data relating to outages or system problems, analyzing failures to develop short and long\-term resolutions. * Physically and/or remotely managing a lab and/or an associated team of individuals responsible for installing, configuring, and executing prioritized testing. Act as a subject matter expert in lab execution and FOA/FSA processes to improve network performance and operability. * Providing technical leadership and guidance, communicating effectively between vendor teams (e.g., Ericsson, Nokia, Hardware vendors) and Verizon. Track progress, manage deliverables, and report cross\-functionally to ensure successful implementations and expedited solution delivery. * Overseeing vendor code and feature delivery processes, managing the lifecycle effectively, and participating in vendor evaluations. * Defining testing strategy, driving automation and AI to deliver greater test cycle efficiency. Lead call flow validation, latency, and resiliency testing. * Issuing and trackingNetwork Advisories / Network Directives, and providing production support, outage management, RCAs, break/fix, and expert escalation support to ensure minimum outage duration. * Providing administrative management of monitored products, including negotiating Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and General Purchasing Agreements. * Reviewing vendor performance regularly (including quarterly scorecards and business reviews) to ensure technical compliance and support contract renewals in partnership with Verizon Sourcing. Drive efforts to minimize the cost of new capital purchases and reduce existing vendor expense costs year over year. ### **What we’re looking for...** You take a lot of pride in your work and as a self\-starter, you enjoy learning new skills and taking on new tasks. You develop resolutions to complex problems that require frequent use of creativity, and your analysis of situations or data relies on an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors. You exercise strong judgment in selecting methods and techniques. While you work well independently, your team orientation and collaborative nature make you an obvious choice to work within cross\-functional teams. You balance competing priorities with ease in a fast\-paced environment and are a strong communicator who can effectively explain issues and resolutions to all levels of the organization. ### **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience in RAN / Radio Deployment and/or optimization experience from any vendor, with a understanding of 4G and 5G RAN technologies. * Knowledge of RF systems, In\-Building technologies, and DAS systems. * Experience in 4G and 5G Core element purposes \& troubleshooting, as well as LTE/5G signaling and user plane flow. * Experience architecting, engineering, and supporting Enterprise or Carrier\-grade Network equipment from key vendors such as Ericsson, Nokia, Cisco, etc. ### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Experience directly or indirectly managing small teams. * Understanding of end\-to\-end Network architecture, structured network design, and the OSI Interconnect Model. * Advanced experience with Packet Capture analysis products and tools. * Strong communication skills (oral and written), demonstrating mastered verbal communication of project details and written communication via technical documentation and presentations. * Demonstrated ability to work on several critical, high\-visibility projects simultaneously and independently. * Strong experience with Ericsson and/or Nokia RAN products, including operation, maintenance, and engineering of the eNodeB/gNodeB, radio, and RF systems. * Ability to troubleshoot issues using tools such as RTT, Irisview, 5GPT, SpiderNET, NCWS, Truecall, etc. * Experience with scripting/programming (Python, Java, C\+\+, Perl, Ansible, Heat, etc.). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $137,000\.00 \- $263,000\.00\.

jobs.title: (USA) Network Engineer II
jobs.description: **Position Summary...** ----------------------- **What you'll do...** --------------------- Join Walmart as a Network Engineer II supporting the Meeting Events \& Enterprise Technology Solutions (MEETS) team, where you will help design, stage, deploy, operate, and support temporary enterprise networks for Walmart and Sam’s Club events nationwide. You’ll work with wired and wireless infrastructure, venue connectivity, and high\-density Wi\-Fi while troubleshooting network issues in dynamic, high\-visibility environments. This role combines network engineering with hands\-on field deployment and requires regular travel, collaboration with internal teams and external partners, and support throughout the event lifecycle from planning and testing through live operations and recovery. **About the Team:** MEETS designs, engineers, deploys, and operates technology infrastructure supporting Walmart and Sam’s Club enterprise events, conferences, training sessions, and pop\-up retail experiences. The team delivers reliable wired and wireless networking, collaboration technologies, event infrastructure, broadcast connectivity, and point\-of\-sale technology for temporary retail environments. Operating as an engineering and field\-deployment organization, MEETS manages solutions from design and staging through onsite deployment, live\-event operations, and recovery. Apply cutting\-edge AI, deep learning, and large\-scale data science to solve complex real\-world challenges at global scale. **Role summary****:** We are looking for a passionate, creative full stack **Senior Data Scientist** to join Walmart's fraud detection team. You will have the unique opportunity to work with massive business and social data generated by Walmart Inc.'s unparalleled online and offline commerce. **About the Team****:** As a Senior Data Scientist on **Walmart's Fraud \& Risk team** **within the Data \& AI organization**, you will leverage machine learning, deep learning, anomaly detection, and large\-scale data to build and deploy predictive models that detect fraud, prevent abuse, and protect millions of customer interactions. Working closely with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders, you will develop scalable AI\-driven solutions that deliver measurable impact across one of the world's largest commerce ecosystems. **What you'll do****:** * **Design, build and implement predictive models** with high\-dimensional, **fast moving real time datasets**. * **Own fraud/abuse risks** in a product or segment of a product, be a strategic partner to product development teams, sharing insights and providing recommendations through effective communication and storytelling with data. * Use ML/AI, deep learning and data mining techniques to develop robust models for anomaly detection such as bot detection. * Build data visualizations and interactive dashboards for monitoring and sharing business insights internally and externally. * Unique opportunities in research and US patent filings to address new fraud issues, develop new tools or automate processes. **What you'll bring****:** * **Ph.D. in Computer Science**/**Data Science/Statistics**/**Machine Learning**, or a related quantitative field **with 2\+ years of industry experience**, **OR** a **Master's degree in a related quantitative discipline with 5\+ years of relevant machine learning experience.** * **Proficient in machine learning and data mining packages in Python**. * Experience working with large data sets and distributed computing tools (GCP/BigQuery experience preferred). * Programming skills in one of the following languages: Java, or JavaScript on a UNIX or Linux platform * **Production deployment experiences required.** * **GenAI/Agentic AI experiences preferred** **About Walmart Global Tech****:** Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. jobs.title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **DevOps \& Infrastructure Engineer — WePro** Houston, TX · On\-site · Full\-time **About WePro** WePro is AI\-first SaaS for the home service industry. We build the tools home service businesses use to run every part of their operation: CRM, dispatch management, call answering, marketing campaigns and billing. Every part is customizable, with AI and automations built into each step. In this industry, a missed call is a lost job and a slow dispatch is a lost customer. Our tools help our customers avoid both. Most software in this space treats AI as an add\-on. We built WePro AI\-first, and every part of the platform is customizable. We're bootstrapped and profitable, so we answer to our customers, not investors. We're a small team moving fast to change what home service software can be, and we're looking for a DevOps \& Infrastructure Engineer to help us do it. **Why this role** * **Work directly with the CTO.** Your ideas go straight to the person who decides, and decisions happen in days, not quarters. * **Own the infrastructure, not a slice of it.** You'll be responsible for reliability, performance, security and cost across both our current production platform (V1\) and the next\-generation cloud architecture we're building (V2\). * **Hard, interesting problems.** Real\-time voice infrastructure that has to stay up. Moving live monoliths onto Kubernetes without disrupting customers. Finding the slow query behind a latency spike before a customer notices it. * **AI\-assisted engineering.** We expect you to use AI tools to investigate, fix and document faster, and to help us find where they work best. **Who we're looking for** Someone who treats production like they own it. You'll be the first responder when something degrades: you gather the evidence, find the root cause, fix what you can and hand developers clear, specific tasks for what you can't. You don't wait to be told something is broken. You find infrastructure risks, billing anomalies and failing builds before they slow anyone down, and you write things down so the team never depends on one person to keep things running, including you. **What you'll ownObservability, monitoring and SLOs** * Design and maintain Datadog dashboards, APM tracing, Database Monitoring (DBM), Real User Monitoring (RUM) and synthetic monitors. * Define and track SLOs for latency, uptime (99\.99%\+) and error rates across critical services and integrations. * Expand log and metric ingestion across our application frameworks (CodeIgniter, PHP\-FPM, Node on Kubernetes) and capture structured exceptions. **Incident management and root cause analysis** * Act as the primary responder for system degradation, gathering telemetry before pulling in backend developers or database leads. * Lead investigations into outages, CPU and memory exhaustion, database lock contention and network bottlenecks. * Write post\-mortems and runbooks and publish them to the engineering repository. **Application performance and databases** * Audit slow endpoints through Datadog APM, spec the code or indexing fix, and track it through the deployment pipeline. * Analyze slow queries in MariaDB/MySQL, recommend and execute indexing changes, and remove blocking query patterns. * Move application session storage to distributed Redis clusters. **Cloud platform, CI/CD and migration** * Manage Kubernetes clusters with GitOps (ArgoCD) and enforce consistent configuration across environments. * Build, secure and maintain self\-hosted GitHub Actions runner pools, balancing build time, runner availability and cost. * Plan and execute the migration from EC2\-based monoliths to containerized Kubernetes (EKS and DOKS). * Maintain internal developer portals and build operations tooling that makes deployments and releases visible. **Telephony and third\-party integrations** * Operate our voice infrastructure on FreeSWITCH and OpenSIPS: high availability, SIP trunk connectivity, and WebRTC/SIP dialer routing. * Monitor third\-party webhooks (such as Twilio) for failure modes, SSL compliance and delivery errors. **Security and access control** * Administer zero\-trust network access (Tailscale) for SSH, database connections and internal tools. * Implement Kubernetes NetworkPolicies, secure cloud storage and CDN configuration (CloudFront, S3\), and manage edge caching. * Run centralized secrets management (Phase, OpenBao) across Kubernetes and standalone workloads, including key rotation. **Cost and infrastructure lifecycle** * Track spend across AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean and third\-party AI APIs, and put cost\-saving policies in place. * Decommission legacy environments safely with Terraform, with verified backups and snapshot retention before anything is torn down. **Daily operations reporting** * Publish an end\-of\-day operations summary covering 500 error rates, telephony and carrier errors, endpoint latency spikes and SLO compliance. * Spot operational bottlenecks and hand developers clear, actionable tasks to resolve backend and database performance issues. **Our stack** **Domain** **Tools** **What you'll do with them** Observability Datadog APM, RUM, DBM, synthetic monitors, latency dashboards Orchestration Kubernetes, ArgoCD GitOps deployment, NetworkPolicies, pod placement, ingress management CI/CD and code GitHub Actions, Git Runner pool maintenance, CI metrics, Copilot integration Public cloud AWS, DigitalOcean, GCP CloudFront and S3, EKS and DOKS, Auto Scaling groups, Droplets, Lambda Telephony FreeSWITCH, OpenSIPS HA voice nodes, SIP trunks, SIP routing, dialer testing Databases and caches MariaDB/MySQL, Redis, MongoDB Indexing, slow query analysis, session storage, build telemetry Security and secrets Tailscale, Phase, OpenBao Role\-based SSH, key rotation, secret injection Infrastructure as code Terraform Provisioning, environment teardown, state management **You might be a fit if** You have: * 4\+ years of hands\-on DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, including running production infrastructure on AWS (EKS, EC2, S3 and CloudFront). * Strong Kubernetes experience, including GitOps with ArgoCD, NetworkPolicies and ingress. * Infrastructure as code with Terraform, including safe teardown of environments. * Deep experience with Datadog or a comparable observability platform: APM, logs, dashboards and monitors. * A track record of leading incident response and writing post\-mortems that change how the team works. * Comfort with relational databases (MariaDB/MySQL): reading query plans, indexing and finding lock contention. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runners. * Working knowledge of network security, access control and secrets management in cloud environments. * Hands\-on use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day engineering work. * Strong written and spoken English; someone who wasn't there can follow your runbooks and post\-mortems. * An owner's mindset: you find risks before they become incidents, fix broken processes and bring your own ideas about how the platform should evolve. Bonus points: * FreeSWITCH, OpenSIPS, SIP trunking or WebRTC experience. * DigitalOcean (DOKS, Droplets) or GCP in production. * Redis and MongoDB in production. * PHP application stacks (CodeIgniter, PHP\-FPM). * Migrating legacy monoliths to containers. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Is this you?** This role isn't for you if you want a large platform team, a narrow lane, or an on\-call rotation someone else owns. It is for you if you'd rather find and fix the root cause yourself than file a ticket about it. We're a small team, so every hire matters, and we're picky. We'd rather take our time and find the right person. **Location** On\-site in Houston, TX, working side by side with the CTO. **How to apply** Send your resume and a short note about an incident you led or a piece of infrastructure you built: what the problem was, how you found the cause, and what you changed so it wouldn't happen again. Pay: $90,900\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Ability to Commute: * Houston, TX 77096 (Required) Work Location: In person

Ensure software meets requirements, adheres to standards, and is properly tested throughout the development lifecycle. Seek guidance on complex technical challenges and architectural decisions while participating in technical planning and estimation activities. Focus on developing technical expertise and leadership skills through mentorship from senior team members. * Cross\-functional Teams \- Begin representing the development team in cross\-functional meetings, collaborating with product team members to clarify requirements. jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** You'll join the AI Products team, where we build Workday's AI agents from the ground up. Our mission is to bring these agents to life inside real customer environments — testing them against real data, real workflows, and real use cases. We're early in the agent lifecycle, which means the work here is hands\-on, fast\-moving, and genuinely entrepreneurial: you'll often help write the playbook for how Workday deploys a new agent, rather than follow one that already exists. You'll work alongside our product and engineering teams as an extension of our internal product managers, playing a central role in agent Early Access (EA) programs and running the customer deployments inside them. Your mission is to make the product better by putting it to work in a live customer environment. A successful deployment is both a win for the customer and proof that the product is improving, so making early customers successful matters just as much as hardening the agent itself. You'll often be the first person at Workday to run a deployment of a given agent, so good judgment, clear communication, ownership, and organization will matter as much as technical curiosity. Every deployment will surface something the product wasn't built for yet, so creative problem\-solving and a "yes, and" mindset are core to this role: instead of telling a customer that something isn't possible, you'll find a way to solve their use case with what exists today, bring them along on what's coming next, and turn the gap into clear feedback for product and engineering. Access (EA) customers, maintaining clear communication and setting expectations * Execute EA deployments end\-to\-end: implement, configure, and troubleshoot solutions based on ongoing customer feedback * Analyze customer tenant data, configurations, and workflows to evaluate agent performance and behavior * Triage issues effectively, distinguishing between bugs, configuration errors, and product gaps, and escalate to appropriate engineering teams * Maintain clear status updates, tracking deployment risks, open technical issues, and next steps for internal and external stakeholders * Translate customer feedback and field findings into detailed problem statements and actionable bug reports for core engineering * Assist in evaluating pre\-GA stage gates and graduation metrics to ensure product readiness * Document deployment playbooks, repeatable configuration patterns, and troubleshooting guides to support scaling efforts * Collaborate closely with program managers and Workday Services leads throughout customer implementations * Support early General Availability (GA) releases until product graduation criteria are achieved **About You** ### **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in technical consulting, solutions engineering, implementation, technical product management, or customer support within enterprise software environments Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% to customer sites as needed * ### **Other Qualifications** * Proven ability to manage technical initiatives in fast\-paced or ambiguous environments with minimal direction * Experience managing customer technical relationships, setting expectations, and resolving technical challenges collaborativ , integrations, and how customers implement and govern Workday, so you can read a customer's tenant and understand how the agent will behave inside it * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. The application deadline for this role is the same as the posting end date stated as below: 01/11/2027 **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Native Quality & Safety,
jobs.description: At Workiva, we build and scale an enterprise platform that powers complex financial reporting, compliance, and collaboration for some of the world’s largest organizations. We solve for high\-throughput data, strict consistency, and architectural scale while exploring what AI can do to transform how engineering teams work. We are not simply adding AI to existing workflows. We are redesigning how engineering gets done. As agents take on more of the work, the human review steps that once caught problems are going away. AI failures often happen when nothing breaks: the model does exactly what it was asked, and the result is still wrong. That makes safety a control problem, not a prediction problem. We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer to lead quality and safety for AI\-native delivery. Our standard is quality through systems, not heroics, so the safe path is the easy path and higher velocity never means higher production risk. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can define strategy, propose original solutions, and raise the technical bar for the teams around them. **What You’ll Do** ================== **Deliver outcomes** -------------------- * Partner with engineering, platform, InfoSec, SRE, and Compliance teams to build layered safety controls, so systems stay safe even when multiple safeguards fail. * Build pre\-production verification, including evals, invariant tests, and risk\-based test selection under a non\-skippable invariant floor. Build automated safety valves into development and delivery, so safety does not depend on slow human review. * **Define and drive technical strategy** --------------------------------------- * Lead the “Ratify Continuously, Expose Deliberately” model: continuous shadow soak, ratified releases, and deliberate per\-tenant exposure. * Define the invariants our systems must never violate, and design controls that make those states unreachable. * Build Agentic Systems to remove CI bottlenecks by quarantining flaky tests and moving full suites to nightly runs. * Frame ambiguous safety problems and propose original approaches to solve them. * Increase agent autonomy only as verification improves. Risk based evaluation approval of PRs * **Design AI\-driven systems** ----------------------------- * Enforce integrity\-protected channels, where authorization comes only from signed sources and permission brokers, and all agent inputs and tool outputs are treated as data. * Ensure agents have zero authority over the guardrails that constrain them, such as CI gates, branch protection, and audit loggers. * Require privileged actuators to independently verify an agent’s claims about environment, approvals, and test status before acting. Test, monitor, and observe AI models in real environments, with containment and rollback when behavior is unsafe. * **Influence and lead** ---------------------- * Raise the technical bar by making quality the default rather than the result of heroics. * Mentor and challenge Staff\+ engineers to expand their scope, judgment, and impact. * Partner with engineering and product leadership to balance velocity with production risk. * Create durable artifacts such as runbooks, decision logs, and tests that can be handed off and evolved by others. Contribute across product domains, bringing context from one area to solve problems in another. * **What You’ll Need** ==================== **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * 8\+ years of experience building and scaling complex software systems. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; or 6\+ years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4\+ years of experience; or equivalent practical experience Demonstrated experience using AI as a primary development collaborator. * **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience designing safety\-critical, high\-assurance, or redundant systems. * Experience building CI/CD and test infrastructure that improves engineering velocity and quality at scale. * Experience designing evals for LLMs or AI agents. * Experience with observability and monitoring for production systems. * Experience with security controls such as least\-privilege access, signed provenance, and policy\-as\-code. * Experience with progressive delivery, including canary releases, traffic mirroring, and automated rollback. * Experience improving testing standards through approaches such as TDD, BDD, load, stress, chaos, invariant, or mutation testing. * Experience working in a highly regulated industry, such as financial services. * Proven success leading large, cross\-pillar technical initiatives. * Strong written communication skills and a habit of creating durable, useful artifacts. * A leadership style that empowers others rather than creating dependency. Partner with AppSec and InfoSec to prevent issues and respond effectively when they arise. This is a player\-coach role: set strategy while staying close to the technical work. **What You'll Do** * Define and execute a risk\-based DevSecOps roadmap; establish ownership, metrics, escalation paths, and a plan to grow the team. * Implement preventive AWS controls for identity, networking, encryption, secrets/key management, and cloud configuration; ensure security\-relevant activity is logged for monitoring, investigation, and audit. * Embed security into IaC, CI/CD, containers/orchestration, and software supply chains (SCA, secrets scanning, artifact integrity/signing, SBOMs where appropriate), including automated pipeline controls (SAST, IaC/container scanning, policy\-as\-code). * Partner with AppSec and InfoSec on security testing, policy, risk, audit evidence, and incident response. * Triage and prioritize vulnerabilities by exposure, exploitability, and business impact; coordinate remediation, track exceptions, and support investigation, containment, recovery, and post\-incident improvement. **What We're Looking For** Required qualifications * 10\+ years combined experience in software, platform/DevOps, and security engineering; 3\+ years as a technical lead. * Experience leading cross\-functional security or infrastructure initiatives and influencing engineering, DevOps/platform, AppSec, and InfoSec teams. * Hands\-on AWS security and IAM (least privilege, service identities, privileged access, encryption, networking/security boundaries); experience automating controls with scripting, IaC, CI/CD, and policy\-as\-code. * Experience securing delivery pipelines end to end (IaC, CI/CD, containers, dependencies/artifacts, secrets). * Experience prioritizing vulnerabilities by risk and establishing ownership, escalation, exception, and remediation workflows. * Experience in security incident investigation, containment, recovery, and post\-incident improvement; ability to communicate risk and tradeoffs to leadership. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Person Data
jobs.description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. You'll make things happen fast. You'll own the strategy for ZoomInfo's person data, which is hundreds of millions of contact records used by more than 35,000 customers. We're moving from rule\-based selection to AI agents that read the full evidence for each record, and you'll build the evaluation engine that decides whether their answers are good enough to publish. If you've shipped data pipelines and entity resolution at scale and use AI every day to improve data systems, you'll help define how we prove the new system is right. **What You'll Do** * Own Person Data end to end, setting the strategy, roadmap, and monthly priorities for the accuracy, coverage, freshness, and compliance of contact data. * Build and run the AI evaluation engine: define "correct" for each attribute, curate golden sets and trap records, stand up LLM\-as\-judge gates, and set confidence thresholds that route records to auto\-accept, auto\-reject, or human review. * Drive the pivot from rules to agents by moving person attributes from deterministic selection to inference over full evidence, proving each step in shadow mode, and retiring legacy logic when the numbers support it. * Introduce models where they earn their place and keep classical tooling where it wins, weighing cost per row, latency, determinism, and auditability. * Solve entity resolution challenges, including person\-to\-company matching, wrong\-company links, and duplicate people. * Own the person data privacy roadmap (suppression, opt\-out, and notification) in partnership with Legal and Privacy. * Prototype adjudication agents, evals, and analyses in code alongside the AI engineer and data science team, and commit to the shared repository. * Partner across Person Data engineering, Match, Research, Data Science, Privacy, and application teams, and present the roadmap and its rationale to product and data leadership. **What You Bring** *Must\-Have* * 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning data products or data platforms at scale * Hands\-on experience with data pipelines, ideally incremental or streaming rather than batch rebuilds, and a working understanding of how records move from ingestion to a served dataset * Direct experience with entity resolution, record linkage, or matching systems, including canonical IDs, match confidence, survivorship rules, and precision/recall trade\-offs * Current, demonstrated use of AI to improve data systems, including bringing an LLM into a production data process while keeping accuracy from degrading * Experience designing evaluations for model output, including golden sets, precision and recall, LLM\-as\-judge, human\-in\-the\-loop routing, and production drift monitoring *Preferred* * Experience with contact, person, or identity data, or with B2B company data * Familiarity with privacy regulation for published personal data (GDPR, CCPA, DNC, and international notification regimes) * Experience with Claude or comparable frontier models, agent frameworks, and eval harnesses * Background at an AI research lab or an AI\-native data company \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-JS1 **About us:** ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all\-in\-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go\-to\-market strategy with confidence. jobs.title: Principal GenAI Data Engineer

(Preferred) * Experience in current programming language and tools based on position (Preferred) * Experience with TypeScript, including building or maintaining production code (Preferred) * Hands\-on experience with AWS Lambda and other AWS services (Preferred) * Working knowledge of Agile development practices, such as sprints, backlog grooming, and standups (Preferred) * Hands\-on experience with AI\-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity. * Experience developing with AI tools, such as building AI\-enabled features or applications, not just using coding assistants (Preferred) * Highschool Diploma / GED (Required) * 4 years / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred) * A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered Company to Work For by U.S. News * Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024 * Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News * Our developers work in agile delivery teams to produce These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role. **What it means to be a Jamf?** We are a team of free\-thinkers, can\-doers, and problem\-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self\-improvement \- driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace. Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly. Above it all, waves our banner of \#OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free\-thinkers, can\-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day. jobs.title: Data & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. **The role** Every hour our operators work produces hours of synchronized video, robot state, and actions, and that data is a core product. You'll own the path from robot site to a searchable, trustworthy dataset that our researchers train on and our customers buy. You'll also run the infrastructure that keeps a growing, geographically spread fleet updated, monitored, and healthy. **What you'll do** * Own data storage and lifecycle: ingest from sites, object storage layout, retention, tiering, and cost. * Build the catalog: episode metadata, task labels, operator and robot info, quality flags, and search, so anyone can find "all successful pick\-and\-place episodes on arm model X last month." * Build automated quality checks: dropped frames, sync drift, missing streams, failed or truncated episodes. * Build dataset export and delivery: convert raw episodes into the formats training teams and customers expect, with versioning and provenance. * Handle data governance: access control, customer and site data agreements, privacy (faces, sensitive scenes on site), and audit trails for data we sell. * Run fleet infrastructure: provisioning edge machines at sites, remote software deploys and rollbacks, secrets, VPN/connectivity, monitoring, and alerting. * Keep cloud costs and bandwidth under control as data volume grows. * Build dashboards to monitor data collection status and progress **What we're looking for** * 3\-4 years as a data, platform, or infrastructure engineer owning production systems end to end. * Experience with large unstructured data (video, sensor logs, images) in object storage, not only tabular warehouses. * Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with infrastructure\-as\-code, containers, and CI/CD. * You've built pipelines with real failure handling: retries, idempotency, backfills, and monitoring. **Nice to have** * Experience with robotics or autonomous\-vehicle data, or ML training data pipelines. * Edge fleet management: deploying to many remote Linux devices on unreliable networks. * Experience packaging and delivering datasets to external customers. * Familiarity with data privacy rules across multiple countries. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered. Compensation Range: CA$140K \- CA$165K

Our mission at Ōura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Ōura is building an AI\-native detection and response program, where agents investigate and resolve routine alerts and people focus on the hard calls. You will be hands\-on in our environment, turning that plan into working solutions that protect our systems, data, and the members we serve. ### **What You Will Do:** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automations that investigate and triage alerts, write and tune detections as code, enrich incidents, and take approved response actions to automate routine security operations. * Run AI\-driven threat hunting, and turn gaps in visibility into new detection capabilities. * Conduct security incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review, coordinating with engineering, IT, our managed SOC partners, and leadership. * Conduct investigations and digital forensics across endpoint, cloud, identity, and SaaS environments. Ōura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co\-working locations. ### **What you'll bring:** * Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a primary focus on security operations, detection engineering and incident response. * Proven experience leading incident investigations and digital forensics. * Hands\-on experience writing and tuning detections in security detection solutions. * Hands\-on experience building or integrating end\-to\-end AI agents and LLM\-based solutions for security operations, such as alert triage, investigation, or automated response. * Scripting and automation skills in Python, and experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure as code. * You are organized, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under pressure, handling incidents alongside long\-term build work. * Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills with the ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into clear and concise language ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being.
